words.enDefinition: A stacked bar chart in which every bar totals 100 percent and its segments show proportional shares.

examples.en: The 100 percent stacked bar chart compares shares of fiction and nonfiction loans across branches.
examples.zh: 「百分比堆叠条形图」比较各分馆小说和非小说借阅所占比例。

examples.en: Every bar has the same total length in our 100 percent stacked bar chart.
examples.zh: 我们的「百分比堆叠条形图」中，每条的总长度都相同。

collocations: build a 100 percent stacked bar chart
read a 100 percent stacked bar chart
segments of a 100 percent stacked bar chart

words.enDefinition: An HTTP status indicating that the server successfully handled the request.

examples.en: The browser displays 200 OK after it retrieves the requested reading list in our demonstration.
examples.zh: 演示中，浏览器获取所请求的阅读书单后显示「200 请求成功」。

examples.en: In the worksheet, 200 OK is the expected response for an existing catalogue page.
examples.zh: 练习纸上，查询已存在的目录页面时，预期响应为「200 请求成功」。

words.enDefinition: An HTTP status indicating that a request succeeded and the response carries no content.

examples.en: The worksheet uses 204 No Content for a successful response that contains no message body.
examples.zh: 练习纸用「204 无内容」表示请求成功但响应没有消息体。

examples.en: We compared 204 No Content with a success response that included an updated reading list.
examples.zh: 我们把「204 无内容」与含有更新后阅读书单的成功响应作了比较。

words.enDefinition: The HTTP status telling a client that a conditional GET or HEAD can use its stored representation.

examples.en: The example server returns 304 Not Modified when the saved timetable is still the current version.
examples.zh: 已保存的时间表仍是当前版本时，示例服务器返回「304 未修改」。

examples.en: In our diagram, 304 Not Modified allows the browser to reuse the existing stylesheet.
examples.zh: 图中，「304 未修改」让浏览器得以复用已有样式表。

words.enDefinition: An HTTP status indicating that the server did not find a current representation of the requested resource or would not disclose it.

examples.en: The sample server returns 404 Not Found when the class requests a catalogue page that does not exist.
examples.zh: 全班请求一个不存在的目录页面时，示例服务器返回「404 未找到」。

examples.en: We recorded 404 Not Found beside the old catalogue path in the class worksheet.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂练习纸的旧目录路径旁记下了「404 未找到」。

words.enDefinition: A DNS record that maps a name to an IPv4 address.

examples.en: The A record for the example catalogue contains a single IPv4 address in the exercise.
examples.zh: 练习中，示例目录的「A 记录」包含一个 IPv4 地址。

examples.en: We put the A record in the IPv4 column and the AAAA record in the next column.
examples.zh: 我们把「A 记录」填进 IPv4 那一列，把 AAAA 记录填进后一列。

words.enDefinition: A route search prioritising travelled cost plus estimated remaining cost

examples.en: Our A* search used a grid distance estimate to guide its choices.
examples.zh: 我们的「A星搜索」用网格距离估计值来引导选择。

examples.en: We traced A* search on the classroom maze before comparing the paths.
examples.zh: 比较路径前，我们先在课堂迷宫里跟踪了「A星搜索」。

collocations: use A* search in a maze

words.enDefinition: A DNS record that maps a name to an IPv6 address.

examples.en: The AAAA record on the slide contains an IPv6 address written with two consecutive colons.
examples.zh: 幻灯片上的「AAAA 记录」含有一个用双冒号缩写的 IPv6 地址。

examples.en: We looked for the AAAA record when reading the sample answer to the IPv6 query.
examples.zh: 阅读 IPv6 查询的示例答案时，我们找的是「AAAA 记录」。

words.enDefinition: an import that identifies its target from an established starting namespace rather than the importing module's location

examples.en: The absolute import named the Python package and the module containing its date conversion routine.
examples.zh: 「绝对导入」写明了 Python 包的名字，也写明了日期转换例程所在的模块名。

examples.en: We used an absolute import so readers could recognise which package supplied the formatting routine.
examples.zh: 我们用「绝对导入」让读者能看出格式化例程来自哪个包。

words.enDefinition: A URL that includes its own scheme and can be understood without a base URL.

examples.en: The absolute URL on our worksheet identifies the example timetable regardless of the current page.
examples.zh: 无论当前显示的是哪一页，练习纸上的「绝对 URL」都能标识示例时间表。

examples.en: The tutor asked us to copy the absolute URL including the scheme shown at the start.
examples.zh: 老师让我们把「绝对 URL」抄下来，包括开头的协议名。

words.enDefinition: a class intended for inheritance rather than direct creation of instances

examples.en: The Java example used an abstract class to share drawing setup among several shapes.
examples.zh: Java 示例用「抽象类」让几种图形共享绘制前的准备。

examples.en: Our tutor declared an abstract class before adding a concrete rectangle to the sample.
examples.zh: 导师先声明了一个「抽象类」，再在样本中添加一个具体矩形类。

collocations: behaviour shared by an abstract class

words.enDefinition: a design supplying related objects through a shared creation interface

examples.en: The abstract factory pattern produced matching labels and buttons for each classroom theme in the example.
examples.zh: 示例用「抽象工厂模式」为每套课堂主题生成相互配套的标签和按钮。

examples.en: Our tutor switched themes by replacing the factory in the abstract factory pattern demonstration.
examples.zh: 导师在「抽象工厂模式」演示中更换工厂，以切换主题。

collocations: a family of objects in the abstract factory pattern

words.enDefinition: a method declared as requiring a concrete implementation

examples.en: The Java worksheet declared an abstract method for drawing each type of classroom shape.
examples.zh: Java 练习表声明了一个「抽象方法」，用于绘制各种课堂图形。

examples.en: Our tutor asked which subclass supplied an implementation of the abstract method in the example.
examples.zh: 导师问，示例中哪个子类为「抽象方法」提供了实现。

words.enDefinition: representing essential features while hiding details irrelevant to the caller

examples.en: The tutor introduced abstraction by describing what all the example shapes could draw and measure.
examples.zh: 导师描述示例图形都能绘制和测量哪些内容，以此介绍「抽象」。

examples.en: Our class used abstraction to give different storage implementations the same set of visible operations.
examples.zh: 同学们用「抽象」让不同存储实现提供同一组可见操作。

words.enDefinition: The HTTP request field that indicates which media types the client can accept in the response.

examples.en: The Accept header in the example lists the media types preferred by the classroom browser.
examples.zh: 示例里的「Accept 首部字段」列出课堂浏览器偏好的媒体类型。

examples.en: We compared the Accept header with the media type the catalogue server actually returned.
examples.zh: 我们把「Accept 首部字段」和目录服务器实际返回的媒体类型作了比较。

collocations: list media types in the Accept header

words.enDefinition: A test checking whether software meets agreed user or business requirements

examples.en: Our acceptance test checked the specified report layout against the assignment requirements.
examples.zh: 我们的「验收测试」按作业要求核对了指定报告的版式。

examples.en: The final acceptance test verified that the example task could be completed successfully.
examples.zh: 最后一项「验收测试」验证了示例任务能否成功完成。

words.enDefinition: a declaration keyword that controls where a member can be accessed

examples.en: The Java exercise changed an access modifier to let another package use the display method.
examples.zh: Java 练习修改了一个「访问修饰符」，让另一个包可以使用显示方法。

examples.en: Our tutor highlighted the access modifier before discussing which classes could call the sample method.
examples.zh: 导师高亮了「访问修饰符」，再讨论哪些类能调用样本方法。

words.enDefinition: A data table structured so readers can navigate and interpret the values using assistive technology.

examples.en: The accessible data table lists the rainfall values that are also shown in the chart.
examples.zh: 「无障碍数据表」列出图中也显示的降雨量数值。

examples.en: We tested whether the column headers in the accessible data table made sense when read aloud.
examples.zh: 我们试听了「无障碍数据表」中的列标题，确认读出时是否容易理解。

words.enDefinition: To obtain a lock so the caller may use the resource or section it protects.

examples.en: The preview worker had to acquire a lock before it could edit the shared drawing state.
examples.zh: 预览工作线程需要先「获取锁」，才能编辑共享的绘图状态。

examples.en: We asked which thread could acquire a lock while the other worker was already updating the list.
examples.zh: 我们问，另一条工作线程正在更新列表时，有哪条线程可以「获取锁」。

words.enDefinition: a value or expression supplied in a call to serve as input to a function

examples.en: The first actual argument was the number read from the form when the student submitted it.
examples.zh: 学生提交表单时读取的数字是第一个「实际参数」。

examples.en: We compared each actual argument with the corresponding parameter listed at the start of the definition.
examples.zh: 我们把每个「实际参数」与定义开头列出的相应参数作了比较。

collocations: match an actual argument to a parameter

words.enDefinition: a design that translates one object's interface into another expected interface

examples.en: The adapter pattern let our drawing tool call an older shape class through the new interface.
examples.zh: 「适配器模式」让绘图工具能通过新接口调用旧的图形类。

examples.en: Our tutor listed the translated operations while explaining the adapter pattern in the worksheet.
examples.zh: 导师解释练习表里的「适配器模式」时，列出了由适配器转换的操作。

collocations: an example of the adapter pattern

words.enDefinition: A sort that benefits when its input already has some order

examples.en: The adaptive sort made fewer comparisons once we nearly ordered the list.
examples.zh: 列表快排好时，「自适应排序」所做的比较更少。

examples.en: We tried an adaptive sort on dates already grouped into sorted runs.
examples.zh: 我们用「自适应排序」处理已经分成多个有序段的日期。

collocations: an adaptive sort on almost sorted data

words.enDefinition: The initial bits common to a block of IP addresses.

examples.en: Every address in this practice block starts with the same address prefix on the worksheet.
examples.zh: 练习纸上，该地址块中的每个地址都以相同的「地址前缀」开头。

examples.en: The router diagram shows which address prefix matches the destination on the sample packet.
examples.zh: 路由器示意图标出了和示例数据包目的地址相匹配的「地址前缀」。

words.enDefinition: Converting a virtual address used by a program into a corresponding physical address.

examples.en: The simulator paused during address translation so we could follow both numbers in the diagram.
examples.zh: 模拟器在「地址转换」期间暂停，以便我们跟踪图中的两个数字。

examples.en: We observed address translation when the example read the first value in its data page.
examples.zh: 例题读取数据页中的第一个值时，我们观察了「地址转换」。

words.enDefinition: A graph representation storing the neighbours of each individual vertex

examples.en: Our adjacency list listed the neighbouring stops beside each named location.
examples.zh: 我们的「邻接表」在每个地点旁列出了相邻站点。

examples.en: I used the adjacency list to find which vertices could be visited next.
examples.zh: 我用「邻接表」查找接下来可以访问哪些顶点。

words.enDefinition: A table indexed by vertices indicating which pairs share edges

examples.en: The adjacency matrix had a row and column for every room.
examples.zh: 「邻接矩阵」为每个房间都设了一行和一列。

examples.en: We compared two entries in the adjacency matrix for the undirected example.
examples.zh: 我们比较了无向图示例里「邻接矩阵」中的两项。

words.enDefinition: A vertex directly connected to a specified vertex by an edge

examples.en: The search checked an adjacent vertex before moving farther across the diagram.
examples.zh: 搜索先检查一个「相邻顶点」，再向图中更远处移动。

examples.en: I marked the adjacent vertex on the other end of the connection.
examples.zh: 我在连接的另一头标出了「相邻顶点」。

collocations: an edge to an adjacent vertex

words.enDefinition: A comparison of two clusterings based on pairs of observations, adjusted for agreement expected by chance.

examples.en: We calculated the adjusted Rand index to compare our two groupings of the same book descriptions.
examples.zh: 我们计算了「调整兰德指数」，以比较同一批图书描述的两种分组方式。

examples.en: Our tutor used the adjusted Rand index after matching the rows shared by both sets of assignments.
examples.zh: 老师先匹配两组分配结果共有的观测行，然后使用「调整兰德指数」。

collocations: compare cluster assignments using the adjusted Rand index

words.enDefinition: a heuristic estimate that never exceeds the minimum remaining cost to a goal

examples.en: The straight-line distance was an admissible heuristic for the walking-distance exercise.
examples.zh: 直线距离在步行距离练习中是一个「可采纳启发式估计」。

examples.en: We checked the estimate before treating it as an admissible heuristic.
examples.zh: 我们先核对估计值，再把它当成「可采纳启发式估计」。

collocations: prove an estimate is an admissible heuristic

words.enDefinition: To move an iterator to the next position it can visit in a traversal.

examples.en: Our tutor asked what happened when we chose to advance an iterator beyond the final element.
examples.zh: 老师问，尝试把「迭代器推进」到最后一个元素之后时会发生什么。

examples.en: We needed to advance an iterator to reach the next card in the classroom exercise.
examples.zh: 为了到达课堂练习中的下一张卡片，我们需要「推进迭代器」。

collocations: advance an iterator by one position
advance an iterator to the next item
check the end before you advance an iterator

words.enDefinition: Data combined into summaries for groups rather than shown as individual records.

examples.en: The published table contains aggregate data for each library branch across the whole teaching term.
examples.zh: 公布的表格包含教学学期内各图书馆分馆的「汇总数据」。

examples.en: We plotted aggregate data so each bar represents an entire reading group's total number of visits.
examples.zh: 我们绘制了「汇总数据」，每个条形表示一个阅读小组的到访总量。

words.enDefinition: a function that computes one result from a set of input rows, such as a sum or average

examples.en: The aggregate function calculated each week's total bookings from all the corresponding records in the activity table.
examples.zh: 「聚合函数」汇总活动表中相应的记录，算出每周预订总数。

examples.en: We chose an aggregate function that counted recorded scores and skipped any missing values in the gradebook.
examples.zh: 我们选择了一个「聚合函数」，统计已记录分数的条数，跳过缺失值。

collocations: compute a total with an aggregate function
check how an aggregate function handles nulls

words.enDefinition: Translation of program code into its target form before execution begins

examples.en: The worksheet used ahead-of-time compilation to illustrate code translated before starting the program.
examples.zh: 练习表通过「提前编译」说明程序启动前代码已被翻译的情形。

examples.en: We noted where ahead-of-time compilation belonged on the example program's execution timeline.
examples.zh: 我们记下了「提前编译」在示例程序执行时间线上的位置。

collocations: compare ahead-of-time compilation with runtime compilation

words.enDefinition: to arrange or match columns between tables using corresponding positions or labels

examples.en: We had to align columns before combining surveys that displayed the same questions in different orders.
examples.zh: 表单以不同顺序显示相同题目，我们先「对齐各列」再合并问卷。

examples.en: The tutor asked us to align columns by their labels before comparing values from separate sources.
examples.zh: 导师要求我们先按标签「对齐各列」，再比较不同来源的值。

collocations: align columns in two data frames

words.enDefinition: minimum-cost paths or distances computed for each pair of vertices for which a shortest path exists

examples.en: The exercise stored all-pairs shortest paths in a table indexed by the two endpoints.
examples.zh: 练习把「所有点对的最短路径」放在以两个端点为索引的表里。

examples.en: We calculated all-pairs shortest paths to compare routes from any stop on our map.
examples.zh: 我们计算了「所有点对的最短路径」，方便比较地图上从任意站点出发的路线。

collocations: a table of all-pairs shortest paths
solve an all-pairs shortest paths problem

words.enDefinition: an alternative entry point that creates an instance from a different input form

examples.en: The Python sample used an alternate constructor to build a reading record from one line of text.
examples.zh: Python 样本用「替代构造入口」从一行文本创建一份阅读记录。

examples.en: Our tutor compared the alternate constructor with calling the class directly using separate values.
examples.zh: 导师比较了使用「替代构造入口」和用各个值直接调用类这两种方式。

collocations: a class method as an alternate constructor

words.enDefinition: a candidate key that was not selected as the primary key

examples.en: In the exercise, the catalogue number became an alternate key after we chose an internal identifier as primary.
examples.zh: 练习中，我们选用内部标识符作主键后，目录编号成了「备选键」。

examples.en: We used an alternate key to find a product by its stable manufacturer code during the demonstration.
examples.zh: 演示时，我们用「备选键」按产品固定的厂商编码查找产品。

collocations: look up a row by an alternate key

words.enDefinition: a proposed match with more than one plausible candidate, or insufficient evidence to choose confidently

examples.en: The ambiguous match involved two venues with identical names but different addresses in the practice inventory.
examples.zh: 这条「无法唯一确定的匹配」涉及练习清单里两处同名但不同地址的场地。

examples.en: We marked an ambiguous match for manual review rather than linking either candidate automatically.
examples.zh: 我们标记一条「无法唯一确定的匹配」供人工复查，避免自动链接任何一个候选。

words.enDefinition: Replace the latest commit with revised content or a revised message

examples.en: I needed to amend a commit because I had missed the example's updated heading.
examples.zh: 我漏了示例里更新的标题，所以需要「修改已有提交」。

examples.en: We practised how to amend a commit using a private classroom branch.
examples.zh: 我们用一个课堂个人分支练习了如何「修改已有提交」。

words.enDefinition: A file or other saved output produced by running an analysis, such as a table or chart.

examples.en: Each analysis artefact is saved with a name that describes its content and reporting period.
examples.zh: 每份「分析产物」保存时的名称都会说明其内容和报告时段。

examples.en: The final chart is an analysis artefact generated directly by the same classroom script.
examples.zh: 最终图表是由同一个课堂脚本直接生成的「分析产物」。

words.enDefinition: A configurable value that controls how an analysis is run or which inputs it uses.

examples.en: We recorded the date range as an analysis parameter so classmates could regenerate the figure.
examples.zh: 我们把日期范围记录为一项「分析参数」，方便同学重新生成图表。

examples.en: Changing one analysis parameter lets the workshop example calculate weekly totals for a different month.
examples.zh: 改动一个「分析参数」就能让工作坊示例计算另一个月份的每周总量。

words.enDefinition: data prepared in a form that meets the requirements of a specific analysis

examples.en: We saved an analysis-ready dataset after documenting why a few rows remained outside the final study sample.
examples.zh: 我们说明了少数几行没有纳入最终研究样本的原因，再保存一份「可直接分析的数据集」。

examples.en: The tutor asked whether the analysis-ready dataset still contained the field needed for comparisons across the two terms.
examples.zh: 导师问，「可直接分析的数据集」中是否仍有比较两个学期所需的字段。

words.enDefinition: Code saved in a file that carries out one or more steps of an analysis.

examples.en: The analysis script reads the public garden records and calculates the rainfall totals by week.
examples.zh: 「分析脚本」读取公开的花园记录，并计算每周降雨总量。

examples.en: We added a comment in the analysis script explaining the unit used for each measurement.
examples.zh: 我们在「分析脚本」里加了一条注释，说明各项测量所用的单位。

words.enDefinition: A node above a given node on its path toward the root

examples.en: The ancestor node was two levels above the selected leaf in our diagram.
examples.zh: 图里，「祖先节点」比我们选择的叶节点高两层。

examples.en: We followed the parent links until we reached the specified ancestor node.
examples.zh: 我们沿着父节点的链接往上走，直到到达指定「祖先节点」。

collocations: move up to an ancestor node

words.enDefinition: a Git tag stored as its own object with metadata such as the tagger, date and message

examples.en: The annotated tag included a short note about the classroom example.
examples.zh: 「附注标签」包含一段关于课堂示例的简短说明。

examples.en: I opened the annotated tag to see the message recorded with it.
examples.zh: 我打开「附注标签」，查看随标签记录的消息。

collocations: a message on an annotated tag

words.enDefinition: a function created without giving it an explicit name in its definition

examples.en: An anonymous function converted each label to lowercase before the programme compared it with the search term.
examples.zh: 「匿名函数」将各标签转成小写，程序再将其与搜索词比较。

examples.en: We used an anonymous function because the comparison was short and called from only one place.
examples.zh: 比较逻辑很短，而且只有一处调用，所以我们用「匿名函数」。

collocations: use an anonymous function as a callback

words.enDefinition: A virtual memory mapping with no ordinary file as its backing object.

examples.en: The demo used an anonymous mapping for temporary pixels that did not belong to any file.
examples.zh: 演示用「匿名内存映射」来存放不属于任何文件的临时像素数据。

examples.en: We compared an anonymous mapping with a region backed by the sample image file.
examples.zh: 我们比较了「匿名内存映射」和以示例图像文件为后备存储的区域。

collocations: use an anonymous mapping for temporary data

words.enDefinition: an operation returning rows of one input for which no matching row exists in the other input

examples.en: The anti-join found all workshop dates that did not have any corresponding reservation in the practice table.
examples.zh: 「反联接」找到了练习表中没有任何对应预订记录的工作坊日期。

examples.en: We used an anti-join to identify catalogue entries that had never appeared in the sample borrowing records.
examples.zh: 我们用「反联接」找出未在示例借阅记录中出现过的目录条目。

collocations: express an anti-join with NOT EXISTS
find unmatched rows with an anti-join

words.enDefinition: To add an item after all the items already in a collection.

examples.en: We chose to append an element whenever the lab recorded another measurement during the experiment.
examples.zh: 实验中每记录一个新的测量值，我们就「在末尾追加元素」。

examples.en: Our program could append an element once the player entered another colour for the palette.
examples.zh: 玩家为调色板输入另一种颜色后，程序就能「在末尾追加元素」。

collocations: append an element to a list
append an element at the end
append an element when space remains

words.enDefinition: A file opening mode that writes new data after existing contents

examples.en: We used append mode to put a new temperature below the earlier readings.
examples.zh: 我们用「追加模式」把一条新温度记录写到已有读数下方。

examples.en: The example opened the log in append mode before adding one more line.
examples.zh: 示例以「追加模式」打开日志，再加一行。

collocations: write to a file in append mode

words.enDefinition: The layer whose protocols define the messages exchanged by applications and network services.

examples.en: The application layer defines how the browser asks the library service for a page.
examples.zh: 「应用层」规定浏览器如何向图书馆服务请求页面。

examples.en: We placed the application layer at the top of the diagram beside the HTTP example.
examples.zh: 我们把「应用层」放在图的顶部，就在 HTTP 示例旁边。

words.enDefinition: agreement within a specified numerical tolerance

examples.en: The class used approximate equality to compare two computed lengths that differed slightly after rounding.
examples.zh: 同学们使用「近似相等」来比较两个舍入后略有差异的计算长度。

examples.en: Our tutor asked us to state a tolerance before checking approximate equality in the worksheet.
examples.zh: 导师让我们先确定容差，再在练习表里检查是否「近似相等」。

words.enDefinition: an integer whose bit count can grow as needed

examples.en: The Python demonstration used an arbitrary-precision integer to store the product of two large numbers.
examples.zh: Python 演示用「任意精度整数」存储两个大数的乘积。

examples.en: Our tutor explained why an arbitrary-precision integer might need more memory as its value grows.
examples.zh: 导师解释了为什么「任意精度整数」的数值越大，可能需要的内存越多。

words.enDefinition: A chart that fills the space between a line and a reference level to emphasize magnitude.

examples.en: The area chart fills the space below the line showing weekly rainfall in the sample garden.
examples.zh: 「面积图」填充了示例花园每周降雨量曲线下方的区域。

examples.en: We compared an area chart with a line chart built from the same classroom temperature records.
examples.zh: 我们比较了同一组课堂温度记录生成的「面积图」和折线图。

words.enDefinition: associating the arguments supplied in a call with the appropriate parameters of the function

examples.en: The tutor illustrated argument binding by showing which parameter received each of the three values in our call.
examples.zh: 导师展示调用中的三个值分别传给哪个形参，以讲解「实参与形参绑定」。

examples.en: An argument binding error occurred because the same parameter received both a positional value and a keyword value.
examples.zh: 同一形参既收到了位置值又收到了关键字值，导致「实参与形参绑定」出错。

words.enDefinition: expanding values in a collection into separate arguments for a function call

examples.en: The Python script used argument unpacking to pass each coordinate to the appropriate parameter of the drawing routine.
examples.zh: Python 脚本用「实参解包」将每个坐标传给绘图例程的对应形参。

examples.en: We tested argument unpacking with a dictionary whose keys matched the parameter names used in the example.
examples.zh: 我们用一个键名与示例形参名一致的字典测试「实参解包」。

collocations: apply argument unpacking at a call
combine argument unpacking with explicit arguments

words.enDefinition: An ordered collection of command arguments available to a running program

examples.en: I inspected the argument vector to see whether the name contained a space.
examples.zh: 我查看了「命令行参数序列」，确认文件名中是否含空格。

examples.en: The sample program printed the argument vector as a list of separate values.
examples.zh: 示例程序把「命令行参数序列」打印成一项项分开的值。

collocations: an entry in the argument vector
read values from the argument vector

words.enDefinition: moving bits down while extending the sign into the vacated positions

examples.en: The fixed-width example used an arithmetic right shift and filled the new top positions with ones.
examples.zh: 固定宽度示例采用「算术右移」，用一填充新腾出的高位。

examples.en: Our tutor used an arithmetic right shift to show that the negative result kept its sign.
examples.zh: 导师用「算术右移」演示负数结果保持原来的符号。

collocations: the result of an arithmetic right shift
an arithmetic right shift by two

words.enDefinition: A test structure separating preparation, the tested action, and result checks

examples.en: The tutor used the Arrange-Act-Assert pattern to separate the three parts of a check.
examples.zh: 导师用「准备执行断言模式」把一项检查分成三个部分。

examples.en: I rewrote the example using the Arrange-Act-Assert pattern so each stage was visible.
examples.zh: 我用「准备执行断言模式」重写示例，让各阶段一目了然。

collocations: write a test using the Arrange-Act-Assert pattern

words.enDefinition: the number of elements an array-backed collection can hold in the storage currently allocated

examples.en: The diagram showed an array capacity of eight even though only three spaces contained elements.
examples.zh: 图示的「数组容量」是八，虽然只有三个位置存有元素。

examples.en: We kept the same array capacity after removing the last entry from the practice collection.
examples.zh: 从练习集合中移除最后一项后，我们保持原有的「数组容量」。

words.enDefinition: A value stored at one of an array's indexed positions.

examples.en: The instructor traced how the first array element changed when the recorded reading was corrected.
examples.zh: 老师逐步说明读数更正后，第一个「数组元素」怎样变化。

examples.en: We inspected each array element to find the missing colour in the classroom example.
examples.zh: 我们逐一检查「数组元素」，寻找课堂例子中缺失的一种颜色。

words.enDefinition: The number used to identify an element's position in an array.

examples.en: We used the array index to select one photograph from the small set shown in class.
examples.zh: 我们用「数组索引」从课堂展示的那小组照片中选出一张。

examples.en: Our tutor wrote the array index above each value so everyone could follow the example.
examples.zh: 老师在每个值上方写出「数组索引」，方便大家看懂示例。

collocations: use an array index to select a value

words.enDefinition: the number of array positions as defined by the array's indexing rules, including empty positions where the language allows them

examples.en: We printed the array length before checking how many samples the exercise had stored.
examples.zh: 我们先输出「数组长度」，再核对练习中存了多少个样本。

examples.en: The last index in the Java example was one less than the array length.
examples.zh: 在 Java 示例中，最后一个索引比「数组长度」小一。

collocations: compare two values with the array length

words.enDefinition: source notation that creates an array from the specified element expressions

examples.en: We wrote a JavaScript array literal containing three colours for the first drawing exercise.
examples.zh: 我们写了一个包含三种颜色的 JavaScript「数组字面量」，供第一次绘图练习使用。

examples.en: The sample used an empty array literal before the program started collecting new entries.
examples.zh: 示例先用了一个空的「数组字面量」，程序随后才开始收集新条目。

collocations: use an array literal for test data

words.enDefinition: A selected portion of an array described by a range of indexes.

examples.en: We used an array slice to inspect the middle three readings without printing the whole collection.
examples.zh: 我们用「数组切片」查看中间三个读数，省去了输出整个集合。

examples.en: Our tutor asked which positions an array slice included when the starting index was two.
examples.zh: 老师问，起始索引为二时，一个「数组切片」包含哪些位置。

collocations: create an array slice from a range

words.enDefinition: a JavaScript function expression written with an arrow token, with lexical binding for this

examples.en: We used an arrow function to convert the list of hours into a new list of minutes.
examples.zh: 我们用「箭头函数」把以小时计的时长列表换算成新的分钟列表。

examples.en: The tutor showed why the arrow function used the surrounding value of this in the given example.
examples.zh: 导师说明了给定示例里的「箭头函数」为什么使用外层的 this 值。

collocations: pass an arrow function as a callback
write an arrow function with an expression body

words.enDefinition: The time a saved workflow output remains available to retrieve

examples.en: The artifact retention period covered both days of our classroom build exercise.
examples.zh: 「产物保留期限」覆盖了课堂构建练习的两天。

examples.en: We checked the artifact retention period before opening the older test report.
examples.zh: 打开较早的测试报告之前，我们先查了「产物保留期限」。

words.enDefinition: matching records to nearby rather than necessarily equal keys in ordered input, usually under a direction or tolerance rule

examples.en: The as-of join matched each observation to the most recent calibration reading taken before it.
examples.zh: 「按邻近键联接」为各观测值匹配在它之前最近取得的一条校准读数。

examples.en: We set a maximum time difference for the as-of join to avoid linking unrelated test sessions.
examples.zh: 我们给「按邻近键联接」设置最大时间差，避免把无关的测试活动连在一起。

collocations: set a tolerance for an as-of join
match earlier records with an as-of join

words.zhGloss: 美国信息交换标准代码
words.enDefinition: a seven-bit character code covering basic Latin text and control characters
acceptedZhAnswers: 美国信息交换标准代码
acceptedEnVariants: American Standard Code for Information Interchange

examples.en: The worksheet found the ASCII code for the capital letter in our sample label.
examples.zh: 练习表找出了样本标签中那个大写字母的「美国信息交换标准代码」。

examples.en: Our tutor checked which characters of the greeting could be represented in ASCII.
examples.zh: 导师检查了问候语中的哪些字符可以用「美国信息交换标准代码」表示。

words.enDefinition: a statement that checks a condition and signals a failed assertion when checks are enabled and the condition fails

examples.en: The assert statement checked that the list still contained the expected number of values after sorting.
examples.zh: 「assert 断言语句」检查排序后列表是否仍包含预期数量的值。

examples.en: We used an assert statement to document a condition that should hold after the helper returned.
examples.zh: 我们用「assert 断言语句」写明辅助函数返回后应当成立的条件。

collocations: check an invariant with an assert statement
disable execution of an assert statement

words.enDefinition: an event indicating that a condition checked by an assertion was not satisfied

examples.en: The assertion failure showed that the sorting exercise had removed an element when two names matched.
examples.zh: 「断言失败」表明排序练习在遇到两个相同的名字时删掉了一个元素。

examples.en: We reproduced the assertion failure with three rows so we could inspect each result in the notebook.
examples.zh: 我们用三行数据重现「断言失败」，这样就能在笔记本中逐一检查结果。

words.enDefinition: Explanatory text supplied for use when an assertion does not hold

examples.en: The assertion message identified the missing column in the generated table.
examples.zh: 「断言提示信息」指出生成的表格缺了哪一列。

examples.en: I updated the assertion message to include the name of the example file.
examples.zh: 我更新了「断言提示信息」，让它包含示例文件名。

words.enDefinition: syntax indicating that a value is being assigned to a target

examples.en: The JavaScript worksheet highlighted the assignment operator between the counter and its new value.
examples.zh: JavaScript 练习表高亮了计数器和新值之间的「赋值运算符」。

examples.en: Our tutor used a different colour for the assignment operator and the strict equality operator.
examples.zh: 导师用两种不同颜色标记「赋值运算符」和严格相等运算符。

collocations: the left side of an assignment operator

words.enDefinition: a statement that stores a value or binds it to a target

examples.en: The assignment statement stored the new score in the variable before the program displayed it.
examples.zh: 这条「赋值语句」先将新分数保存到变量里，程序随后才显示分数。

examples.en: I moved the assignment statement above the line that used the result in our Python script.
examples.zh: 我把 Python 脚本里的「赋值语句」移到使用结果的那一行上面。

collocations: the target of an assignment statement

words.enDefinition: A collection in which keys identify stored values instead of requiring sequential numeric positions.

examples.en: The example used an associative array to look up a colour's code by its name.
examples.zh: 例题用「关联数组」按颜色名称查找颜色代码。

examples.en: We stored each book title under its catalogue number in an associative array for the exercise.
examples.zh: 练习中，我们用「关联数组」，以各书的目录编号存放书名。

collocations: look up values in an associative array
store counts in an associative array

words.enDefinition: Studying resource use as input grows while ignoring lower-order effects

examples.en: We used asymptotic analysis to compare how two methods scaled with larger inputs.
examples.zh: 我们用「渐近分析」比较两个方法处理更大输入时资源开销的增长情况。

examples.en: Our tutor introduced asymptotic analysis before comparing the plotted growth curves in class.
examples.zh: 导师先介绍「渐近分析」，再在课上比较画出的增长曲线。

words.enDefinition: Input or output submitted with completion reported separately so other work can proceed in the meantime.

examples.en: The sample viewer used asynchronous I/O so it could keep drawing while a file read was pending.
examples.zh: 示例查看器用「异步 I/O」，这样读取文件期间仍能继续绘制。

examples.en: Our tutor drew an asynchronous I/O timeline with separate points for submission and completion.
examples.zh: 老师画了一条「异步 I/O」时间线，分别标出提交和完成时刻。

collocations: use asynchronous I/O for file reads

words.enDefinition: While a program is actually being executed

examples.en: The program learned the filename at run time from what I typed.
examples.zh: 程序「在运行时」从我的输入中得知文件名。

examples.en: The diagram showed what happens at run time when the program reads input.
examples.zh: 这张图展示了程序「在运行时」读取输入会发生什么。

collocations: check a value at run time

words.enDefinition: A commit containing one coherent change that can be understood independently

examples.en: I made an atomic commit containing the heading change and its matching test.
examples.zh: 我做了一个「单一目的提交」，含标题改动和对应测试。

examples.en: Our tutor preferred an atomic commit for the classroom's formatting correction.
examples.zh: 导师希望用一个「单一目的提交」单独记录课堂上的格式修正。

words.enDefinition: A counter supporting indivisible operations such as incrementing or reading its value.

examples.en: The example kept an atomic counter for the number of sample pictures processed by its workers.
examples.zh: 例题用「原子计数器」统计工作线程已处理的示例图片数。

examples.en: We compared the atomic counter with the number of completed jobs recorded in the worksheet.
examples.zh: 我们把「原子计数器」的值与练习表上记录的已完成作业数作了比较。

collocations: track completed work with an atomic counter

words.enDefinition: An operation whose effect is indivisible as observed by concurrent participants.

examples.en: The simulator treated each counter increment as an atomic operation in the completed practice example.
examples.zh: 在已完成的练习例题里，模拟器把计数器的每次递增视为「原子操作」。

examples.en: The tutor used an atomic operation to illustrate why other workers saw only the completed change.
examples.zh: 老师用一次「原子操作」说明为什么其他工作线程只能看到完成后的改动。

collocations: use an atomic operation to update a counter
observe the result of an atomic operation

words.enDefinition: the process of finding an attribute requested by name

examples.en: The Python worksheet traced attribute lookup to show how an ordinary class attribute was found.
examples.zh: Python 练习表追踪了「属性查找」，展示如何找到普通类属性。

examples.en: Our tutor asked what attribute lookup returned after a new value was assigned to the instance.
examples.zh: 给实例赋新值后，导师问「属性查找」会返回什么。

words.enDefinition: a nearer attribute taking precedence over another with the same name

examples.en: The Python example illustrated attribute shadowing when an instance stored its own plain category attribute.
examples.zh: Python 示例通过给实例存入自己的普通类别属性，演示了「属性遮蔽」。

examples.en: Our tutor checked which label was returned after attribute shadowing occurred in the exercise.
examples.zh: 练习出现「属性遮蔽」后，导师核实了实际返回哪个标签。

words.enDefinition: A condition requiring users of a resource to credit its creator or source.

examples.en: The attribution requirement says to name the organisation that published the sample rainfall data.
examples.zh: 「署名要求」规定，应注明发布示例降雨数据的机构名称。

examples.en: The class fulfilled the attribution requirement by adding the source and creator below the chart.
examples.zh: 全班在图下补充了来源和创作者，满足了「署名要求」。

words.enDefinition: assignment that combines an operation with updating its target

examples.en: The Python demonstration used augmented assignment to add two points to the player's running score.
examples.zh: Python 演示用「增强赋值」给玩家的当前累计分数加两分。

examples.en: Our tutor compared augmented assignment using addition with the longer statement that reads and updates the total.
examples.zh: 导师比较了使用加法的「增强赋值」和先读总数再更新的较长语句。

collocations: the target of an augmented assignment

words.enDefinition: A DNS server that serves the official records for a particular zone.

examples.en: The authoritative name server holds the published records for the example zone in our diagram.
examples.zh: 图中的「权威域名服务器」保存着示例域区已发布的记录。

examples.en: We identified the authoritative name server for each zone by reading the labels on the whiteboard.
examples.zh: 我们根据白板上的标签找出了每个域区的「权威域名服务器」。

collocations: authoritative name server for a zone

words.enDefinition: A software check executed by code or a testing tool

examples.en: The automated test compared the calculated total with the value in our worksheet.
examples.zh: 「自动化测试」把计算出的合计值与练习表里的值作了对照。

examples.en: I added an automated test for the room selector before class ended.
examples.zh: 下课前，我给房间选择器加了一个「自动化测试」。

collocations: an automated test for a calculation

words.enDefinition: Extra working storage an algorithm uses beyond its given input

examples.en: The example counted a temporary array as auxiliary space in the exercise.
examples.zh: 示例把一个临时数组计入练习的「辅助空间」。

examples.en: We compared auxiliary space before choosing a sort for the memory exercise.
examples.zh: 我们先比较「辅助空间」，再为内存练习选择排序算法。

words.enDefinition: Expected running cost under a stated distribution of possible inputs

examples.en: We stated a distribution before calculating average-case running time for the search.
examples.zh: 计算搜索算法的「平均情况运行时间」前，我们先说明了输入分布。

examples.en: The example gave each possible position equal weight when estimating average-case running time.
examples.zh: 示例估算「平均情况运行时间」时，给每个可能的位置相同的权重。

collocations: an assumption about average-case running time

words.enDefinition: A weighted sum of precision values across thresholds, with weights given by successive increases in recall.

examples.en: We compared average precision for the two classifiers that ranked books by their likelihood of being poetry.
examples.zh: 我们比较了两个分类器的「平均精确率」，它们都按属于诗歌的可能性给图书排序。

examples.en: The tutor explained how changes in recall affect the weighting used to calculate average precision.
examples.zh: 老师解释了召回率的变化怎样影响计算「平均精确率」时的权重。

words.enDefinition: a binary search tree whose left and right subtree heights differ by at most one at each node

examples.en: Our AVL tree needed a rotation after we inserted the largest key.
examples.zh: 我们插入最大键后，这棵「AVL 平衡二叉树」需要旋转一次。

examples.en: The tutor used an AVL tree to illustrate a precise balance rule.
examples.zh: 导师用一棵「AVL 平衡二叉树」来说明一条明确的平衡规则。

words.enDefinition: Text identifying the variable or unit represented along an axis.

examples.en: The axis label states that rainfall is measured in millimetres on the garden chart.
examples.zh: 花园图上的「轴标签」说明降雨量以毫米为单位。

examples.en: I changed the axis label after noticing that the plot shows hours rather than minutes.
examples.zh: 我发现图里按小时计量，于是修改了「轴标签」。

words.enDefinition: The interval of values from the lower limit to the upper limit of an axis.

examples.en: The axis range runs from zero to fifty in both charts of weekly library visits.
examples.zh: 两张图书馆每周客流图的「轴范围」都是零到五十。

examples.en: We kept the axis range the same so that both panels could be compared directly.
examples.zh: 我们让「轴范围」保持一致，以便直接比较两幅子图。

words.enDefinition: in depth-first search, an edge from a node to an ancestor in the depth-first tree, including a self-loop where applicable

examples.en: The back edge pointed back to a vertex on our current path.
examples.zh: 「回边」指回我们当前路径上的一个顶点。

examples.en: Our tutor drew a back edge while discussing cycle detection in directed graphs.
examples.zh: 导师讲有向图的环检测时，画了一条「回边」。

collocations: a cycle indicated by a back edge

words.enDefinition: A process running without taking over the user's current foreground interaction.

examples.en: The example image converter ran as a background process while we continued working in the editor.
examples.zh: 示例图像转换器作为「后台进程」运行，我们则继续在编辑器里工作。

examples.en: Our tutor checked whether the background process had finished before opening the converted images.
examples.zh: 老师先查「后台进程」是否完成，再打开转换后的图片。

words.enDefinition: An internal array that stores the elements of another collection, such as a resizable list.

examples.en: The list used a backing array to store the colours while exposing methods for editing them.
examples.zh: 这个列表用「底层数组」存放颜色，同时对外提供编辑这些颜色的方法。

examples.en: We drew a larger backing array when the next addition no longer fit in the old storage.
examples.zh: 下一项放不进原存储空间时，我们画了一个更大的「底层数组」。

collocations: copy elements to a new backing array

words.enDefinition: The ability of a newer version to support earlier users or formats

examples.en: The example kept backward compatibility by accepting both versions of the report file.
examples.zh: 示例同时接受两个版本的报告文件，从而保持「向后兼容性」。

examples.en: Our tests checked backward compatibility with notes saved during the previous lesson.
examples.zh: 我们的测试核查了能否「向后兼容」上一课保存的笔记。

collocations: ensure backward compatibility with saved files

words.enDefinition: filling missing positions with the next available value later in an ordered sequence

examples.en: The example used backward fill to copy the next recorded label into an empty preceding position.
examples.zh: 示例使用「后向填充」把后续第一个已记录标签复制到它之前的空位置。

examples.en: We avoided backward fill in our forecasting exercise because future observations were unavailable at prediction time.
examples.zh: 我们在预测练习中避免了「后向填充」，因为预测时还拿不到未来观测结果。

collocations: limit the length of a backward fill
compare backward fill with forward fill

words.enDefinition: Visiting the elements of a structure in the reverse of its usual order.

examples.en: Backward traversal let the classroom playlist display its songs from the final entry to the first.
examples.zh: 课堂示例的播放列表通过「反向遍历」从最后一项到第一项依次显示歌曲。

examples.en: The tutor attached a predecessor link to each node before demonstrating backward traversal to the class.
examples.zh: 老师给每个节点加了前驱链接，然后向全班演示「反向遍历」。

collocations: start backward traversal at the end

words.enDefinition: The difference between the heights of two subtrees at a node

examples.en: The balance factor became zero after we added a child on the left.
examples.zh: 我们在左边加了一个子节点后，「平衡因子」变成了零。

examples.en: Our example defined the balance factor as left height minus right height.
examples.zh: 示例把「平衡因子」定义为左子树高度减去右子树高度。

words.enDefinition: The unweighted average of per-class recall scores used to evaluate classification.

examples.en: The team reported balanced accuracy because one plant species was far more common than the others.
examples.zh: 因为一个植物物种远比其他物种常见，团队报告了「平衡准确率」。

examples.en: Our tutor calculated balanced accuracy after examining how well the classifier recovered each separate class.
examples.zh: 老师查看分类器识别各类别样本的表现后，计算了「平衡准确率」。

collocations: report balanced accuracy for imbalanced data

words.enDefinition: An ordered tree maintained to keep its height from growing excessively

examples.en: The balanced search tree kept its height small after we inserted several keys.
examples.zh: 我们插入多个键后，「平衡搜索树」仍维持较小的高度。

examples.en: Our lecturer compared a balanced search tree with an example shaped like a chain.
examples.zh: 老师把「平衡搜索树」与链条形状的示例作了比较。

collocations: insert into a balanced search tree

words.enDefinition: A chart that uses bar lengths to show the values of different categories.

examples.en: The bar chart compares the number of books borrowed from each section of the classroom library.
examples.zh: 「条形图」比较了班级图书角不同区域的图书借阅量。

examples.en: We chose a horizontal bar chart because the names would not fit below vertical bars.
examples.zh: 类别名称太长，排不进竖向条形的下方，所以我们改用了横向「条形图」。

words.enDefinition: Requiring participating tasks to reach the same checkpoint before any proceeds beyond it.

examples.en: The exercise used barrier synchronization so every worker finished the first round before any started the second.
examples.zh: 练习采用「屏障同步」，确保每条工作线程都完成第一轮之后才会有线程开始第二轮。

examples.en: Our diagram used a vertical line to show barrier synchronization between two stages of the task.
examples.zh: 图中用一条竖线表示任务两个阶段之间的「屏障同步」。

words.enDefinition: The branch selected to receive the changes in a merge proposal

examples.en: We checked the base branch before submitting our example for review.
examples.zh: 把示例提交评审之前，我们先核对了「合并目标分支」。

examples.en: The wrong base branch made our comparison show unrelated edits from last week.
examples.zh: 「合并目标分支」选错了，对比里就显示了上周无关的编辑。

collocations: compare changes against the base branch

words.enDefinition: a class from which another class inherits

examples.en: The drawing exercise kept the shared label logic in a base class for all shapes.
examples.zh: 绘图练习把所有图形共用的标签逻辑放在一个「基类」里。

examples.en: Our tutor moved the common method to the base class before defining the second shape.
examples.zh: 导师先把共用方法移到「基类」，再定义第二种图形。

collocations: a method from the base class

words.enDefinition: writing the same numeric value in a different base

examples.en: The class practised base conversion by rewriting several small decimal numbers in binary notation.
examples.zh: 同学们练习「进制转换」，把几个小的十进制数改写成二进制。

examples.en: I checked the base conversion by reading the new digits back as the original value.
examples.zh: 我把新的数字读回原数值，以核对「进制转换」的结果。

words.enDefinition: A simple reference model used to judge whether a more elaborate method improves performance.

examples.en: The baseline model always predicted the average sorting time observed in the training records.
examples.zh: 「基准模型」一律预测训练记录中观察到的平均分拣时间。

examples.en: We evaluated a baseline model before deciding whether the more complicated classifier added any benefit.
examples.zh: 我们先评估一个「基准模型」，再判断更复杂的分类器是否带来了改善。

words.enDefinition: a design pattern for how objects divide work or communicate

examples.en: The class identified the observer as a behavioural pattern for passing changes to interested objects.
examples.zh: 同学们把观察者识别为一种把变更传给相关对象的「行为型模式」。

examples.en: Our tutor described a behavioural pattern before drawing the communication between the example's objects.
examples.zh: 导师先描述一种「行为型模式」，再画出示例对象之间的通信。

words.enDefinition: A shortest-path method allowing negative weights and detecting reachable negative cycles

examples.en: The Bellman-Ford algorithm accommodated a negative edge weight in our classroom puzzle.
examples.zh: 「贝尔曼福特算法」适用于我们课堂谜题中的一个负边权。

examples.en: We traced the Bellman-Ford algorithm after adding an edge with a negative cost.
examples.zh: 加了一条代价为负的边后，我们跟踪了「贝尔曼福特算法」。

collocations: detect a negative cycle with the Bellman-Ford algorithm

words.enDefinition: The smallest running cost among inputs of a fixed size

examples.en: Our best-case running time came from matching the first item examined in the list.
examples.zh: 我们的「最好情况运行时间」来自列表第一项就匹配成功的情形。

examples.en: We calculated best-case running time before counting the work for other inputs.
examples.zh: 我们先计算「最好情况运行时间」，再统计其他输入需完成的工作。

words.enDefinition: A layer of vertices at the same minimum distance from the source

examples.en: Both rooms received the same BFS level because each was two steps away.
examples.zh: 两个房间都离起点两步，所以它们的「广度优先搜索层级」相同。

examples.en: I labelled the BFS level on the board before tracing the next layer.
examples.zh: 我在白板上标出「广度优先搜索层级」，再跟踪下一层。

collocations: vertices at the same BFS level

words.enDefinition: The balance between systematic prediction error and sensitivity to variations in the training sample.

examples.en: Our tutor explained the bias-variance trade-off by comparing a rigid line with a highly flexible curve.
examples.zh: 老师用一条刚性的直线和一条非常灵活的曲线作对比，解释了「偏差与方差的权衡」。

examples.en: We used repeated fits of the time predictor to illustrate the bias-variance trade-off in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们多次拟合用时预测模型，以说明「偏差与方差的权衡」。

collocations: illustrate the bias-variance trade-off with two models

words.enDefinition: a relationship that can be followed from either of its ends

examples.en: The worksheet modelled a bidirectional association so each order and customer could find the other.
examples.zh: 练习表用「双向关联」建模，让订单和顾客能互相查到对方。

examples.en: Our tutor used a bidirectional association for a sample club that tracked members and their clubs.
examples.zh: 导师为记录成员及其所属社团的样本使用了「双向关联」。

words.enDefinition: storing the most significant byte at the lowest address or first in sequence

examples.en: The big-endian example put the most significant byte first in the two-byte sequence on the board.
examples.zh: 黑板上的「大端序」示例把最高有效字节放在双字节序列的开头。

examples.en: Our tutor read the big-endian sequence from the stated order before converting it to decimal.
examples.zh: 导师先按规定顺序读取「大端序」字节序列，再把它转换成十进制。

collocations: store a value in big-endian format

words.enDefinition: Notation giving an upper growth bound up to constant factors

examples.en: The worksheet expressed the upper bound using big O notation beside the graph.
examples.zh: 练习表在图旁用「大O记号」表示上界。

examples.en: I used big O notation after counting the comparisons for a larger input.
examples.zh: 我数完较大输入所需的比较次数后，用了「大O记号」。

collocations: express a bound using big O notation
compare functions using big O notation

words.enDefinition: Notation giving a lower growth bound up to constant factors

examples.en: The lecturer used big Omega notation when writing the comparison lower bound.
examples.zh: 老师写比较次数的下界时，用了「大Ω记号」。

examples.en: We expressed the minimum growth rate using big Omega notation in the exercise.
examples.zh: 练习中，我们用「大Ω记号」表示最低增长速度。

collocations: write a lower bound in big Omega notation
express comparison counts in big Omega notation

words.enDefinition: Notation giving matching upper and lower growth bounds up to constants

examples.en: We used big Theta notation after establishing both bounds for the same function.
examples.zh: 我们确定同一函数的上下界后，用「大Θ记号」表示。

examples.en: Our worksheet compared big Theta notation with a statement giving only an upper bound.
examples.zh: 我们的练习表把「大Θ记号」与只给出了上界的表述作了比较。

collocations: state a tight bound in big Theta notation
express growth in big Theta notation

words.zhGloss: JavaScript 任意精度整数类型
words.enDefinition: JavaScript's primitive type for integers of arbitrary magnitude
acceptedZhAnswers: JavaScript 任意精度整数类型

examples.en: The JavaScript exercise used BigInt to keep a very large classroom counter exact.
examples.zh: JavaScript 练习用「JavaScript 任意精度整数类型」精确保存一个很大的课堂计数值。

examples.en: Our tutor marked the final lowercase n on a BigInt literal in the sample.
examples.zh: 导师在样本的「JavaScript 任意精度整数类型」字面量上标出了末尾的小写 n。

collocations: convert an integer to a BigInt

words.enDefinition: a value marking the start or end of a grouping interval

examples.en: We checked which interval included a score of fifty because that value lay exactly on a bin boundary.
examples.zh: 五十分正好位于「分箱边界」，我们确认它归到哪个区间。

examples.en: The first bin boundary was set below the lowest observed temperature in our classroom exercise.
examples.zh: 课堂练习将第一个「分箱边界」设在最低观测温度之下。

collocations: check a value on a bin boundary

words.enDefinition: the size of a numeric interval used to group observations into bins

examples.en: We reduced the bin width from ten minutes to five before looking more closely at waiting times.
examples.zh: 我们把「分箱宽度」从十分钟缩小到五分钟，再仔细查看等待时长。

examples.en: The bin width determined how many intervals covered the range of measurements collected in class.
examples.zh: 「分箱宽度」决定多少个区间能覆盖课堂测量值的范围。

words.enDefinition: A classification task with exactly two possible categories.

examples.en: The library used binary classification to distinguish books for young readers from the other books.
examples.zh: 图书馆用「二分类」区分供低龄读者阅读的图书与其他图书。

examples.en: Our worksheet introduced binary classification with two possible outcomes for each photographed garden leaf.
examples.zh: 练习表用每张花园叶片照片的两种可能结果来介绍「二分类」。

collocations: use binary classification for two categories

words.enDefinition: floating-point representation using powers of two for scaling

examples.en: The worksheet showed why binary floating point could represent one half exactly but only approximate one tenth.
examples.zh: 练习表说明，为什么「二进制浮点」能精确表示二分之一，却只能近似表示十分之一。

examples.en: Our tutor compared binary floating point with a calculation using exact decimal quantities in class.
examples.zh: 导师在课堂上将「二进制浮点」与使用精确十进制数值的计算作了比较。

words.enDefinition: base-two representation using the digits zero and one

examples.en: The worksheet wrote the same small number in binary notation and in ordinary decimal notation.
examples.zh: 练习表用「二进制记数法」和普通十进制记数法写出同一个小数字。

examples.en: Our tutor used binary notation to show how two positions added up to the sample value.
examples.zh: 导师用「二进制记数法」说明两个数位的位权如何相加得到样本值。

collocations: write a value in binary notation

words.enDefinition: Searching an ordered range by repeatedly discarding one half of it

examples.en: The binary search ruled out the smaller half after comparing the middle key.
examples.zh: 「二分查找」比较中间的键后，排除了较小的那一半。

examples.en: We tried binary search again after putting the dates in order.
examples.zh: 我们把日期排好序后，又试了一次「二分查找」。

collocations: implement binary search on sorted data

words.enDefinition: a binary tree in which the keys in each node's left and right subtrees follow the corresponding smaller and larger ordering rules

examples.en: We used a binary search tree to look up the numbers in the exercise.
examples.zh: 我们用「二叉搜索树」查找练习中的数字。

examples.en: Our binary search tree placed the smaller keys on the left at each step.
examples.zh: 我们的「二叉搜索树」在每个节点都把较小的键放到左侧。

collocations: insert a key into a binary search tree

words.enDefinition: A tree whose nodes have at most two ordered children

examples.en: Our binary tree had some nodes with only a right child.
examples.zh: 我们的「二叉树」里有些节点只有右子节点。

examples.en: The tutor drew a binary tree to illustrate left and right branches.
examples.zh: 导师画了一棵「二叉树」来说明左分支和右分支。

words.enDefinition: a binary unit with a value of zero or one

examples.en: The diagram used one bit to record whether the classroom lamp was on or off.
examples.zh: 图中用一个「比特」记录教室里的灯是亮还是灭。

examples.en: Our tutor changed the last bit in the example and asked us to recalculate the value.
examples.zh: 导师改变示例中的最后一个「比特」，请我们重新计算数值。

words.enDefinition: a pattern of bits used to select or modify particular positions

examples.en: We used a bit mask to highlight two positions in the sample pattern of bits.
examples.zh: 我们用一个「位掩码」标出样本位模式里的两个位置。

examples.en: The tutor drew the bit mask above the original value so the selected positions lined up.
examples.zh: 导师把「位掩码」画在原值上面，让被选中的位置对齐。

collocations: select bits with a bit mask

words.enDefinition: a particular sequence of zero and one bits

examples.en: The same bit pattern represented different numbers when we changed the interpretation in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上改变解读方式后，同一个「位模式」表示了不同的数字。

examples.en: Our worksheet highlighted the bit pattern that represented the student team's test value.
examples.zh: 练习表高亮了表示学生团队测试值的「位模式」。

words.enDefinition: the number of bits used in a representation

examples.en: The worksheet changed the bit width from four to eight before repeating the calculation.
examples.zh: 练习表把「位宽」从四改为八，然后重复计算。

examples.en: Our tutor asked how a larger bit width affected the range of representable integers.
examples.zh: 导师问，增大「位宽」会怎样影响可表示的整数范围。

words.enDefinition: an operation giving one where both input bits are one

examples.en: The worksheet used bitwise AND to keep only the positions selected by a mask.
examples.zh: 练习表用「按位与」保留掩码选中的位置。

examples.en: Our tutor practised bitwise AND with two short binary numbers before introducing a longer example.
examples.zh: 导师先用两个简短的二进制数练习「按位与」，再介绍更长的示例。

words.enDefinition: inverting each bit in the representation used by an operation

examples.en: We found the bitwise complement by switching each zero and one in the eight-bit example.
examples.zh: 我们互换八位示例中的每个零和一，得到了「按位取反」的结果。

examples.en: Our tutor fixed the width before asking us to calculate the bitwise complement on paper.
examples.zh: 导师先确定了位宽，再请我们在纸上计算「按位取反」的结果。

words.enDefinition: an operation giving one wherever at least one input bit is one

examples.en: The class used bitwise OR to merge two patterns representing lamps that had been switched on.
examples.zh: 同学们用「按位或」合并两个表示哪些灯已打开的位模式。

examples.en: Our tutor asked what bitwise OR would produce where both input bits were already one.
examples.zh: 导师问，两个输入位都为一时，「按位或」会得到什么结果。

collocations: combine bit patterns with bitwise OR

words.enDefinition: an operation giving one wherever the two input bits differ

examples.en: The worksheet used bitwise XOR to mark positions where its two patterns were different.
examples.zh: 练习表用「按位异或」标记两个位模式中不同的位置。

examples.en: Our tutor applied bitwise XOR to identical bit patterns and asked us to interpret the result.
examples.zh: 导师对相同的位模式执行「按位异或」，并请我们解读结果。

collocations: compare bit patterns with bitwise XOR

words.enDefinition: A line with no visible characters separating source text or output

examples.en: I added a blank line between the two sections of the example.
examples.zh: 我在示例的两个部分之间加了一条「空行」。

examples.en: The output showed a blank line before the final total on screen.
examples.zh: 屏幕上的输出在最终合计前有一条「空行」。

words.enDefinition: A comment enclosed by markers that can cover several lines

examples.en: The Java example started with a block comment describing the purpose of the exercise.
examples.zh: Java 示例开头有一段「块注释」，说明练习的目的。

examples.en: I closed the block comment before writing the next line of JavaScript.
examples.zh: 我先结束「块注释」，再写下一行 JavaScript。

words.enDefinition: The state of a task that cannot continue until a required event occurs.

examples.en: The task entered a blocked state while it waited for the simulated storage device to respond.
examples.zh: 任务等待模拟存储设备响应期间进入「阻塞状态」。

examples.en: We watched the task leave the blocked state after the worksheet indicated that input had arrived.
examples.zh: 练习表显示输入已到达后，我们看到任务退出了「阻塞状态」。

words.enDefinition: Input or output where the calling thread can wait when the operation cannot yet proceed.

examples.en: The example used blocking I/O, so the worker waited when no data was ready.
examples.zh: 例题使用「阻塞式 I/O」，所以没有数据就绪时，工作线程会等待。

examples.en: We marked the point where blocking I/O paused one thread while another could still run.
examples.zh: 我们标出了「阻塞式 I/O」使一条线程暂停、另一条线程仍可运行的位置。

collocations: compare blocking I/O with a readiness-based design

words.enDefinition: a sequence or array of Boolean selections marking which values or positions to keep or operate on

examples.en: We built a Boolean mask to keep only records whose temperature fell within the instrument's valid range.
examples.zh: 我们创建「布尔掩码」，只保留温度处于仪器有效范围内的记录。

examples.en: The tutor displayed the Boolean mask next to the original values so we could see which rows stayed.
examples.zh: 导师把「布尔掩码」和原始值并列显示，让我们看出保留了哪些行。

words.enDefinition: a value representing true or false

examples.en: The classroom program stored a boolean value indicating whether the drawing was complete.
examples.zh: 课堂程序保存了一个「布尔值」，表示图画是否完成。

examples.en: Our tutor asked what boolean value the comparison would produce for the two equal numbers.
examples.zh: 导师问，比较两个相等的数会产生什么「布尔值」。

collocations: convert a value to a boolean value

words.enDefinition: Repeatedly drawing samples with replacement from the available observations.

examples.en: We used bootstrap resampling to compare model predictions across varied samples of the same workshop records.
examples.zh: 我们用「自助法重采样」，比较模型在同一组工作坊记录的不同重抽样本下的预测。

examples.en: The tutor used bootstrap resampling to show why some practice observations appeared more than once.
examples.zh: 老师用「自助法重采样」说明为什么某些练习观测值会出现不止一次。

collocations: generate new samples with bootstrap resampling

words.enDefinition: The end of a stack opposite the end used for insertion and removal.

examples.en: The first card remained at the bottom of the stack after two more were added.
examples.zh: 又放入两张卡片后，第一张仍留在「栈底」。

examples.en: We reached the bottom of the stack after taking out each later card in turn.
examples.zh: 我们依次取出后放入的每张卡片后到达「栈底」。

collocations: the item at the bottom of the stack
reach the bottom of the stack
remain at the bottom of the stack

words.enDefinition: a method value that retains the instance or class it will receive

examples.en: Reading the method from the Python object produced a bound method in the classroom demonstration.
examples.zh: 在课堂演示中，从 Python 对象读取该方法得到一个「绑定方法」。

examples.en: We called the bound method later and checked that it still used the same instance.
examples.zh: 我们稍后调用了「绑定方法」，确认它仍在使用同一个实例。

words.enDefinition: A test exercising values at or near a specified limit

examples.en: Our boundary-value test checked the highest score allowed by the exercise.
examples.zh: 我们的「边界值测试」检查了练习允许的最高分。

examples.en: We added another boundary-value test just below the minimum length for names.
examples.zh: 我们给略短于姓名最短长度的情况加了一个「边界值测试」。

collocations: a boundary-value test for a limit

words.enDefinition: A holding area for items in transit with a fixed maximum amount it can hold.

examples.en: The sample used a bounded buffer to hold video frames until the display thread took them.
examples.zh: 示例用「有界缓冲区」暂存视频帧，等显示线程取走。

examples.en: Our tutor showed what happened when the bounded buffer filled with four pending sample readings.
examples.zh: 老师展示了四个待处理样本读数填满「有界缓冲区」后会发生什么。

collocations: wait for space in a bounded buffer
limit a bounded buffer to four items

words.enDefinition: A queue with a fixed upper limit on the number of items it can hold.

examples.en: The bounded queue in our simulator could hold four samples and then had no space for more.
examples.zh: 模拟器中的「有界队列」最多放四个样本。

examples.en: We filled the bounded queue and checked how the exercise handled another arrival.
examples.zh: 我们填满了「有界队列」，然后查看练习怎样处理再到达的一项。

collocations: test a bounded queue at capacity

words.enDefinition: A stack that can hold at most a specified number of items.

examples.en: The bounded stack held at most three cards in the worksheet we used in class.
examples.zh: 课堂练习表里的「有界栈」最多只能放三张卡片。

examples.en: We tested what the bounded stack did after all its available positions were occupied.
examples.zh: 所有可用位置都放满后，我们测试了这个「有界栈」的表现。

collocations: test a bounded stack when full
push an item onto a bounded stack

words.enDefinition: A chart that summarizes a numerical distribution with a quartile box, median, and whiskers.

examples.en: The box plot shows that the middle half of the sunflower measurements covers a narrow range.
examples.zh: 「箱线图」显示向日葵测量值中间一半的跨度较窄。

examples.en: We used a box plot for each greenhouse to compare the spread of the plant heights.
examples.zh: 我们为每座温室各画一个「箱线图」，比较植株高度的离散程度。

words.enDefinition: a normal form requiring the determinant of every nontrivial functional dependency to be a superkey

examples.en: The instructor tested Boyce-Codd normal form by looking for any nontrivial dependency whose determinant was not a superkey.
examples.zh: 导师检查是否存在决定因素并非超键的非平凡依赖，以判断是否符合「博伊斯科德范式」。

examples.en: We discussed whether adopting Boyce-Codd normal form would make some original dependencies harder to enforce without joining tables.
examples.zh: 我们讨论采用「博伊斯科德范式」后，是否有些原依赖需要联接表才更容易核验。

collocations: decompose a relation into Boyce-Codd normal form

words.enDefinition: an expression whose result determines whether execution follows a particular path

examples.en: We rewrote the branch condition to check room capacity before the program offered any available times.
examples.zh: 我们重写了「分支条件」，让程序提供可用时段前先检查房间容量。

examples.en: The branch condition became true after the total number of bookings reached the specified limit.
examples.zh: 预订总数达到设定的上限后，「分支条件」成立。

words.enDefinition: The proportion of possible decision branches exercised during a test run

examples.en: The branch coverage report showed that the alternative path had not been tested.
examples.zh: 「分支覆盖率」报告显示，另一路径尚未经过测试。

examples.en: We increased branch coverage by adding a case with no matching date.
examples.zh: 我们添加了一个日期完全不匹配的用例，提高了「分支覆盖率」。

words.enDefinition: The commit currently pointed to by a named branch reference

examples.en: The branch tip moved when I recorded another revision on that branch.
examples.zh: 我在该分支又记录一项修订时，「分支当前指向的提交」变了。

examples.en: We compared the branch tip with the commit used during the demonstration.
examples.zh: 我们把「分支当前指向的提交」与演示用的提交作了比较。

words.enDefinition: A search exploring vertices in successive layers from the starting point

examples.en: Our breadth-first search visited all one-step neighbours before checking places farther away.
examples.zh: 我们的「广度优先搜索」先访问相距一步的所有邻居，再查看更远的位置。

examples.en: We used breadth-first search to count the fewest steps through the maze.
examples.zh: 我们用「广度优先搜索」计算走迷宫最少需要几步。

collocations: use breadth-first search for minimum hops

words.enDefinition: a statement that exits an enclosing loop or another breakable construct allowed by the language

examples.en: The break statement ended the search after the program found the first matching book in the list.
examples.zh: 程序找到列表中第一本匹配的书后，「break 跳出语句」结束了搜索。

examples.en: We placed the break statement inside the branch that handled an input ending the session.
examples.zh: 我们把「break 跳出语句」放到处理会话结束输入的分支中。

collocations: exit a loop with a break statement

words.enDefinition: A change that makes some previously supported usage stop working

examples.en: Removing the old argument caused a breaking change in the course example.
examples.zh: 删除旧参数在课程示例中造成了一项「破坏兼容性的更改」。

examples.en: We noted the breaking change beside the updated function description in our notes.
examples.zh: 我们在笔记里更新后的函数说明旁记下了这项「破坏兼容性的更改」。

words.enDefinition: a design letting an abstraction and its implementation vary independently

examples.en: The bridge pattern let our example shapes work with either screen drawing or printed output.
examples.zh: 「桥接模式」让示例图形既能在屏幕绘制，也能用于打印输出。

examples.en: Our tutor used the bridge pattern to change the output method while keeping the shape class.
examples.zh: 导师通过「桥接模式」更换输出方式，同时保留图形类。

collocations: an example of the bridge pattern

words.enDefinition: For a binary outcome, the mean squared difference between its predicted probability and its zero-or-one outcome.

examples.en: We calculated the Brier score using predicted oak probabilities and the actual labels for the photographed leaves.
examples.zh: 我们用照片中叶片的橡树叶预测概率和实际标签计算「布里尔分数」。

examples.en: The tutor compared the Brier score before and after revising the probabilities in the example.
examples.zh: 老师比较了更改例题中概率之前和之后的「布里尔分数」。

collocations: report the Brier score for probability predictions

words.enDefinition: A browser tool showing messages and accepting interactive JavaScript commands

examples.en: We used the browser console to evaluate an arithmetic expression in JavaScript.
examples.zh: 我们用「浏览器控制台」对一个 JavaScript 算术表达式求值。

examples.en: The tutor cleared the browser console before showing what the example printed.
examples.zh: 导师先清空「浏览器控制台」，再展示示例打印的内容。

collocations: view messages in the browser console
run an expression in the browser console

words.enDefinition: The process by which a browser turns document structure and styles into visible output.

examples.en: The lesson on browser rendering starts with a simple page containing only headings and text.
examples.zh: 这节「浏览器渲染」课从一个只有标题和正文的简单页面入手。

examples.en: The browser rendering diagram follows the catalogue from markup to text and shapes on screen.
examples.zh: 「浏览器渲染」图展示目录从标记变成屏幕上的文字和形状的过程。

words.enDefinition: A chart in which the position and size of each circular mark encode different values.

examples.en: The bubble chart uses circle area to show each garden's total number of plants.
examples.zh: 「气泡图」用圆的面积表示各花园的植物总数。

examples.en: The worksheet asks which variables determine each circle's position in the bubble chart.
examples.zh: 练习题问的是哪些变量决定「气泡图」中每个圆的位置。

words.enDefinition: Sorting through repeated passes that swap adjacent items out of order

examples.en: Our bubble sort moved the largest key to the end during its first pass.
examples.zh: 我们的「冒泡排序」在第一趟就把最大键移到了末尾。

examples.en: We checked whether bubble sort needed another pass after a round without swaps.
examples.zh: 一趟未发生交换后，我们检查了「冒泡排序」是否还需要继续。

words.enDefinition: The position identifying a bucket in the storage array of a hash table.

examples.en: The worksheet printed the bucket index next to the name assigned to that bucket.
examples.zh: 练习表把「桶索引」印在分配到该桶的姓名旁边。

examples.en: Our tutor recomputed the bucket index after changing the number of storage positions in the example.
examples.zh: 例题中存储位置数量变了，老师重新计算了「桶索引」。

collocations: map a hash value to a bucket index

words.enDefinition: Sorting by distributing items into groups and combining ordered groups

examples.en: The bucket sort example put scores into groups before ordering each group.
examples.zh: 「桶排序」示例先把分数分组，再在组内排序。

examples.en: We chose ranges for bucket sort before placing the values into groups.
examples.zh: 我们先为「桶排序」选定值域，再把数值分到各组。

words.enDefinition: Input or output that uses temporary storage between a program and the underlying source or destination.

examples.en: The example used buffered I/O to collect several small writes before passing them to the lower layer.
examples.zh: 示例采用「缓冲式 I/O」，累积几次小块数据写入后再交给下一层处理。

examples.en: Our tutor used buffered I/O to explain why a write need not reach storage immediately.
examples.zh: 老师用「缓冲式 I/O」解释为什么写入的数据不一定马上到达存储设备。

collocations: compare buffered I/O with unbuffered I/O
batch small requests through buffered I/O

words.enDefinition: A software change intended to correct a specific faulty behaviour

examples.en: The bug fix restored the missing label in our sample table.
examples.zh: 「缺陷修复」恢复了样表中缺失的标签。

examples.en: We checked the bug fix against the example that previously produced two headings.
examples.zh: 我们用先前会生成两个标题的示例核验了「缺陷修复」。

words.enDefinition: A description of unintended software behaviour submitted for investigation

examples.en: The bug report included a screenshot of the missing report heading.
examples.zh: 「缺陷报告」附了报告标题缺失的截图。

examples.en: I filed a bug report after the example exported a blank page.
examples.zh: 示例导出空白页后，我提交了一份「缺陷报告」。

words.enDefinition: A file or collection of files saved from a build

examples.en: The build artifact included instructions alongside the program built in our lab.
examples.zh: 「构建产物」包括实验课上构建的程序及其说明。

examples.en: I downloaded the build artifact before comparing its contents with the worksheet.
examples.zh: 我先下载了「构建产物」，再把内容和练习表作对照。

words.enDefinition: An automated task producing compiled files, packages, or other build outputs

examples.en: The build job produced a classroom package before any tests ran.
examples.zh: 还没有运行任何测试时，「构建作业」先产出了课堂用的软件包。

examples.en: We opened the build job to see whether the package was created.
examples.zh: 我们打开「构建作业」，检查是否生成了软件包。

words.enDefinition: The recorded messages and results produced during a software build

examples.en: I checked the build log to see where the example package was saved.
examples.zh: 我查了「构建日志」，确认示例软件包存放在哪里。

examples.en: The build log recorded a warning about an optional report file.
examples.zh: 「构建日志」记录了一条关于可选报告文件的警告。

collocations: a warning in the build log

words.enDefinition: Optional version information identifying a build without changing its version precedence

examples.en: The guide used build metadata to record the identity of the classroom build.
examples.zh: 指南用「构建元数据」记录课堂构建的标识。

examples.en: We compared build metadata for two builds that shared the same version.
examples.zh: 我们比较了两个版本号相同的构建的「构建元数据」。

collocations: a version string containing build metadata

words.enDefinition: a design that assembles a complex object through separate construction steps

examples.en: With the builder pattern, we added a title and optional notes before creating the worksheet.
examples.zh: 使用「建造者模式」时，我们先添加标题和可选备注，再创建练习表。

examples.en: Our tutor used the builder pattern to assemble two versions of the same sample report.
examples.zh: 导师用「建造者模式」组装同一份样本报告的两个版本。

collocations: construct an object with the builder pattern

words.enDefinition: a customary unit of digital data consisting of eight bits

examples.en: The worksheet grouped eight bits into one byte before showing the value in hexadecimal.
examples.zh: 练习表先把八个位合成一个「字节」，再用十六进制显示该值。

examples.en: I compared the number of characters with the byte count for a short encoded greeting.
examples.zh: 我比较了一句简短问候在编码后的字符数和「字节」数。

words.enDefinition: an optional initial marker that can indicate an encoding or byte order

examples.en: The example file began with a byte order mark indicating the order used for UTF-16.
examples.zh: 示例文件以一个「字节序标记」开头，用来表示 UTF-16 采用的字节顺序。

examples.en: Our tutor asked why the byte order mark should not be counted as part of the greeting.
examples.zh: 导师问，为什么「字节序标记」不应算作问候语的一部分。

collocations: a file starting with a byte order mark

words.enDefinition: A continuous sequence of bytes presented to an application without built-in message divisions.

examples.en: The catalogue application reads a byte stream even when TCP sends the response in several segments.
examples.zh: 即使 TCP 用多个报文段传输响应，目录应用读到的也是一条「字节流」。

examples.en: Our diagram displays the byte stream as one continuous row rather than separate boxes.
examples.zh: 图中将「字节流」画成连续的一排，没有用方框分隔。

words.enDefinition: a sequence of byte values stored as one value

examples.en: The Python example read a short byte string before interpreting it as text.
examples.zh: Python 示例先读入一小段「字节串」，再把它解释为文本。

examples.en: Our tutor showed the byte string as hexadecimal values beside the decoded greeting.
examples.zh: 导师把「字节串」表示为十六进制值，列在解码后的问候语旁边。

collocations: the length of a byte string

words.enDefinition: An intermediate instruction format executable by a language runtime or virtual machine

examples.en: The tutor showed bytecode between the Java source and its execution.
examples.zh: 导师展示了 Java 源代码从编写到执行之间的「字节码」。

examples.en: We compared bytecode from two versions of the same short program.
examples.zh: 我们比较了同一个短程序两个版本的「字节码」。

words.enDefinition: saved bytecode that the runtime can reuse if it still matches the source under the relevant validity checks

examples.en: The tutor pointed to the bytecode cache after importing the Python example.
examples.zh: 导入 Python 示例后，导师指出了「字节码缓存」的位置。

examples.en: We compared the bytecode cache with the source files still used for editing.
examples.zh: 我们把「字节码缓存」和仍用于编辑的源文件作了比较。

collocations: a file in the bytecode cache

words.enDefinition: The field that carries directives about caching and reuse in HTTP messages.

examples.en: The Cache-Control header states how long the example response may be considered fresh by the cache.
examples.zh: 「Cache-Control 首部字段」说明缓存可以在多长时间内把示例响应视为新鲜。

examples.en: We found the Cache-Control header in the printed response for the classroom timetable today.
examples.zh: 今天我们在课堂时间表的打印响应中找到了「Cache-Control 首部字段」。

words.enDefinition: A stored item in an HTTP cache containing a response and details needed to reuse it.

examples.en: The cache entry stores the sample directory response together with the details used for later requests.
examples.zh: 「缓存条目」保存示例目录的响应及后续请求会用到的信息。

examples.en: We looked at one cache entry for the reading list and another for its stylesheet.
examples.zh: 我们查看了阅读书单的一个「缓存条目」以及样式表的另一个条目。

words.enDefinition: a request for which a cache finds a stored result that can be reused for the request

examples.en: The simulation marked a cache hit when a fresh matching stylesheet could be served from memory.
examples.zh: 模拟程序发现内存中有可复用的匹配样式表且仍在有效期内时，标记一次「缓存命中」。

examples.en: In the exercise, a cache hit lets the browser reuse a fresh copy of the timetable.
examples.zh: 练习中，「缓存命中」让浏览器得以复用仍然新鲜的时间表副本。

words.enDefinition: The information a cache uses to match an incoming request with a stored response.

examples.en: Our example uses the request method and target URL as parts of the cache key.
examples.zh: 示例把请求方法和目标 URL 用作「缓存键」的组成部分。

examples.en: The tutor drew the cache key beside each stored response in the simplified catalogue example.
examples.zh: 老师在简化的目录示例中，把「缓存键」画在各个已存响应旁。

words.enDefinition: An occasion when a cache has no matching stored result for a request.

examples.en: The first request produces a cache miss because the sample stylesheet has not been stored yet.
examples.zh: 首次请求发生「缓存未命中」，因为示例样式表尚未存入缓存。

examples.en: A cache miss is marked in the chart before the browser receives the new timetable.
examples.zh: 浏览器收到新版时间表之前，图表上标出一次「缓存未命中」。

words.enDefinition: A check to determine whether a stored HTTP response is still valid for reuse.

examples.en: The browser performs cache revalidation for the saved stylesheet before reusing it in the demonstration.
examples.zh: 演示中，浏览器先对保存的样式表执行「缓存重新验证」，然后才复用它。

examples.en: Cache revalidation saved the classroom browser from downloading the entire unchanged timetable again in the example.
examples.zh: 示例中，「缓存重新验证」让课堂浏览器省去了重新下载整份未修改的时间表。

words.enDefinition: Metadata used to check whether a cached representation can still be reused.

examples.en: The sample entity tag serves as a cache validator for the stylesheet in our exercise.
examples.zh: 在练习里，示例实体标签充当样式表的「缓存验证器」。

examples.en: The diagram stores a cache validator beside each copy of the timetable for later checks.
examples.zh: 示意图在每份时间表副本旁存放一个「缓存验证器」，供之后检查时使用。

words.enDefinition: organising time-stamped records by calendar year and month rather than by a fixed number of days

examples.en: The calendar month grouping kept February separate even though it had fewer days than the surrounding months.
examples.zh: 尽管二月比前后两个月的天数少，「按自然月分组」仍将二月单独归组。

examples.en: We used calendar month grouping to compare totals with the library's monthly attendance records.
examples.zh: 我们用「按自然月分组」得到合计，再与图书馆的月度到访记录比较。

collocations: report totals using calendar month grouping

words.enDefinition: A plot comparing predicted probabilities with observed event frequencies across groups of predictions.

examples.en: The calibration curve compared mean predicted probabilities with the observed share of oak leaves in each bin.
examples.zh: 「校准曲线」比较各分箱的平均预测概率与实际橡树叶所占比例。

examples.en: We checked the calibration curve to see whether the observed frequencies tracked the estimated probabilities.
examples.zh: 我们查看了「校准曲线」，确认观测频率是否和估计概率吻合。

collocations: compare a calibration curve with the diagonal

words.enDefinition: the location in code where a call to a function or other callable is made

examples.en: The tutor marked the call site where the program first asked the date helper to format a label.
examples.zh: 导师标出了程序第一次使用日期辅助函数设置标签格式的「调用处」。

examples.en: We checked every call site after adding an optional parameter to the routine that reads dates.
examples.zh: 给读取日期的例程增加可选形参后，我们检查了每一处「调用处」。

words.enDefinition: a runtime structure tracking active calls, typically with the most recently entered call at the top

examples.en: The nested calls appeared on the call stack in the order shown by the classroom example.
examples.zh: 各层嵌套调用按课堂示例所示的顺序出现在「调用栈」上。

examples.en: We checked the call stack to find which routine had called the formatter before execution paused.
examples.zh: 我们查看「调用栈」，查出执行暂停之前哪个例程调用了格式化函数。

collocations: push a frame onto the call stack

words.enDefinition: a function supplied to other code so that code can invoke it at an appropriate point

examples.en: The callback function saved each processed record after the routine finished converting its date and amount fields.
examples.zh: 例程转换完每条记录的日期和金额字段后，「回调函数」保存了这条处理好的记录。

examples.en: We passed a callback function that compared the two names whenever the sorting routine needed an ordering.
examples.zh: 排序例程每次需要确定顺序时，就调用我们传入的「回调函数」比较两个名称。
