words.enDefinition: a minimal set of columns whose values uniquely identify each row of a relation

examples.en: The exercise used the serial number as a candidate key because no two items shared the same number.
examples.zh: 练习把序列号用作「候选键」，因为没有两件物品的序列号相同。

examples.en: We checked whether the student identifier alone was a candidate key for the table containing course registrations.
examples.zh: 我们核查在存放选课登记的表里，仅靠学生标识符能否构成「候选键」。

collocations: test the minimality of a candidate key

words.enDefinition: a Unicode relationship between sequences representing the same abstract characters

examples.en: The tutor illustrated canonical equivalence using a precomposed letter and a matching decomposed letter sequence.
examples.zh: 导师用一个预组字符和对应的分解字母序列说明「规范等价」。

examples.en: Our worksheet checked canonical equivalence before testing whether the two sequences had identical code points.
examples.zh: 练习表先检查「规范等价」，再检查两个序列的码点是否完全相同。

collocations: a Unicode rule for canonical equivalence

words.enDefinition: the version of a record designated to represent an entity across several source records

examples.en: We chose the verified address entry as the canonical record after checking the competing sources.
examples.zh: 核对各个不同来源之后，我们选经核实的地址条目作为「权威记录」。

examples.en: The canonical record kept the approved course name and a link to its earlier spellings.
examples.zh: 「权威记录」保留经批准的课程名称，并记录它与早期不同拼法的关联。

collocations: link an alias to a canonical record

words.enDefinition: a pattern that binds the matched value or subvalue to a name

examples.en: The Python capture pattern gave us a name for the width stored in the input record.
examples.zh: Python 的「捕获模式」让我们用一个名称引用输入记录中存的宽度。

examples.en: The student replaced the capture pattern with a wildcard because the code never used the value.
examples.zh: 学生把「捕获模式」换成了通配符，因为代码始终没使用这个值。

collocations: bind a value with a capture pattern

words.enDefinition: a variable from an outer scope that a function retains access to through its closure

examples.en: The returned function read a captured variable holding the label prefix supplied to the outer routine.
examples.zh: 返回的函数读取了一个「捕获的变量」，它保存传入外层例程的标签前缀。

examples.en: We changed the captured variable and checked whether the two callbacks still referred to the same binding.
examples.zh: 我们修改了「捕获的变量」，再检查两个回调是否仍引用同一个绑定。

collocations: preserve access to a captured variable

words.enDefinition: A pointed diagnostic symbol highlighting a position in displayed source text

examples.en: The caret indicator pointed near the place where parsing had stopped.
examples.zh: 「插入符位置标记」指在语法分析停止位置的附近。

examples.en: I used the caret indicator to begin looking for the missing bracket.
examples.zh: 我从「插入符位置标记」指的位置开始找漏掉的括号。

collocations: a caret indicator under a character

words.enDefinition: a foreign key action in which deleting a referenced row automatically deletes dependent rows that refer to it

examples.en: A cascading delete removed the sample worksheet's temporary rows when the worksheet record itself was deleted.
examples.zh: 删除示例练习表的记录时，「级联删除」移除了它所关联的临时行。

examples.en: The classroom model showed how a cascading delete affected the child records linked to that entry.
examples.zh: 课堂模型演示了「级联删除」如何删除链接到该条目的子记录。

collocations: inspect rows affected by a cascading delete

words.enDefinition: a foreign key action that copies changes in referenced key values into dependent foreign key values

examples.en: The cascading update changed related room identifiers after we corrected the key in the practice table.
examples.zh: 我们纠正练习表中的键后，「级联更新」更改了相关的教室标识符。

examples.en: We verified that the cascading update preserved both reservations when the original workshop identifier was corrected.
examples.zh: 我们验证了原工作坊标识符被更正后，「级联更新」保留了两条预订记录。

collocations: apply a cascading update to dependent rows

words.enDefinition: execution that continues into a following case instead of leaving a switch after the current case

examples.en: The JavaScript quiz illustrated case fall-through by printing two messages after a single case matched.
examples.zh: JavaScript 小测在匹配一个分支后打印了两条消息，以说明「分支贯穿」。

examples.en: We documented the intentional case fall-through where several labels shared the same reporting code.
examples.zh: 有几个标签共用同一段输出代码，我们注明这里的「分支贯穿」是有意安排的。

words.enDefinition: a label identifying a value or pattern that selects a branch in a selection statement

examples.en: The JavaScript example used a case label for each supported unit of measurement in the converter.
examples.zh: JavaScript 示例为换算器支持的每种计量单位设置了一个「分支标签」。

examples.en: We were missing a case label for the code representing the building's study rooms.
examples.zh: 我们漏写了楼内自习室对应代码的「分支标签」。

words.enDefinition: representing category labels with agreed codes while preserving their category meanings

examples.en: Our categorical coding used separate numbers for rooms without treating those numbers as a measure of room size.
examples.zh: 我们的「类别编码」为不同房间使用不同数字，但没有把数字当作房间大小。

examples.en: We documented categorical coding so the next group could trace each label back to its original category.
examples.zh: 我们记录了「类别编码」，使下一组能将各标记追溯到原类别。

words.enDefinition: A colour scale that uses distinct colours to differentiate categories without implying rank or order.

examples.en: The categorical colour scale assigns a different hue to each of the three reading groups.
examples.zh: 「分类色标」给三个阅读小组各分配一种不同的色相。

examples.en: We used a categorical colour scale because the garden names have no natural numerical order.
examples.zh: 我们用「分类色标」，因为花园名称本身没有数值顺序。

words.enDefinition: the number of observations assigned to a particular category

examples.en: The category frequency dropped after we removed two forms that recorded the same student's response twice.
examples.zh: 删除两份重复记录同一学生答复的表单后，「类别频数」减少了。

examples.en: We reported both the category frequency and its percentage share in the appendix to the class report.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂报告的附录里同时列出了「类别频数」与它的百分比占比。

words.enDefinition: The displayed result produced by running code in a notebook cell

examples.en: The cell output still displayed yesterday's result until I ran the cell again.
examples.zh: 在我再次运行单元格之前，「单元格输出」还显示着昨天的结果。

examples.en: I copied the cell output so I could compare the two runs.
examples.zh: 我复制了「单元格输出」，这样就能比较两次运行。

words.enDefinition: Withholding selected values from a released table to protect confidential information.

examples.en: The published example uses cell suppression to protect information about a very small group.
examples.zh: 发布示例用「单元格抑制」保护一个人数很少的群体的信息。

examples.en: The note beneath the table tells readers where cell suppression affected the published values.
examples.zh: 表下说明告知读者哪些公布数值受到了「单元格抑制」的影响。

collocations: use cell suppression in a table

words.enDefinition: a design passing a request along possible handlers until one handles it

examples.en: The class used a chain of responsibility to pass each worksheet request to a suitable handler.
examples.zh: 同学们用「责任链模式」把每项练习表请求传给适合的处理者。

examples.en: Our tutor drew the chain of responsibility to show where the sample request stopped.
examples.zh: 导师画出「责任链模式」，说明样本请求在哪里停止传递。

collocations: handlers in a chain of responsibility

words.enDefinition: assigning one evaluated value to multiple targets in a single chain

examples.en: The Python demo used chained assignment to initialise both counters to zero in one statement.
examples.zh: Python 演示用一条「链式赋值」语句把两个计数器都初始化为零。

examples.en: The worksheet used chained assignment with an immutable string to illustrate how several names received it.
examples.zh: 练习表用「链式赋值」把一个不可变字符串赋给多个名称。

words.enDefinition: A maintained history summarising changes across versions of a project

examples.en: The changelog listed changes from several weeks of our exercises.
examples.zh: 「版本变更记录」列出了几周练习里的改动。

examples.en: We consulted the changelog to see when the old label disappeared.
examples.zh: 我们查阅「版本变更记录」，看看旧标签何时被移除。

collocations: add an entry to the changelog

words.enDefinition: a rule for representing text as code units or bytes so that a system can store or exchange it

examples.en: The character encoding mattered because the names file contained accented letters.
examples.zh: 姓名文件中有带重音符号的字母，因此「字符编码」很重要。

examples.en: We checked the character encoding before opening the sample text in Python.
examples.zh: 我们先核对「字符编码」，再用 Python 打开示例文本。

collocations: read text using a character encoding

words.enDefinition: a defined collection of characters supported by a system or standard

examples.en: The exercise used a character set containing Greek letters and basic punctuation for the sample labels.
examples.zh: 练习给样本标签使用了包含希腊字母和基本标点的「字符集」。

examples.en: Our tutor checked which symbols belonged to the character set before discussing how to encode them.
examples.zh: 导师先核对哪些符号属于「字符集」，再讨论怎样编码。

collocations: the characters in a character set

words.enDefinition: A note or graphical callout that adds context to a specific feature of a chart.

examples.en: The chart annotation explains why the building was closed during the third week of the term.
examples.zh: 「图表注释」说明了该楼在学期第三周关闭的原因。

examples.en: We shifted the chart annotation so its arrow still pointed to the correct reading.
examples.zh: 我们移动了「图表注释」，同时让箭头继续指向正确的读数。

words.enDefinition: Text accompanying a chart to identify the figure and explain its meaning or context.

examples.en: The chart caption explains that the two panels cover different months of the same year.
examples.zh: 「图注」说明两幅子图呈现同一年里的不同月份。

examples.en: We added the measurement unit to the chart caption for readers using the printed handout.
examples.zh: 我们把计量单位写进「图注」，方便看纸质讲义的读者。

words.enDefinition: Decorative or distracting features that add no useful meaning to a data chart.

examples.en: We removed the fake shadows as chart junk so the bar lengths were easier to compare.
examples.zh: 我们把模拟阴影当作「图表装饰冗余」删掉，让条形长度更容易比较。

examples.en: The group agreed that the heavy decorative borders were chart junk in the tiny printed figure.
examples.zh: 大家一致认为，粗装饰边框在这张小幅印刷图中属于「图表装饰冗余」。

words.enDefinition: An explanatory key linking a chart's graphical features to the series or categories they represent.

examples.en: The chart legend explains which line represents each of the towns in our rainfall comparison.
examples.zh: 「图例」说明降雨量对比图中的每条线分别代表哪个城镇。

examples.en: We moved the chart legend beside the plot so it would not cover the data.
examples.zh: 我们把「图例」移到绘图区旁边，以免遮挡数据。

words.enDefinition: A small information box that appears when a reader interacts with a chart feature.

examples.en: The chart tooltip gives the exact rainfall value when a reader selects a plotted bar.
examples.zh: 读者选择某根条形时，「图表浮动提示」会给出精确的降雨量。

examples.en: Our chart tooltip displays the full name of the garden and the date of the reading.
examples.zh: 我们的「图表浮动提示」显示花园的全名以及读数日期。

words.enDefinition: a constraint evaluating a condition on inserted or updated row values, normally accepting true or unknown in SQL

examples.en: The check constraint rejected negative durations when we tried adding them to the practice table of events.
examples.zh: 我们向活动练习表添加负数时长时，「检查约束」拒绝了这些值。

examples.en: We combined a check constraint on the maximum score with a separate requirement that the score be present.
examples.zh: 我们通过「检查约束」限制成绩的上限，并另行规定成绩不能为空。

words.enDefinition: to take the change introduced by a selected commit and apply it to the current line of development

examples.en: We could cherry-pick a commit to bring over only the revised report title.
examples.zh: 我们可以「选取并应用某个提交」，只把改过的报告标题带过来。

examples.en: The example showed when to cherry-pick a commit from the class demonstration branch.
examples.zh: 示例展示了什么时候该从课堂演示分支「选取并应用某个提交」。

collocations: cherry-pick a commit from another branch

words.enDefinition: A tree node linked directly below its parent in the structure

examples.en: I added a child node below the item we had just inserted.
examples.zh: 我在刚插入的项目下方添加了一个「子节点」。

examples.en: The traversal moved to a child node after printing the current key.
examples.zh: 遍历打印当前键之后，移到了一个「子节点」。

collocations: a child node of the root

words.enDefinition: A process created by another process.

examples.en: The classroom launcher started a child process to count the words in the sample document.
examples.zh: 课堂示例的启动器启动了一个「子进程」，统计示例文档中的词数。

examples.en: We let the child process finish its conversion before displaying the new thumbnail in the example.
examples.zh: 例题中，我们等「子进程」完成转换后才显示新缩略图。

words.enDefinition: a map showing rates, proportions or other statistical values by colouring geographic areas according to their assigned values

examples.en: The choropleth map shades each district according to its share of households with a public library nearby.
examples.zh: 「分级设色地图」按比例为各区着色，该比例表示住在公共图书馆附近的住户所占份额。

examples.en: The tutor asked why the choropleth map uses a rate instead of the raw district count.
examples.zh: 老师问「分级设色地图」为何用比率来着色，而非各区的原始计数。

words.enDefinition: reading a large file in successive groups of records instead of loading it all into memory at once

examples.en: The example used chunked file reading to count records without keeping every row in memory together.
examples.zh: 示例用「分批读取文件」来统计记录，无需将所有行同时放进内存。

examples.en: We added the separate counts from chunked file reading before checking the total against the reference file.
examples.zh: 我们把「分批读取文件」得到的各批计数相加，再与参考文件核对总数。

collocations: choose a group size for chunked file reading
aggregate results from chunked file reading

words.enDefinition: A machine or process that executes jobs for continuous integration

examples.en: The CI runner executed the same tests we had run in class.
examples.zh: 「持续集成运行器」执行了我们在课堂上跑过的同样一组测试。

examples.en: The logs showed which CI runner had built our sample package.
examples.zh: 日志显示了是哪个「持续集成运行器」构建了我们的示例软件包。

collocations: run jobs on a CI runner
a log from a CI runner

words.enDefinition: An automated sequence of checks used to verify integrated changes

examples.en: The CI workflow built the classroom project before checking its sample output.
examples.zh: 「持续集成工作流」先构建课堂项目，再核对其示例输出。

examples.en: We read the CI workflow before adding a check for date formatting.
examples.zh: 我们先读了「持续集成工作流」，再添加日期格式检查。

words.enDefinition: A way to write an IP address or block with a slash followed by its prefix length.

examples.en: The first column uses CIDR notation to show the address and prefix length together.
examples.zh: 第一列用「CIDR 表示法」把地址和前缀长度写在一起。

examples.en: Our class uses CIDR notation in diagrams for both the IPv4 and IPv6 examples.
examples.zh: 课堂上的 IPv4 和 IPv6 示例图都使用「CIDR 表示法」。

collocations: represent a block in CIDR notation
express a prefix in CIDR notation

words.enDefinition: an import dependency that leads from one module back to itself through other modules

examples.en: The circular import occurred because the calendar module imported the report module which imported the calendar again.
examples.zh: 日历模块导入报告模块，而报告模块又导入日历模块，形成了「循环导入」。

examples.en: We removed the circular import by moving the common text helper into an independent module.
examples.zh: 我们把共用的文本辅助函数移到一个独立模块，消除了「循环导入」。

words.enDefinition: A linked list whose links lead from its last node back to its first.

examples.en: We used a circular linked list to cycle through the names in a classroom game.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂游戏中用「循环链表」循环读取姓名。

examples.en: The exercise stopped walking the circular linked list when it returned to the starting node.
examples.zh: 练习遍历「循环链表」时，回到起始节点便停止。

collocations: detect a return to the start of a circular linked list

words.enDefinition: A FIFO queue in which array positions are reused as the front and rear indexes wrap around.

examples.en: We reused the first slot in our circular queue after earlier removals had made it available.
examples.zh: 先前几次出队腾出了位置，之后我们重新使用了「循环队列」的第一格。

examples.en: The worksheet traced a circular queue through several removals and additions using the same array.
examples.zh: 练习表用同一个数组演示「循环队列」的几次出队和入队。

collocations: represent a circular queue in an array

words.enDefinition: an attribute stored on a class and available through its instances

examples.en: The Python worksheet stored the default category as a class attribute for all sample books.
examples.zh: Python 练习表把样本书籍的默认类别存为一个「类属性」。

examples.en: Our tutor read the class attribute directly from the class before creating any objects.
examples.zh: 还没创建任何对象时，导师直接从类上读取了「类属性」。

words.enDefinition: the part of a class definition containing its members or statements

examples.en: In the Python exercise, the class body contained two definitions at the same indentation level.
examples.zh: 在 Python 练习中，「类体」内有两个缩进层级相同的定义。

examples.en: Our tutor added a field inside the class body before changing the example's constructor.
examples.zh: 导师先在「类体」内加了一个字段，然后才修改示例的构造方法。

collocations: put a method in the class body
the end of a class body

words.enDefinition: a language construct that defines a class and its members

examples.en: The Python class definition grouped the student's name with methods for recording attendance.
examples.zh: Python「类定义」把学生姓名和记录出勤的方法组织在一起。

examples.en: Our tutor moved the class definition above the example that created its first object.
examples.zh: 导师把「类定义」移到创建该类第一个对象的示例前面。

collocations: add a member to a class definition

words.enDefinition: a diagram showing classes, their members, and relationships

examples.en: The class diagram showed how the drawing class referred to a palette and several shapes.
examples.zh: 「类图」展示了绘图类如何引用一套调色板和多个图形。

examples.en: Our tutor added the missing association to the class diagram before checking the worksheet.
examples.zh: 导师先把缺失的关联加到「类图」上，再核对练习表。

words.enDefinition: a file in the JVM class-file format describing a class or interface and containing method bytecode where applicable

examples.en: The newly created class file appeared beside the Java source in our exercise.
examples.zh: 在练习中，新生成的「Java 类文件」出现在 Java 源文件旁。

examples.en: Our tutor pointed out the class file generated by the Java compiler.
examples.zh: 导师指出了 Java 编译器生成的「Java 类文件」。

collocations: run code from a class file
the location of a class file

words.enDefinition: the arrangement of classes according to their inheritance relationships

examples.en: The class hierarchy diagram placed different kinds of shapes below their common general class.
examples.zh: 「类层次结构」图把不同类型的图形放在它们共同的通用类之下。

examples.en: Our tutor redrew the class hierarchy after adding a shared abstraction for the remaining shapes.
examples.zh: 导师为剩余图形添加共用抽象后，重新画了「类层次结构」。

collocations: a level in the class hierarchy

words.enDefinition: An uneven distribution of the number of observations across classes.

examples.en: We noticed class imbalance because the library sample contained many more novels than books of poetry.
examples.zh: 我们注意到「类别不平衡」，因为图书馆样本中的小说远多于诗集。

examples.en: The tutor discussed class imbalance before asking us which evaluation measure would capture the classifier's errors.
examples.zh: 老师先讨论了「类别不平衡」，再问哪个评估指标能反映分类器的错误。

words.enDefinition: an individual object created from a class

examples.en: The exercise created a separate class instance for each book in the fictional library.
examples.zh: 练习为虚构图书馆中的每本书创建了独立的「类的实例」。

examples.en: Our tutor checked a class instance after changing its reading status in the program.
examples.zh: 导师在程序中改变一本书的阅读状态后，检查了一个「类的实例」。

words.enDefinition: a condition that should hold for valid observable states of instances

examples.en: The drawing class maintained a class invariant requiring every stored width to be nonnegative.
examples.zh: 绘图类维持一个「类不变量」，要求保存的宽度始终非负。

examples.en: Our tutor checked the class invariant after each public operation in the small example.
examples.zh: 导师在小示例中每次执行公开操作后，都检查了「类不变量」。

words.enDefinition: A value identifying the category assigned to an observation in classification.

examples.en: The librarian assigned a class label to each description based on the book's main subject.
examples.zh: 图书馆员根据图书的主要主题给每段描述分配一个「类别标签」。

examples.en: We compared the predicted class label with the recorded designation for each plant in the exercise.
examples.zh: 对于练习中的每株植物，我们把预测的「类别标签」与已记录的分类作了比较。

words.enDefinition: a field, method, or other named element belonging to a class

examples.en: The Java worksheet asked which class member held the reading list's title for each object.
examples.zh: Java 练习表问，哪个「类成员」为每个对象保存阅读书单的标题。

examples.en: Our tutor identified each class member before explaining its role in the classroom example.
examples.zh: 导师先指出每个「类成员」，再解释它在课堂示例中的作用。

words.enDefinition: a Python method that automatically receives the class as its first argument

examples.en: The Python example used a class method to create an object from an abbreviated name.
examples.zh: Python 示例用「类方法」根据一个简写名称创建对象。

examples.en: Our tutor showed which class the class method received when called through the inherited name.
examples.zh: 导师演示通过继承得来的名称调用「类方法」时，会收到哪个类。

collocations: the implicit argument to a class method

words.enDefinition: Giving examples from different target classes different weights during model fitting.

examples.en: The team tried class weighting so that errors on rare poetry examples contributed more during fitting.
examples.zh: 团队尝试「类别加权」，让少数诗歌样本上的错误在拟合时占更大权重。

examples.en: Our tutor compared class weighting with changing the number of examples from each category.
examples.zh: 老师对比了「类别加权」和调整各类别样本数量这两种做法。

collocations: fit a model using class weighting

words.enDefinition: The proportion of evaluated examples assigned the correct class in a single-label task.

examples.en: The team calculated classification accuracy by dividing the number of correctly labelled books by the total evaluated.
examples.zh: 团队用正确归类的图书数除以评估图书总数，计算「分类准确率」。

examples.en: We compared classification accuracy on the reserved garden photographs after choosing the final classifier.
examples.zh: 选定最终分类器后，我们比较了留出的花园照片上的「分类准确率」。

words.enDefinition: Predicting a category or a set of categories for an observation.

examples.en: The classification exercise assigned each book to one of the library's four broad subject categories.
examples.zh: 「分类」练习把每本书分到图书馆四大主题类别之一。

examples.en: We used classification to predict whether a photographed leaf belonged to one of the target species.
examples.zh: 我们用「分类」预测照片中的叶片是否属于目标物种之一。

words.enDefinition: A run that starts from a fresh state without relying on values or artefacts from earlier runs.

examples.en: A clean run reproduced the table using only the documented files and settings in our project.
examples.zh: 一次「从干净状态运行」仅用了项目文档列出的文件和设置，就复现了表格。

examples.en: We did a clean run to check that the notebook could recreate the original chart.
examples.zh: 我们让笔记本「从干净状态运行」，确认它能重新生成原图。

words.enDefinition: a value after an identified error or inconsistency has been corrected or standardised

examples.en: The cleaned value used the official building name after we resolved three spellings in the forms.
examples.zh: 我们确定表单中三种拼法指同一楼宇后，「清洗后的值」采用其正式名称。

examples.en: We kept the original label beside the cleaned value so readers could reproduce the change later.
examples.zh: 我们把原始标签保留在「清洗后的值」旁边，便于读者日后复现这一更改。

collocations: compare a cleaned value with its original

words.enDefinition: Create a local copy of a project's repository history and files

examples.en: Our first step was to clone a repository onto the classroom computer.
examples.zh: 我们的第一步是在教室电脑上「克隆版本库」。

examples.en: I chose to clone a repository before opening the source file in my editor.
examples.zh: 我决定先「克隆版本库」，再在编辑器里打开源文件。

words.enDefinition: End a program's access to an open file and release resources

examples.en: Our tutor explained why we should close a file after writing the result text.
examples.zh: 导师解释了为什么写完结果文本后要「关闭文件」。

examples.en: I added a note to close a file once the readings had been saved.
examples.zh: 我加了一条备注，提醒保存读数后「关闭文件」。

words.enDefinition: In k-means, the mean feature vector of the observations assigned to a cluster.

examples.en: The cluster centroid represented the average measurements for the leaves assigned to the first group.
examples.zh: 「簇质心」表示分到第一组的叶片的平均测量值。

examples.en: We recalculated the cluster centroid after two samples moved to a different group in the example.
examples.zh: 例题中两个样本移至另一组之后，我们重新计算了「簇质心」。

collocations: measure distance to a cluster centroid

words.enDefinition: In k-means, the sum of squared distances from observations to their assigned cluster centers.

examples.en: Cluster inertia was lower when the new centers lay closer to the leaves assigned to them.
examples.zh: 新中心更靠近分给它们的叶片时，「聚类惯性」较低。

examples.en: We compared cluster inertia across several fits with the same number of clusters and features.
examples.zh: 我们比较了簇数和特征数相同的几次拟合的「聚类惯性」。

words.enDefinition: Grouping similar observations by their features without using supplied category labels.

examples.en: We used clustering to see which leaf measurements formed natural groups in the practice dataset.
examples.zh: 我们用「聚类」看看练习数据集中的哪些叶片测量值能自然地分成一组。

examples.en: The library exercise used clustering to find similar descriptions before anyone gave the groups names.
examples.zh: 图书馆练习在尚未给各组取名时使用「聚类」寻找相近的描述。

words.enDefinition: A DNS record that specifies the canonical name associated with an alias.

examples.en: The CNAME record links the short catalogue name to another name in the example zone.
examples.zh: 「CNAME 记录」把简短的目录名称指向示例 DNS 区中的另一个名称。

examples.en: The CNAME record in the diagram points to a host name listed in the next row.
examples.zh: 图中的「CNAME 记录」指向下一行列出的主机名。

words.zhGloss: 返回首个非空值的函数
words.enDefinition: a SQL function-like expression returning the first argument that is not null, or null if all arguments are null
acceptedZhAnswers: 返回首个非空值的函数

examples.en: The COALESCE function displayed the short workshop title whenever a separate display label had not been entered.
examples.zh: 没有另行录入展示标签时，「返回首个非空值的函数」显示工作坊的短标题。

examples.en: Our tutor used the COALESCE function to select the first recorded reading from three alternate measurement fields.
examples.zh: 导师用「返回首个非空值的函数」选取三个候选测量字段中第一个有记录的读数。

collocations: replace a null with the COALESCE function
provide a fallback through the COALESCE function

words.enDefinition: A section of a computational notebook containing executable instructions

examples.en: The first code cell displayed the temperature after I entered a value.
examples.zh: 输入数值后，第一个「代码单元格」显示了温度。

examples.en: I added a code cell below the explanation to show the calculation.
examples.zh: 我在说明下方加了一个「代码单元格」来展示计算过程。

words.enDefinition: Editor suggestions that fill in partly typed source code

examples.en: The first code completion suggestion showed how to finish the built-in function's name.
examples.zh: 第一条「代码补全」建议显示了这个内置函数的完整名称。

examples.en: I used code completion while entering the name of the print function.
examples.zh: 输入打印函数的名称时，我用了「代码补全」。

words.enDefinition: An application designed for writing and editing programming language files

examples.en: I used a code editor to remove accidental formatting from the example.
examples.zh: 我用「代码编辑器」去掉了示例里误加的格式。

examples.en: The code editor opened both source files in tabs beside each other.
examples.zh: 「代码编辑器」把两个源文件放在相邻的标签页里打开。

collocations: open a file in a code editor

words.enDefinition: Temporarily hiding sections of code without deleting any source text

examples.en: We used code folding to hide completed sections during the live demonstration.
examples.zh: 我们在现场演示中用「代码折叠」收起了已经讲完的部分。

examples.en: The student enabled code folding to make the longer example easier to scan.
examples.zh: 学生开启「代码折叠」，方便快速浏览较长的示例。

words.enDefinition: A displayed or printed version of a program's written instructions

examples.en: The handout used a code listing to show the whole example program.
examples.zh: 讲义用一份「代码清单」展示了完整的示例程序。

examples.en: I marked the section of the code listing that printed the receipt.
examples.zh: 我在「代码清单」上标出了打印收据的那部分。

words.enDefinition: a number identifying a position in a coded character set

examples.en: We looked up the code point of the accented letter in the classroom character chart.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂字符表中查找那个带重音字母的「码点」。

examples.en: Our tutor distinguished a code point from the bytes used to store it.
examples.zh: 导师区分了「码点」和用于存储它的字节。

words.enDefinition: Inspecting proposed code changes and giving feedback before integration

examples.en: During code review, my partner asked how the example handled blank rows.
examples.zh: 「代码评审」时，同伴问我的示例如何处理空行。

examples.en: The code review caught a heading that did not match the worksheet.
examples.zh: 「代码评审」发现一个和练习表不一致的标题。

words.enDefinition: A short piece of code presented separately for an example

examples.en: The tutor pasted a code snippet into the console to demonstrate printing.
examples.zh: 导师把一段「代码片段」粘贴到控制台里演示打印。

examples.en: I added a code snippet to my notes instead of the entire program.
examples.zh: 我往笔记里加了一段「代码片段」，只摘了程序的一小部分。

words.enDefinition: a fixed-width unit used within a particular text encoding

examples.en: The worksheet counted each code unit in the JavaScript string and compared the result with its visible characters.
examples.zh: 练习表先数 JavaScript 字符串里各个「码元」，再拿结果与可见字符数比较。

examples.en: Our tutor showed that a UTF-16 code unit occupies sixteen bits in the example.
examples.zh: 导师展示了示例中的一个 UTF-16「码元」占十六位。

words.enDefinition: to turn values that cannot be parsed during conversion into missing entries instead of raising a conversion error for them

examples.en: We chose to coerce invalid values to missing when the demonstration file showed letters in its score field.
examples.zh: 示例文件的分数字段出现字母时，我们选择「将无效值转为缺失」。

examples.en: The tutor counted the rejected dates before asking us to coerce invalid values to missing.
examples.zh: 导师统计了被拒绝的日期，再让我们「将无效值转为缺失」。

collocations: choose to coerce invalid values to missing
coerce invalid values to missing during conversion
log attempts to coerce invalid values to missing

words.enDefinition: An error encountered while a framework locates and prepares tests

examples.en: The runner reported a collection error before executing any of our checks.
examples.zh: 运行器在执行任何检查之前报告了「测试收集错误」。

examples.en: We found the unfinished test declaration after investigating the collection error in class.
examples.zh: 课上调查「测试收集错误」后，我们发现有一处测试声明没写完。

words.enDefinition: A visible feature such as a shape, pattern, or label that conveys information without relying on colour.

examples.en: Distinct dash patterns provide a colour-independent cue for the three reading groups on our chart.
examples.zh: 在图表中，三种不同的虚线图案为三个阅读小组提供了「不依赖颜色的提示」。

examples.en: The class used a colour-independent cue by placing each group's name next to its line.
examples.zh: 全班把各组名称放在线条旁边，作为「不依赖颜色的提示」。

words.enDefinition: a name given to an output column or expression within a query

examples.en: The column alias gave the calculated average a name that made sense on the printed report.
examples.zh: 「列别名」为计算得到的平均值指定了一个在纸质报告上容易理解的名称。

examples.en: We added a column alias so readers could tell the registration date from the event date.
examples.zh: 我们加了「列别名」，让读者把报名日期和活动日期区分开。

collocations: display a result under a column alias

words.enDefinition: the specification of a column's name, data type and any column settings included in the table declaration

examples.en: The column definition made the assignment title required while a separately defined completion date could remain null.
examples.zh: 「列定义」规定作业标题必须填写，而另行定义的完成日期可以为空。

examples.en: We changed the column definition to let the example store marks with a decimal portion.
examples.zh: 我们修改「列定义」，以便示例能存储带小数的成绩。

collocations: include a default in a column definition

words.enDefinition: the name or other label identifying a column in a data frame or similar table

examples.en: We changed the column label to include the measurement unit before sharing the table with our class.
examples.zh: 和同学分享表格之前，我们改了「列标签」，让它写明计量单位。

examples.en: The column label was repeated twice because the two forms used the same question heading.
examples.zh: 两个表单使用了同样的问题标题，所以这个「列标签」出现了两次。

collocations: check for a duplicate column label

words.enDefinition: a discrepancy in the columns expected and supplied, such as different labels, counts or types

examples.en: A column mismatch appeared because one file used two fields for the address and the other used one.
examples.zh: 一个文件用两个字段存地址，另一个只用一个，因此出现「列不匹配」。

examples.en: We resolved the column mismatch before adding the spring records to the original table.
examples.zh: 我们先解决「列不匹配」，再把春季记录加到原来的表里。

collocations: report a column mismatch during import

words.enDefinition: a summary of properties of one column, often covering its value types, counts and distribution

examples.en: The column profile listed the smallest and largest valid distances and the number of unrecorded measurements.
examples.zh: 「列概况」列出最小及最大的有效距离，以及未记录的测量次数。

examples.en: We compared a new column profile with the original one after standardising several category labels.
examples.zh: 统一了几个类别标签后，我们把新的「列概况」与原来的列概况作了比较。

words.enDefinition: an operation performed on each column as a separate set of values

examples.en: The column-wise operation computed the number of complete entries in each of the survey's numeric fields.
examples.zh: 「逐列操作」统计调查各个数值字段中完整条目的数量。

examples.en: We used a column-wise operation because each measurement type needed its own mean in the summary.
examples.zh: 我们用「逐列操作」，因为汇总中每种测量类型都需要分别计算均值。

collocations: compute statistics with a column-wise operation

words.enDefinition: to build one column by combining values drawn from two or more existing columns

examples.en: We chose to combine columns containing year and month before parsing them as a single date field.
examples.zh: 我们决定先「合并多列」，将年份和月份拼在一起，再将其解析为一个日期字段。

examples.en: The exercise asked us to combine columns so every address had one display label for the report.
examples.zh: 练习要求我们「合并多列」，让报表中的每个地址都只有一个展示标签。

words.enDefinition: a character that combines with another character in displayed text

examples.en: The worksheet showed a combining mark after the base letter in the decomposed example.
examples.zh: 在分解形式的示例中，练习表在基本字母之后列出了一个「组合标记」。

examples.en: The tutor added a combining mark to demonstrate why the text still looked like one letter.
examples.zh: 导师添加一个「组合标记」，展示为什么这段文本看起来仍像一个字母。

collocations: a combining mark after a base letter
a character sequence containing a combining mark

words.enDefinition: a tabular text format that uses commas to separate fields, with quoting rules where needed

examples.en: The project exported comma-separated values so the class could open the timetable in several different tools.
examples.zh: 项目导出「逗号分隔值」文件，以便同学们用不同工具打开日程表。

examples.en: We checked how comma-separated values represented an address that contained a comma within the address text.
examples.zh: 我们核查了「逗号分隔值」格式如何表示文本本身包含逗号的地址。

collocations: read a file of comma-separated values

words.enDefinition: A piece of information passed to a program when starting it

examples.en: The file name was passed as a command-line argument when the example started.
examples.zh: 示例启动时，文件名作为「命令行参数」传给了程序。

examples.en: Our tutor changed one command-line argument and ran the same program again.
examples.zh: 导师改了一个「命令行参数」，然后再次运行同一个程序。

words.enDefinition: A named command-line option used to request particular program behaviour

examples.en: The handout showed a command-line flag that changed how much the example printed.
examples.zh: 讲义展示了一个能改变示例打印多少内容的「命令行选项标记」。

examples.en: I removed a command-line flag and compared the result with my first run.
examples.zh: 我去掉一个「命令行选项标记」，并和第一次运行的结果比较。

collocations: a command-line flag for extra output

words.enDefinition: A searchable menu of actions available inside a software editor

examples.en: I opened the command palette to find the option for running Python.
examples.zh: 我打开「命令面板」，找到运行 Python 的选项。

examples.en: Our tutor searched the command palette for the action that changes interpreters.
examples.zh: 导师在「命令面板」里找了切换解释器的操作。

collocations: choose an action from the command palette

words.enDefinition: a design packaging a request as an object that can execute it

examples.en: The command pattern represented adding a shape as an object in a small classroom drawing exercise.
examples.zh: 在一项简易课堂绘图练习里，「命令模式」以一个对象表示添加图形这项操作。

examples.en: Our tutor traced when the command pattern passed the request to the drawing object.
examples.zh: 导师追踪「命令模式」何时将请求交给绘图对象。

collocations: requests represented through the command pattern

words.enDefinition: Turn a source line into a comment to prevent its execution

examples.en: I decided to comment out a line while checking where the repeated message came from.
examples.zh: 为了查明重复消息来自哪里，我决定「把一行代码注释掉」。

examples.en: Could you comment out a line in the example before we run it again?
examples.zh: 再次运行示例前，你能「把其中一行代码注释掉」吗？

collocations: comment out a line while debugging
remember to comment out a line

words.enDefinition: A hash identifying a particular Git commit object

examples.en: We copied the commit hash to make sure both groups reviewed the same revision.
examples.zh: 我们复制了「提交哈希值」，确保两个小组审阅的是同一修订版本。

examples.en: The commit hash identified the exact snapshot used for the classroom demonstration.
examples.zh: 「提交哈希值」标识了课堂演示使用的那份具体快照。

collocations: refer to a commit by its hash

words.enDefinition: The recorded sequence or graph of commits in a repository

examples.en: The commit history showed two improvements to the example after Monday's lesson.
examples.zh: 「提交历史」显示周一上课后，示例有过两处改进。

examples.en: I looked through the commit history to find when the title changed.
examples.zh: 我查看「提交历史」，找标题是什么时候改的。

words.enDefinition: Text describing the purpose of a recorded change in version history

examples.en: The commit message explained why we renamed a column in the example.
examples.zh: 「提交说明」解释了我们为什么给示例里的一列改名。

examples.en: I read the commit message before comparing the old and new files.
examples.zh: 我先读了「提交说明」，再比较新旧文件。

words.enDefinition: a named query expression defined within a statement so other parts of that statement can reference its result

examples.en: The common table expression named the monthly totals so the main query could reference them for its comparison.
examples.zh: 「公用表表达式」给月度合计命名，使主查询能引用它们进行比较。

examples.en: We put the filtered catalogue rows in a common table expression to make the query easier to read.
examples.zh: 我们把筛选后的目录行放在「公用表表达式」中，让课堂查询更容易阅读。

collocations: define a common table expression in a WITH clause

words.enDefinition: The number of pairwise key comparisons made by an algorithm

examples.en: Our comparison count went up when the input arrived in reverse order.
examples.zh: 输入按相反顺序到来时，我们的「比较次数」增加了。

examples.en: We recorded the comparison count without including the separate swaps in that total.
examples.zh: 我们记录了「比较次数」，另行统计交换次数。

words.enDefinition: A sorting method that orders items by comparing their keys

examples.en: The worksheet used a comparison sort with alphabetically ordered names as keys.
examples.zh: 练习表采用「比较排序」，按姓名的字母顺序比较各键。

examples.en: We traced a comparison sort on five names from our practice roster.
examples.zh: 我们用练习名册里的五个姓名跟踪了「比较排序」。

collocations: the limits of a comparison sort

words.enDefinition: A stage in preparing code that translates it into another form

examples.en: The compilation step produced class files before we ran the Java example.
examples.zh: 运行 Java 示例前，「编译步骤」生成了类文件。

examples.en: I repeated the compilation step after fixing the incorrect source line.
examples.zh: 我修好错误的源代码行后，重新执行了「编译步骤」。

words.enDefinition: The platform or representation for which a compiler produces code

examples.en: The lab used the same compilation target for everyone building the Java example.
examples.zh: 实验课上，所有人生成 Java 示例时都用相同的「编译目标」。

examples.en: We compared the compilation target with the runtime available in the classroom.
examples.zh: 我们把「编译目标」和教室里可用的运行时环境作了比较。

words.enDefinition: The stage when code is translated and checked before execution

examples.en: The lesson explained why Java complained at compile time about the assignment.
examples.zh: 课上解释了 Java 为什么在「编译阶段」就对这条赋值语句报错。

examples.en: We listed checks that took place at compile time in the example.
examples.zh: 我们列出了示例中在「编译阶段」执行的检查。

collocations: detect an error at compile time

words.enDefinition: A file created by translating source code during a build

examples.en: The fresh compiled artifact appeared after I recompiled the changed Java source.
examples.zh: 我重新编译修改过的 Java 源码后，出现了新的「编译产物」。

examples.en: We identified which compiled artifact came from the last successful compilation.
examples.zh: 我们确认了哪个「编译产物」来自上一次成功的编译。

collocations: the location of a compiled artifact

words.enDefinition: A tool that translates code into another executable or intermediate representation

examples.en: The compiler translated the Java source before the classroom program ran.
examples.zh: 课堂程序运行前，「编译器」先翻译了 Java 源代码。

examples.en: Our tutor showed where the compiler placed the generated files.
examples.zh: 导师展示了「编译器」把生成的文件放在哪里。

words.enDefinition: A message reporting something the compiler discovered during code analysis

examples.en: The compiler diagnostic named a source file and showed a line number.
examples.zh: 「编译器诊断信息」列出一个源文件名，还显示了行号。

examples.en: Our tutor looked at the first compiler diagnostic before discussing later messages.
examples.zh: 导师查看第一条「编译器诊断信息」后，再讨论后面的提示。

words.enDefinition: a compiler diagnostic that ordinarily flags a potential problem without treating it as a compilation error

examples.en: The Java example produced a compiler warning after the tutor changed one declaration.
examples.zh: 导师改了一条声明后，Java 示例出现了一条「编译器警告」。

examples.en: I read the compiler warning even though the class file had appeared.
examples.zh: 虽然类文件已经生成，我还是看了那条「编译器警告」。

collocations: a compiler warning about an unchecked operation

words.enDefinition: A binary tree filled by levels, with any final gaps rightmost

examples.en: The complete binary tree had its last two nodes at the far left.
examples.zh: 「完全二叉树」最后一层的两个节点都在最左边。

examples.en: We checked the leftward placement of nodes in a complete binary tree.
examples.zh: 我们检查了「完全二叉树」中的节点是否靠左排列。

collocations: levels of a complete binary tree

words.enDefinition: an analysis restricted to observations with present values for all variables needed in that analysis

examples.en: The complete-case analysis used fewer records because some participants had not supplied values for both measures.
examples.zh: 由于有些参与者没有提供两项度量的值，「完整个案分析」使用了较少的记录。

examples.en: We compared the complete-case analysis with a separate sensitivity check based on a different treatment of missing data.
examples.zh: 我们将「完整个案分析」与按另一种方法处理缺失数据的敏感性检查作了比较。

collocations: report the sample size for a complete-case analysis
compare a complete-case analysis with imputation

words.enDefinition: a check that required entries, fields or records are present

examples.en: The completeness check flagged two sign-in forms that did not contain the session date.
examples.zh: 「完整性检查」标记了两张没有活动日期的签到表。

examples.en: We ran a completeness check to see whether all the expected weekly files had arrived.
examples.zh: 我们做了「完整性检查」，查看所有预期的周文件是否已经收到。

words.enDefinition: A test focusing on the behaviour of an individual software component

examples.en: The component test exercised the date picker with the rest of the page absent.
examples.zh: 「组件测试」在页面其他部分都未加载时，测试了日期选择器。

examples.en: Our component test checked which unit the converter displayed after we changed its setting.
examples.zh: 我们的「组件测试」检查修改设置后，换算器显示了哪个单位。

collocations: a component test for a form

words.enDefinition: a single database index defined over more than one column or index expression

examples.en: The composite index contained both room code and date because the classroom searches commonly used those fields together.
examples.zh: 「复合索引」包含房间编号和日期，因为课堂搜索经常结合使用这两个字段。

examples.en: We examined the column order in the composite index before testing the most common catalogue search.
examples.zh: 测试最常见的目录搜索之前，我们检查了「复合索引」中的列顺序。

collocations: choose the order of a composite index
query columns in a composite index

words.enDefinition: a key made up of more than one column

examples.en: The composite key combined a schedule identifier with a seat number to identify each available place.
examples.zh: 「复合键」将日程标识符与座位号组合，用于标识每个可用座位。

examples.en: We explained why dropping either column from the composite key could make two registrations indistinguishable.
examples.zh: 我们解释了为何从「复合键」中删掉任意一列，都可能使两条登记记录无法区分。

collocations: use columns in a composite key

words.enDefinition: a design treating individual objects and groups through the same interface

examples.en: The composite pattern let the drawing tool move single shapes and groups through one operation.
examples.zh: 「组合模式」让绘图工具通过同一个操作移动单个图形或一组图形。

examples.en: Our tutor used the composite pattern to display a group together with its smaller groups.
examples.zh: 导师用「组合模式」显示一个分组及其中较小的分组。

collocations: a hierarchy using the composite pattern

words.enDefinition: the principle of favouring collaborating objects when they offer simpler reuse than subclassing

examples.en: Our tutor illustrated composition over inheritance by giving each drawing a separate colour selector.
examples.zh: 导师为每幅画配上独立的颜色选择器，以说明「优先组合而非继承」。

examples.en: The class discussed composition over inheritance when the example needed several interchangeable label formats.
examples.zh: 示例需要多种可互换的标签格式时，同学们讨论了「优先组合而非继承」。

collocations: a design using composition over inheritance

words.enDefinition: the place where an application assembles its main object graph

examples.en: The sample's composition root created the output helper and passed it to the drawing tool.
examples.zh: 样本的「对象组装入口」创建输出辅助对象，再把它传给绘图工具。

examples.en: Our tutor placed the composition root near startup so the object's dependencies were easy to locate.
examples.zh: 导师把「对象组装入口」放在启动部分附近，便于找到对象的依赖。

collocations: assemble dependencies in the composition root

words.enDefinition: in Python, a statement made up of one or more clauses that can contain other statements

examples.en: Our tutor identified the loop as a compound statement consisting of a header and an indented body.
examples.zh: 导师指出，这个循环是一条「复合语句」，由头部和缩进的循环体组成。

examples.en: In Python, the entire conditional is one compound statement even when it has three separate clauses.
examples.zh: 在 Python 中，就算分成三个子句，整个条件结构也是一条「复合语句」。

collocations: the header of a compound statement

words.enDefinition: The combination of software, versions, settings, and computing resources used to run an analysis.

examples.en: The report describes the computational environment so readers can see which software produced the figure.
examples.zh: 报告说明了「计算环境」，读者可以了解生成图表时用了哪些软件。

examples.en: We recreated the computational environment before comparing our output with the instructor's sample report.
examples.zh: 我们重建了「计算环境」，再将输出与老师的示例报告作比较。

words.enDefinition: An interactive document combining executable code, explanatory text, and the results it produces.

examples.en: Our computational notebook contains the code, comments, and chart for the rainfall exercise.
examples.zh: 我们的「计算笔记本」包含降雨量练习所需的代码、注释和图表。

examples.en: I opened the computational notebook to review the calculation just above the displayed table.
examples.zh: 我打开「计算笔记本」，查看结果表正上方的计算过程。

words.enDefinition: The ability to obtain consistent computational results using the same inputs and the same analysis procedures.

examples.en: The teaching assistant assessed computational reproducibility by regenerating the plots from the submitted data and code.
examples.zh: 助教用提交的数据和代码重新生成图表，以评估「计算可复现性」。

examples.en: Our report discusses computational reproducibility and lists the tools used to generate every figure.
examples.zh: 我们的报告讨论了「计算可复现性」，还列出生成各图所用的工具。

words.enDefinition: a property whose value is derived when it is read

examples.en: The JavaScript example used a computed property to return the area from two saved measurements.
examples.zh: JavaScript 示例用「计算属性」根据两个保存的测量值返回面积。

examples.en: Our tutor changed one dimension and checked the computed property on the same shape.
examples.zh: 导师改变其中一个尺寸，然后检查同一个图形的「计算属性」。

words.enDefinition: a class whose instances can be created directly when construction requirements are met

examples.en: The exercise created a concrete class implementing the remaining operations of the shape example.
examples.zh: 练习创建了一个「具体类」，实现图形示例中剩余的操作。

examples.en: Our tutor explained which concrete class the program instantiated for each sample shape.
examples.zh: 导师解释了程序为每种样本图形实例化的是哪个「具体类」。

collocations: a concrete class implementing an interface

words.enDefinition: a method with an implementation that can be executed

examples.en: The abstract class included a concrete method that returned the shape's label in our exercise.
examples.zh: 练习中的抽象类包含一个「具体方法」，用来返回图形的标签。

examples.en: Our tutor used the concrete method to share formatting among the example's different classes.
examples.zh: 导师用这个「具体方法」让示例中的不同类共享格式化逻辑。

words.enDefinition: Making progress on multiple tasks over overlapping periods, potentially by alternating between them on one processor.

examples.en: The simulator showed concurrent execution by alternating two classroom tasks on one processor.
examples.zh: 模拟器在一个处理器上交替运行两项课堂任务，以展示「并发执行」。

examples.en: Our tutor used concurrent execution to explain how the editor remained active during an image conversion.
examples.zh: 老师用「并发执行」解释为什么编辑器在图像转换期间还能继续使用。

collocations: draw a timeline of concurrent execution

words.enDefinition: A synchronization object that lets threads wait for changes to a shared condition.

examples.en: The example used a condition variable to wake the display worker when a thumbnail became available.
examples.zh: 缩略图就绪时，例题借助「条件变量」唤醒显示工作线程。

examples.en: We drew the condition variable beside the shared list of jobs still waiting to run.
examples.zh: 我们把「条件变量」画在仍等待运行的共享作业列表旁。

collocations: use a condition variable with a lock

words.enDefinition: one of the paths in a program when a condition determines which code runs

examples.en: The second conditional branch handled the case where the booking existed but its room was unavailable.
examples.zh: 第二个「条件分支」处理已有预订但对应房间不可用的情况。

examples.en: The test exercised a conditional branch that the class had missed during its first demonstration.
examples.zh: 这个测试执行了课堂首次演示时遗漏的一个「条件分支」。

words.enDefinition: An HTTP request with fields that make its outcome depend on a test of resource metadata.

examples.en: The browser uses a conditional request to check whether the cached catalogue page has changed.
examples.zh: 浏览器用「条件请求」检查缓存的目录页是否有变化。

examples.en: The tutor showed which field made our conditional request depend on the saved entity tag.
examples.zh: 老师指出是哪个字段让「条件请求」的结果取决于已保存的实体标签。

words.enDefinition: a statement directing which code runs according to the outcome of a condition or selection

examples.en: Our conditional statement printed a different message when no seats remained for the evening class.
examples.zh: 晚课没有空位时，我们的「条件语句」会打印另一条消息。

examples.en: We moved the file update into a conditional statement so it ran only after approval.
examples.zh: 我们把文件更新移到「条件语句」里，让它只在获得批准后进行。

words.enDefinition: Text Git inserts to show where competing edits require resolution

examples.en: I found a conflict marker above the two proposed versions of the label.
examples.zh: 我在该标签的两个提议版本上方找到了一个「冲突标记」。

examples.en: The tutor pointed to the conflict marker before comparing the affected lines.
examples.zh: 导师先指出「冲突标记」，再比较受影响的几行。

collocations: remove a conflict marker after resolution
a conflict marker in the file

words.enDefinition: A table counting how often each observed class is paired with each predicted class.

examples.en: The confusion matrix showed that the model often labelled poetry books as works of fiction.
examples.zh: 「混淆矩阵」显示，模型经常把诗集标为小说。

examples.en: We checked the row labels before interpreting the confusion matrix in the garden classification exercise.
examples.zh: 解读花园分类练习的「混淆矩阵」之前，我们先核对了行标签。

collocations: inspect errors in a confusion matrix

words.enDefinition: A mechanism that adapts the amount of traffic sent to the conditions on the network path.

examples.en: The networking lab uses congestion control to illustrate how senders respond to a busy path.
examples.zh: 网络实验用「拥塞控制」说明发送方如何应对繁忙的路径。

examples.en: In the simulation, congestion control reduces the sending rate when the shared link becomes overloaded.
examples.zh: 在模拟中，共享链路超负荷时，「拥塞控制」会降低发送速率。

words.enDefinition: A maximal group of mutually reachable vertices in an undirected graph

examples.en: We placed every room reachable from the entrance in one connected component.
examples.zh: 我们把从入口可达的所有房间归到同一个「连通分量」。

examples.en: Each side of the broken footbridge formed a separate connected component on the map.
examples.zh: 步行桥损坏后，地图上桥的两侧各形成一个独立「连通分量」。

words.enDefinition: The process through which endpoints create the state needed for a transport connection.

examples.en: The connection establishment phase happens before the catalogue request in our simplified TCP diagram.
examples.zh: 在简化的 TCP 图中，「连接建立」阶段发生在目录请求之前。

examples.en: The worksheet sets aside one row for connection establishment and another for the first request.
examples.zh: 练习纸用一行表示「连接建立」，另一行表示首次请求。

words.enDefinition: A transport model in which endpoints establish a connection before exchanging application data.

examples.en: The class used connection-oriented transport to illustrate what happens before a catalogue response begins.
examples.zh: 课堂上用「面向连接的传输」说明目录响应开始前会发生什么。

examples.en: The diagram shows the initial exchange required by connection-oriented transport before the first page request.
examples.zh: 图中标出了首次页面请求前「面向连接的传输」需要进行的初始交换。

words.enDefinition: A transport model in which messages can be sent without establishing a transport connection first.

examples.en: The diagram uses connectionless transport for the example with separate updates from a classroom sensor.
examples.zh: 图中，教室传感器逐条发送更新的示例采用「无连接传输」。

examples.en: In this simulation, each message sent by connectionless transport is handled as an independent datagram.
examples.zh: 在这次模拟里，通过「无连接传输」发送的每条消息都作为独立数据报处理。

words.enDefinition: Messages or results displayed in a console by a running program

examples.en: I compared the console output from two runs of the same program.
examples.zh: 我比较了同一程序运行两次的「控制台输出」。

examples.en: The console output showed the prices before displaying the final total.
examples.zh: 「控制台输出」先显示了各项价格，之后才显示最终合计。

words.enDefinition: A running cost bounded independently of the input size

examples.en: The course model treated reading one known array position as constant time.
examples.zh: 课程模型把读取一个已知数组位置视为「常数时间」操作。

examples.en: We checked whether the lookup still took constant time as inputs grew.
examples.zh: 我们检查了输入变大时，查找是否仍用「常数时间」。

words.enDefinition: a case in which a proposed or stored value fails to satisfy a defined database rule

examples.en: A constraint violation explained why the example could not add another product with that catalogue number.
examples.zh: 因为「违反约束」，示例无法再添加一件目录编号相同的产品。

examples.en: We inspected the reported constraint violation and found that the booking referred to a nonexistent room.
examples.zh: 我们检查报告的「违反约束」错误后发现，这条预订指向不存在的教室。

collocations: reject a row for a constraint violation

examples.en: The Java constructor received the shape's width and height when the sample rectangle was created.
examples.zh: 创建样本矩形时，Java「构造方法」接收了图形的宽和高。

examples.en: Our tutor stepped through the constructor to see when the object's title was assigned.
examples.zh: 导师逐步执行「构造方法」，查看对象标题何时被赋值。

words.enDefinition: a special class method that creates and initializes a new object instance
having one constructor invoke another as part of object setup

examples.en: The Java example used constructor chaining so one constructor could reuse the setup in another.
examples.zh: Java 示例用「构造方法链式调用」，让一个构造方法复用另一个的初始化工作。

examples.en: Our tutor drew the sequence of calls involved in constructor chaining for the sample shape.
examples.zh: 导师画出了样本图形的「构造方法链式调用」顺序。

words.enDefinition: supplying required dependencies through arguments when an object is created

examples.en: The classroom example used constructor injection to provide the drawing class with a required palette.
examples.zh: 课堂示例用「构造方法注入」给绘图类提供必需的调色板对象。

examples.en: Our tutor checked whether constructor injection made each required collaborator visible in the parameter list.
examples.zh: 导师核对「构造方法注入」是否能在参数列表里列出每个必需的协作对象。

collocations: supply a dependency through constructor injection

words.enDefinition: providing several constructors with different parameter lists in one class

examples.en: The Java example used constructor overloading to create a circle with or without an explicit radius.
examples.zh: Java 示例用「构造方法重载」来创建圆，可以显式提供半径，也可以省略。

examples.en: Our tutor explained which parameter list distinguished the two versions in the constructor overloading exercise.
examples.zh: 导师解释了哪个参数列表区分了「构造方法重载」练习中的两个版本。

words.enDefinition: The field that identifies codings such as compression applied to an HTTP representation.

examples.en: The sample Content-Encoding header shows that the catalogue response was compressed before being sent.
examples.zh: 示例「Content-Encoding 首部字段」表明目录响应在发送前经过压缩。

examples.en: The tutor compared the Content-Encoding header with the field that describes the original media type.
examples.zh: 老师比较了「Content-Encoding 首部字段」和用来描述原始媒体类型的字段。

collocations: detect compression from the Content-Encoding header

words.enDefinition: The selection of a representation for an HTTP resource based on available variants and client preferences.

examples.en: The catalogue service uses content negotiation to choose between an HTML version and a plain text version.
examples.zh: 目录服务利用「内容协商」在 HTML 版和纯文本版之间选择。

examples.en: We illustrated content negotiation by requesting the same classroom notice in two different languages.
examples.zh: 我们用两种语言请求同一则课堂通知，以演示「内容协商」。

words.enDefinition: The field that identifies the media type of the content in an HTTP message.

examples.en: The Content-Type header identifies the sample catalogue response as HTML before the browser displays it.
examples.zh: 浏览器显示示例目录前，「Content-Type 首部字段」先标明响应格式为 HTML。

examples.en: Our worksheet asks what format the Content-Type header identifies in the response for the library map.
examples.zh: 练习题问的是图书馆地图响应的「Content-Type 首部字段」标明了哪种格式。

words.enDefinition: a Python object that manages entry to and exit from a with block, often to acquire and release resources

examples.en: The context manager closed the file when execution left the block that read the table.
examples.zh: 程序离开读取表格的语句块时，「上下文管理器」关闭了文件。

examples.en: We used a context manager to restore the previous display settings even if formatting failed during the example.
examples.zh: 我们用「上下文管理器」来恢复之前的显示设置，即使示例中格式化失败也能恢复。

words.enDefinition: Saving the execution state of one task and restoring that of another so it can run.

examples.en: The trace recorded a context switch when the scheduler replaced the running task with another one.
examples.zh: 调度器用另一项任务替换当前运行的任务时，跟踪记录显示发生了「上下文切换」。

examples.en: We drew a context switch between two tasks to show which registers needed to be saved.
examples.zh: 我们画出了两项任务之间的「上下文切换」，以展示需要保存哪些寄存器。

collocations: measure the overhead of a context switch

words.enDefinition: A layout in which a block of successive elements occupies adjacent memory locations.

examples.en: The diagram showed contiguous storage as one block, with each numeric element directly beside the next.
examples.zh: 图示把「连续存储」画成一个块，各数值元素都紧挨着下一个元素。

examples.en: Our tutor contrasted contiguous storage for array elements with separately allocated nodes in a linked list.
examples.zh: 老师把数组元素的「连续存储」同链表节点各自分配内存作了对比。

collocations: compare contiguous storage with linked nodes

words.enDefinition: A prompt showing that an interactive instruction needs another line

examples.en: Python displayed a continuation prompt while waiting for the rest of the expression.
examples.zh: Python 等待表达式的剩余部分时，显示了「续行提示符」。

examples.en: The tutor pointed to the continuation prompt after entering the unfinished first line.
examples.zh: 导师输入还没写完的第一行后，指向「续行提示符」。

collocations: enter text at the continuation prompt

words.enDefinition: a statement that skips the rest of the current loop iteration and resumes the loop's control process

examples.en: A continue statement skipped the current row when the required date was missing from the spreadsheet.
examples.zh: 表格缺少必填日期时，「continue 跳过本轮语句」跳过了当前行。

examples.en: We added a continue statement before the calculation so blank responses would never reach the total.
examples.zh: 我们在计算前加了一条「continue 跳过本轮语句」，这样空白答复不会被计入总数。

collocations: skip the remaining work with a continue statement

words.enDefinition: Keeping validated software ready for release through an automated process

examples.en: Our example of continuous delivery prepared a tested package for later release.
examples.zh: 我们的「持续交付」示例准备了一个经过测试的软件包，供之后发布。

examples.en: The diagram showed continuous delivery ending with a version ready for approval.
examples.zh: 图里，「持续交付」最后产出了一个待批准发布的版本。

words.enDefinition: Frequently integrating changes and verifying them with automated checks

examples.en: Our course used continuous integration to check each submitted version automatically.
examples.zh: 课程用「持续集成」自动检查每个提交的版本。

examples.en: The tutor drew a diagram showing where continuous integration ran the tests.
examples.zh: 导师画了一张图，展示「持续集成」在哪一步运行测试。

words.enDefinition: A target measured on a continuous numerical scale.

examples.en: The example used elapsed time as a continuous target and rounded it only for the report.
examples.zh: 例题把实际用时作为「连续型目标」，只在写报告时对它取整。

examples.en: The tutor asked us to identify the continuous target among the three outcomes listed in the exercise.
examples.zh: 老师让我们在练习列出的三个结果中找出「连续型目标」。

collocations: evaluate predictions for a continuous target

words.enDefinition: A numerical comparison of the relative luminance of two colours.

examples.en: The contrast ratio increased when we darkened the axis labels against the pale chart background.
examples.zh: 我们把浅色背景上的轴标签调深后，「对比度比值」变大了。

examples.en: We recorded the contrast ratio for each pair of colours used in the sample graphic.
examples.zh: 我们记录了示例图中每一对颜色的「对比度比值」。

words.enDefinition: the order in which a program runs statements and moves between paths

examples.en: The diagram traced control flow from the first condition to the message printed for each grade.
examples.zh: 这张图跟踪了从第一个条件到按分数等级输出提示的「控制流」。

examples.en: We compared control flow before and after moving the input check inside the loop.
examples.zh: 我们比较了把输入检查移入循环前后的「控制流」。

words.enDefinition: Scheduling in which running tasks give up execution voluntarily rather than being routinely preempted by the scheduler.

examples.en: The example used cooperative scheduling, so the other task waited until the calculation voluntarily yielded.
examples.zh: 例题采用「协作式调度」，因此另一项任务必须等正在计算的任务主动让出 CPU。

examples.en: We compared cooperative scheduling with a policy that could interrupt a long task before it finished.
examples.zh: 我们把「协作式调度」和允许在长任务结束前打断它的策略作了对比。

words.enDefinition: a constructor that initialises a new object using another of the same type

examples.en: The Java example defined a copy constructor that created a new point from an existing point.
examples.zh: Java 示例定义了一个「复制构造方法」，用已有的点创建一个新点。

examples.en: Our tutor compared the two positions after the copy constructor built the second point.
examples.zh: 「复制构造方法」创建第二个点后，导师比较了两者的位置。

words.enDefinition: Sharing underlying data until a write needs a private copy for the writer.

examples.en: The simulator used copy-on-write so the two views initially shared the same underlying page.
examples.zh: 模拟器采用「写时复制」，因此两个视图最初共享同一个底层页。

examples.en: We saw copy-on-write create a private page only when the example changed its stored value.
examples.zh: 我们看到，只有例题修改其中的值时，「写时复制」才创建独立的页。

collocations: make a private copy with copy-on-write

words.enDefinition: a subquery containing a reference to a value supplied by an enclosing query scope

examples.en: The correlated subquery reused the room identifier from the outer query to count bookings for that room.
examples.zh: 「相关子查询」使用外层查询的房间标识符，统计该房间的预订记录。

examples.en: We identified the outer reference in the correlated subquery before explaining how its result depended on each row.
examples.zh: 我们在「相关子查询」中找出对外层的引用，再解释其结果如何依赖各行数据。

collocations: identify the outer reference in a correlated subquery

words.enDefinition: a SQL aggregate operation that counts distinct non-null values of a specified expression

examples.en: The tutor used COUNT DISTINCT to count how many different rooms appeared in the weekly bookings.
examples.zh: 导师用「去重计数」统计本周预订里出现了多少个不同房间。

examples.en: We compared COUNT DISTINCT with a count of all registration rows in the sample course dataset.
examples.zh: 我们把「去重计数」与样本课程数据中全部登记行的计数作了比较。

collocations: calculate a total with COUNT DISTINCT
use COUNT DISTINCT on a column
compare COUNT DISTINCT with a row count

words.enDefinition: a loop whose continuation is determined by the value of a counter

examples.en: The counter-controlled loop ran the same demonstration exactly eight times before displaying the average result.
examples.zh: 「计数控制循环」将同一演示恰好运行八次，再显示平均结果。

examples.en: We used a counter-controlled loop to fill a table with a fixed number of sample rows.
examples.zh: 我们用「计数控制循环」向表中填入固定行数的样本数据。

words.enDefinition: A synchronization object that tracks available permits and can let several participants proceed when permits remain.

examples.en: The simulator used a counting semaphore to let at most three workers enter the practice room.
examples.zh: 模拟器用「计数信号量」控制进入练习室的工作线程数量，最多允许三条同时进入。

examples.en: Our worksheet changed the counting semaphore value when a worker returned its permit after finishing.
examples.zh: 一条工作线程完成后交还许可，练习表随之修改了「计数信号量」的值。

collocations: acquire a permit from a counting semaphore
use a counting semaphore to limit concurrency

words.enDefinition: Sorting by counting occurrences of each key within a limited range

examples.en: Our counting sort counted each score before writing the values in order.
examples.zh: 我们的「计数排序」先统计各分数的出现次数，再按顺序写出。

examples.en: The exercise used counting sort on ratings drawn from five possible values.
examples.zh: 练习用「计数排序」处理只有五种可能取值的评分。

collocations: the key range for counting sort

words.enDefinition: A summary identifying software areas exercised or missed by tests

examples.en: The coverage report marked two lines that none of our checks executed.
examples.zh: 「覆盖率报告」标出了我们的检查都没执行到的两行。

examples.en: I compared the coverage report before and after the additional worksheet tests.
examples.zh: 我比较了添加练习表测试前后的「覆盖率报告」。

collocations: a line in a coverage report

words.enDefinition: A minimum coverage level required by a project's testing rules

examples.en: The class project met its coverage threshold after we added two checks.
examples.zh: 添加两项检查后，课堂项目达到了「覆盖率门槛」。

examples.en: We verified the configured coverage threshold before comparing the project reports.
examples.zh: 比较项目报告之前，我们先核对了配置里的「覆盖率门槛」。

words.enDefinition: A setting or preference relating a task to particular processor cores for execution.

examples.en: The example used CPU affinity to keep the sample worker on the same pair of cores.
examples.zh: 示例通过「CPU 亲和性」，让这条工作线程在固定的一对核心上运行。

examples.en: Our tutor discussed why CPU affinity might change which tasks appeared on each core's timeline.
examples.zh: 老师讨论了为什么「CPU 亲和性」可能改变各核心时间线上显示的任务。

words.enDefinition: Work whose completion time is mainly limited by CPU computation.

examples.en: The example image filter was a CPU-bound workload once all the pixels were already in memory.
examples.zh: 所有像素都已在内存中时，示例图像滤镜的运算是「计算受限的工作负载」。

examples.en: We plotted CPU use for a CPU-bound workload that repeatedly resized a set of sample images.
examples.zh: 我们为反复调整一组样图尺寸的「计算受限的工作负载」绘出了 CPU 使用率。

collocations: compare a CPU-bound workload with an I/O-bound one

words.enDefinition: The reference implementation of Python, written primarily in the C language

examples.en: The lab used CPython to demonstrate what a Python interpreter does.
examples.zh: 实验课用「Python 参考实现」来演示 Python 解释器的作用。

examples.en: Our notes listed CPython as one implementation of the Python language.
examples.zh: 笔记把「Python 参考实现」列为 Python 的一种实现。

words.enDefinition: a design pattern concerned with how objects are created

examples.en: The worksheet classified the builder as a creational pattern because it changed how objects were assembled.
examples.zh: 练习表将建造者归为「创建型模式」，因为它改变了对象的组装方式。

examples.en: Our tutor introduced a creational pattern for constructing objects from several pieces of input.
examples.zh: 导师介绍一种根据多项输入构建对象的「创建型模式」。

collocations: an example of a creational pattern

words.enDefinition: A section of code that accesses shared state and must be protected against conflicting execution.

examples.en: The diagram highlighted the critical section where the classroom program updated its shared results list.
examples.zh: 图中标出课堂程序更新共享结果列表的「临界区」。

examples.en: We marked what the critical section covered before reviewing how the practice queue was protected.
examples.zh: 检查练习队列如何受到保护之前，我们标出了「临界区」的范围。

words.enDefinition: a join pairing each row of one input with every row of the other input

examples.en: The cross join paired each study room with every time slot when generating the blank timetable.
examples.zh: 生成空白日程表时，「交叉联接」把每间自习室与所有时段逐一组合起来。

examples.en: We predicted the number of rows produced by the cross join before running the classroom query.
examples.zh: 运行课堂查询前，我们预测了这次「交叉联接」会产生多少行。

collocations: count rows produced by a cross join
generate combinations with a cross join

words.enDefinition: a table summarising counts or other aggregated values for combinations of categories from two or more variables

examples.en: The cross-tabulation showed how often each rating appeared for the morning and afternoon workshops in the sample.
examples.zh: 「交叉表」显示样本中的上午、下午工作坊各出现多少次不同评级。

examples.en: We built a cross-tabulation of venue and event type after checking that the names were spelled consistently.
examples.zh: 确认场地名称的拼写一致后，我们按场地和活动类型构建了「交叉表」。

words.enDefinition: Evaluating a learning procedure by repeatedly fitting and validating on different data partitions.

examples.en: We used cross-validation to compare two plant classifiers without relying on a single fixed partition.
examples.zh: 我们用「交叉验证」比较两个植物分类器，无需依赖单一的固定划分。

examples.en: The tutor showed how cross-validation let different examples serve as validation data in different rounds.
examples.zh: 老师演示了「交叉验证」怎样在不同轮次使用不同样本作为验证数据。

words.enDefinition: A performance score from cross-validation, often reported per fold or summarized across folds.

examples.en: Our report gave the mean cross-validation score along with the individual scores for each held-out fold.
examples.zh: 我们的报告给出了平均「交叉验证得分」，同时也列出各留出折的单独得分。

examples.en: We compared the cross-validation score of the forest with that of a simple reference model.
examples.zh: 我们将森林的「交叉验证得分」与一个简单的参照模型作了比较。

words.enDefinition: A property name and value in CSS that specify one aspect of presentation.

examples.en: The CSS declaration sets the font size for the book titles in the sample catalogue.
examples.zh: 这条「CSS 声明」设置了示例目录中书名的字号。

examples.en: Our worksheet asks which CSS declaration changes the background colour of the reading list.
examples.zh: 练习题问的是哪条「CSS 声明」改变阅读书单的背景颜色。

words.enDefinition: A pattern in a style rule that identifies the elements to which the rule can apply.

examples.en: The CSS selector matches all the headings in a particular section of the classroom catalogue page.
examples.zh: 「CSS 选择器」匹配课堂目录页中某一区域的全部标题。

examples.en: We changed the CSS selector so the new colour applied only to book titles.
examples.zh: 我们更改了「CSS 选择器」，让新颜色仅应用到书名。

words.enDefinition: the number of qualifying observations seen so far in a specified order

examples.en: The cumulative count reached six after the last workshop's attendance form had been added to the group.
examples.zh: 最后一场工作坊的出勤表纳入该组后，「累计计数」达到了六。

examples.en: We restarted the cumulative count at the beginning of each session in the sequence of recorded events.
examples.zh: 在记录的活动序列中，每场开始时我们重新进行「累计计数」。

words.enDefinition: an exception type defined by a program to represent a particular error condition of its own

examples.en: We defined a custom exception for a schedule that contained two conflicting bookings for the same room.
examples.zh: 我们为同一房间出现两个冲突预订的日程定义了「自定义异常」。

examples.en: The test handled the custom exception to check how the caller reported an invalid date range.
examples.zh: 测试处理了「自定义异常」，以检查调用方如何报告无效日期范围。

words.enDefinition: deciding whether a graph contains a cycle, a path that returns to its start without other repeated vertices

examples.en: We used cycle detection to check for circular prerequisites in the sample.
examples.zh: 我们用「环检测」查找示例里的循环先修关系。

examples.en: The worksheet applied cycle detection before trying to put the tasks in order.
examples.zh: 练习表先做了「环检测」，再尝试给任务排序。

collocations: cycle detection in a directed graph

words.enDefinition: a loop of object dependencies that returns to its starting point

examples.en: The workshop found a cyclic object dependency when each constructor required the other's instance.
examples.zh: 工作坊发现，每个构造方法都需要对方的实例，形成了「对象循环依赖」。

examples.en: We removed a cyclic object dependency by moving the shared calculation to a separate object.
examples.zh: 我们把共享计算移到独立对象中，消除了「对象循环依赖」。

collocations: a diagram of a cyclic object dependency

words.enDefinition: Formal permission for a person or group to use specified data under stated conditions.

examples.en: The project lead recorded data access approval before the team used the restricted teaching files.
examples.zh: 团队使用有限制的教学文件前，项目负责人记录了「数据访问批准」。

examples.en: Our example form describes which dataset and time period the data access approval covers.
examples.zh: 示例表单说明「数据访问批准」适用哪个数据集和哪个时段。

words.enDefinition: a class primarily representing data in named fields, with generated common methods where the language or tool provides them

examples.en: The Python worksheet used a data class to hold a title and reading status.
examples.zh: Python 练习表用「数据类」存储标题和阅读状态。

examples.en: Our tutor showed which initialization code Python generated for the data class in the example.
examples.zh: 导师展示了 Python 为示例中的「数据类」生成了哪些初始化代码。

words.enDefinition: finding and handling missing values, errors, duplicates or inconsistencies in a dataset

examples.en: We did the data cleaning before counting survey responses because several forms had been submitted twice.
examples.zh: 有几份问卷重复提交了，所以我们先做「数据清洗」，再统计答复。

examples.en: The data cleaning step caught a month entered as thirteen in the practice timetable.
examples.zh: 「数据清洗」步骤发现练习日程表里有一个月份被填成了十三。

words.enDefinition: a record describing changes that corrected erroneous or inconsistent values and the reasons for those changes

examples.en: The data correction log recorded why a month was changed after we checked the paper registration form.
examples.zh: 我们核查纸质报名表并修改月份后，在「数据更正记录」里写明了原因。

examples.en: We reviewed the data correction log to confirm which original values had been preserved in a separate file.
examples.zh: 我们查看「数据更正记录」，确认哪些原始值保存在另一个文件里。

collocations: document a decision in a data correction log

words.enDefinition: A person or organisation responsible for the practical storage, protection, or maintenance of data.

examples.en: The data custodian keeps the archived teaching files available to approved course staff.
examples.zh: 「数据保管人」保存教学档案，供获准访问的课程工作人员使用。

examples.en: Our scenario names a data custodian who maintains the published files and their accompanying records.
examples.zh: 我们在情境设定中指定一位「数据保管人」，负责维护已发布的文件及随附记录。

words.enDefinition: the part of a database language used to create or change the definitions of database objects

examples.en: The class used data definition language to describe two tables before loading any of the sample records.
examples.zh: 同学们先用「数据定义语言」定义两张表，然后才载入示例记录。

examples.en: We read the data definition language commands to find where the table's primary key had been declared.
examples.zh: 我们阅读「数据定义语言」命令，找出在哪里声明了该表的主键。

collocations: use data definition language to create tables
execute a data definition language command

words.enDefinition: A reference explaining the fields, meanings, permitted values, and units in a dataset.

examples.en: The data dictionary explains why the example file contains two different fields for rainfall.
examples.zh: 「数据字典」解释了示例文件为什么有两个不同的降雨量字段。

examples.en: We used the data dictionary to check which unit the garden height column uses.
examples.zh: 我们用「数据字典」确认花园数据中高度列使用的单位。

words.enDefinition: The principles used to judge whether collecting, analysing, sharing, or using data is responsible.

examples.en: The class discussed data ethics before deciding which fields belonged in the public example table.
examples.zh: 全班讨论了「数据伦理」，再决定应在公开示例表中保留哪些字段。

examples.en: Our data ethics exercise asks whether a chart fairly represents the residents of smaller districts.
examples.zh: 我们的「数据伦理」练习要求判断图表是否公允地呈现人口较少地区的居民。

collocations: apply data ethics to a project

words.enDefinition: A structured review in which a team evaluates the ethical aspects of its own data project.

examples.en: The data ethics self-assessment asks the class to describe who might benefit from the report.
examples.zh: 「数据伦理自评」要求全班说清哪些人可能从这份报告中受益。

examples.en: We completed the data ethics self-assessment before deciding whether our example chart needed more context.
examples.zh: 我们先完成「数据伦理自评」，再决定是否为示例图表补充背景。

words.enDefinition: a two-dimensional data structure with labelled row and column axes, often supporting columns of different types

examples.en: We stored the workshop dates and attendance counts together in a data frame for the reporting exercise.
examples.zh: 我们把工作坊日期和出勤人数存入同一个「数据框」，供报表练习使用。

examples.en: The data frame kept the room name as text and the seat count as an integer.
examples.zh: 「数据框」以文本存储教室名称，以整数存储座位数。

words.enDefinition: The roles, policies, and decision processes that guide how an organisation manages its data.

examples.en: The data governance policy identifies who approves changes to the fictional city's public dataset.
examples.zh: 「数据治理」政策说明由谁批准对虚构城市的公开数据集进行修改。

examples.en: We used a simple data governance model to assign responsibility for each classroom data file.
examples.zh: 我们用一个简单的「数据治理」模型来明确每个课堂数据文件由谁负责。

words.enDefinition: a defined representation for transferring data between separate systems or tools

examples.en: The class selected a data interchange format that both the spreadsheet and analysis tools could read.
examples.zh: 同学们选了一种电子表格与分析工具都能读的「数据交换格式」。

examples.en: We checked that the data interchange format could preserve the labels from all the sample records.
examples.zh: 我们确认「数据交换格式」能保留所有示例记录的标签。

collocations: export in a data interchange format
read a supported data interchange format

words.enDefinition: Text next to a plotted mark that gives its value or another identifying detail.

examples.en: The data label above each bar gives the number of visitors recorded for that week.
examples.zh: 每根条形上方的「数据标签」显示该周记录的访客量。

examples.en: We removed one data label because it covered the point from the following day.
examples.zh: 有一个「数据标签」挡住了次日的数据点，我们把它删掉了。

words.enDefinition: Information reaching training or model selection that would be unavailable when evaluating or using the model in its intended setting.

examples.en: We identified data leakage after finding the same photographed leaf on both sides of the split.
examples.zh: 发现拆分后的两边都含有同一片叶片的照片后，我们识别出了「数据泄漏」。

examples.en: The worksheet showed how fitting a transformation on all examples could introduce data leakage before evaluation.
examples.zh: 练习表展示了用所有样本拟合数据变换怎样在评估前引入「数据泄漏」。

collocations: detect data leakage between training and test data

words.enDefinition: a chain tracing data from their sources through processing steps and on to the datasets or outputs that depend on them

examples.en: The data lineage links the monthly percentages to the original counts and the calculation step.
