examples.zh: 「数据血缘」将月度百分比追溯至原始计数和计算步骤。

examples.en: We drew the data lineage to show how two source tables feed the same figure.
examples.zh: 我们画出「数据血缘」，说明同一张图的输入数据来自哪两张源表。

words.enDefinition: the part of a database language used to retrieve or change stored data, with scope varying by convention

examples.en: The workbook introduced data manipulation language by adding a new booking and correcting an existing classroom record.
examples.zh: 练习册通过新增一条预订和更正一条现有教室记录介绍「数据操作语言」。

examples.en: We used data manipulation language to update the class roster without changing the definitions of its columns.
examples.zh: 我们用「数据操作语言」更新班级名册，保持各列的定义。

collocations: write a data manipulation language command
use data manipulation language to update rows

words.enDefinition: The practice of collecting and keeping only the data needed for a stated purpose.

examples.en: Data minimisation led the group to request attendance totals without collecting individual names for the exercise.
examples.zh: 按照「数据最小化」原则，小组只索取练习所需的出席总量，没有收集姓名。

examples.en: The tutor used data minimisation to explain why the example form asks for fewer details.
examples.zh: 老师用「数据最小化」解释了为什么示例表单要求填写的细节较少。

words.enDefinition: A single plotted observation or value in a chart.

examples.en: Each data point shows the measured height of one sunflower in the classroom example.
examples.zh: 课堂示例中的每个「数据点」表示一株向日葵的实测高度。

examples.en: The highlighted data point marks the busiest day in the sample library attendance records.
examples.zh: 突出显示的「数据点」代表示例图书馆客流记录里最繁忙的一天。

words.enDefinition: examining a dataset's structure, value distributions and signs of data quality problems

examples.en: The data profiling report showed that one department used three spellings for the same room name.
examples.zh: 「数据概况分析」报告显示，一个部门给同一教室名称用了三种拼法。

examples.en: We performed data profiling before deciding which values to repair and which to leave unchanged.
examples.zh: 我们先做「数据概况分析」，再决定修复哪些值、保留哪些值。

collocations: summarise the results of data profiling

words.enDefinition: information documenting the origin and processing history of a data item or dataset

examples.en: The data provenance records which rainfall file the team used and who corrected its labels.
examples.zh: 「数据溯源信息」记载了团队使用的降雨量文件，以及谁更正了标签。

examples.en: We checked data provenance before combining two public spreadsheets with similar names and different dates.
examples.zh: 两份公开电子表格的名称相近但日期不同，我们合并它们前核查了「数据溯源信息」。

words.enDefinition: conflicting accesses by different threads to the same memory location, with at least one write and no required ordering between them

examples.en: The classroom diagnostics reported a data race involving an ordinary progress counter in the sample program.
examples.zh: 课堂诊断工具报告了示例程序中涉及普通进度计数器的「数据竞争」。

examples.en: Our tutor explained why the reported data race concerned memory accesses rather than the task schedule alone.
examples.zh: 老师解释了为什么报告中的「数据竞争」涉及内存访问，并非仅涉及任务调度。

collocations: eliminate a data race with synchronization

words.enDefinition: changing the arrangement of rows and columns while preserving the meaning of the recorded observations

examples.en: The data reshaping step moved each month's figures from separate columns into a shared value field.
examples.zh: 「数据重塑」步骤把每个月的数字从不同列移入同一个值字段。

examples.en: We compared the file before and after data reshaping to make sure every recorded measurement was still present.
examples.zh: 我们比较「数据重塑」前后的文件，确认保留了所有有记录的测量值。

words.enDefinition: A record stating how long different kinds of data are kept and when they are reviewed or removed.

examples.en: The data retention schedule tells the fictional team when it should review its teaching files.
examples.zh: 「数据留存计划表」告诉虚构团队何时复查教学文件。

examples.en: Our case study compares the entries for raw records and published totals in the data retention schedule.
examples.zh: 案例比较了「数据留存计划表」中原始记录与公开总量各自对应的条目。

words.enDefinition: A set of related values treated as a group in a chart.

examples.en: The chart includes one data series for each of the three gardens in our exercise.
examples.zh: 练习图中的三个花园各有一个「数据系列」。

examples.en: We made the second data series a dashed line to distinguish it from the first.
examples.zh: 我们把第二个「数据系列」画成虚线，使它与第一个区分开。

words.enDefinition: An agreement setting the terms and responsibilities for sharing data between parties.

examples.en: The data sharing agreement describes what each fictional institution may send to the other.
examples.zh: 「数据共享协议」说明两家虚构机构各自可以向对方发送哪些内容。

examples.en: We read the data sharing agreement to see which team maintains the approved public summary.
examples.zh: 我们查阅「数据共享协议」，确认哪一组负责维护已获批准的公开摘要。

collocations: enter into a data sharing agreement
responsibilities under a data sharing agreement

words.enDefinition: The ongoing responsibility for keeping data documented, usable, and properly managed.

examples.en: Her data stewardship duties include checking the file descriptions and maintaining the public dataset inventory.
examples.zh: 她的「数据管护」职责包括检查文件描述，以及维护公开数据集清单。

examples.en: The course uses data stewardship to discuss caring for archives after a project team disbands.
examples.zh: 课程借助「数据管护」这一概念，讨论项目组解散后如何管理档案。

words.enDefinition: applying a defined rule to change the values or representation of data for a specific purpose

examples.en: The data transformation converted weekly attendance counts into percentages using the capacity recorded for each room.
examples.zh: 「数据变换」用各教室记录的容量，将每周出勤人数转换为百分比。

examples.en: We documented each data transformation so another group could calculate the same values from the original file.
examples.zh: 我们记录了每项「数据变换」，让另一组能从原始文件算出同样的值。

collocations: verify the result of a data transformation

words.enDefinition: a classification that defines a value's permitted operations or representation

examples.en: The quiz asked which data type could represent the two answers to a true-or-false question.
examples.zh: 测验问，哪种「数据类型」能表示判断题的两种答案。

examples.en: I checked the data type after the script joined two scores end to end.
examples.zh: 脚本把两个分数拼接在一起后，我检查了「数据类型」。

collocations: values of the same data type

words.enDefinition: determining likely column types from the values in a dataset instead of receiving the types explicitly

examples.en: The reader's data type inference recognised attendance counts as integers and letter-prefixed booking codes as text.
examples.zh: 读取程序通过「数据类型推断」将出勤人数识别为整数，将有字母前缀的预订代码识别为文本。

examples.en: We reviewed data type inference when a numeric column became text after adding the spring files.
examples.zh: 加入春季文件后，一列从数值变成文本，于是我们复查了「数据类型推断」。

collocations: check the result of data type inference

words.enDefinition: An agreement setting conditions on who can use data and for what purposes.

examples.en: The data use agreement limits the example records to the agreed classroom analysis.
examples.zh: 「数据使用协议」把示例记录的用途限定为已约定的课堂分析。

examples.en: The team reviewed the data use agreement before writing its plans for the fictional dataset.
examples.zh: 团队在写出虚构数据集的使用计划前，先查阅了「数据使用协议」。

collocations: terms of a data use agreement

words.enDefinition: a requirement on the format, range, relationships or other permitted properties of data

examples.en: A data validation rule prevented the classroom exercise from accepting a completion date before the start date.
examples.zh: 「数据校验规则」使课堂练习拒绝早于开始日期的完成日期。

examples.en: We wrote a data validation rule for the unit field after finding three unexplained abbreviations.
examples.zh: 我们找出三个没有解释的缩写后，为单位字段写了「数据校验规则」。

collocations: report a failed data validation rule

words.enDefinition: The use of graphical forms to communicate information in data.

examples.en: We used data visualisation to show how library visits changed over the teaching term.
examples.zh: 我们用「数据可视化」展示图书馆到访量在教学学期内的变化。

examples.en: The data visualisation for our class report shows when the garden received the most rain.
examples.zh: 课堂报告里的「数据可视化」展示了花园在哪个时段降雨最多。

words.enDefinition: transforming, joining and reorganising data from its original form to make it usable for a task

examples.en: The data wrangling stage combined the weekly sign-in lists and moved the dates into a single column.
examples.zh: 「数据整理」阶段合并了每周签到名单，并将日期移到同一列。

examples.en: Our group finished the data wrangling before comparing attendance across events that used different registration forms.
examples.zh: 我们组完成「数据整理」后，才比较使用不同报名表的活动的出勤情况。

words.enDefinition: a maintained data structure that helps the database find or order rows for supported queries

examples.en: The database index helped the practice query locate the recorded loan by its catalogue number and date.
examples.zh: 「数据库索引」帮助练习查询按目录编号和日期定位借阅记录。

examples.en: We considered the cost of maintaining the database index when adding new sample records every day.
examples.zh: 我们考虑了每天新增示例记录时维护「数据库索引」的成本。

words.enDefinition: organising relational tables using dependency rules to reduce unnecessary repetition and prevent common modification anomalies

examples.en: The example used database normalization to keep each instructor's contact details in just one table.
examples.zh: 示例采用「数据库规范化」，使每位教师的联系信息只保存在一张表里。

examples.en: We discussed which inconsistencies database normalization could prevent if the course titles changed during the term.
examples.zh: 我们讨论了在学期内更改课程标题时，「数据库规范化」能防止哪些不一致。

collocations: explain the purpose of database normalization

words.enDefinition: the formal structure of a database, specifying how data and database objects are organised

examples.en: The database schema diagram showed which table stored the names of the supervisors for each room.
examples.zh: 「数据库模式」图显示了哪个表存放各房间负责人的姓名。

examples.en: We reviewed the database schema after changing the tables used to record attendance at weekly workshops.
examples.zh: 更换记录每周工作坊出勤情况的表后，我们复查了「数据库模式」。

words.enDefinition: a unit of database work that succeeds as a whole or has its effects rolled back

examples.en: The database transaction recorded both parts of the practice adjustment before the new totals became visible.
examples.zh: 「数据库事务」先记录练习中调整的两个部分，随后其他会话才看得到新的合计。

examples.en: We grouped the sample updates in a database transaction so the exercise could undo them together.
examples.zh: 我们把示例更新放进同一「数据库事务」，使练习能把它们一起撤销。

words.enDefinition: a named virtual table whose rows are defined by a stored query

examples.en: The database view displayed a calendar using the current rows in the two underlying tables in the example.
examples.zh: 在示例里，「数据库视图」根据两个底层表中的当前数据展示日历。

examples.en: We queried the database view so we could use the same summary without rewriting the original join.
examples.zh: 我们查询「数据库视图」，无需重写原联接就能使用同一汇总结果。

words.enDefinition: A formal reference identifying the dataset used and giving the information needed to locate it.

examples.en: We added a dataset citation to the report so readers could find the original garden records.
examples.zh: 我们在报告里加了「数据集引用」，方便读者找到原始花园记录。

examples.en: The dataset citation specifies the version of the public table used for the classroom exercise.
examples.zh: 「数据集引用」注明课堂练习用的是公开表格的哪个版本。

collocations: dataset citation with a persistent identifier

words.enDefinition: Material explaining how a dataset was collected, organized, and intended to be interpreted or used.

examples.en: The dataset documentation explains why the garden sensor collected fewer readings during the final week.
examples.zh: 「数据集文档」说明了花园传感器为何在最后一周采集到较少读数。

examples.en: Our class read the dataset documentation before selecting columns for the library attendance figure.
examples.zh: 我们班先读「数据集文档」，再为图书馆客流图挑选数据列。

words.enDefinition: the terms under which a particular dataset may be accessed, copied, modified or distributed

examples.en: We checked the dataset licence before including a copy of the public table in our handout.
examples.zh: 我们把公开表格副本放进讲义之前，先查阅了「数据集许可」。

examples.en: The dataset licence requires credit when students reuse the example values in a published chart.
examples.zh: 「数据集许可」要求学生在已发布图表中使用示例数值时注明来源。

words.enDefinition: Descriptive information about a dataset, including details such as its creator, subject, or coverage.

examples.en: The dataset metadata gives the publication date and the period covered by the rainfall readings.
examples.zh: 「数据集元数据」给出了发布日期和降雨量读数覆盖的时段。

examples.en: We updated the dataset metadata when the teaching team released a corrected copy of the file.
examples.zh: 教学团队发布更正后的文件副本时，我们更新了「数据集元数据」。

words.enDefinition: A specific published or saved state of a dataset distinguished from other states.

examples.en: The report states which dataset version contains the corrected library counts for the final week.
examples.zh: 报告写明哪个「数据集版本」包含更正后的最后一周图书馆客流量。

examples.en: Our sample chart changed because the class used a newer dataset version for the workshop.
examples.zh: 工作坊上，全班用了较新的「数据集版本」，示例图随之变化。

words.enDefinition: a disagreement between the layout of supplied dates and the format expected by a parser or data rule

examples.en: A date format mismatch caused dates from one form to be interpreted with the month and day reversed.
examples.zh: 一处「日期格式不匹配」导致某个表单里的日期被按月日颠倒的方式读取。

examples.en: We detected a date format mismatch because the parser rejected dates only after the twelfth day.
examples.zh: 解析程序只拒绝日数大于十二的日期，我们因此发现了「日期格式不匹配」。

words.enDefinition: a number representing a date by counting days from a spreadsheet system's chosen origin

examples.en: The spreadsheet displayed a date serial number after we changed the example cell to a numeric format.
examples.zh: 我们把示例单元格设为数字格式后，电子表格显示了一个「日期序列号」。

examples.en: The tutor checked which date system defined the date serial number before converting it to a calendar date.
examples.zh: 导师确认了「日期序列号」使用哪套日期系统，才将其转换为日历日期。

collocations: identify the origin of a date serial number

words.enDefinition: The treatment of data to remove or weaken links to the people described and reduce disclosure risk.

examples.en: The privacy worksheet presents de-identification as one way to reduce risk before releasing a table.
examples.zh: 隐私练习把「去标识化」列为降低表格发布风险的一种方式。

examples.en: We discussed de-identification while reading the privacy notes that accompanied an example public dataset.
examples.zh: 阅读示例公开数据集附带的隐私说明时，我们讨论了「去标识化」。

words.enDefinition: A state where participants cannot make progress because each waits for an event another waiting participant must cause.

examples.en: The classroom diagram showed a deadlock because each worker was waiting for the other to finish.
examples.zh: 课堂图中，两条工作线程都在等对方结束，因此出现了「死锁」。

examples.en: Our tutor asked how a deadlock differed from one worker simply taking a long time.
examples.zh: 老师问，「死锁」和一条工作线程只是用时很长有什么区别。

collocations: describe a deadlock in a trace

words.enDefinition: A console for messages or interactive evaluation during a debugging session

examples.en: We checked the debug console while the program was stopped at a breakpoint.
examples.zh: 程序停在断点时，我们查看了「调试控制台」。

examples.en: I entered a calculation in the debug console to check the stored value.
examples.zh: 我在「调试控制台」输入一个算式，核对已存储的数值。

collocations: evaluate an expression in the debug console

words.enDefinition: A tool for controlling execution and inspecting what a program does

examples.en: We started the debugger so we could watch the example execute slowly.
examples.zh: 我们启动「调试器」，这样就能慢慢观察示例运行。

examples.en: The debugger showed the program's values while the calculation was paused.
examples.zh: 计算暂停时，「调试器」显示了程序中的各个值。

collocations: run a program in the debugger

words.enDefinition: base-ten representation using the digits zero through nine

examples.en: The class converted a short binary value to decimal notation before checking the answer.
examples.zh: 学生先把一个简短的二进制值转为「十进制记数法」，再核对答案。

examples.en: Our tutor used decimal notation to explain why the leftmost digit carried a larger weight.
examples.zh: 导师用「十进制记数法」解释为什么最左边的数字有更大的位权。

collocations: write a number in decimal notation

words.enDefinition: A boundary in feature space separating regions where a classifier predicts different classes.

examples.en: The diagram showed the decision boundary between plant categories using leaf length and width.
examples.zh: 图中利用叶片长度和宽度展示了植物类别之间的「决策边界」。

examples.en: We noticed that the decision boundary moved after the model saw additional training examples.
examples.zh: 我们注意到，模型加入额外训练样本后，「决策边界」发生了移动。

collocations: learn a decision boundary from data

words.enDefinition: A classifier that follows a series of feature tests from a root to a prediction leaf.

examples.en: The decision tree classifier checked leaf shape first and then considered the length measurement.
examples.zh: 「决策树分类器」先检查叶形，再考虑测得的长度。

examples.en: We followed the decision tree classifier from its first question to the predicted library category.
examples.zh: 我们沿着「决策树分类器」从第一个判断一直走到预测的图书类别。

collocations: limit the depth of a decision tree classifier

words.enDefinition: to recover text from bytes using an encoding

examples.en: The worksheet asked us to decode bytes from a short sample saved with a known encoding.
examples.zh: 练习表要求按已知编码「将一小段样本字节解码为文本」。

examples.en: Our tutor demonstrated how to decode bytes before comparing the resulting greeting with its original text.
examples.zh: 导师演示了怎样「将字节解码为文本」，再把得到的问候语和原文比较。

collocations: decode bytes using the original encoding

words.enDefinition: A failure when bytes cannot be interpreted using the selected encoding

examples.en: The script reported a decoding error when it read the older file.
examples.zh: 脚本读取较旧的文件时报告了「解码错误」。

examples.en: We checked the saved text format after seeing a decoding error in Python.
examples.zh: 在 Python 里看到「解码错误」后，我们检查了文本保存格式。

collocations: read text without a decoding error

words.enDefinition: adding behaviour by wrapping an object while keeping its basic interface

examples.en: The decorator pattern added a border around the sample label without changing the original label class.
examples.zh: 「装饰器模式」为样本标签加了一圈边框，同时保留原标签类的实现。

examples.en: Our tutor combined two wrappers to illustrate the decorator pattern in the drawing exercise.
examples.zh: 导师组合两个包装对象，说明绘图练习里的「装饰器模式」。

collocations: behaviour added through the decorator pattern

words.enDefinition: To remove repeated occurrences of equal elements from a list.

examples.en: We needed to deduplicate a list before counting how many people had joined the game.
examples.zh: 在统计有多少人加入游戏之前，我们需要「对列表去重」。

examples.en: Our tutor asked how to deduplicate a list while keeping each name's first occurrence in place.
examples.zh: 老师问，怎样「对列表去重」，同时保留各姓名第一次出现的顺序。

collocations: deduplicate a list while preserving order
use a set to deduplicate a list

words.enDefinition: a rule specifying which records count as duplicates and which representative to retain

examples.en: Our deduplication rule kept the most recently approved version when the same booking appeared several times.
examples.zh: 同一预订出现多次时，我们的「去重规则」保留最近获批的版本。

examples.en: We tested the deduplication rule on two records with matching dates but different venues.
examples.zh: 我们用两条日期相同、场地不同的记录测试了「去重规则」。

words.enDefinition: the value used for a parameter when the caller does not supply the corresponding argument

examples.en: The default argument value limited the report to ten rows when the caller omitted that setting.
examples.zh: 调用方没提供该设置时，「默认参数值」把报告限定为十行。

examples.en: We changed the default argument value so a short label would appear when none was supplied.
examples.zh: 我们修改了「默认参数值」，使没有提供标签时显示一个简短的标签。

words.enDefinition: the repository branch selected as the initial branch for normal browsing or checkout

examples.en: I checked which default branch our school repository displayed to new users.
examples.zh: 我查看了学校版本库向新用户显示的是哪个「默认分支」。

examples.en: The default branch still showed the class example before our proposed correction.
examples.zh: 「默认分支」仍显示我们提交更正建议前的课堂示例。

words.enDefinition: a branch selected by default when none of the explicitly tested cases matches

examples.en: The default case returned a generic category name when none of the recognised codes matched.
examples.zh: 没有已识别代码匹配时，「默认分支」返回了一个通用的类别名称。

examples.en: We included a default case so the exercise still displayed a label for other ticket types.
examples.zh: 我们加了一个「默认分支」，使练习程序也能给其他票种显示标签。

collocations: fall back to the default case

words.enDefinition: in Java, the constructor implicitly declared when an ordinary class declares no constructor

examples.en: The Java example received a default constructor because its class declared no constructor of its own.
examples.zh: Java 示例的类没有声明任何构造方法，因此获得了「默认构造方法」。

examples.en: Our tutor checked when the compiler would supply a default constructor for the simple class.
examples.zh: 导师核对编译器会在何种情况下为这个简单类提供「默认构造方法」。

words.enDefinition: the single export identified as default in an ES module, which an importing file can bind to a local name

examples.en: The default export provided the main formatter used by both chart examples in the exercise.
examples.zh: 「默认导出」提供了练习中两个图表示例共用的主要格式化器。

examples.en: We imported the default export under a local name that described the helper's purpose in the report.
examples.zh: 我们用一个说明辅助函数在报告中用途的本地名称导入了「默认导出」。

words.enDefinition: an expression used to calculate a column's value when a new row does not provide one

examples.en: The default expression recorded today's date whenever our example added a loan without an explicit date.
examples.zh: 示例新增未明确提供日期的借阅记录时，「默认表达式」会记录当天日期。

examples.en: We changed the default expression so new workshop records started with an empty notes field.
examples.zh: 我们修改了「默认表达式」，让新增工作坊记录的备注字段默认为空。

words.enDefinition: The router a device uses to reach destinations without a more specific route.

examples.en: The default gateway appears beside the classroom computers in our simple campus network diagram.
examples.zh: 在简化的校园网络图里，「默认网关」画在教室电脑旁。

examples.en: The example laptop sends traffic through its default gateway when no more specific route applies.
examples.zh: 没有更具体的路由时，示例电脑通过「默认网关」发送数据。

words.enDefinition: a Java interface method with a provided implementation

examples.en: The Java example declared a default method that supplied a standard label for new shapes.
examples.zh: Java 示例声明了一个「接口默认方法」，为新图形提供统一标签。

examples.en: Our tutor checked whether the implementing class inherited the default method from the drawing interface.
examples.zh: 导师核对实现类是否从绘图接口继承了「接口默认方法」。

words.expression: default value for a missing key
words.lemma: default value for a missing key
words.enDefinition: A fallback value returned when a lookup does not find the requested key.
acceptedEnVariants: default value for a missing key

examples.en: The counting example used zero as the default value for a missing key in the dictionary.
examples.zh: 计数示例用零作为字典中「缺失键的默认值」。

examples.en: We supplied a default value for a missing key so the program could display a blank label.
examples.zh: 我们提供了一个「缺失键的默认值」，让程序可以显示空标签。

collocations: provide a default value for a missing key
choose a default value for a missing key
return a default value for a missing key

words.enDefinition: a deferrable constraint whose current check is postponed until a later point in the transaction

examples.en: The temporary inconsistency was permitted under a deferred constraint because both reference changes completed before the transaction committed.
examples.zh: 「延迟检查的约束」允许中途暂时不一致，因为两处引用变更都在事务提交前完成了。

examples.en: We tested whether the deferred constraint would reject the final state once the classroom transaction tried to commit.
examples.zh: 我们测试课堂事务尝试提交时，「延迟检查的约束」会不会拒绝最终状态。

collocations: check a deferred constraint at commit
switch a deferred constraint to immediate mode

words.enDefinition: A tree where each internal node has only one child

examples.en: The insertion sequence produced a degenerate tree that looked like a chain.
examples.zh: 这个插入顺序产生了一棵看上去像链条的「退化树」。

examples.en: We counted every edge when tracing the degenerate tree from top to bottom.
examples.zh: 我们从上到下跟踪「退化树」时，数了每一条边。

collocations: a search in a degenerate tree

words.enDefinition: To remove the association for a particular key so that the key is no longer present.

examples.en: The editor could delete a mapping when the selected colour was removed from the sample palette.
examples.zh: 从示例调色板移除选中的颜色时，编辑器可以「删除一条键值映射」。

examples.en: Our code checked that the key existed before trying to delete a mapping for that name.
examples.zh: 代码先核对该键是否存在，再尝试为这个名字「删除一条键值映射」。

collocations: delete a mapping for a removed entry
check the key before you delete a mapping

words.enDefinition: a SQL statement removing selected existing rows from a table

examples.en: The DELETE statement removed the cancelled visit from the practice timetable while keeping the other visits in place.
examples.zh: 「DELETE 删除语句」从练习用的日程表移除了已取消的访问，保留了其他访问。

examples.en: We tested the DELETE statement against a disposable copy of the example records used in the tutorial.
examples.zh: 我们在一份用完即可丢弃的示例数据副本上测试了教程中的「DELETE 删除语句」。

collocations: filter rows in a DELETE statement
test a DELETE statement on sample data

words.enDefinition: loss of an independent fact when removing a row that also stores unrelated information

examples.en: A deletion anomaly erased the course title from the sample table when the last registration was removed.
examples.zh: 最后一条选课记录被移除时，「删除异常」让样本表里的课程标题也随之消失。

examples.en: We demonstrated a deletion anomaly by removing the only booking that still contained the classroom's address.
examples.zh: 我们通过删除唯一仍保存教室地址的预订记录，演示了「删除异常」。

words.enDefinition: the character used to separate fields in a text record under the file's format rules

examples.en: The tutor set the delimiter character to a tab because some names contained commas or spaces.
examples.zh: 由于有些名称包含逗号或空格，导师把「字段分隔字符」设为制表符。

examples.en: We checked the delimiter character before importing a text file that placed hyphens inside its record identifiers.
examples.zh: 我们导入一份记录标识符内部含连字符的文本文件之前，核查了「字段分隔字符」。

words.enDefinition: Managing virtual pages by making them resident when they are first needed, instead of loading everything beforehand.

examples.en: The classroom simulator used demand paging to load each part of the sample file only when accessed.
examples.zh: 课堂模拟器采用「请求分页」，只在访问示例文件的某部分时才加载它。

examples.en: Our tutor used demand paging to explain why opening the large sample did not load it all.
examples.zh: 老师用「请求分页」解释为什么打开大样本时不会将其全部加载。

collocations: demonstrate demand paging in a simulator

words.enDefinition: deliberately introducing some redundancy into a relational design to obtain another benefit, such as faster common queries

examples.en: The reporting system used denormalization to keep the frequently requested category name beside each summary record.
examples.zh: 报告系统采用「反规范化」，在各汇总记录旁保存经常要查的类别名称。

examples.en: We discussed who would update the repeated names after denormalization made the report easier to read.
examples.zh: 「反规范化」让报告更易读后，我们讨论了由谁负责更新重复保存的名称。

words.enDefinition: A graph containing many edges relative to the possible connections

examples.en: The dense graph had connections between nearly every pair in the example.
examples.zh: 在这个示例中，「稠密图」几乎每对顶点都相连。

examples.en: We counted the marked entries when drawing the dense graph as a table.
examples.zh: 我们把「稠密图」画成表格后，数了表里标记过的项。

collocations: an adjacency matrix for a dense graph

words.zhGloss: 并列后不跳号的排名函数
words.enDefinition: a SQL window function assigning shared ranks to ties without leaving gaps in subsequent ranks
acceptedZhAnswers: 并列后不跳号的排名函数

examples.en: The DENSE_RANK function gave both top scores rank one and the next distinct score rank two.
examples.zh: 「并列后不跳号的排名函数」把两个最高分都排为第一，把下一个不同的分数排为第二。

examples.en: We used the DENSE_RANK function to display consecutive ranks for each distinct completion time in the exercise.
examples.zh: 我们用「并列后不跳号的排名函数」给练习中各个不同的完成时间显示连续名次。

collocations: rank distinct values with the DENSE_RANK function
compare the DENSE_RANK function with RANK

words.enDefinition: Stored dependency files reused instead of being retrieved on every run

examples.en: The dependency cache held files downloaded by the earlier class build.
examples.zh: 「依赖项缓存」保存了先前课堂构建下载的文件。

examples.en: We compared logs from builds with and without a dependency cache.
examples.zh: 我们对比了使用和未使用「依赖项缓存」的两次构建日志。

words.enDefinition: which component relies on which other component

examples.en: The arrows showed the dependency direction from the drawing tool to its colour selector.
examples.zh: 箭头显示「依赖方向」是从绘图工具指向它的颜色选择器。

examples.en: Our tutor asked whether changing the dependency direction would simplify the example's object construction.
examples.zh: 导师问，改变「依赖方向」会不会简化示例中的对象构建。

words.enDefinition: supplying an object's collaborators from outside its own implementation

examples.en: The sample used dependency injection to give the drawing tool a formatter chosen by the exercise.
examples.zh: 样本用「依赖注入」给绘图工具提供练习指定的格式化对象。

examples.en: Our tutor explained how dependency injection let the same class work with two output implementations.
examples.zh: 导师解释了「依赖注入」怎样让同一个类配合两种输出实现。

words.enDefinition: a component that builds objects and supplies their configured dependencies

examples.en: The class registered two example services with a dependency injection container before creating the drawing tool.
examples.zh: 同学们先把两个示例服务注册到「依赖注入容器」，再创建绘图工具。

examples.en: Our tutor traced how the dependency injection container assembled the formatter and the display object.
examples.zh: 导师追踪「依赖注入容器」怎样把格式化对象和显示对象组装起来。

collocations: register with a dependency injection container
objects built by a dependency injection container

words.enDefinition: the design principle that high-level policy and low-level details depend on abstractions and those abstractions do not depend on implementation details

examples.en: The tutor used the dependency inversion principle to connect a drawing tool to interchangeable output objects.
examples.zh: 导师运用「依赖倒置原则」，让绘图工具连接可互换的输出对象。

examples.en: Our worksheet applied the dependency inversion principle by putting a common interface between the two classes.
examples.zh: 练习表通过在两个类之间设置公共接口，应用了「依赖倒置原则」。

collocations: an example of the dependency inversion principle

words.enDefinition: A file recording resolved dependency versions so later installations can reproduce the same selection.

examples.en: The dependency lockfile records the exact package versions used in the successful analysis run.
examples.zh: 「依赖锁定文件」记录成功运行分析时使用的软件包的确切版本。

examples.en: We checked the dependency lockfile after finding different library versions on the two classroom computers.
examples.zh: 我们发现两台教室电脑上的库版本不同，随后查看了「依赖锁定文件」。

words.enDefinition: A message warning that a feature is discouraged or may be removed

examples.en: The deprecation notice explained that the old formatter might be removed later.
examples.zh: 「弃用通知」说明旧格式化器后续可能被移除。

examples.en: We read the deprecation notice before comparing the old and new options.
examples.zh: 我们先读了「弃用通知」，再比较新旧两个选项。

collocations: a deprecation notice for a feature

words.enDefinition: A search following a branch as far as possible before returning

examples.en: The depth-first search followed one branch until it could go no further.
examples.zh: 「深度优先搜索」沿一条分支前进，直到无法再深入。

examples.en: We drew the path taken by depth-first search through the small puzzle.
examples.zh: 我们画出了「深度优先搜索」在这个小游戏中经过的路径。

collocations: detect a cycle using depth-first search

words.enDefinition: A collection that supports adding and removing elements at both ends.

examples.en: The exercise used a deque so either end could accept a new playing card.
examples.zh: 练习采用「双端队列」，两端都可以放入新的扑克牌。

examples.en: Our tutor showed how a deque could act like a stack or a queue.
examples.zh: 老师演示了「双端队列」怎样既能当栈用，也能当队列用。

collocations: add an item to a deque
remove items from either end of a deque

words.enDefinition: To remove the next item from the front of a queue, usually returning it.

examples.en: The program tried to dequeue a card each time the student clicked the next button.
examples.zh: 学生每次点击下一步按钮，程序都尝试让一张卡片「从队首出队」。

examples.en: Our worksheet asked what value the queue would return if we chose to dequeue once.
examples.zh: 练习表问，如果执行一次「从队首出队」，队列会返回哪个值。

words.enDefinition: a table expression produced by a subquery used as a row source within a query

examples.en: The outer query read a derived table containing one attendance total per room and day in the sample.
examples.zh: 外层查询读取「派生表」，其中每种房间和日期组合各有一个出勤总数。

examples.en: We gave the derived table an alias before using its computed total in a second calculation.
examples.zh: 我们先给「派生表」取了别名，再把它算出的合计用于下一步计算。

collocations: use a derived table in a join

words.enDefinition: A node reachable by following one or more child links downward

examples.en: The deepest descendant node lay three levels below the node we selected.
examples.zh: 最深的「后代节点」比我们选的节点低三层。

examples.en: Our exercise marked every descendant node below the chosen internal node.
examples.zh: 我们的练习标出了指定内部节点下方的所有「后代节点」。

words.enDefinition: a reusable approach to a design problem that occurs repeatedly

examples.en: The tutor introduced one design pattern through a reading app that needed several display formats.
examples.zh: 导师通过一个需要多种显示格式的阅读应用，介绍了一种「设计模式」。

examples.en: Our class discussed why a design pattern could work across languages with different class syntax.
examples.zh: 同学们讨论了为什么一种「设计模式」可用于采用不同类语法的语言。

words.enDefinition: The transport header field identifying the port at the receiving endpoint.

examples.en: The destination port in our request diagram identifies where the catalogue application receives the traffic.
examples.zh: 请求图中的「目的端口」标识目录应用接收数据的位置。

examples.en: In the sample reply, the browser's port appears as the destination port on the worksheet.
examples.zh: 在练习纸上的示例应答中，浏览器端口成了「目的端口」。

words.enDefinition: assigning individual parts of an array or object to separate targets

examples.en: The JavaScript example used destructuring assignment to name the two coordinates in a single statement.
examples.zh: JavaScript 示例用一条「解构赋值」语句分别为两个坐标值命名。

examples.en: We used destructuring assignment to take the title field from a small JavaScript object.
examples.zh: 我们用「解构赋值」提取了一个小型 JavaScript 对象里的标题字段。

words.enDefinition: A Git state with HEAD pointing directly to a commit

examples.en: I saw detached HEAD when viewing a particular old revision for the exercise.
examples.zh: 查看练习某个旧修订版本时，我看到了「分离头指针状态」。

examples.en: Our tutor explained detached HEAD using the stored copy from last week.
examples.zh: 导师用上周保存下来的副本解释了「分离头指针状态」。

collocations: inspect a revision in detached HEAD

words.enDefinition: Execution that produces the same result when the relevant inputs and conditions are the same.

examples.en: The teaching script uses deterministic execution so the same input table always yields the same totals.
examples.zh: 教学脚本采用「确定性执行」，使相同的输入表始终得出同样的总量。

examples.en: Our report explains how deterministic execution lets reviewers compare the two runs figure by figure.
examples.zh: 报告说明「确定性执行」如何让审阅者逐图比较两次运行的结果。

words.enDefinition: Software that lets the operating system communicate with and control a device.

examples.en: The simulator showed how a device driver passed the read request to the storage hardware.
examples.zh: 模拟器演示了「设备驱动程序」怎样把读取请求传给存储硬件。

examples.en: We read the diagram to see where the device driver fit between the operating system and hardware.
examples.zh: 我们看图了解「设备驱动程序」在操作系统与硬件之间处在什么位置。

collocations: a device driver handles a request

words.enDefinition: A collection of requests waiting to be sent to or handled by a device.

examples.en: The diagram showed two pending read requests waiting in the device queue behind an active write.
examples.zh: 图中有两个待读请求在「设备请求队列」里等待，前面有一项正在执行的写入。

examples.en: We compared the order of requests in the device queue with the order in which they finished.
examples.zh: 我们比较了请求在「设备请求队列」中的顺序和它们完成的顺序。

collocations: place a request in a device queue
take a request from the device queue

words.enDefinition: A sequential marker for when a search first discovers a vertex

examples.en: The tutor wrote each DFS discovery time beside the vertex in the diagram.
examples.zh: 导师在图中的顶点旁写上各自的「深搜发现时间戳」。

examples.en: We compared the DFS discovery time with the recorded completion marker for that vertex.
examples.zh: 我们把「深搜发现时间戳」和那个顶点记录的完成标记作了对照。

words.enDefinition: The recorded point when depth-first exploration of a vertex finishes

examples.en: We recorded the DFS finish time after exploring the vertex and its search descendants.
examples.zh: 完成该顶点及其搜索树后代的探索后，我们记录了「深搜完成时间戳」。

examples.en: We wrote the DFS finish time beside the point where the search returned.
examples.zh: 我们在图中的搜索返回处写了「深搜完成时间戳」。

collocations: order vertices by DFS finish time

words.enDefinition: ambiguity when a class reaches the same ancestor through multiple inheritance paths

examples.en: The tutor drew two paths to the same ancestor to illustrate the diamond problem.
examples.zh: 导师画出通向同一祖先类的两条路径，说明「菱形继承问题」。

examples.en: Our exercise discussed the diamond problem before applying Python's method resolution rules to the example.
examples.zh: 练习先讨论了「菱形继承问题」，再将 Python 的方法解析规则用于示例。

words.enDefinition: A shortest-path method that requires edges with nonnegative weights

examples.en: We applied Dijkstra's algorithm to a map whose walking times were all positive.
examples.zh: 我们把「迪杰斯特拉算法」用于步行耗时都为正数的地图。

examples.en: The worksheet showed the next vertex chosen by Dijkstra's algorithm during the search.
examples.zh: 练习表显示了搜索时「迪杰斯特拉算法」选定的下一个顶点。

collocations: use Dijkstra's algorithm on a weighted graph

words.enDefinition: Representing observations with fewer dimensions while retaining useful information from the original features.

examples.en: The team used dimensionality reduction to represent many leaf measurements with a smaller set of values.
examples.zh: 团队用「降维」将多项叶片测量值表示成一组较少的值。

examples.en: Our tutor asked which information was lost during dimensionality reduction in the book description exercise.
examples.zh: 老师问，在图书描述练习的「降维」过程中丢失了哪些信息。

words.enDefinition: A value such as a name or unique assigned number that directly identifies a person.

examples.en: The worksheet classifies a full name as a direct identifier in its fictional registration table.
examples.zh: 练习纸把虚构登记表里的完整姓名归为「直接标识符」。

examples.en: We marked each direct identifier on the example form before considering what the published table needs.
examples.zh: 在考虑公开表格需要哪些字段之前，我们标出了示例表单上的所有「直接标识符」。

words.enDefinition: The practice of placing explanatory text next to the chart marks it describes.

examples.en: Direct labelling places each garden's name at the end of its rainfall line on the chart.
examples.zh: 「直接标注」把每个花园的名称放在其降雨量线条的末端。

examples.en: We used direct labelling to identify the groups on the printed black and white chart.
examples.zh: 我们用「直接标注」标识黑白印刷图中的各个组别。

words.enDefinition: Data transfer between a device and memory without the processor moving each piece of data itself.

examples.en: The device model used direct memory access to move a block of samples into memory.
examples.zh: 设备模型通过「直接内存访问」把一块样本数据传入内存。

examples.en: Our diagram showed the processor setting up the transfer before direct memory access began.
examples.zh: 图中显示，在「直接内存访问」开始前，处理器先设置好这次传输。

collocations: use direct memory access for a transfer

words.enDefinition: A directed graph with no route forming a directed cycle

examples.en: Our course requirements formed a directed acyclic graph in the simplified example.
examples.zh: 在简化示例中，课程要求组成了一个「有向无环图」。

examples.en: We drew a directed acyclic graph before putting its tasks into order.
examples.zh: 我们先画了一个「有向无环图」，再给图上的任务排序。

collocations: check for a directed acyclic graph

words.enDefinition: A graph whose edges each have a specified direction

examples.en: The directed graph represented which course had to come before another.
examples.zh: 「有向图」表示哪门课必须排在另一门之前。

examples.en: We used arrows when drawing the directed graph on the board.
examples.zh: 我们画白板上的「有向图」时用了箭头。

collocations: represent dependencies in a directed graph

words.enDefinition: reading another transaction's changes before that transaction has committed them

examples.en: The diagram labelled the observation a dirty read because the other transaction still had not committed its changes.
examples.zh: 示意图把该次读取标作「脏读」，因为另一个事务还没提交更改。

examples.en: We explained why a dirty read might expose a value that later vanished after the writer rolled back.
examples.zh: 我们解释了为什么「脏读」可能读到一个在写入方回滚后便消失的值。

words.enDefinition: An examination of information before release to check for confidentiality or privacy concerns.

examples.en: The example table goes through disclosure review before it is added to the public report.
examples.zh: 示例表在写入公开报告之前要经过「披露审查」。

examples.en: Our project notes say who completed the disclosure review and which version was examined.
examples.zh: 项目笔记写明谁完成了「披露审查」，以及审查的是哪个版本。

words.enDefinition: The possibility that sharing data would reveal protected information about the units they describe.

examples.en: The review considers disclosure risk before the team publishes the example district attendance table.
examples.zh: 团队发布示例各区客流表之前，审查会考虑「披露风险」。

examples.en: We wrote a short note explaining how the proposed chart changes could reduce disclosure risk.
examples.zh: 我们写了一段简短说明，解释拟议的图表改动如何降低「披露风险」。

words.enDefinition: replacing values from a continuous scale with a finite set of categories or intervals

examples.en: The discretisation step assigned each distance to one of four ranges for the classroom report.
examples.zh: 「离散化」步骤把各距离划入四个区间之一，以便制作课堂报告。

examples.en: We compared values before and after discretisation to see how much precision the summary lost.
examples.zh: 我们比较「离散化」前后的数值，了解汇总损失了多少精度。

words.enDefinition: Sets that have no elements in common.

examples.en: The program recognised disjoint sets after finding no colours shared by the two palettes.
examples.zh: 程序发现两个调色板没有共同颜色，认定它们是「不相交的集合」。

examples.en: Our drawing used separate circles to represent disjoint sets of animals in the example.
examples.zh: 例题图示中，我们用彼此分开的圆表示两组「不相交的集合」。

words.enDefinition: Movement of a traditional hard disk's read or write head to the required track.

examples.en: The diagram used a disk seek to show how the head reached another track.
examples.zh: 图中通过一次「磁盘寻道」展示磁头怎样到达另一条磁道。

examples.en: Our tutor compared a disk seek on a hard drive with reading a solid-state drive.
examples.zh: 老师对比了机械硬盘的「磁盘寻道」和固态硬盘的读取过程。

collocations: reduce the number of disk seeks

words.enDefinition: the rows remaining when duplicate combinations of selected values are removed from a query result

examples.en: We selected distinct rows to produce one entry per room and date combination in the timetable.
examples.zh: 我们选择「去重后的行」，使日程表中每种房间与日期组合只有一条记录。

examples.en: The example counted distinct rows after selecting the two location fields needed for the exercise.
examples.zh: 示例选出练习所需的两个地点字段后，统计了「去重后的行」。

words.enDefinition: A change in how data or outcomes are distributed between training and later use or evaluation.

examples.en: The team suspected distribution shift because the new leaf photographs were taken under very different lighting.
examples.zh: 新叶片照片的光照条件差异很大，团队怀疑出现了「分布偏移」。

examples.en: We discussed distribution shift after finding that the new library featured many book genres absent from training.
examples.zh: 发现新图书馆中有不少训练时没有见过的图书体裁后，我们讨论了「分布偏移」。

collocations: evaluate a model under distribution shift

words.enDefinition: A colour scale with contrasting colours on the two sides of a meaningful midpoint.

examples.en: The diverging colour scale uses different hues above and below zero in our temperature chart.
examples.zh: 示例温度图的「发散色标」在零点上下采用不同色相。

examples.en: We used a diverging colour scale to distinguish readings above and below the long-term average.
examples.zh: 我们用「发散色标」区分高于与低于长期平均值的读数。

words.enDefinition: A method splitting a problem into smaller parts and combining solutions

examples.en: The tutor used a divide-and-conquer algorithm to explain splitting work into smaller pieces.
examples.zh: 导师用「分治算法」解释如何把工作拆成更小的部分。

examples.en: Our divide-and-conquer algorithm solved each half before combining the two results.
examples.zh: 我们的「分治算法」先解决两半的子问题，再合并两个结果。

words.enDefinition: A request to find information associated with a name in the Domain Name System.

examples.en: The lesson starts with a DNS lookup for the address of the example catalogue service.
examples.zh: 这堂课先做一次「DNS 查询」，查找示例目录服务的地址。

examples.en: In our diagram, a DNS lookup happens before the browser sends its first catalogue request.
examples.zh: 图中，浏览器在发送首次目录请求前先做一次「DNS 查询」。

words.enDefinition: An entry in DNS containing a particular type of information for a name.

examples.en: The sample DNS record associates the catalogue name with a classroom example IP address.
examples.zh: 示例「DNS 记录」把目录名称与课堂用的示例 IP 地址关联起来。

examples.en: The tutor asked us to identify the type of each DNS record on the sheet.
examples.zh: 老师让我们辨认练习纸上每条「DNS 记录」的类型。

words.enDefinition: A value in seconds specifying how long a DNS record may be kept in a cache before it must be refreshed for ordinary reuse.

examples.en: The worksheet gives the DNS record TTL in seconds next to each sample answer.
examples.zh: 练习纸在每个示例答案旁用秒标明了「DNS 记录生存时间」。

examples.en: The resolver can reuse this cached answer while the DNS record TTL has time remaining.
examples.zh: 「DNS 记录生存时间」还有剩余时，解析器可以复用这个缓存答案。

words.enDefinition: A portion of the DNS namespace managed as a unit by the responsible authority.

examples.en: The DNS zone on our diagram covers the names assigned to the example department.
examples.zh: 图中的「DNS 区」涵盖分配给示例院系的名称。

examples.en: The second team drew a separate DNS zone for the delegated part of the tree.
examples.zh: 第二组为域名树中委托出去的部分画了一个独立的「DNS 区」。

words.enDefinition: a loop that executes its body before checking whether another iteration should run

examples.en: The do-while loop displayed the menu once before checking whether the user wanted to see it again.
examples.zh: 「do-while 循环」先显示了一次菜单，再检查用户是否想重新查看。

examples.en: We chose a do-while loop because the program needed one reading before it could test the condition.
examples.zh: 我们选择「do-while 循环」，因为程序必须先取得一条读数才能判断条件。

collocations: compare a do-while loop with a while loop

words.enDefinition: The model that represents a document as objects in a tree and defines ways to work with them.

examples.en: The Document Object Model lets the class describe the catalogue as a tree of related nodes.
examples.zh: 「文档对象模型」让全班可以把目录描述为由相互关联的节点组成的树。

examples.en: We traced the Document Object Model from the list element to its first item.
examples.zh: 我们顺着「文档对象模型」，从列表元素找到它的第一项。

words.enDefinition: An object in a DOM tree, such as an element node, a text node, or the document itself.

examples.en: The tree diagram shows a DOM node for the text inside the example heading.
examples.zh: 树状图用一个「DOM 节点」表示示例标题里的文字。

examples.en: We followed the links from one DOM node to its parent in the catalogue exercise.
examples.zh: 在目录练习中，我们沿着节点关系，从一个「DOM 节点」找到它的父节点。

words.enDefinition: The distributed naming system that stores information associated with domain names.

examples.en: The Domain Name System lets software look up information using a name such as example.org.
examples.zh: 「域名系统」让软件能用 example.org 这样的名称查询相关信息。

examples.en: We drew the Domain Name System as a tree to show how its names are arranged.
examples.zh: 我们把「域名系统」画成一棵树，展示名称是怎样分层的。

words.enDefinition: an object representing a concept from the problem being modelled

examples.en: The library example treated a loan as a domain object with rules about returns.
examples.zh: 图书馆示例把借阅记录视为一个带有归还规则的「领域对象」。

examples.en: Our tutor asked which domain object represented the student's place in the reading programme.
examples.zh: 导师问，哪个「领域对象」表示学生在阅读项目中的名额。

words.enDefinition: The event fired after the HTML document has been parsed and the scripts that delay it have executed.

examples.en: The DOMContentLoaded event fires while the large cover image is still loading in our example.
examples.zh: 示例中，大幅封面图片仍在加载时，「DOMContentLoaded 事件」就已触发。

examples.en: We recorded the DOMContentLoaded event on the timeline after the browser finished parsing the HTML.
examples.zh: 浏览器解析完 HTML 后，我们在时间线上记录了「DOMContentLoaded 事件」。

words.enDefinition: A chart that represents quantities or the distribution of observations with dots along a scale.

examples.en: The dot plot makes it easy to count how many plants have each recorded height.
examples.zh: 「点图」让人容易数出每个记录高度分别对应多少株植物。

examples.en: We used a dot plot to show each group's total on one shared numerical axis.
examples.zh: 我们用「点图」把各组总量显示在同一条数值轴上。

words.enDefinition: floating-point precision commonly implemented with the binary64 format

examples.en: The exercise compared double precision with a smaller format when storing the same fractional value.
examples.zh: 存储同一个小数值时，练习比较了「双精度」和一种较小的格式。

examples.en: JavaScript Number arithmetic used double precision in the sample, but some decimal fractions remained inexact.
examples.zh: 示例中的 JavaScript Number 运算使用「双精度」，但有些十进制小数仍只能近似表示。

collocations: a value stored in double precision

words.enDefinition: A linked list with links to both the previous and next nodes.

examples.en: The doubly linked list let students move through the sample photo collection in either direction.
examples.zh: 借助「双向链表」，学生可向两个方向查看示例照片集。

examples.en: Our tutor drew two arrows between neighbouring nodes in the example of a doubly linked list.
examples.zh: 老师画「双向链表」示例时，在相邻节点之间画了两个方向的箭头。

collocations: insert into a doubly linked list
walk a doubly linked list backwards

words.enDefinition: A proposed merge marked as work still in progress

examples.en: We opened a draft pull request while the example still needed its final check.
examples.zh: 示例还缺最后一项检查时，我们创建了「草稿拉取请求」。

examples.en: The draft pull request let my partner see changes before I finished testing.
examples.zh: 「草稿拉取请求」让同伴能在我测完之前看到改动。

collocations: mark a draft pull request ready

words.enDefinition: using a value according to what operations it supports

examples.en: The Python exercise used duck typing to draw objects that each supplied a draw method.
examples.zh: Python 练习用「鸭子类型」绘制各自提供 draw 方法的对象。

examples.en: Our tutor used duck typing when both unrelated classes supported the same operation in practice.
examples.zh: 两个无继承关系的类都支持同一操作时，导师使用了「鸭子类型」。

words.enDefinition: A chart that connects two dots on a shared scale to show a difference for each category.

examples.en: The dumbbell plot connects the morning and afternoon visitor counts for each example library branch.
examples.zh: 「哑铃图」把每家示例图书馆分馆上午和下午的访客数连接起来。

examples.en: We read the gap between the two dots for October on the dumbbell plot.
examples.zh: 我们在「哑铃图」上读取十月对应的两个点相距多远。

words.enDefinition: a repeated key value or combination that is expected to identify a unique record

examples.en: The reader reported a duplicate key because two catalogue entries had been assigned the same code.
examples.zh: 两条目录记录被分配了相同编码，因此读取程序报告了「重复键值」。

examples.en: We inspected the duplicate key before deciding which of the two room records needed correction.
examples.zh: 在确定两条房间记录中哪一条需要更正前，我们核对了「重复键值」。

collocations: check which records share a duplicate key

words.enDefinition: an index or column label appearing more than once on the same axis

examples.en: The duplicate label meant selecting that date returned two rows from the example data frame.
examples.zh: 由于存在「重复标签」，按该日期选择时会从示例数据框返回两行。

examples.en: We changed one duplicate label after discovering that two columns both had the heading Attendance.
examples.zh: 发现有两列标题都叫 Attendance 后，我们修改了其中一个「重复标签」。

words.enDefinition: a data row repeating another row's values under the chosen comparison fields

examples.en: The file contained a duplicate row because the same completed form was entered twice by accident.
examples.zh: 同一份已填表单不慎录入两次，因此文件包含一条「重复行」。

examples.en: We verified the duplicate row against the source before removing one of the two copies.
examples.zh: 我们先用来源数据核对「重复行」，再删去两条中的一条。

words.enDefinition: An array-backed collection that can increase its storage capacity as elements are added.

examples.en: Our dynamic array grew when the program added a sixth colour to the drawing palette.
examples.zh: 程序给绘图调色板增加第六种颜色时，「动态数组」扩大了容量。

examples.en: The tutor used a dynamic array because the number of readings was unknown before the exercise.
examples.zh: 老师用了「动态数组」，因为练习开始前无法确定读数有多少。

words.enDefinition: selecting a method implementation at runtime based on the receiver

examples.en: The Java example demonstrated dynamic dispatch when the shape reference pointed to a rectangle object.
examples.zh: 当图形引用指向矩形对象时，Java 示例演示了「动态分派」。

examples.en: Our tutor traced dynamic dispatch to find which drawing method ran for the sample object.
examples.zh: 导师追踪「动态分派」，找出样本对象实际执行的是哪个绘图方法。

collocations: a method chosen by dynamic dispatch

words.enDefinition: Solving a problem by storing and combining answers to smaller subproblems

examples.en: We used dynamic programming to reuse counts of shorter routes in the maze.
examples.zh: 我们用「动态规划」复用迷宫中较短路线的计数结果。

examples.en: The tutor introduced dynamic programming with a table for a route-counting puzzle.
examples.zh: 导师用一张路线计数谜题的表格介绍了「动态规划」。

collocations: solve a problem with dynamic programming

words.enDefinition: a type discipline in which the types of runtime values determine which operations are valid as the program runs

examples.en: Our Python exercise illustrated dynamic typing by assigning values of different types to one name.
examples.zh: Python 练习把不同类型的值赋给同一个名称，演示了「动态类型机制」。

examples.en: The tutor linked dynamic typing to the error raised when our Python program combined incompatible values.
examples.zh: 导师解释了 Python 程序组合不兼容的值时报错与「动态类型机制」有什么关系。

words.enDefinition: a return executed before a function reaches its main logic or the end of its body

examples.en: The early return prevented the function from computing an average when the list had no valid readings.
examples.zh: 列表没有有效读数时，「提前返回」避免了函数继续计算平均值。

examples.en: We used an early return for the special case where both intervals were already known to match.
examples.zh: 两个区间已知匹配是一种特殊情况，我们对此采用了「提前返回」。

collocations: handle an empty input with an early return

words.enDefinition: Ending training when a monitored criterion suggests further fitting is unlikely to improve the model.

examples.en: We used early stopping after the validation loss stopped improving across several rounds of training.
examples.zh: 验证损失连续几轮未改善后，我们采用了「提前停止」。

examples.en: The tutor compared early stopping with letting the classroom experiment continue for the full planned duration.
examples.zh: 老师对比了「提前停止」和让课堂实验跑完全部预定时长的做法。

collocations: monitor validation loss for early stopping

words.enDefinition: Display characters or data just received from the user again

examples.en: The sample chose to echo the input before calculating the total from it.
examples.zh: 示例选择先「回显输入」，再据此计算总数。

examples.en: I added a line to echo the input while checking what the program read.
examples.zh: 我添加一行来「回显输入」，检查程序读到了什么。

collocations: configure a program to echo the input
decide whether to echo the input

words.enDefinition: A graph representation storing its edges as pairs of endpoints

examples.en: The edge list had one pair for each path in the diagram.
examples.zh: 「边列表」为图中每段路径记录了一对顶点。

examples.en: We converted the edge list into a record of neighbours for each vertex.
examples.zh: 我们把「边列表」转换为记录各顶点邻居的数据。

collocations: store weights in an edge list

words.enDefinition: Updating a distance estimate if going through an edge improves it

examples.en: An edge relaxation lowered the distance recorded for the final vertex in class.
examples.zh: 课上，一次「边松弛」降低了最后一个顶点记录的距离。

examples.en: We traced edge relaxation by checking whether the new route was cheaper.
examples.zh: 我们通过查看新路线是否代价更低来跟踪「边松弛」。

collocations: update a predecessor during edge relaxation

words.enDefinition: A numeric value representing the cost or length of an edge

examples.en: The edge weight showed the number of minutes for one route segment.
examples.zh: 「边权」表示一段路线需要多少分钟。

examples.en: I changed an edge weight and recalculated the cheapest route on paper.
examples.zh: 我改了一个「边权」，在纸上重新计算了成本最低的路线。

words.enDefinition: The in-memory copy of a file being edited before changes are saved

examples.en: My changes were in the editor buffer while the old script still ran.
examples.zh: 我的修改还在「编辑器缓冲区」里，运行的仍是旧脚本。

examples.en: The editor restored the editor buffer when I reopened the lab project.
examples.zh: 我重新打开实验项目时，编辑器恢复了「编辑器缓冲区」。

words.enDefinition: The margin beside source lines showing numbers, markers, or other indicators

examples.en: I saw a red dot in the editor gutter beside the print line.
examples.zh: 我看到打印语句旁边的「编辑器侧栏」有一个红点。

examples.en: The editor gutter displayed line numbers in the IDE used for our lab.
examples.zh: 实验课用的集成开发环境在「编辑器侧栏」里显示行号。

collocations: a mark in the editor gutter
line numbers in the editor gutter

words.enDefinition: a Python clause testing another condition when earlier branches of the same if statement were skipped

examples.en: The first elif clause checked whether the recorded score qualified for the second award level.
examples.zh: 第一个「elif 子句」检查记录分数是否达到了第二档奖项的要求。

examples.en: We added an elif clause for entries created this month but updated before the review date.
examples.zh: 我们为本月创建且在审查日期前更新的条目加了一个「elif 子句」。

words.enDefinition: an optional alternative clause taken when the preceding conditions do not succeed, in a conditional statement

examples.en: The else clause displayed a neutral icon whenever no matching colour had been set for the category.
examples.zh: 没有为类别设置匹配颜色时，「else 子句」会显示一个中性的图标。

examples.en: We moved that prompt into the else clause after confirming it belonged to the other outcome.
examples.zh: 确认该提示属于另一种结果后，我们把它移到了「else 子句」。

words.enDefinition: a sequence of connected conditional branches tested in order until one applies

examples.en: The else-if chain checked booking sizes from the largest group to the smallest group first.
examples.zh: 这条「多路条件判断链」先检查人数最多的预订，再依次判断规模较小的团体。

examples.en: We shortened the else-if chain by removing a branch that could never match any valid value.
examples.zh: 我们删掉一个无法匹配任何有效值的分支，缩短了「多路条件判断链」。

collocations: reorder branches in an else-if chain

words.enDefinition: A linked list with no data nodes, even if its implementation uses a sentinel.

examples.en: Our empty linked list contained only a sentinel, so the exercise reported a size of zero.
examples.zh: 我们的「空链表」只有一个哨兵节点，因此练习报告的大小为零。

examples.en: Before adding the first note, we checked how the diagram represented an empty linked list.
examples.zh: 加入第一条笔记之前，我们查看了图中怎样表示「空链表」。

collocations: test for an empty linked list
append to an empty linked list

words.enDefinition: a string containing no text units

examples.en: The example returned an empty string when the user cleared the sample label field.
examples.zh: 用户清空样本标签字段后，示例返回「空字符串」。

examples.en: Our tutor asked whether adding an empty string would change the greeting's length.
examples.zh: 导师问，加上一个「空字符串」是否会改变问候语的长度。

words.enDefinition: grouping state with behaviour and controlling how callers use it

examples.en: The library example used encapsulation to keep borrowing status with the methods that changed it.
examples.zh: 图书馆示例用「封装」把借阅状态和改变该状态的方法放在一起。

examples.en: Our tutor explained how encapsulation let the class maintain valid values through its public operations.
examples.zh: 导师解释了「封装」如何让类通过公开操作维持有效的值。

words.enDefinition: a scope surrounding the current scope in the source structure

examples.en: The nested function read the selected unit from its enclosing scope on every call in the example.
examples.zh: 示例的嵌套函数每次调用都从其「外层作用域」读取所选单位。

examples.en: We located the enclosing scope before deciding which declaration supplied the label seen by the nested code.
examples.zh: 我们先找出「外层作用域」，再判断嵌套代码看到的标签来自哪条声明。

collocations: look up a name in an enclosing scope
update a binding in an enclosing scope

words.enDefinition: to represent text as bytes using an encoding

examples.en: The Python exercise asked us to encode text before saving the short greeting as bytes.
examples.zh: Python 练习要求我们先「对文本编码」，再以字节保存这句简短问候语。

examples.en: We used UTF-8 to encode text containing both an English greeting and an accented name.
examples.zh: 我们用 UTF-8「对文本编码」，文本里包含英语问候语和带重音符号的姓名。

collocations: encode text using a chosen character encoding

words.enDefinition: The state reached when no more data remains to be read

examples.en: The reader detected an end-of-file condition after the last recorded price.
examples.zh: 读取程序读完最后一个价格后，检测到「文件结束状态」。

examples.en: The example stopped reading once it reached the end-of-file condition in the text file.
examples.zh: 示例读到文本文件的「文件结束状态」后就不再读取。

words.enDefinition: A test following a complete workflow through the relevant software system

examples.en: The end-to-end test created a practice booking and displayed its confirmation on screen.
examples.zh: 「端到端测试」创建了一笔模拟预订，并在屏幕上显示确认信息。

examples.en: We wrote an end-to-end test that began with an empty draft and exported a report.
examples.zh: 我们写了一个从空草稿开始、最终导出报告的「端到端测试」。

collocations: an end-to-end test of a workflow

words.enDefinition: the order used to store a multi-byte numeric value

examples.en: We marked the endianness beside each two-byte example so everyone could read the value consistently.
examples.zh: 我们在每个双字节示例旁标出「字节序」，让大家用一致的方式读取数值。

examples.en: Our tutor asked why changing the endianness could change the interpretation of the same stored bytes.
examples.zh: 导师问，为什么更改「字节序」可能改变对同一串已存储字节的解读。

collocations: the endianness of a byte sequence

words.enDefinition: To insert an item at the end of a queue.

examples.en: The simulator would enqueue each colour card as soon as the student clicked its button.
examples.zh: 学生点击某张颜色卡的按钮后，模拟器马上让该卡「入队」。

examples.en: We watched the queue length increase after asking the program to enqueue two more items.
examples.zh: 让程序把另外两项「入队」后，我们看到队列变长了。

words.enDefinition: a diagram showing the types of entities in a data model and the relationships between them

examples.en: The entity relationship diagram showed how borrowers, books and their loans would fit together in the database.
examples.zh: 「实体关系图」显示了借阅人、图书和借阅记录在数据库里的关联方式。

examples.en: We revised the entity relationship diagram after learning that each course could have several instructors.
examples.zh: 得知每门课程可以有多名教师后，我们修改了「实体关系图」。

words.enDefinition: An opaque value supplied by a server to identify a particular representation for comparison.

examples.en: The server assigns an entity tag to the example stylesheet so the browser can check it later.
examples.zh: 服务器给示例样式表分配一个「实体标签」，便于浏览器之后检查。

examples.en: The entity tag in our worksheet differs between the two versions of the same timetable.
examples.zh: 练习中的同一份时间表有两个版本，「实体标签」不同。

words.enDefinition: The location or function where a program begins running

examples.en: The example used its main method as the entry point for execution.
examples.zh: 示例用主方法作为执行的「程序入口」。

examples.en: I marked the entry point before describing what the program did next.
examples.zh: 我先标出「程序入口」，再描述程序接下来的操作。

words.enDefinition: A file or document listing the software and settings needed to recreate a computing environment.

examples.en: The environment specification lists the interpreter and the packages used to generate the example table.
examples.zh: 「环境配置说明」列出生成示例表时所用的解释器和软件包。

examples.en: Our group read the environment specification before trying to reproduce the two classroom figures.
examples.zh: 我们组先读了「环境配置说明」，再尝试复现两张课堂图表。

words.enDefinition: a Python exception raised by operations such as input when they encounter end-of-file without reading a value

examples.en: The exercise displayed EOFError when it expected another line but received nothing.
examples.zh: 练习程序需要再读一行却没收到内容，因此显示「输入提前结束异常」。

examples.en: We saw EOFError after the example tried to read from empty input.
examples.zh: 示例尝试从空的输入中读取时，我们看到了「输入提前结束异常」。

words.enDefinition: grouping data into intervals intended to contain roughly the same number of observations

examples.en: The tutor used equal-frequency binning to create four groups with similar numbers of observations despite different interval widths.
examples.zh: 导师用「等频分箱」创建四组，各组的观测值数量相近，但区间宽度不同。

examples.en: We checked whether ties prevented equal-frequency binning from dividing the sample into equally populated groups.
examples.zh: 我们检查相同取值是否使「等频分箱」无法把样本划分为条数相同的组。

words.enDefinition: grouping numeric data into intervals of the same width

examples.en: We used equal-width binning to group the full range of temperatures into five intervals of identical size.
examples.zh: 我们用「等宽分箱」把整个温度范围划入五个等宽区间。

examples.en: The equal-width binning produced one interval with no observations because the readings left a gap there.
examples.zh: 读数在一段范围内没有取值，因此「等宽分箱」产生了一个没有观测值的区间。

collocations: choose cut points for equal-width binning
compare equal-width binning with equal-frequency binning

words.enDefinition: A test check requiring the observed and expected values to match

examples.en: Our equality assertion compared the stored room name with a short expected value.
examples.zh: 我们的「相等断言」把所存房间名和一个较短的期望值作了比较。

examples.en: The equality assertion checked that both reports began with the same three headings.
examples.zh: 「相等断言」检查两份报告是否都以同样三个标题开始。

collocations: an equality assertion for two values

words.enDefinition: a join that matches rows using equality between the relevant values

examples.en: The equi-join compared each loan's catalogue code with the matching code in the table of books.
examples.zh: 「等值联接」将每条借阅记录的目录编码与图书表中的对应编码比较。

examples.en: We used an equi-join because the matching rule required exact agreement between the two workshop identifiers.
examples.zh: 因为匹配规则要求两个工作坊标识符完全一致，我们使用了「等值联接」。

collocations: compare an equi-join with a range join

words.enDefinition: A line attached to a plotted value showing a specified range of uncertainty or variation.

examples.en: The caption explains what each error bar measures around the average plant height in the example.
examples.zh: 图注解释了示例中平均株高旁每条「误差线」表示什么。

examples.en: We added an error bar to each average and explained the chosen range below the plot.
examples.zh: 我们给每个平均值加上一条「误差线」，并在图下说明所选范围。

words.enDefinition: a JavaScript module that uses the ECMAScript system for module imports and exports

examples.en: We converted the helper into an ES module and imported it from the main example file.
examples.zh: 我们把辅助函数改成「ES 模块」，在主要示例文件中导入它。

examples.en: The tutor showed that an ES module could have private names as well as visible exports.
examples.zh: 导师演示了「ES 模块」既可以有模块内部的名称，也可以对外导出名称。

collocations: export a function from an ES module

words.enDefinition: source characters representing a character or action indirectly

examples.en: The worksheet inserted an escape sequence to place a line break inside the greeting.
examples.zh: 练习表插入了一个「转义序列」，在问候语中加进换行。

examples.en: Our tutor checked which escape sequence represented a tab in the sample source code.
examples.zh: 导师检查了样本源代码中哪个「转义序列」表示制表符。

collocations: an escape sequence for a newline

words.enDefinition: A structured unit of data used to deliver information over an Ethernet link.

examples.en: We drew an Ethernet frame around the IP packet on the classroom whiteboard today.
examples.zh: 我们今天在教室白板上画出了把 IP 包封装在内的「以太网帧」。

examples.en: In the sample Ethernet frame, the two address fields identify interfaces on the local link.
examples.zh: 在示例「以太网帧」中，两个地址字段用来标识本地链路上的接口。

words.enDefinition: A defined numerical measure used to judge predictions or another model outcome.

examples.en: Our group chose an evaluation metric that expressed sorting time errors directly in minutes.
examples.zh: 我们组选了一个以分钟直接表示分拣用时误差的「评估指标」。

examples.en: The tutor asked why that evaluation metric was useful for comparing the two plant classifiers.
examples.zh: 老师问，为什么这个「评估指标」适合比较这两个植物分类器。

collocations: compare models using the same evaluation metric

words.enDefinition: a matching rule requiring identical values for the chosen comparison fields under stated normalisation

examples.en: The exact match rule compared both the workshop code and its recorded date in our exercise.
examples.zh: 我们的练习用「精确匹配规则」同时比较工作坊编号和记录日期。

examples.en: We used an exact match rule after standardising the extra spaces in the library codes.
examples.zh: 统一清除图书馆编号中的多余空格后，我们采用「精确匹配规则」。

words.enDefinition: a Python clause that handles exceptions of the selected type or types, or all exceptions if none are specified

examples.en: The except clause used the filename in its message after Python could not open the requested file.
examples.zh: Python 无法打开请求的文件后，「except 子句」在消息中显示了文件名。

examples.en: We narrowed the except clause to handle the error we expected from converting a malformed date.
examples.zh: 我们缩小了「except 子句」的处理范围，只处理转换格式错误的日期时预期的错误。

collocations: specify an exception type in an except clause

words.enDefinition: a SQL operator returning rows of the first input absent from the second, with duplicates removed by default

examples.en: The EXCEPT operator returned titles on the current list that were absent from last term's list.
examples.zh: 「EXCEPT 差集运算符」返回本期清单上有而上学期课程清单上没有的标题。

examples.en: We used the EXCEPT operator to identify product codes present last month but missing from the latest extract.
examples.zh: 我们用「EXCEPT 差集运算符」找出上月有、最新提取结果中没有的产品编号。

collocations: find differences with the EXCEPT operator
compare lists using the EXCEPT operator

words.enDefinition: A test check requiring a specified exception from some code

examples.en: We added an exception assertion for an impossible date in the example parser.
examples.zh: 我们给示例解析器加了一条「异常断言」，测试一个不可能出现的日期。

examples.en: The exception assertion checked which error the converter raised for an empty value.
examples.zh: 「异常断言」检查换算器遇到空值时会抛出哪个异常。

collocations: an exception assertion for invalid input

words.enDefinition: associating one exception with another through an explicit cause or an implicit handling context

examples.en: Python's exception chaining showed that the formatting failure came from an earlier error while converting the input.
examples.zh: Python 的「异常链」显示，格式化失败源于先前转换输入时的错误。

examples.en: We used exception chaining to retain the original cause while reporting the higher-level operation that failed.
examples.zh: 我们用「异常链」保留原始原因，同时报告失败的上层操作。

collocations: preserve a cause with exception chaining

words.enDefinition: code that runs when a matching exception is raised and reaches the construct that handles it

examples.en: The exception handler displayed a useful message when the imported file contained a date with an invalid format.
examples.zh: 导入文件包含格式无效的日期时，「异常处理程序」显示了一条有帮助的提示。

examples.en: We added an exception handler for missing input so the notebook could keep processing the other files.
examples.zh: 我们为缺少输入的情况添加了「异常处理程序」，这样笔记本可以继续处理其他文件。

words.enDefinition: Text associated with a specific exception giving details about what happened

examples.en: The exception message included the name of the file that was missing.
examples.zh: 「异常说明信息」包含了没找到的文件名。

examples.en: We read the exception message after checking where the program had stopped.
examples.zh: 我们先确认程序停在哪里，再读「异常说明信息」。

collocations: an exception message with a filename

words.enDefinition: the process by which a raised exception passes through enclosing blocks or callers seeking a handler

examples.en: The diagram traced exception propagation from a small formatting helper to the main routine that handled it.
examples.zh: 示意图跟踪了一次「异常传播」从小型格式化辅助函数到作出处理的主例程的过程。

examples.en: Our tutor explained exception propagation after the error skipped the remaining instructions in two active functions.
examples.zh: 错误使两个活动函数的余下指令被跳过后，导师介绍了「异常传播」。

words.enDefinition: The class or category identifying which kind of problem occurred

examples.en: The exception type told us the program had failed to find a file.
examples.zh: 「异常类型」告诉我们，程序没找到某个文件。

examples.en: I copied the exception type from the last line of the diagnostic.
examples.zh: 我从诊断信息最后一行复制了「异常类型」。

collocations: the exception type in a traceback

words.enDefinition: an upper limit that is excluded from the permitted values

examples.en: We used an exclusive upper bound so the range stopped immediately before reaching the number of items.
examples.zh: 我们使用「不包含端点的上界」，让范围恰好在达到条目数之前结束。

examples.en: The documentation called ten the exclusive upper bound even though nine was the largest selectable integer.
examples.zh: 文档把十称为「不包含端点的上界」，尽管可选的最大整数是九。

collocations: compare a value with an exclusive upper bound

words.enDefinition: A notebook number showing a cell run's order in the current session

examples.en: The execution count showed that I had run the bottom cell first.
examples.zh: 「单元格执行计数」显示，我最先运行了底部单元格。

examples.en: We compared the execution count beside each cell in the sample notebook.
examples.zh: 我们比较了样本笔记本中各个单元格旁的「单元格执行计数」。

collocations: look at a cell's execution count
the execution count in a notebook

words.enDefinition: a description of the operations a database will use to carry out a query

examples.en: The execution plan showed which table the engine searched before joining it to the timetable records.
examples.zh: 「查询执行计划」显示引擎先搜索哪张表，再与日程记录联接。

examples.en: We read the execution plan to see whether the database expected to sort the example result explicitly.
examples.zh: 我们查看「查询执行计划」，了解数据库预计是否要对示例结果显式排序。

collocations: show the execution plan for a query

words.enDefinition: a SQL predicate true when its subquery returns at least one row

examples.en: The EXISTS predicate checked whether each room had any reservation in the timetable for the following week.
examples.zh: 「EXISTS 存在谓词」检查日程表上的各房间下周是否至少有一条预订记录。

examples.en: We negated the EXISTS predicate to return only products with no corresponding sale in the classroom data.
examples.zh: 我们对「EXISTS 存在谓词」取反，只返回课堂数据中没有对应销售记录的产品。

collocations: filter rows with an EXISTS predicate

words.enDefinition: A code returned to the calling environment when a program ends

examples.en: I checked the exit status when the program ended without printing a result.
examples.zh: 程序结束时没打印结果，我查看了「退出状态码」。

examples.en: The guide explained how the exit status differed between the example runs.
examples.zh: 指南说明了几次示例运行的「退出状态码」有什么区别。

words.enDefinition: A test outcome anticipated to fail and marked separately in advance

examples.en: The runner reported an expected failure for the example unfinished export option.
examples.zh: 运行器把示例中尚未完成的导出选项报为「预期失败」。

examples.en: We marked the known outcome as an expected failure in the classroom exercise.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂练习中将已知结果标记为「预期失败」。

collocations: mark a test as an expected failure

words.enDefinition: one minus the ratio of prediction-error variance to target variance when the observed numerical target has nonzero variance

examples.en: Our tutor compared the explained variance score with R-squared after adding a constant to the predictions.
examples.zh: 老师给预测值统一加上一个常数后，比较了「解释方差得分」与决定系数。

examples.en: The worksheet used the explained variance score to describe how well predictions tracked changes in sorting times.
examples.zh: 练习表用「解释方差得分」描述预测结果在多大程度上跟随分拣时间的变化。

collocations: compare the explained variance score with R-squared

words.enDefinition: column data types declared by the user or schema rather than inferred from observed values

examples.en: We provided explicit column types so the reader would keep leading zeros in the classroom identifiers.
examples.zh: 我们提供「显式指定的列类型」，让读取程序保留教室标识符的前导零。

examples.en: The tutor compared explicit column types with the reader's guesses for a file containing several missing entries.
examples.zh: 导师把「显式指定的列类型」和读取程序对含多个缺失条目的文件所推测的类型作了比较。

collocations: read a file with explicit column types

words.enDefinition: ending a function call by executing a return statement rather than through automatic completion

examples.en: An explicit return made it clear that the function should deliver the total to its caller.
examples.zh: 「显式返回」清楚表明，函数应将合计值交给调用方。

examples.en: We added an explicit return after calculation because the caller needed the number for another step.
examples.zh: 调用方还需要这个数字完成下一步，所以我们在计算之后加了「显式返回」。

words.enDefinition: a conversion requested directly in the program's code

examples.en: The example used explicit type conversion to turn a numeric string into a Python integer.
examples.zh: 示例用「显式类型转换」把数字字符串转成 Python 整数。

examples.en: Our tutor added explicit type conversion before passing the sample value to the arithmetic expression.
examples.zh: 导师先加上「显式类型转换」，再让样本值参与算术表达式。

collocations: a call for explicit type conversion

words.enDefinition: to turn each element of list values in a column into its own row, repeating other fields as needed

examples.en: We needed to explode a list column so each book appeared once per subject tag it carried.
examples.zh: 我们需要「将列表列拆成多行」，使每本书为它的各个主题标签各占一行。

examples.en: The tutor showed how to explode a list column without losing the corresponding catalogue numbers.
examples.zh: 导师演示了如何「将列表列拆成多行」，同时保留对应的目录编号。

collocations: explode a list column into rows
explode a list column while retaining the index
decide when to explode a list column

words.enDefinition: examining data with summaries and other techniques to discover patterns, inconsistencies and questions worth investigating

examples.en: We used exploratory data analysis to compare temperature readings across buildings before suggesting any explanation for the differences.
examples.zh: 我们先用「探索性数据分析」比较各楼宇的温度读数，再尝试解释差异。

examples.en: Our exploratory data analysis showed that most missing responses came from two sessions held on the same day.
examples.zh: 我们的「探索性数据分析」发现，大多数缺失答复来自同一天的两场活动。

words.enDefinition: the power that specifies the scale in a numeric representation

examples.en: The exponent in our binary example told us which power of two to use.
examples.zh: 我们二进制示例中的「指数」指明要用二的哪一个幂。

examples.en: We changed the exponent in the worksheet while keeping the significand the same throughout.
examples.zh: 我们在练习表中改变「指数」，同时保持有效数字部分始终不变。

words.enDefinition: For a given class, the harmonic mean of precision and recall.

examples.en: The class used the F1 score because it wanted to consider both precision and recall.
examples.zh: 全班使用「F1 分数」，因为希望同时考察精确率与召回率。

examples.en: We compared the F1 score for poetry with the score for a more common category.
examples.zh: 我们把诗歌的「F1 分数」与另一个更常见类别的得分作了比较。

collocations: report the F1 score for a class

words.enDefinition: a design providing a simpler entry point to several underlying components

examples.en: The facade pattern gave the classroom display one operation for preparing and drawing the whole page.
examples.zh: 「外观模式」给课堂显示模块提供一个操作，用来准备并绘制整页。

examples.en: Our tutor used the facade pattern to hide the order of calls from the sample's client.
examples.zh: 导师用「外观模式」让样本的调用方无需了解内部调用顺序。

collocations: a subsystem using the facade pattern

words.enDefinition: One panel in a chart that displays a particular subset of the data.

examples.en: Each facet shows a different garden while the scales stay fixed across the rows.
examples.zh: 每幅「分面子图」显示一个不同的花园，各行采用相同标度。

examples.en: We switched the order of two months so the first facet would show April.
examples.zh: 我们调换了两个月份的顺序，使第一幅「分面子图」显示四月。

words.enDefinition: a design letting subclasses choose the concrete type created by a shared operation

examples.en: The factory method pattern let each worksheet class create its own type of example question.
examples.zh: 「工厂方法模式」让每种练习表类创建各自类型的示例题目。

examples.en: Our tutor traced the factory method pattern to see which subclass created the sample object.
examples.zh: 导师追踪「工厂方法模式」，找出哪个子类创建了样本对象。

collocations: an example of the factory method pattern

words.enDefinition: The source line whose execution directly resulted in an error

examples.en: The failing line tried to read a file we had not created yet.
examples.zh: 「触发错误的代码行」尝试读取一个我们还没有创建的文件。

examples.en: We read the name printed beside the failing line in the traceback.
examples.zh: 我们看了异常回溯中「触发错误的代码行」旁印出的名称。

collocations: step back from the failing line

words.enDefinition: A test whose result does not satisfy its required checks
