examples.en: The failing test showed that the new table had replaced a column heading.
examples.zh: 「未通过的测试」显示，新表格替换了一个列标题。

examples.en: We kept the failing test visible while comparing the two saved results.
examples.zh: 比较两份保存结果时，我们一直留着「未通过的测试」供查看。

words.enDefinition: A working simplified replacement used instead of a production dependency during tests

examples.en: We used a fake implementation that stored the schedule in memory for the exercise.
examples.zh: 我们用了一个「轻量的测试替代实现」，在内存中保存练习用的日程表。

examples.en: The fake implementation let us check saves and reads without opening a database.
examples.zh: 「轻量的测试替代实现」让我们可以先验证保存和读取功能。

words.enDefinition: The proportion of actual positive examples incorrectly predicted as negative.

examples.en: The false negative rate was higher for the model that missed more of the actual oak leaves.
examples.zh: 漏掉更多真正橡树叶的模型，其「假负率」更高。

examples.en: Our tutor asked which denominator was needed to calculate the false negative rate for poetry detection.
examples.zh: 老师问，计算诗歌识别的「假负率」要用哪个分母。

collocations: compare false negative rates across models

words.enDefinition: The proportion of actual negative examples incorrectly predicted as positive.

examples.en: The false positive rate increased when more non-oak leaves were incorrectly classified as oak leaves.
examples.zh: 更多非橡树叶被错分为橡树叶时，「假正率」上升了。

examples.en: We compared the false positive rate at two probability thresholds in the plant exercise.
examples.zh: 在植物练习中，我们比较了两个概率阈值下的「假正率」。

collocations: compare the false positive rate across thresholds

words.enDefinition: treated as false when tested in a Boolean context

examples.en: The JavaScript exercise marked the empty string as falsy when it was used in a condition.
examples.zh: JavaScript 练习中，空字符串「在条件中被视为假」。

examples.en: Our tutor showed why numeric zero was falsy even though the text string containing zero was truthy.
examples.zh: 导师演示，为什么数字零「在条件中被视为假」，而字符零组成的字符串被视为真。

words.enDefinition: A merge advancing a branch pointer along existing history without a new commit

examples.en: The fast-forward merge moved the branch forward without creating another commit.
examples.zh: 「快进合并」把分支往前移，没有创建另一条提交。

examples.en: Our tutor drew a fast-forward merge when one branch directly followed the other.
examples.zh: 导师在一条分支直接承接另一分支时画出了「快进合并」。

words.enDefinition: A branch used to develop a change separately from shared work

examples.en: We used a feature branch while adding the date selector to the sample.
examples.zh: 我们给示例添加日期选择器时，用了一个「功能分支」。

examples.en: The feature branch contained my edits without changing the shared exercise immediately.
examples.zh: 「功能分支」保存了我的编辑，课堂共用练习还没有改动。

words.enDefinition: A measure of how strongly a feature contributes to predictions under a specified assessment method.

examples.en: We checked feature importance to see how much leaf width contributed to the classifier under our chosen method.
examples.zh: 我们检查了「特征重要性」，看看按所选方法衡量，叶宽对分类器的贡献有多大。

examples.en: Our tutor cautioned that feature importance alone could not tell us which measurements caused a plant's label.
examples.zh: 老师提醒，仅凭「特征重要性」无法判断哪些测量值是植物被标为某类的原因。

words.enDefinition: A table containing the feature values for a collection of observations.

examples.en: The feature matrix had one row per plant and one column per measurement in our exercise.
examples.zh: 练习中的「特征矩阵」每行对应一株植物，每列对应一项测量。

examples.en: We checked the feature matrix before fitting the model to the recorded workshop times.
examples.zh: 在用记录的工作坊用时拟合模型之前，我们先检查了「特征矩阵」。

collocations: fit a model using the feature matrix
inspect the columns of a feature matrix

words.enDefinition: An ordered collection of feature values describing one observation.

examples.en: We made a feature vector for each leaf using its length, width and colour measurements.
examples.zh: 我们用每片叶子的长、宽和色彩测量值创建一个「特征向量」。

examples.en: The tutor checked the feature vector to see whether the two measurements were in the expected order.
examples.zh: 老师检查了「特征向量」，确认两项测量值是否按预计的次序排列。

collocations: represent an observation with a feature vector

words.enDefinition: Download repository objects and references from a remote without integrating them

examples.en: We used the editor to fetch changes before comparing the two branches.
examples.zh: 比较两个分支之前，我们用编辑器「获取远程改动」。

examples.en: I decided to fetch changes while keeping the current work unchanged.
examples.zh: 我决定「获取远程改动」，当前工作先保持原样。

words.enDefinition: an expression supplying a field's initial value at declaration

examples.en: The JavaScript example used a field initializer to give each reading counter an initial zero.
examples.zh: JavaScript 示例用「字段初始化表达式」将每个阅读计数器的初始值设为零。

examples.en: Our tutor moved the calculation into a field initializer beside the field's declaration.
examples.zh: 导师把计算移入字段声明旁的「字段初始化表达式」。

words.enDefinition: A collection in which items are removed in the same order they were added.

examples.en: The printer example used a FIFO queue so earlier class projects were processed before later arrivals.
examples.zh: 打印示例采用「先进先出队列」，先处理较早到达的课堂项目。

examples.en: We drew a FIFO queue and numbered the cards in the order they left it.
examples.zh: 我们画了一个「先进先出队列」，按卡片离开队列的顺序给它们编号。

collocations: add work to a FIFO queue
process entries from a FIFO queue

words.enDefinition: In POSIX-style systems, a nonnegative integer that a process uses to refer to an open file or similar object.

examples.en: The example printed the file descriptor returned when it opened the sample data for reading.
examples.zh: 示例以读取方式打开样本数据时，打印了返回的「文件描述符」。

examples.en: We checked which file descriptor the program used for the second open file in the exercise.
examples.zh: 我们查看了程序在练习中对第二个打开的文件使用哪个「文件描述符」。

words.enDefinition: A program's reference to a file that it has already opened

examples.en: The example used a file handle to read the file one line at a time.
examples.zh: 示例通过「文件句柄」逐行读取那个文件。

examples.en: We checked when the file handle stopped being usable in the program.
examples.zh: 我们核对了程序里「文件句柄」何时变得不可用。

words.enDefinition: A position, expressed as a byte count from the start of a file.

examples.en: The file offset moved forward after the program read several bytes from the practice file.
examples.zh: 程序从练习文件中读取几个字节后，「文件偏移量」向前移动了。

examples.en: Our tutor marked the file offset that corresponded to the beginning of the second sample record.
examples.zh: 老师标出了第二条样本记录开头对应的「文件偏移量」。

words.enDefinition: A Python exception indicating a requested file or directory does not exist

examples.en: The script showed FileNotFoundError when I typed a nonexistent file name.
examples.zh: 我输入一个不存在的文件名时，脚本显示了「文件或目录缺失异常」。

examples.en: Our tutor read the filename reported with FileNotFoundError in the example.
examples.zh: 导师读了示例中随「文件或目录缺失异常」报告的文件名。

words.enDefinition: a logical condition evaluated to decide which rows a query retains

examples.en: The filter predicate required both a future date and at least one seat available for the workshop.
examples.zh: 「筛选谓词」要求工作坊日期尚未到来，同时至少还有一个空位。

examples.en: We moved the filter predicate into the example query after confirming how it treated missing dates.
examples.zh: 确认它如何处理缺失日期后，我们把「筛选谓词」移进示例查询。

words.enDefinition: a block executed as control leaves its associated try construct during ordinary execution, including normal completion, a return or exception propagation

examples.en: The finally block closed the temporary file even after one line could not be read correctly.
examples.zh: 有一行没能正确读出时，「finally 清理块」仍关闭了临时文件。

examples.en: We traced when the finally block ran after the function reached a return inside the protected code.
examples.zh: 函数在受保护代码里遇到 return 后，我们跟踪了「finally 清理块」的运行时机。

collocations: put cleanup in a finally block

words.enDefinition: a numeric value that is neither infinite nor NaN

examples.en: The JavaScript worksheet used Number.isFinite to check whether each computed result was a finite number.
examples.zh: JavaScript 练习表用 Number.isFinite 检查每个计算结果是否为「有限数值」。

examples.en: Our tutor separated each finite number from the infinite results before plotting the sample values.
examples.zh: 导师在绘制样本数据前，把各个「有限数值」与无穷值分开。

words.enDefinition: a function treated as a value that can be assigned, passed to other functions or returned

examples.en: A first-class function can be stored in the table of formatters alongside several other available formatting options.
examples.zh: 「一等函数」可以与其他可选格式化方法一起存到格式化函数表里。

examples.en: Our tutor used a first-class function as the return value in a short exercise about choosing behaviour.
examples.zh: 在一个选择行为的小练习中，导师把「一等函数」作为返回值。

collocations: treat a function as a first-class function
pass a first-class function as an argument

words.enDefinition: the current value in an ordered sequence minus the immediately preceding value

examples.en: The first difference showed how much the number of bookings changed from one day to the next.
examples.zh: 「一阶差分」显示预订数从一天到下一天变化多少。

examples.en: The tutor showed why first difference produced an empty entry at the start of the example series.
examples.zh: 导师说明了为什么「一阶差分」使示例序列的第一项为空。

collocations: apply a first difference to a time series

words.enDefinition: Describing an order in which the first item added is the first removed.

examples.en: The ticket exercise used first-in, first-out order so earlier arrivals kept their places.
examples.zh: 取号练习采用「先进先出」顺序，让先到者保持原来的次序。

examples.en: Our tutor explained first in, first out by comparing card arrival times with card removal times.
examples.zh: 老师比较卡片的进入时间和取出时间来解释「先进先出」。

words.enDefinition: a relational design form that gives each attribute a single value from its domain in each row

examples.en: The tutor moved the repeating list of phone numbers into separate rows to illustrate first normal form.
examples.zh: 导师把重复出现的电话号码列表拆成若干行，用于演示「第一范式」。

examples.en: Our table design satisfied first normal form after we separated the individual workshop dates into their own rows.
examples.zh: 把各场工作坊的日期拆到独立的行后，我们的表设计符合「第一范式」。

collocations: convert a relation to first normal form
check a table for first normal form

words.enDefinition: To estimate a model's learned settings from training data.

examples.en: We needed to fit a model before predicting the time required for the next sorting task.
examples.zh: 预测下一项分拣任务的用时之前，我们需要先「拟合模型」。

examples.en: The tutor asked us to fit a model using only the records from our training set.
examples.zh: 老师要求我们仅使用训练集中的记录来「拟合模型」。

collocations: fit a model to the data
fit a model on the training set
fit a model with fewer features

words.enDefinition: the minimum, first quartile, median, third quartile and maximum of a set of numbers

examples.en: We prepared a five-number summary of the waiting times before comparing the longest and shortest observed delays.
examples.zh: 我们先为等待时长制作「五数概括」，再对比观测到的最长和最短延迟。

examples.en: The five-number summary placed the median much closer to the first quartile than the third quartile.
examples.zh: 「五数概括」显示中位数比起第三四分位数，更接近第一四分位数。

words.enDefinition: a number represented by an integer with a constant scale

examples.en: The worksheet represented centimetres as a fixed-point number by storing measurements in whole millimetres.
examples.zh: 练习表用整数毫米存储测量值，从而用「定点数」表示厘米。

examples.en: Our tutor labelled the scale beside each fixed-point number so the class could interpret it.
examples.zh: 导师在每个「定点数」旁标注缩放比例，方便同学们解读。

words.enDefinition: An array whose number of element positions stays fixed after it is created.

examples.en: The lab used a fixed-size array with seven positions for the days of the week.
examples.zh: 实验课用一个有七个位置的「定长数组」来存放一周的各天。

examples.en: We replaced the fixed-size array when the assignment started accepting more readings than it could hold.
examples.zh: 作业开始接收超过原容量的读数后，我们换掉了这个「定长数组」。

collocations: store scores in a fixed-size array

words.enDefinition: an integer represented using a fixed number of bits

examples.en: The worksheet used a fixed-width integer with eight bits to keep the calculation small.
examples.zh: 练习表采用八位「固定宽度整数」，以缩小计算规模。

examples.en: Our class compared a fixed-width integer with Python's ordinary integers by examining their ranges.
examples.zh: 同学们通过考察表示范围，比较了「固定宽度整数」和 Python 的普通整数。

collocations: the range of a fixed-width integer

words.enDefinition: A setting controlling how long a test fixture is shared

examples.en: The fixture scope determined whether the two tests shared one prepared object.
examples.zh: 「夹具作用范围」决定这两个测试会不会共用同一个准备好的对象。

examples.en: We compared fixture scope settings in a lab exercise with three checks.
examples.zh: 我们在包含三项检查的实验练习中比较了「夹具作用范围」设置。

collocations: a fixture scope limited to one test

words.enDefinition: a test that can pass or fail across runs without a relevant change to the code under test

examples.en: The flaky test sometimes failed because two checks shared a temporary folder.
examples.zh: 两项检查共用临时文件夹，导致这个「结果不稳定的测试」偶尔失败。

examples.en: We reran the flaky test and compared its two different results.
examples.zh: 我们重新运行「结果不稳定的测试」，对比它的两种不同结果。

words.enDefinition: To turn a multi-dimensional array or nested array structure into a single sequence of elements.

examples.en: We had to flatten an array before comparing its values with the worksheet's single list.
examples.zh: 我们需要先「把数组展平」，再把里面的值与练习表的一个列表作比较。

examples.en: The exercise asked us to flatten an array row by row to keep its order predictable.
examples.zh: 练习要求我们按行「把数组展平」，以确保元素顺序可预期。

collocations: flatten an array row by row
flatten an array into one dimension
flatten an array before displaying the results

words.enDefinition: a number represented with a scaled significand and limited precision

examples.en: The program used a floating-point number to represent the measured length in the classroom example.
examples.zh: 程序用一个「浮点数」表示课堂示例中测得的长度。

examples.en: Our tutor asked whether the printed digits fully described the value of the floating-point number.
examples.zh: 导师问，打印出来的数字能否完全描述这个「浮点数」的实际值。

words.enDefinition: the condition in which a result's magnitude is too small for normal representation and may lose precision or round to zero

examples.en: The worksheet illustrated floating-point underflow by rounding a tiny positive result down to zero.
examples.zh: 练习表把一个极小的正数舍入为零，演示「浮点下溢」。

examples.en: Our tutor used floating-point underflow to discuss the limited range of the small demonstration format.
examples.zh: 导师用「浮点下溢」讨论小型演示格式有限的表示范围。

words.enDefinition: division whose quotient is rounded toward negative infinity

examples.en: In Python, floor division of negative five by two gives negative three in our worksheet.
examples.zh: 练习表中的 Python 示例里，负五除以二作「向下取整除法」得到负三。

examples.en: The tutor compared floor division with ordinary division when the numbers did not divide evenly.
examples.zh: 两个数除不尽时，导师比较了「向下取整除法」和普通除法。

words.enDefinition: A mechanism that limits a sender so it does not overwhelm the receiver's capacity.

examples.en: In the simulation, flow control slows the sender when the receiving application reads data slowly.
examples.zh: 模拟中，接收应用读取数据较慢时，「流量控制」会让发送方放慢速度。

examples.en: Our tutor explained flow control using two computers that can process data at different rates.
examples.zh: 老师用两台处理数据速度不同的电脑讲解「流量控制」。

words.enDefinition: An all-pairs shortest-path method that progressively allows more intermediate vertices

examples.en: The Floyd-Warshall algorithm filled a distance table for every pair of locations.
examples.zh: 「弗洛伊德沃舍尔算法」填写了各地点两两之间的距离表。

examples.en: We watched the Floyd-Warshall algorithm update its entries after considering a new intermediate vertex.
examples.zh: 我们观察了「弗洛伊德沃舍尔算法」在考虑一个新的中间顶点后更新各项。

collocations: a matrix in the Floyd-Warshall algorithm

words.enDefinition: an interface designed so calls can read as a connected sequence

examples.en: The Java example used a fluent interface to express several drawing settings in an easy sequence.
examples.zh: Java 示例用「流畅接口」把多项绘图设置写成易读的调用序列。

examples.en: Our tutor read the fluent interface example aloud to check whether the operations flowed naturally together.
examples.zh: 导师大声读出「流畅接口」示例，检查各操作连起来是否自然。

collocations: a fluent interface for configuring an object

words.enDefinition: Send buffered output onward without waiting for accumulated data

examples.en: The sample had to flush output before waiting for the next entry.
examples.zh: 示例等待下一次输入前，得先「立即送出缓冲的输出」。

examples.en: Our tutor chose to flush output so the progress message appeared promptly.
examples.zh: 导师选择「立即送出缓冲的输出」，让进度消息及时显示。

words.zhGloss: 将待写数据送出缓冲区
words.enDefinition: To ask a buffering layer to send waiting writes to the next layer or destination.
acceptedZhAnswers: 将待写数据送出缓冲区

examples.en: The simulator could flush pending writes before showing the completed sample report on the screen.
examples.zh: 模拟器在屏幕上显示已完成的示例报告之前，可以先「将待写数据送出缓冲区」。

examples.en: We asked what would happen if the library needed to flush pending writes during the lesson.
examples.zh: 我们问，课程例题里的程序库若需要「将待写数据送出缓冲区」，会发生什么。

collocations: flush pending writes from a buffer
ask the program to flush pending writes

words.enDefinition: To move from the current linked node to the node identified by its successor reference.

examples.en: We had to follow the next link before reading another colour from the sample chain.
examples.zh: 从示例节点链读取下一种颜色前，我们得「沿后继链接移动」。

examples.en: Our tutor asked us to follow the next link and write down the node we reached.
examples.zh: 老师让我们「沿后继链接移动」，并记下到达的节点。

collocations: follow the next link from the head
follow the next link to its target
follow the next link while traversing

words.enDefinition: a loop that visits elements of a collection without requiring the programmer to manage a numerical index

examples.en: A for-each loop printed each line in the report without referring to its position in the list.
examples.zh: 「逐元素循环」逐行打印报告，无需引用各行在列表中的位置。

examples.en: We replaced the index-based code with a for-each loop because only the item names were needed.
examples.zh: 只需要各项的名称，所以我们将基于索引的代码换成了「逐元素循环」。

collocations: traverse a collection with a for-each loop

words.enDefinition: a loop that iterates over an iterable or uses explicit control expressions, depending on the language

examples.en: A for loop displayed the shelf label associated with each book in the inventory list.
examples.zh: 一个「for 循环」显示了库存清单里每本书对应的书架标签。

examples.en: The original for loop counted from one through ten before printing the table of results.
examples.zh: 原先的「for 循环」从一数到十，然后输出结果表。

collocations: iterate over a list with a for loop

words.enDefinition: In a shell, a process in the foreground job that can interact with the terminal.

examples.en: The shell waited for the foreground process to finish displaying its results before accepting another command.
examples.zh: Shell 等「前台进程」显示完结果后才接受另一条命令。

examples.en: In our terminal exercise, the foreground process handled the input we typed during the demonstration.
examples.zh: 终端练习中，「前台进程」处理了演示期间我们键入的内容。

collocations: show output from a foreground process

words.enDefinition: a column or set of columns constrained to match values of a referenced key, subject to any null rules

examples.en: The foreign key linked each booking to a classroom that was already listed in the room table.
examples.zh: 「外键」把每条预订记录关联到教室表中已经列出的一个教室。

examples.en: We added a foreign key so a sample order could only refer to a recorded product.
examples.zh: 我们添加了「外键」，使练习中的订单只能指向已记录的产品。

collocations: reference another table with a foreign key

words.enDefinition: Create a linked copy of an existing project on a hosting service

examples.en: We needed to fork a repository before editing our own hosted copy for class.
examples.zh: 编辑各自托管的课堂副本前，我们得先「派生远程版本库」。

examples.en: The assignment asked everyone to fork a repository and add one example file.
examples.zh: 作业要求每个人「派生远程版本库」，再加一份示例文件。

collocations: fork a repository for an exercise
fork a repository into a personal workspace

words.enDefinition: a name in a function definition that receives an argument or otherwise binds an input value

examples.en: The formal parameter named units held whichever measurement unit the caller supplied to the conversion routine.
examples.zh: 调用方把什么计量单位传给转换例程，名为 units 的「形式参数」就会保存什么单位。

examples.en: We renamed the formal parameter to distinguish the measurement itself from the name of the person recording it.
examples.zh: 我们给「形式参数」改名，以区分测量值本身与记录人的姓名。

collocations: bind an argument to a formal parameter

words.enDefinition: uniform use of a required representation for equivalent kinds of data

examples.en: We checked format consistency because some files recorded dates with slashes and others used hyphens.
examples.zh: 我们检查了「格式一致性」，因为有些文件的日期用斜杠分隔，有些用连字符。

examples.en: The import improved format consistency by storing every room code with the same number of characters.
examples.zh: 导入时将所有房间编号存为相同长度，提升了「格式一致性」。

words.enDefinition: notation describing how a value should appear as text

examples.en: The Python example used a format specifier to show the measured length with two decimal places.
examples.zh: Python 示例用「格式说明符」把测得的长度显示为两位小数。

examples.en: Our tutor changed the format specifier and asked why the underlying numeric value stayed the same.
examples.zh: 导师改了「格式说明符」，问为什么底层数值保持不变。

words.enDefinition: Python string literal syntax that evaluates embedded expressions

examples.en: The formatted string literal placed the calculated average between two pieces of ordinary text.
examples.zh: 「格式化字符串字面量」把算出的平均值放在两段普通文字之间。

examples.en: Our Python worksheet used a formatted string literal to display the reading with two decimal places.
examples.zh: Python 练习表用「格式化字符串字面量」显示保留两位小数的读数。

collocations: an expression inside a formatted string literal

words.enDefinition: to pass a received method request on to another object

examples.en: The worksheet asked the wrapper to forward a call to the original drawing object.
examples.zh: 练习表要求包装对象向原来的绘图对象「转发调用」。

examples.en: Our tutor showed when to forward a call to the helper after recording the request.
examples.zh: 导师演示了记录请求后，何时向辅助对象「转发调用」。

collocations: forward a call to a delegate
forward a call to another object
forward a call with its arguments

words.enDefinition: filling missing positions with the most recent available value earlier in an ordered sequence

examples.en: A forward fill carried the last recorded room setting into later empty cells until another setting appeared.
examples.zh: 「前向填充」把最近记录的教室设置带入之后的空单元格，直到有新设置出现。

examples.en: We limited forward fill to a single session so values could not carry over into another day.
examples.zh: 我们把「前向填充」限制在单场活动内，使数值不会延续到第二天。

collocations: limit the length of a forward fill
use forward fill within each group

words.zhGloss: 仍在有效期内的缓存响应
words.enDefinition: A stored HTTP response whose age has not yet reached its freshness lifetime.
acceptedZhAnswers: 仍在有效期内的缓存响应

examples.en: A fresh response in the demonstration can be reused while the class revisits the catalogue page.
examples.zh: 全班重新访问目录页时，演示中的「仍在有效期内的缓存响应」仍可复用。

examples.en: The worksheet labels the saved timetable as a fresh response on the first revisit.
examples.zh: 首次回访时，练习纸将已保存的时间表标记为「仍在有效期内的缓存响应」。

collocations: a fresh response in the cache

words.enDefinition: The period during which a stored HTTP response can qualify as fresh.

examples.en: The sample response's freshness lifetime is long enough for several page views during the class.
examples.zh: 示例响应的「缓存新鲜度有效期」够长，能覆盖课堂上的几次页面浏览。

examples.en: We wrote the freshness lifetime on the diagram beside the age of the stored stylesheet.
examples.zh: 我们在图中把「缓存新鲜度有效期」标在缓存样式表当前的响应年龄旁边。

words.enDefinition: the SQL clause determining the tables, joins or other sources from which query rows are drawn

examples.en: The FROM clause referred to the table holding workshop dates and the table holding bookable rooms.
examples.zh: 「FROM 来源子句」引用了存储工作坊日期的表和存储可预订教室的表。

examples.en: We checked the FROM clause after the query pulled rows from a table containing archived events.
examples.zh: 查询从存放归档活动的表里取数后，我们检查了「FROM 来源子句」。

collocations: reference a table in the FROM clause
put a join in the FROM clause

words.enDefinition: The first item in a queue, which is next to be removed in FIFO order.

examples.en: We marked the front element because it would leave the practice queue before the other cards.
examples.zh: 我们标出了「队首元素」，因为它会比其他卡片更早离开练习队列。

examples.en: The tutor displayed the front element without removing it from the small queue on screen.
examples.zh: 老师显示了「队首元素」，它仍留在屏幕上的小队列中。

collocations: inspect the front element without removing it

words.enDefinition: A binary tree whose nodes have either zero or two children

examples.en: The full binary tree had two children at every node that was not a leaf.
examples.zh: 「严格二叉树」里的每个非叶节点都有两个子节点。

examples.en: We checked whether removing only one child still left a full binary tree.
examples.zh: 我们检查了只去掉一个子节点后，剩下的还是不是「严格二叉树」。

collocations: check for a full binary tree

words.enDefinition: a join retaining matching row pairs and also unmatched rows from either side, padded with nulls as needed

examples.en: The full outer join showed matched catalogue codes and entries found in just one list.
examples.zh: 「全外联接」显示匹配的目录编码，以及只出现在一份清单中的条目。

examples.en: We used a full outer join to compare two class rosters compiled by different systems in the example.
examples.zh: 在示例中，我们用「全外联接」比较由两个不同系统生成的两份班级名册。

collocations: compare unmatched rows from a full outer join
reconcile lists using a full outer join

words.enDefinition: A complete DNS name that specifies a location in the domain hierarchy all the way to the root.

examples.en: The fully qualified domain name includes all the labels needed to find our example host.
examples.zh: 「完全限定域名」包含定位示例主机所需的所有标签。

examples.en: The DNS exercise contrasts a fully qualified domain name with a short local name.
examples.zh: DNS 练习比较了「完全限定域名」和本地短名称。

collocations: resolve a fully qualified domain name
write a fully qualified domain name
fully qualified domain name ending in a dot

words.enDefinition: the statements or expression that specify the work performed when a function runs

examples.en: The function body first checked that the input list was nonempty, then calculated the mean of its values.
examples.zh: 「函数体」先检查输入列表非空，再计算其中数值的平均数。

examples.en: We shortened the function body by moving the date formatting code into a separate helper function.
examples.zh: 我们把日期格式处理代码移到另一个辅助函数里，缩短了「函数体」。

words.enDefinition: an expression or action that invokes a function, passing any arguments required by that function

examples.en: The function call passed the selected date to the routine that formatted dates for the printed schedule.
examples.zh: 这次「函数调用」把所选日期传给了为印刷日程表设置日期格式的例程。

examples.en: We replaced a repeated calculation with a function call to the helper we had already tested.
examples.zh: 我们用对已测试辅助函数的「函数调用」替换了重复的计算。

words.enDefinition: combining functions so the result of one function serves as the input to another

examples.en: The exercise used function composition to trim a label before passing it to the formatter.
examples.zh: 练习用「函数复合」先去掉标签首尾的空白，再把标签传给格式化器。

examples.en: We drew the order of evaluation for function composition using three short text filters from the exercise.
examples.zh: 我们用练习里的三个简短文字过滤函数画出了「函数复合」的求值顺序。

words.enDefinition: a construct that introduces a function name and specifies part or all of its definition, depending on the language

examples.en: The C example placed a function declaration above the first call and defined its body farther down.
examples.zh: C 语言示例将「函数声明」放在首次调用之前，并在后面定义函数体。

examples.en: The JavaScript lesson compared a function declaration with a function written as part of another expression.
examples.zh: JavaScript 课将「函数声明」与写在另一表达式中的函数作了比较。

collocations: check a function declaration against its definition

words.enDefinition: code creating a function and specifying its behaviour, typically including parameters and a body

examples.en: The function definition showed how the program converted a measurement before returning the result to the caller.
examples.zh: 「函数定义」展示了程序如何换算测量值，再把结果返回给调用方。

examples.en: We moved the function definition above the test code so the routine existed before the first call.
examples.zh: 我们将「函数定义」移到测试代码的上方，使该例程在第一次调用前已经定义。

collocations: separate a function definition from its calls

words.enDefinition: an expression in which evaluating the code produces a function value

examples.en: We assigned the result of a function expression to a local name in the example.
examples.zh: 我们将一个「函数表达式」的求值结果赋给了局部名称。

examples.en: We passed a function expression directly to the sorting method to specify how ties should be handled.
examples.zh: 我们把「函数表达式」直接传给排序方法，说明如何处理同序的条目。

collocations: pass a function expression as an argument

words.enDefinition: the name and parameter information identifying a function or describing how it can be called, according to the language

examples.en: We inspected the function signature to see which arguments the caller could omit.
examples.zh: 我们查看「函数签名」，确认调用方可以省略哪些实参。

examples.en: The editor showed the function signature after we changed the order of its parameters.
examples.zh: 我们调整形参顺序后，编辑器显示了更新的「函数签名」。

words.enDefinition: a rule that rows with the same values for one set of attributes must also agree on another set

examples.en: The functional dependency meant that the same product code always determined the same product name in the model.
examples.zh: 「函数依赖」表示在这个模型里，同一个产品编码总能确定同一个产品名称。

examples.en: We checked whether a proposed functional dependency represented a business rule or only a coincidence in the sample.
examples.zh: 我们核查了一项拟定的「函数依赖」，判断它代表业务规则，还是样本中碰巧存在的关系。

words.enDefinition: a Java interface with one abstract method under Java's counting rules

examples.en: The Java sample used a functional interface to represent one operation for scoring a guess.
examples.zh: Java 样本用「函数式接口」表示给一次猜测评分的操作。

examples.en: Our tutor matched the example lambda expression to the functional interface used by the exercise.
examples.zh: 导师把示例 lambda 表达式与练习所用的「函数式接口」对应起来。

collocations: a lambda for a functional interface

words.enDefinition: finding possible matches using similarity rules when the compared values may differ in spelling or representation

examples.en: We used fuzzy matching to suggest catalogue names that differed by one character in the two files.
examples.zh: 我们用「模糊匹配」给出两份文件中仅相差一个字符的目录名称候选。

examples.en: The tutor reviewed fuzzy matching results before accepting any proposed pair of nearly identical school names.
examples.zh: 导师先复查「模糊匹配」结果，再接受任何一对近乎相同的学校名称。

collocations: set a similarity threshold for fuzzy matching

words.enDefinition: The ability of a learned model to perform well on examples outside its training data.

examples.en: We assessed generalization by testing the leaf classifier on samples from plants it had never seen.
examples.zh: 我们用分类器没见过的植物样本做测试，评估它的「泛化」能力。

examples.en: Our tutor discussed generalization after checking whether the new book descriptions resembled the original training examples.
examples.zh: 老师查看新的图书描述是否与原训练样本相近以后，讨论了「泛化」。

words.enDefinition: The difference between performance on the training data and performance on unseen data.

examples.en: The generalization gap grew when the classifier improved on training photographs but lost accuracy on new ones.
examples.zh: 分类器在训练照片上进步、在新照片上的准确率下降时，「泛化差距」扩大了。

examples.en: We compared the generalization gap for two models fitted to the same set of garden measurements.
examples.zh: 我们比较了用同一组花园测量数据拟合的两种模型的「泛化差距」。

collocations: report a generalization gap between scores

words.enDefinition: a column whose value is calculated by the database from an expression rather than stored as independently supplied input

examples.en: The generated column displayed the area of each rectangle using the lengths stored in the same row.
examples.zh: 「生成列」用同一行存储的边长计算并显示每个矩形的面积。

examples.en: We changed a width value and watched the generated column show the new result without entering it ourselves.
examples.zh: 我们改了宽度值，看到「生成列」自动显示新结果，不需要自己录入。

collocations: compute the value of a generated column

words.enDefinition: An HTTP request using GET to retrieve a representation of its target resource.

examples.en: The browser sends a GET request to retrieve the reading list for the classroom display.
examples.zh: 浏览器发出「GET 请求」，获取教室屏幕要显示的阅读书单。

examples.en: The worksheet follows a GET request from the browser to the example campus catalogue server.
examples.zh: 练习纸展示一条「GET 请求」如何从浏览器到达示例校园目录服务器。

words.enDefinition: a method that exposes or computes a value for callers

examples.en: The Java sample used a getter method to return the book's title to the display.
examples.zh: Java 样本用「取值方法」把书名返回给显示模块。

examples.en: Our tutor checked whether the getter method returned the saved value or calculated it.
examples.zh: 导师核对「取值方法」返回的是保存的值还是计算得到的值。

collocations: return a value from a getter method

words.enDefinition: Storage for tracked project history and references managed by Git

examples.en: I opened the Git repository to compare this week's classroom example with last week's.
examples.zh: 我打开「Git 版本库」，比较本周与上周的课堂示例。

examples.en: Our group kept the exercise files together in one Git repository.
examples.zh: 我们组把练习文件集中存放在同一个「Git 版本库」里。

collocations: the history of a Git repository

words.enDefinition: the outermost scope for ordinary named declarations under a language's execution rules

examples.en: We moved the constant into global scope so multiple functions in the Python module could read it.
examples.zh: 我们把常量放进「全局作用域」，这样 Python 模块中的多个函数都能读取它。

examples.en: The JavaScript tutor distinguished global scope from the scope of variables declared at the top of a module.
examples.zh: JavaScript 导师区分了「全局作用域」与位于模块顶层的变量的作用域。

collocations: define a name in global scope

words.enDefinition: An iterative optimization method that updates parameters in the direction opposite the gradient of the objective.

examples.en: The exercise used gradient descent to adjust the line until predicted sorting times improved on average.
examples.zh: 练习用「梯度下降」调整直线，使分拣用时的预测整体有所改善。

examples.en: Our tutor drew two steps of gradient descent on a simple curve representing the loss.
examples.zh: 老师在表示损失的一条简单曲线上画出了「梯度下降」的两个步骤。

words.enDefinition: A connection between two vertices in a graph

examples.en: I drew a graph edge for the walkway connecting the two buildings.
examples.zh: 我为连接两座楼的步道画了一条「图的边」。

examples.en: We removed one graph edge to represent the closed path in class.
examples.zh: 我们在课上删掉一条「图的边」，表示这条路已经关闭。

collocations: a graph edge between two vertices

words.enDefinition: Systematically exploring vertices and edges according to a selected search order

examples.en: The graph traversal recorded both the vertices and their discovery order.
examples.zh: 「图遍历」记录了顶点以及发现它们的顺序。

examples.en: We compared two methods of graph traversal using the same map.
examples.zh: 我们用同一张地图比较了两种「图遍历」方式。

words.enDefinition: a text segment that approximates a single user-perceived character

examples.en: Our worksheet treated the letter and its accent mark as one grapheme cluster for counting.
examples.zh: 练习表计数时，把字母和它的重音标记视为一个「字素簇」。

examples.en: The tutor counted a grapheme cluster rather than individual code points in the displayed example.
examples.zh: 导师在示例中按「字素簇」计数，每个字素簇可能包含多个码点。

collocations: treat text as a grapheme cluster

words.enDefinition: A visible element such as a point, line, or rectangle that represents data in a chart.

examples.en: Each graphical mark in the diagram represents one reading from the greenhouse temperature log.
examples.zh: 图中的每个「图形标记」表示温室温度日志中的一次读数。

examples.en: The class selected a rectangle as the graphical mark for each category in its chart.
examples.zh: 全班选择用矩形作为图中每个类别的「图形标记」。

words.enDefinition: Evaluating every combination of specified candidate settings in a finite search grid.

examples.en: Our grid search tried each combination of the two tree settings listed in the worksheet.
examples.zh: 我们的「网格搜索」尝试了练习表所列两项树设置的每一种组合。

examples.en: The tutor expanded the grid search after adding a new candidate for maximum tree depth.
examples.zh: 老师加入一个新的最大树深度候选值后，扩大了「网格搜索」范围。

collocations: define candidates for a grid search
compare models with a grid search

words.enDefinition: A guide line across the chart area that corresponds to a position on an axis.

examples.en: The light grey gridline helps readers see that the weekly count reaches exactly twenty.
examples.zh: 浅灰色的「网格线」让读者看出周计数恰好达到二十。

examples.en: We removed one gridline that crossed the note and made the text hard to read.
examples.zh: 我们删去了一条穿过注释并让文字难以辨认的「网格线」。

words.enDefinition: observed or independently established reference information treated as correct when developing or evaluating a model

examples.en: We used the botanist's labels as ground truth when evaluating the model on the held-out plants.
examples.zh: 评估留出的植物时，我们把植物学家的标签作为「真实标注」。

examples.en: Our tutor asked how uncertain ground truth would affect the findings of the book classification exercise.
examples.zh: 老师问，如果「真实标注」本身不确定，会怎样影响图书分类练习的结论。

collocations: use expert labels as ground truth

words.enDefinition: the SQL clause that groups input rows by selected expressions for further calculation

examples.en: The GROUP BY clause gathered the sales rows by month before the query calculated each monthly total.
examples.zh: 查询计算各月合计之前，「GROUP BY 分组子句」先把销售记录按月归组。

examples.en: We changed the GROUP BY clause to show separate totals for each workshop location and date.
examples.zh: 我们修改了「GROUP BY 分组子句」，让各工作坊按地点及日期分别显示合计。

collocations: group rows with a GROUP BY clause
add an expression to the GROUP BY clause

words.enDefinition: A bar chart that places bars for related groups side by side within each category.

examples.en: The grouped bar chart puts last year and this year side by side for each month.
examples.zh: 「分组条形图」把每个月去年的数值与今年的数值并排显示。

examples.en: We used a grouped bar chart to compare morning and evening attendance across three workshops.
examples.zh: 我们用「分组条形图」比较三个工作坊上午和晚上的出席人数。

words.enDefinition: Cross-validation that keeps related observations from the same group together when separating training and validation data.

examples.en: We used grouped cross-validation because several photographs came from each plant in the garden exercise.
examples.zh: 我们用了「分组交叉验证」，因为花园练习中每株植物可能有多张照片。

examples.en: Our tutor checked that grouped cross-validation kept photos of each plant together in every round.
examples.zh: 老师核查了「分组交叉验证」是否在每一轮都把同一株植物的照片放在一起。

words.enDefinition: a column used to determine which rows are grouped together in a query

examples.en: We added a second grouping column to keep totals for different years separate in the report.
examples.zh: 我们加了第二个「分组列」，让报表里的不同年份各自计算合计。

examples.en: The tutor checked whether the grouping column represented a room name or a stable room identifier.
examples.zh: 导师核对了「分组列」记录的是房间名称，还是保持不变的房间标识符。

collocations: calculate totals by a grouping column

words.enDefinition: combining observations within each group into summary results such as group totals

examples.en: The groupwise aggregation reduced repeated readings to one total for each instrument and day.
examples.zh: 「按组汇总」把重复测量的读数按仪器和日期分别做了合计。

examples.en: We used groupwise aggregation to produce a separate response count for each age band in the classroom example.
examples.zh: 我们用「按组汇总」，对课堂示例里各年龄段的答复分别计数。

collocations: choose a summary function for groupwise aggregation
compare the results of groupwise aggregation

words.enDefinition: filling missing entries using an estimation or replacement rule fitted or calculated separately within groups

examples.en: Our example used groupwise imputation so missing travel times were filled from the same campus location.
examples.zh: 示例采用「按组插补」，用校内同一地点的数据填补缺失的行程用时。

examples.en: The tutor checked for groups with no observed values before applying groupwise imputation to the file.
examples.zh: 导师检查是否有整组没有观测值，再对文件做「按组插补」。

collocations: check group size before groupwise imputation

words.enDefinition: a calculation done within each group that returns a value aligned with each original observation

examples.en: The groupwise transformation placed the corresponding site average beside every original measurement in the file.
examples.zh: 「按组变换」将对应地点的平均值放到文件中每条原始测量记录旁。

examples.en: We used a groupwise transformation because the table needed to retain the individual readings for later checks.
examples.zh: 我们用「按组变换」，因为表格还需保留各条读数供之后核对。

collocations: check index alignment in a groupwise transformation
retain rows with a groupwise transformation

words.enDefinition: an early check that handles an exceptional or trivial input before the main logic proceeds

examples.en: A guard clause returned an empty result when the caller supplied a list with no entries.
examples.zh: 调用者传入空列表时，「卫语句」直接返回空结果。

examples.en: We put the guard clause above the calculation that needed at least one measured value.
examples.zh: 我们把「卫语句」放在至少需要一个测量值的计算之前。

words.enDefinition: A slice whose range includes the start position and excludes the stop position.

examples.en: The example used a half-open slice beginning at index two and ending just before index five.
examples.zh: 示例使用了一个「半开区间切片」，从索引二开始，到索引五之前结束。

examples.en: We drew a half-open slice to show why the value at the stop index was excluded.
examples.zh: 我们画了一个「半开区间切片」，说明为什么不包含终止索引处的值。

collocations: take a half-open slice of an array

words.enDefinition: An ordering relation in a memory model that constrains when the effects of one action are visible to another.

examples.en: The Java worksheet used a happens-before relation to explain which writes the joining thread could see.
examples.zh: Java 练习表用「先行发生关系」解释等待另一条线程结束的线程可以看到哪些写入。

examples.en: We drew the happens-before relation between actions shown in the two threads of the exercise.
examples.zh: 我们画出了练习中两条线程所示操作之间的「先行发生关系」。

words.enDefinition: a collaborator fixed inside a component's implementation

examples.en: The drawing class had a hard-coded dependency because it always constructed one particular helper class.
examples.zh: 绘图类有一个「写死的依赖」，因为它总是自行实例化同一个辅助类。

examples.en: Our tutor identified the hard-coded dependency before passing a formatter into the class from outside.
examples.zh: 导师先找出「写死的依赖」，再从外部给类传入格式化对象。

collocations: a hard-coded dependency on a concrete class

words.enDefinition: A signal from hardware asking the processor to handle an event.

examples.en: The sample device raised a hardware interrupt after it finished a transfer in the simulator.
examples.zh: 示例设备在模拟器里完成一次传输后发出「硬件中断」。

examples.en: We marked the hardware interrupt where the diagram showed the processor handling the device event.
examples.zh: 我们在图中处理器处理设备事件的位置标出了「硬件中断」。

words.enDefinition: a relationship in which one object holds or contains another

examples.en: The worksheet represented a has-a relationship by giving every drawing a separate palette object.
examples.zh: 练习表为每幅画配上独立的调色板对象，表示「拥有关系」。

examples.en: Our tutor drew a has-a relationship between a reading list and its title formatter.
examples.zh: 导师画出阅读清单和其标题格式化对象之间的「拥有关系」。

collocations: an example of a has-a relationship

words.enDefinition: an event where different keys produce the same hash value

examples.en: A hash collision occurred when the sample hash function produced the same value for two different colour names.
examples.zh: 示例散列函数为两个不同的颜色名生成同一个散列值，产生了「散列冲突」。

examples.en: The tutor illustrated a hash collision before showing how the table stored the two keys separately.
examples.zh: 在演示散列表如何分别存储两个键之前，导师先说明了一次「散列冲突」。

collocations: distinguish keys after a hash collision

words.enDefinition: A function that computes a hash code from a key to help locate entries in a table.

examples.en: The classroom hash function turned each colour name into a number for choosing a storage bucket.
examples.zh: 课堂示例的「散列函数」把每个颜色名变成一个数，用来选择存储桶。

examples.en: We applied the same hash function when adding an entry and when searching for it.
examples.zh: 我们在添加条目和查找条目时使用同一个「散列函数」。

collocations: apply a hash function to a key
compare the output of a hash function

words.enDefinition: A structure that uses a hash function to place and find entries by key.

examples.en: The classroom hash table stored paint colours so we could find them by name.
examples.zh: 课堂示例的「散列表」存放油漆颜色，方便按名称查找。

examples.en: Our diagram showed how the hash table found an entry after determining its bucket.
examples.zh: 图中展示了「散列表」在确定桶之后怎样找到条目。

collocations: insert entries into a hash table
look up a key in a hash table

words.enDefinition: The result produced by applying a hash function to an input.

examples.en: The example used the hash value to determine which storage bucket to check for the key.
examples.zh: 示例用「散列值」确定应在哪个存储桶里查找这个键。

examples.en: Two different inputs had the same hash value in the sample function shown on the worksheet.
examples.zh: 练习表中的样本函数对两个不同输入生成了相同的「散列值」。

collocations: derive a bucket from a hash value

words.enDefinition: A key with a stable hash during use and a hash consistent with how key equality is defined.

examples.en: The Python exercise used a tuple of integers as a hashable key for each square.
examples.zh: Python 练习中，每个格子都用一个整数元组作「可散列的键」。

examples.en: Our tutor asked why an ordinary Python list could not be used as a hashable key.
examples.zh: 老师问，为什么普通 Python 列表不能作为「可散列的键」。

words.enDefinition: the SQL clause filtering groups according to a specified condition after grouping

examples.en: The HAVING clause excluded locations whose total number of workshop bookings was below the chosen minimum.
examples.zh: 「HAVING 分组筛选子句」排除了工作坊预订数低于所选下限的地点。

examples.en: We used a HAVING clause to return only product categories with at least three different items.
examples.zh: 我们用「HAVING 分组筛选子句」只返回至少有三种商品的产品类别。

collocations: filter grouped results with a HAVING clause
include an aggregate condition in the HAVING clause

words.enDefinition: The branch containing changes proposed for merging into a different branch

examples.en: I added another correction to the head branch before asking for feedback.
examples.zh: 申请反馈前，我又给「变更来源分支」加了一项更正。

examples.en: The head branch held the example whose output our group had checked.
examples.zh: 「变更来源分支」保存了我们组核验过输出的示例。

collocations: compare the head branch with its base

words.enDefinition: The first node in a linked list, excluding any separate sentinel used by the implementation.

examples.en: The head node held the first card in the sequence shown on the worksheet.
examples.zh: 「头节点」保存了练习表所示序列中的第一张卡片。

examples.en: We checked the head node after adding a new colour before the original first item.
examples.zh: 把新颜色加到原第一项之前后，我们查看了「头节点」。

words.enDefinition: A pointer or reference used to locate the start of a linked list.

examples.en: The head pointer changed when the new list node became the first element in our example.
examples.zh: 例题中的新链表节点成为第一项后，「头指针」发生了变化。

examples.en: Our diagram used an arrow from the head pointer to the start of the chain.
examples.zh: 图中画了一条从「头指针」指向链起点的箭头。

words.enDefinition: Git's reference to the currently checked-out branch or commit

examples.en: We checked the HEAD reference before editing the classroom files.
examples.zh: 我们编辑课堂文件前，检查了「HEAD 引用」。

examples.en: The tutorial diagram showed the HEAD reference pointing to the current branch.
examples.zh: 教程示意图显示，「HEAD 引用」指向当前分支。

words.enDefinition: An HTTP request that asks for metadata much like a GET request, without response content.

examples.en: The sample HEAD request returns information about the catalogue page without including its HTML content.
examples.zh: 示例「HEAD 请求」返回目录页的相关信息，省去 HTML 内容。

examples.en: Our diagram gives the HEAD request its own row to highlight the absent response body.
examples.zh: 图中用单独一行画出「HEAD 请求」，突出这个响应没有响应体。

words.enDefinition: a row listing the column labels rather than containing an ordinary data observation

examples.en: The header row identified the columns in the timetable before the first actual booking record appeared.
examples.zh: 第一条实际预订记录之前，「标题行」标明了日程表各列。

examples.en: We removed an extra header row that had been repeated in the middle of the combined file.
examples.zh: 我们删除了在合并文件中部重复出现的一条多余「标题行」。

words.enDefinition: Memory used for objects or data allocated dynamically during program execution.

examples.en: The image tool used heap memory to store a preview whose dimensions were decided at runtime.
examples.zh: 图像工具把预览图存入「堆内存」，预览图的尺寸在运行时才确定。

examples.en: Our tutor traced heap memory use while the example loaded three photographs of different sizes.
examples.zh: 例题加载三张尺寸不同的照片时，老师跟踪了「堆内存」的使用量。

words.enDefinition: Sorting by building a heap and repeatedly removing its highest priority item

examples.en: The heapsort example built a heap before moving the largest values.
examples.zh: 「堆排序」示例先建立堆，然后才移出最大的值。

examples.en: We compared storage use for heapsort and a method with temporary lists.
examples.zh: 我们比较了「堆排序」和一种用临时列表的方法的存储用量。

words.enDefinition: A chart that uses colour shades or intensities to represent values across positions in a grid or space.

examples.en: The heat map shows library attendance by hour and day using a shade for each value.
examples.zh: 「热图」按小时和日期展示图书馆客流量，用色阶表示各个数值。

examples.en: We added a key to the heat map so readers could interpret the darkest cells.
examples.zh: 我们给「热图」添加图例，方便读者理解颜色最深的单元格。

words.enDefinition: base-sixteen representation using digits and the letters A through F

examples.en: The worksheet expressed one byte in hexadecimal notation using two digits for the display.
examples.zh: 练习表用「十六进制记数法」表示一个字节，显示为两个数位。

examples.en: I used hexadecimal notation to read the small colour values printed beside the sample drawing.
examples.zh: 我用「十六进制记数法」读出样本图旁印出的几个简短颜色值。

collocations: write a value in hexadecimal notation

words.enDefinition: Values or settings from earlier actions that affect a computation without being declared in the current run.

examples.en: Hidden state from an earlier notebook cell changed the result in our classroom example.
examples.zh: 课堂示例中，先前笔记本单元格的「隐藏状态」改变了计算结果。

examples.en: We traced the hidden state to a table that was still loaded from a previous run.
examples.zh: 我们追溯到「隐藏状态」来自上一轮运行后仍然在内存里的表格。

words.enDefinition: Building nested groups of observations by successively merging or splitting them.

examples.en: We used hierarchical clustering to see which book groups combined as the similarity requirement changed.
examples.zh: 我们用「层次聚类」观察相似程度要求变化后，哪些图书分组会合并。

examples.en: Our tutor drew the nested groups produced by hierarchical clustering in the practice exercise.
examples.zh: 老师画出了练习中「层次聚类」得到的嵌套分组。

collocations: inspect the result of hierarchical clustering

words.enDefinition: a design where the parts of a component serve closely related responsibilities

examples.en: The tutor illustrated high cohesion with a class containing only closely related label formatting methods.
examples.zh: 导师用一个只包含紧密相关的标签格式化方法的类说明「高内聚」。

examples.en: To demonstrate high cohesion, we moved unrelated output work out of the drawing class.
examples.zh: 为说明「高内聚」，我们把无关的输出工作移出了绘图类。

words.enDefinition: a function that takes at least one function as an argument, returns a function, or does both

examples.en: The higher-order function accepted a predicate function for deciding which survey responses should appear in its results.
examples.zh: 「高阶函数」接收一个谓词函数，用它决定哪些调查答复应列入结果。

examples.en: We wrote a higher-order function that returned a different formatting routine for each supported output style.
examples.zh: 我们写了一个「高阶函数」，为每种支持的输出样式返回不同的格式化例程。

collocations: pass a function to a higher-order function

words.enDefinition: a chart grouping numeric observations into intervals, with each bar's area representing the frequency or proportion in its interval

examples.en: We used a histogram to show how the measured plant heights were distributed across intervals.
examples.zh: 我们用「直方图」展示实测植物高度在各区间内的分布。

examples.en: The histogram has its tallest bar in the middle interval of the example rainfall measurements.
examples.zh: 示例降雨量数据的「直方图」中，最高的条形位于中间区间。

words.enDefinition: Evaluating a model on a reserved portion of the data after fitting on the remaining portion.

examples.en: The exercise used holdout validation by reserving one fixed portion of the workshop records for evaluation.
examples.zh: 练习保留了工作坊记录的固定一部分做评估，采用的是「留出法验证」。

examples.en: We chose holdout validation so every trial model could be compared on the same reserved examples.
examples.zh: 我们选择「留出法验证」，以便让每个试验模型在相同的留出样本上比较。

words.enDefinition: a method called at a defined point to allow custom behaviour

examples.en: The base class called a hook method before displaying every worksheet in the classroom example.
examples.zh: 在课堂示例中，基类每次显示练习表前都会调用一个「钩子方法」。

examples.en: Our tutor supplied a hook method that added a short heading to one worksheet.
examples.zh: 导师提供了一个「钩子方法」，为其中一份练习表加上简短标题。

words.enDefinition: The IPv6 header field that limits how many routers can forward a packet.

examples.en: The Hop Limit field in the IPv6 diagram shows a lower value after each forwarding step.
examples.zh: IPv6 图中的「跳数限制字段」在每次转发后都显示更低的数值。

examples.en: The tutor circled the Hop Limit field so we could distinguish it from the payload length.
examples.zh: 老师圈出了「跳数限制字段」，方便我们把它与有效载荷长度区分开。

collocations: zero in the Hop Limit field

words.enDefinition: The axis that runs from left to right on a standard two-dimensional plot.

examples.en: The horizontal axis shows the months of the year in the class rainfall chart.
examples.zh: 课堂降雨量图的「横轴」显示一年中的各个月份。

examples.en: We checked where the horizontal axis crosses the vertical axis on the worksheet figure.
examples.zh: 我们在练习图上查看了「横轴」与纵轴的交点。

words.enDefinition: A name used to identify a host on a network, often within a domain.

examples.en: The host name on our diagram identifies the classroom catalogue server within the example domain.
examples.zh: 图中的「主机名」用来标识示例域里的课堂目录服务器。

examples.en: The sample URL contains the host name before the slash that starts the path.
examples.zh: 示例 URL 的「主机名」位于路径开头的斜杠之前。

words.enDefinition: A name or name-value setting in HTML markup that gives additional information about an element.

examples.en: An HTML attribute supplies the alternative text for the picture in our classroom timetable example.
examples.zh: 课堂时间表示例通过「HTML 属性」为图片提供替代文本。

examples.en: The tutor underlined the HTML attribute that points to the stylesheet for the catalogue page.
examples.zh: 老师在指向目录页样式表的「HTML 属性」下面画了线。

words.enDefinition: A document whose markup describes the structure and content of a web page or related resource.

examples.en: The HTML document for the classroom catalogue contains a heading and a short list of books.
examples.zh: 课堂目录的「HTML 文档」包含一个标题和一份简短的图书清单。

examples.en: We opened the tiny HTML document in a browser to see the reading list it describes.
examples.zh: 我们用浏览器打开简短的「HTML 文档」，查看它描述的阅读书单。

words.enDefinition: A structural component of an HTML document, often represented in markup by one or more tags.

examples.en: The class added an HTML element to turn the title into a heading on the page.
examples.zh: 全班添加了一个「HTML 元素」，让书单标题成为页面上的标题。

examples.en: In our tree diagram, each HTML element for a book title sits inside the list.
examples.zh: 树状图里，用于书名的每个「HTML 元素」都在列表之内。

words.enDefinition: The software component that reads HTML markup and builds the document structure from it.

examples.en: The HTML parser reads the classroom catalogue file and builds a tree from its markup.
examples.zh: 「HTML 解析器」读取课堂目录文件，按其标记构建一棵树。

examples.en: Our diagram shows the HTML parser creating a list element before adding its first item.
examples.zh: 图中，「HTML 解析器」先创建列表元素，再加入第一项。

words.enDefinition: The HTTP version whose textual message format begins with a request or status line.

examples.en: The HTTP/1.1 example shows each header field on a separate line in the printed response.
examples.zh: 「HTTP/1.1」示例把打印响应中的每个首部字段单独列一行。

examples.en: Our diagram shows several requests using the same persistent HTTP/1.1 connection to the catalogue server.
examples.zh: 图中几条请求通过同一条持久的「HTTP/1.1」连接发送到目录服务器。

words.enDefinition: The HTTP version that uses binary frames and supports concurrent streams over one connection.

examples.en: The HTTP/2 diagram shows the catalogue page and stylesheet travelling on different streams of one connection.
examples.zh: 「HTTP/2」示意图显示目录页面和样式表通过同一连接的不同流传输。

examples.en: In class we compared the structure of an HTTP/2 frame with an older HTTP message format.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们比较了一个「HTTP/2」帧的结构和较早的 HTTP 消息格式。

words.enDefinition: A program that sends HTTP requests to a server and receives responses.

examples.en: The browser acts as the HTTP client in our diagram of a catalogue lookup.
examples.zh: 在目录查询示意图中，浏览器充当「HTTP 客户端」。

examples.en: The instructor drew the HTTP client on the left and the catalogue server on the right.
examples.zh: 老师把「HTTP 客户端」画在左边，把目录服务器画在右边。

collocations: an HTTP client sends a request

words.enDefinition: an HTTP response instructing the client to take a further action such as requesting a different resource

examples.en: An HTTP redirect takes the classroom browser from the former catalogue page to the new one.
examples.zh: 一条「HTTP 重定向」把课堂浏览器从旧的目录移到新页面。

examples.en: The tutor pointed out the HTTP redirect before showing the response from the final page.
examples.zh: 老师在展示最终页面的响应前，先指出了「HTTP 重定向」。

words.enDefinition: An HTTP message that asks a server to perform an operation on a target resource.

examples.en: Our browser sends an HTTP request when we choose the catalogue link in the lesson.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂上选中目录链接时，浏览器发出一条「HTTP 请求」。

examples.en: The sample HTTP request asks for a description of the workshop's opening hours in plain text.
examples.zh: 示例「HTTP 请求」以纯文本格式索取工作坊开放时间说明。

words.enDefinition: An HTTP message a server sends as its reply to a request.

examples.en: The HTTP response contains the library opening hours in the format requested by the classroom browser.
examples.zh: 「HTTP 响应」以课堂浏览器请求的格式提供图书馆开放时间。

examples.en: In the sample HTTP response, the status code appeared on the line before the header fields.
examples.zh: 在示例「HTTP 响应」中，状态码位于首部字段之前的状态行上。

words.enDefinition: A three-digit number that indicates the outcome of an HTTP request.

examples.en: The HTTP status code tells the classroom browser whether the request for the catalogue succeeded.
examples.zh: 「HTTP 状态码」告诉课堂浏览器，目录请求是否成功。

examples.en: I copied the HTTP status code into the notes column before reading the returned page.
examples.zh: 我在阅读返回的页面前，先把「HTTP 状态码」抄进笔记栏。

words.enDefinition: The edition of HTTP whose message format and connection rules govern an exchange.

examples.en: The classroom browser shows the HTTP version used to fetch the catalogue page in the example.
examples.zh: 课堂浏览器会显示示例中获取目录页面时用的「HTTP 版本」。

examples.en: Our lesson compares how each HTTP version carries the same request and its matching response.
examples.zh: 这一课比较各个「HTTP 版本」如何传输同一请求及其对应响应。

words.enDefinition: A setting of a model or training procedure chosen outside the fitting of its learned parameters.

examples.en: The tutor described tree depth as a hyperparameter we could restrict before fitting the model.
examples.zh: 老师介绍，树的最大深度是一项可在模型拟合前限制的「超参数」。

examples.en: We changed one hyperparameter at a time while comparing results on the same validation examples.
examples.zh: 在同一组验证样本上对比结果时，我们每次只改一个「超参数」。

collocations: choose a value for a hyperparameter

words.enDefinition: Comparing settings chosen outside fitting to find a configuration with better validation performance.

examples.en: We used hyperparameter tuning to compare several limits on the depth of the plant classification tree.
examples.zh: 我们用「超参数调优」对比了植物分类树的几种深度限制。

examples.en: The report recorded which settings were considered during hyperparameter tuning for the time prediction model.
examples.zh: 报告记录了用时预测模型在「超参数调优」期间考虑了哪些设置。

collocations: use validation data for hyperparameter tuning

words.enDefinition: The application-level protocol that defines how clients and servers exchange messages for web resources.

examples.en: The Hypertext Transfer Protocol defines the messages our browser and the classroom catalogue server exchange.
examples.zh: 「超文本传输协议」规定浏览器与课堂目录服务器交换的消息。

examples.en: We used the Hypertext Transfer Protocol to explain how the browser requests a public stylesheet.
examples.zh: 我们用「超文本传输协议」来解释浏览器怎样请求一个公开的样式表。

words.enDefinition: Work whose completion time is mainly limited by waiting for input or output operations.

examples.en: The copy job was an I/O-bound workload because it spent most of its time awaiting storage.
examples.zh: 复制任务大部分时间都在等存储设备，因此属于「I/O 受限的工作负载」。

examples.en: Our worksheet compared an I/O-bound workload reading large files with a calculation done entirely in memory.
examples.zh: 练习表对比了读取大文件的「I/O 受限的工作负载」和完全在内存中进行的运算。

collocations: measure waiting in an I/O-bound workload

words.enDefinition: The point at which an input or output request finishes and its result becomes available.

examples.en: The viewer displayed the new image only after I/O completion made the file data available.
examples.zh: 只有「I/O 完成」、文件数据可用之后，查看器才显示新图片。

examples.en: We marked I/O completion separately from the moment the request was first queued.
examples.zh: 我们将「I/O 完成」和请求首次入队的时刻分别标出。

words.enDefinition: The time between submitting an input or output request and receiving its result.

examples.en: The graph showed I/O latency rising when several simulated reads were waiting at the same time.
examples.zh: 几项模拟读取同时在等待时，图表显示「I/O 延迟」上升。

examples.en: We measured I/O latency for each of the small file reads rather than tracking total bytes.
examples.zh: 我们测量了每次小文件读取的「I/O 延迟」，侧重用时而非总字节数。

words.enDefinition: A request to carry out an input or output operation on a file or device.

examples.en: The monitor displayed an I/O request when the classroom program asked to read another record.
examples.zh: 课堂程序要求读取另一条记录时，监视器显示了一项「I/O 请求」。

examples.en: We timed the I/O request from submission until the simulator reported that it had finished.
examples.zh: 我们从提交「I/O 请求」开始计时，直到模拟器报告该请求完成。

words.enDefinition: An HTTP method whose intended server-side effect is the same for one request or several identical requests.

examples.en: The tutor used GET as an example of an idempotent method in the catalogue exercise.
examples.zh: 老师在目录练习中用 GET 作为「幂等方法」的例子。

examples.en: With an idempotent method, repeating an identical request has the same intended effect on the server.
examples.zh: 使用「幂等方法」时，重复发送相同请求对服务器的预期效果相同。

words.enDefinition: a name used to identify a program entity

examples.en: The workshop asked us to choose an identifier for the variable holding our total score.
examples.zh: 工作坊要求我们给保存总分的变量选一个「标识符」。

examples.en: I checked whether the leading character was allowed in a Python identifier before renaming it.
examples.zh: 我先检查那个字符能不能用作 Python「标识符」的首字符，再改名。

collocations: use an identifier in an expression

words.enDefinition: a variable used to identify observations or their groups during reshaping or matching

examples.en: The identifier variable kept the original room code attached to each measurement after the table was reshaped.
examples.zh: 表格重塑后，「标识变量」仍把原教室编号与各测量记录关联起来。

examples.en: We used two columns as an identifier variable pair because no room number was unique across campus.
examples.zh: 由于房间号在全校并不唯一，我们将两列结合起来作为一对「标识变量」。

collocations: retain an identifier variable during reshaping
match records using an identifier variable

words.enDefinition: a column whose missing insert values are automatically provided by an associated sequence under SQL identity rules

examples.en: The identity column automatically assigned a number when the tutor inserted a new sample product into the table.
examples.zh: 导师向表中插入一件示例产品时，「标识列」自动分配了一个编号。

examples.en: We used an identity column for the loan number and added a primary key to enforce its uniqueness.
examples.zh: 我们用「标识列」生成借阅编号，再加主键来保证唯一性。

collocations: insert a row with an identity column
use an identity column as a primary key

words.enDefinition: the initial clause of an if statement containing the first condition and its associated code

examples.en: The if clause printed a warning when the returned item was overdue by more than seven days.
examples.zh: 归还的物品逾期超过七天时，「if 子句」会打印一条提醒。

examples.en: We changed the if clause to distinguish a missing temperature value from a valid reading of zero.
examples.zh: 我们修改了「if 子句」，以区分温度缺失和数值为零的有效读数。

collocations: add code to the if clause
test the condition in an if clause

words.enDefinition: a statement that tests one or more conditions to decide which associated block, if any, to run

examples.en: An if statement checked whether the temperature reading fell outside the range used in our demonstration.
examples.zh: 一条「if 条件语句」检查温度读数是否落在演示所用范围以外。

examples.en: Our if statement skipped the average calculation when there were no recorded scores in the list.
examples.zh: 在列表没有分数记录时，我们的「if 条件语句」跳过了平均值计算。

collocations: the condition in an if statement

words.enDefinition: A fixed copy of data from a particular time whose contents are kept unchanged.

examples.en: The class kept an immutable data snapshot so subsequent edits would not affect the original analysis.
examples.zh: 全班保存了一份「不可变数据快照」，这样后续编辑就不会影响原始分析。

examples.en: We opened the immutable data snapshot to check the inputs used in the submitted report.
examples.zh: 我们打开「不可变数据快照」，核查提交报告时所用的输入数据。

collocations: immutable data snapshot from a given date

words.enDefinition: a value whose contents cannot be changed after creation

examples.en: The Python string was an immutable value, so editing its text produced a new string.
examples.zh: Python 字符串是「不可变值」，因此编辑文本会生成新的字符串。

examples.en: Our tutor used an immutable value to show why both names could safely share it.
examples.zh: 导师用一个「不可变值」说明为什么两个名称可以共享它。

words.enDefinition: to provide the operations specified by an interface

examples.en: The Java worksheet asked us to implement an interface for shapes with a measurable area.
examples.zh: Java 练习表要求我们为面积可计算的图形「实现一个接口」。

examples.en: Our tutor showed two ways to implement an interface while keeping the caller's code unchanged.
examples.zh: 导师展示了两种「实现一个接口」的方式，两种方式都保持调用方代码不变。

words.enDefinition: a design choice inside a component that clients need not rely on

examples.en: The public drawing method stayed unchanged when the tutor replaced an implementation detail inside the class.
examples.zh: 导师替换类内部的一个「实现细节」时，公开绘图方法保持不变。

examples.en: We marked the choice of units as an implementation detail in the sample diagram.
examples.zh: 我们在样本图中把单位的选择标记为「实现细节」。

words.enDefinition: returning a value automatically without an explicit return statement for that result

examples.en: The JavaScript example used an implicit return in an arrow function whose body was a single expression.
examples.zh: JavaScript 示例的箭头函数体是单个表达式，因此采用「隐式返回」。

examples.en: The class discussed the implicit return of None when a Python function reached the end of its body.
examples.zh: 全班讨论了 Python 函数运行到函数体末尾时对 None 的「隐式返回」。

collocations: replace an implicit return with a return statement

words.enDefinition: an alternative local name assigned to a module or member during import

examples.en: The import alias gave the formatting module a shorter name in the small examples used during class.
examples.zh: 「导入别名」让格式化模块在课堂小示例中能用更短的名字。

examples.en: We added an import alias because the new helper otherwise shared a name with an existing function.
examples.zh: 新辅助函数原先和一个现有函数同名，所以我们加了「导入别名」。

collocations: rename a module with an import alias

words.enDefinition: a statement that refers to a module and may bind names from it for use by the importing code

examples.en: The import statement made the shared formatting helper available to the part of the program that printed labels.
examples.zh: 「导入语句」让程序中负责打印标签的部分可以使用共用的格式化辅助函数。

examples.en: We changed the import statement after moving the helper into a separate file within the package.
examples.zh: 把辅助函数移到包内的另一个文件后，我们修改了「导入语句」。

collocations: resolve the module in an import statement

words.enDefinition: a function that has an observable side effect or whose output can vary for the same inputs

examples.en: The tutor called it an impure function because it wrote a message into the shared activity log.
examples.zh: 这个函数会往共享活动日志里写一条消息，所以导师称它为「非纯函数」。

examples.en: We tested the impure function with a fixed clock because it normally read the current time.
examples.zh: 我们用固定时钟测试「非纯函数」，因为它通常会读取当前时间。

words.enDefinition: to replace a missing entry with an estimated or assigned value according to a specified method

examples.en: The tutor asked whether we could impute a missing value without adding information from later measurements.
examples.zh: 导师问，我们能否不引入日后测量的信息，直接「插补一个缺失值」。

examples.en: We chose to impute a missing value only after checking how many observations lacked that measure.
examples.zh: 我们先核查多少观测没有该测量值，再决定「插补一个缺失值」。

collocations: impute a missing value using a model
choose how to impute a missing value
document the decision to impute a missing value

words.enDefinition: The number of directed edges entering a specified vertex

examples.en: The course had an in-degree of two because two prerequisites pointed to it.
examples.zh: 两个先修课都指向这门课，所以这门课对应顶点的「入度」是二。

examples.en: We updated the in-degree after removing one incoming arrow in class.
examples.zh: 我们在课上删掉一条指入的箭头后，更新了「入度」。

words.enDefinition: Changing an existing collection directly instead of building a replacement collection.

examples.en: The operation performed an in-place modification, so both variables referring to the list saw the new value.
examples.zh: 操作进行了「原地修改」，所以引用该列表的两个变量都能看到新值。

examples.en: Our tutor asked whether the sorting method used in-place modification or returned a separate list.
examples.zh: 老师问，排序方法执行的是「原地修改」，还是返回单独的列表。

collocations: perform in-place modification on a list

words.enDefinition: A sort rearranging items directly with little additional working storage

examples.en: The in-place sort rearranged values directly inside the existing array in our example.
examples.zh: 在我们的示例中，「原地排序」直接在现有数组里重新排列值。

examples.en: Our tutor compared an in-place sort with a method needing a separate array.
examples.zh: 导师把「原地排序」和一种需要独立数组的方法作了比较。

collocations: the extra storage of an in-place sort

words.enDefinition: a SQL predicate testing a value for membership in a list or a query result, with SQL null rules

examples.en: Our IN predicate selected bookings for any of the three rooms used in the class workshop.
examples.zh: 我们的「IN 成员谓词」选出课堂工作坊使用的三个房间中任一房间的预订。

examples.en: The tutor checked how the IN predicate behaved when the comparison list included a missing code.
examples.zh: 导师检查比较列表包含一个缺失代码时，「IN 成员谓词」会怎样求值。

collocations: combine an IN predicate with a subquery
check null handling in an IN predicate

words.enDefinition: Use space characters to move code inward from the left margin

examples.en: We set the editor to indent with spaces for the Python worksheet.
examples.zh: 我们把编辑器设为「用空格缩进」，用来做 Python 练习。

examples.en: The style guide asked everyone to indent with spaces in the shared examples.
examples.zh: 风格指南要求大家在共用示例里「用空格缩进」。

collocations: configure an editor to indent with spaces

words.enDefinition: A position in the hierarchy defined by how far lines are indented

examples.en: The last print line sat at a different indentation level from the others.
examples.zh: 最后一条打印语句和其他几条处在不同的「缩进层级」。

examples.en: I matched the indentation level of both lines before rerunning the Python exercise.
examples.zh: 我先统一两行的「缩进层级」，再重新运行 Python 练习。

words.enDefinition: Language syntax in which indentation has a structural or grammatical role

examples.en: Our tutor introduced indentation-sensitive syntax by moving one line in the Python example.
examples.zh: 导师通过移动 Python 示例中的一行来介绍「用缩进分组的语法」。

examples.en: The diagram showed how indentation-sensitive syntax could change the result without changing the words.
examples.zh: 这张图说明，即使用词没变，「用缩进分组的语法」也可能使程序结果发生变化。

words.enDefinition: A Python syntax exception indicating invalid indentation in source code

examples.en: The example produced an IndentationError because the next instruction was misaligned.
examples.zh: 下一条指令没对齐，导致示例出现「Python 缩进错误」。

examples.en: The traceback showed which line of source triggered the IndentationError.
examples.zh: 异常回溯显示了源代码的哪一行触发了「Python 缩进错误」。

collocations: fix the cause of an IndentationError

words.enDefinition: matching values on labelled indexes so operations combine corresponding labels rather than positions

examples.en: The index alignment matched readings by date although the two source lists had been sorted differently.
examples.zh: 尽管两份原始列表的排序不同，「索引对齐」仍然按日期匹配各项读数。

examples.en: We checked index alignment after addition produced missing values for dates appearing in only one input.
examples.zh: 两份数据相加时，仅在其中一份出现的日期对应结果为缺失值，于是我们检查了「索引对齐」。

collocations: handle missing values after index alignment

words.enDefinition: The limits defining the lowest and highest valid positions for a collection.

examples.en: The exercise asked us to check index bounds before reading a square on the board.
examples.zh: 练习要求我们先核对「索引边界」，再读取棋盘上的格子。

examples.en: We wrote the index bounds beside the array so the final valid position was clear.
examples.zh: 我们把「索引边界」写在数组旁，标清最后一个有效位置。

words.enDefinition: A message or description indicating that an index does not identify an accessible position.

examples.en: The Python exercise reported an index out of range error when we read past the final item.
examples.zh: 我们尝试读取最后一项之后的位置时，Python 练习报告了「索引超出范围」错误。

examples.en: Our tutor traced the index out of range message to a row number beyond the table.
examples.zh: 老师查明，「索引超出范围」的提示是因为行号超过了表格范围。

collocations: an index out of range error
handle an index out of range condition

words.enDefinition: finding qualifying or ordered records by traversing an index according to a query plan

examples.en: The index scan located a small range of matching dates in the test table of workshop bookings.
examples.zh: 「索引扫描」在工作坊预订测试表中定位到一小段匹配日期。

examples.en: We compared the index scan with a plan that read the whole table for the same report.
examples.zh: 对于同一份报表，我们把「索引扫描」与读取整张表的执行计划进行了比较。

collocations: retrieve matching rows with an index scan

words.enDefinition: A feature that may help distinguish a person when combined with other information.

examples.en: The review considers whether a detailed location could serve as an indirect identifier in the example.
examples.zh: 审查会考虑详细地点在示例中是否可能充当「间接标识符」。

examples.en: The workshop asks why an indirect identifier may still deserve attention after names are removed.
examples.zh: 工作坊要求解释为什么去掉姓名后，「间接标识符」仍可能值得关注。

words.enDefinition: a loop that does not end through its own normal control logic

examples.en: The notebook kernel stayed busy because an infinite loop kept processing the same row without advancing.
examples.zh: 「无限循环」不断处理同一行数据，始终没有前进，笔记本内核因此一直处于忙碌状态。

examples.en: We found the infinite loop after noticing that the counter never changed on the empty input path.
examples.zh: 我们注意到空输入路径上计数器一直不变，由此发现了「无限循环」。

words.enDefinition: keeping implementation choices out of a component's exposed contract

examples.en: The example used information hiding to let us change storage while keeping the same drawing methods.
examples.zh: 示例运用「信息隐藏」，让我们在保持绘图方法不变的情况下修改存储方式。

examples.en: Our tutor discussed information hiding before replacing the internal representation of each classroom shape.
examples.zh: 导师先讨论「信息隐藏」，再替换各课堂图形的内部表示。

words.enDefinition: defining one class in terms of members or behaviour of another

examples.en: The example used inheritance to give two related shapes the same method for displaying labels.
examples.zh: 示例用「继承」让两种相关图形共用显示标签的方法。

examples.en: Our tutor discussed inheritance before deciding which behaviours belonged in the sample's general class.
examples.zh: 导师讨论了「继承」，然后决定样本通用类应包括哪些行为。

words.enDefinition: the sequence in which an object's parts receive their initial values

examples.en: The JavaScript worksheet compared initialization order for fields in the base and derived classes.
examples.zh: JavaScript 练习表比较基类和派生类字段的「初始化顺序」。

examples.en: Our tutor drew the initialization order before tracing when the example's label became available.
examples.zh: 导师先画出「初始化顺序」，再追踪示例中的标签何时可用。

words.enDefinition: a method that sets up the state of an already created instance

examples.en: The Python example used an initializer method to set the title of each new library item.
examples.zh: Python 示例用「初始化方法」给每个新借阅项目设置标题。

examples.en: Our tutor identified __init__ as the initializer method called during construction of the example object.
examples.zh: 导师指出，__init__ 是构造示例对象过程中调用的「初始化方法」。

words.enDefinition: a join returning combinations of input rows that match the join condition

examples.en: The inner join returned only catalogue entries that had at least one recorded loan in the sample.
examples.zh: 「内联接」只返回样本中至少存在一条借阅记录的目录条目。

examples.en: We used an inner join to show each order alongside the matching record for its supplier.
examples.zh: 我们用「内联接」把各条订单和对应的供应商记录并列显示。

collocations: join two tables with an inner join

words.enDefinition: a loop contained in the body of another loop

examples.en: The inner loop counted the occupied seats for the row selected by the outer loop.
examples.zh: 「内层循环」统计外层循环选中那一排中已占用的座位。

examples.en: Most of the exercise's work happened inside the inner loop because it compared every pair of items.
examples.zh: 练习的大部分运算发生在「内层循环」中，因为它要比较每一对条目。

collocations: move work out of the inner loop

words.enDefinition: The node visited immediately after another in an inorder traversal

examples.en: The inorder successor came from the right subtree in this example.
examples.zh: 这个示例中的「中序后继节点」来自右子树。

examples.en: We found the inorder successor by writing out the ordered list of keys.
examples.zh: 我们把键按顺序写成列表，找出了「中序后继节点」。

collocations: replace a node with its inorder successor

words.enDefinition: A binary tree traversal visiting left subtree, node, then right subtree

examples.en: The inorder traversal displayed the binary search tree's keys in increasing order.
examples.zh: 「中序遍历」按升序显示二叉搜索树中的键。

examples.en: We traced inorder traversal by writing the parent between its two subtrees.
examples.zh: 我们把父节点写在两棵子树之间，跟踪了「中序遍历」。

collocations: an inorder traversal of a binary tree

words.enDefinition: A file containing data that a program reads for processing

examples.en: I chose the smaller input file before running the program again.
examples.zh: 我在再次运行程序前，选择了较小的「输入文件」。

examples.en: The input file held one temperature reading on each line of text.
examples.zh: 「输入文件」的每行文字记录一个温度读数。

words.enDefinition: A file or record listing the inputs for a particular workflow, typically with identifying details.

examples.en: The input manifest lists two public tables and the version information for both source files.
examples.zh: 「输入清单」列出两张公开表及这两个源文件的版本信息。

examples.en: We compared the input manifest with the contents of the folder before starting the analysis.
examples.zh: 开始分析前，我们把「输入清单」与文件夹里的内容作了核对。

collocations: sources listed in the input manifest

words.enDefinition: A message asking a user to enter data for a program

examples.en: I changed the input prompt so it asked for the temperature in Celsius.
examples.zh: 我改了「输入提示」，让它要求用户输入摄氏温度。

examples.en: The input prompt appeared before the program waited for me to type.
examples.zh: 程序等我输入之前，出现了「输入提示」。

words.enDefinition: The quantity used to measure how much data an algorithm receives

examples.en: We defined input size as the number of records for this exercise.
examples.zh: 我们把练习中的「输入规模」定义为记录的数量。

examples.en: The input size grew when we added more vertices to the example graph.
examples.zh: 我们给示例图加了更多顶点后，「输入规模」增大了。

words.enDefinition: To add a new list node immediately after an existing one by changing the relevant links.

examples.en: The tutor showed how to insert after a node by updating the links in our drawing.
examples.zh: 老师通过更新图上的链接，演示怎样「在节点后插入」。

examples.en: Our worksheet asked where the new colour would appear if we chose to insert after a node.
examples.zh: 练习表问，如果选择「在节点后插入」，新颜色会出现在哪里。

collocations: insert after a node in a list
insert after a node without shifting elements
prepare the link before you insert after a node
