words.enDefinition: To add an element at a chosen position, moving later elements if the collection preserves their order.

examples.en: The tutor showed how to insert at an index while keeping the other colours in order.
examples.zh: 老师演示了怎样「在指定索引处插入」并保持其他颜色的顺序。

examples.en: We let the user insert at an index chosen from the valid positions on the worksheet.
examples.zh: 我们允许使用者从练习表中选一个有效位置，然后「在指定索引处插入」。

collocations: insert at an index in a list
insert at an index before the final element
check the position before you insert at an index

words.enDefinition: a SQL statement adding one or more new rows to a table

examples.en: The INSERT statement added a new classroom to the sample table with its name and maximum capacity.
examples.zh: 「INSERT 插入语句」向样本表添加了一间新教室，并写入名称和最大容量。

examples.en: We checked the INSERT statement before adding the batch of catalogue entries supplied for the classroom exercise.
examples.zh: 把课堂练习提供的一批目录条目加入表中之前，我们核查了「INSERT 插入语句」。

collocations: list target columns in an INSERT statement

words.enDefinition: difficulty recording one fact because the existing design requires an unrelated fact to be present at insertion

examples.en: The insertion anomaly meant we could not list a new course until at least one student enrolled.
examples.zh: 「插入异常」导致我们至少要等一名学生选课，才能将新课程列入表中。

examples.en: We fixed the insertion anomaly by keeping courses and enrolments in separate tables for the assignment.
examples.zh: 我们在作业中把课程和选课信息存于不同的表，修复了「插入异常」。

words.enDefinition: The order in which distinct entries were originally added to a collection.

examples.en: The Python dictionary kept insertion order, so the names appeared in the sequence we added them.
examples.zh: Python 字典保留「插入顺序」，所以姓名按我们添加它们的次序出现。

examples.en: We chose to show the sample cards in insertion order instead of sorting them alphabetically.
examples.zh: 我们选择按「插入顺序」显示样本卡片，而非按字母顺序排序。

words.enDefinition: A position where adding a key preserves the current sorted order

examples.en: The search returned an insertion point for a name absent from the list.
examples.zh: 查找为列表中没有的姓名返回了「有序插入位置」。

examples.en: We drew the insertion point between two scores on the number line.
examples.zh: 我们在数轴上两个分数之间画出了「有序插入位置」。

collocations: insert a key at the insertion point

words.enDefinition: Sorting by inserting successive items into an already ordered part

examples.en: The insertion sort moved the next card into the correct place.
examples.zh: 「插入排序」把下一张卡放到了正确位置。

examples.en: We tried insertion sort with a sequence that was nearly sorted already.
examples.zh: 我们用一组几乎已经排好序的数据试了「插入排序」。

collocations: use insertion sort on small inputs

words.enDefinition: an attribute associated with a particular object, rather than with the class shared by its instances

examples.en: The Python example stored each book's title in an instance attribute on that object.
examples.zh: Python 示例把每本书的标题保存在该对象的一个「实例属性」中。

examples.en: Our tutor changed one instance attribute and checked that the second object's value stayed unchanged.
examples.zh: 导师修改一个「实例属性」，再确认第二个对象的值保持不变。

words.enDefinition: a method called with a particular instance as its receiver

examples.en: The Python exercise called an instance method to move one shape to a new position.
examples.zh: Python 练习调用「实例方法」，把一个图形移到新位置。

examples.en: Our tutor checked which object received the instance method call in the drawing example.
examples.zh: 导师检查绘图示例中的哪个对象接收了这次「实例方法」调用。

words.enDefinition: to create a new object from a class

examples.en: The worksheet asked us to instantiate a class representing a recipe with a name.
examples.zh: 练习表要求我们「实例化一个类」，该类表示一份有名称的食谱。

examples.en: Our tutor showed how to instantiate a class twice and inspect the two objects.
examples.zh: 导师演示了怎样两次「实例化一个类」，并检查得到的两个对象。

collocations: instantiate a class for a test

words.enDefinition: an integer result falling outside the type's representable range

examples.en: The worksheet flagged integer overflow when our toy counter exceeded the range permitted by its type.
examples.zh: 练习表用来演示的小计数器超出类型所允许的范围时，标记了「整数溢出」。

examples.en: We discussed why integer overflow could behave differently across the exercise's two example languages.
examples.zh: 我们讨论了为什么「整数溢出」在练习所用两种示例语言中的表现可能不同。

words.enDefinition: a numeric type used for numbers with no fractional part

examples.en: The class chose an integer type for counting the pages in each sample booklet.
examples.zh: 同学们选用「整数类型」来统计每本样本小册子的页数。

examples.en: Our tutor asked what range the integer type could represent in the worksheet's example language.
examples.zh: 导师问，练习表的示例语言中，这种「整数类型」可以表示多大的数值范围。

words.enDefinition: An application combining code editing, running, and often debugging tools

examples.en: Our lab used an integrated development environment to run Java from the editor.
examples.zh: 我们在实验课上用「集成开发环境」，直接从编辑器运行 Java 程序。

examples.en: The integrated development environment showed program output below the source file after each run.
examples.zh: 每次运行后，「集成开发环境」都把程序输出显示在源文件下方。

collocations: open a project in an integrated development environment

words.enDefinition: A test checking how two or more software components work together

examples.en: Our integration test checked that the reader passed dates to the report generator.
examples.zh: 我们的「集成测试」检查读取程序有没有把日期传给报告生成程序。

examples.en: The integration test used a small database shared by both components in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上的「集成测试」用一个小数据库供两个组件共用。

collocations: an integration test for two components

words.enDefinition: A chart that responds to reader actions to reveal or change the information shown.

examples.en: The interactive chart lets readers select a month and see the corresponding library visitor counts.
examples.zh: 「交互式图表」让读者选一个月份，查看相应的图书馆访客量。

examples.en: We checked that the interactive chart could be used without a mouse during the demonstration.
examples.zh: 演示中，我们确认了不用鼠标也能操作「交互式图表」。

words.enDefinition: A mode accepting and evaluating instructions while the user types

examples.en: I opened Python in interactive mode to try the short calculation.
examples.zh: 我以「交互模式」打开 Python，试算这个短算式。

examples.en: The tutor used interactive mode while demonstrating how each line was evaluated.
examples.zh: 导师用「交互模式」演示每一行如何求值。

collocations: try an expression in interactive mode

words.enDefinition: A marker showing an interactive session is ready for another command

examples.en: The interactive prompt appeared again after the interpreter displayed the answer.
examples.zh: 解释器显示答案后，「交互提示符」再次出现。

examples.en: I waited for the interactive prompt before typing my next Python instruction.
examples.zh: 我等「交互提示符」出现后，才输入下一条 Python 指令。

words.enDefinition: a type specifying operations that implementing classes agree to support

examples.en: The Java example defined an interface for objects that could be drawn on the screen.
examples.zh: Java 示例为能够在屏幕上绘制的对象定义了一个「接口」。

examples.en: The timetable accepted either of the classroom room types through the same interface.
examples.zh: 课堂时间表通过同一个「接口」接收两种教室类型。

words.enDefinition: the operations and behavioural promises callers can rely on

examples.en: The interface contract said that the returned area would be measured in square centimetres.
examples.zh: 「接口契约」说明，返回的面积以平方厘米为单位。

examples.en: Our class checked whether both example implementations kept the same interface contract about empty lists.
examples.zh: 同学们核对两套示例实现是否遵守有关空列表的同一份「接口契约」。

words.enDefinition: the principle that clients should rely only on operations they need

examples.en: The worksheet applied the interface segregation principle by separating drawing operations from measurement operations.
examples.zh: 练习表将绘图和测量操作分开，应用了「接口隔离原则」。

examples.en: Our tutor used the interface segregation principle so a simple label needed only one operation.
examples.zh: 导师运用「接口隔离原则」，使简单的标签只需要一种操作。

collocations: an example of the interface segregation principle

words.enDefinition: An ordering in which steps from different tasks are mixed during concurrent execution.

examples.en: The worksheet pictured one possible interleaving of the steps from the two tasks.
examples.zh: 练习表画出了这两项任务的步骤之间一种可能的「交错执行顺序」。

examples.en: We compared the interleaving shown by the simulator with the order drawn on the board.
examples.zh: 我们把模拟器显示的「交错执行顺序」和黑板上画出的次序作了比较。

words.enDefinition: A tree node that has at least one child

examples.en: The new child made the previously isolated leaf an internal node in the tree.
examples.zh: 添加子节点后，原来没有子节点的叶节点成了「内部节点」。

examples.en: I checked each internal node while tracing the search on the worksheet.
examples.zh: 我在练习表上跟踪查找过程时，核对了每个「内部节点」。

collocations: an internal node with two children

words.enDefinition: the way an object stores and organises its underlying data

examples.en: The class changed its internal representation from two measurements to a list of coordinates.
examples.zh: 这个类把「内部表示」从两个测量值改为一组坐标。

examples.en: Our tutor compared the internal representation of two shapes that shared the same drawing method.
examples.zh: 导师比较了两个共享同一绘图方法的图形的「内部表示」。

words.enDefinition: a gap between observed positions where values could be estimated using interpolation

examples.en: We measured the interpolation gap before deciding whether the nearest readings were too far apart to use.
examples.zh: 我们先测量「待插值的区间」，再判断最近的两条读数之间是否相隔太远。

examples.en: The tutor left the interpolation gap unchanged because there were no observations from that entire afternoon.
examples.zh: 由于整个下午都没有观测值，导师没有填补这个「待插值的区间」。

collocations: limit the length of an interpolation gap

words.enDefinition: Software that executes program instructions from source or an intermediate representation

examples.en: The interpreter accepted my next line after printing the first result.
examples.zh: 「解释器」打印第一个结果后，接受了我输入的下一行。

examples.en: I checked which interpreter the editor was using for the exercise.
examples.zh: 我检查了编辑器为这次练习选用的是哪个「解释器」。

words.enDefinition: The release of an interpreter used to execute a program

examples.en: I noted the interpreter version after noticing the file ran differently in the lab.
examples.zh: 我注意到文件在实验课上运行方式不同，就记下了「解释器版本」。

examples.en: The guide asked us to check the interpreter version before opening the examples.
examples.zh: 指南要求我们在打开示例前先确认「解释器版本」。

words.enDefinition: Mechanisms that let separate processes exchange information or coordinate work.

examples.en: The example used interprocess communication to pass a completed thumbnail from the helper to the viewer.
examples.zh: 例题用「进程间通信」把完成的缩略图从辅助程序传给查看器。

examples.en: Our tutor explained why two processes needed interprocess communication to exchange the sample measurements.
examples.zh: 老师解释为什么两个进程需要借助「进程间通信」交换样本测量值。

collocations: send a result through interprocess communication

words.enDefinition: a potential-outlier cutoff formed by extending beyond a quartile by a chosen multiple of the interquartile range

examples.en: The tutor calculated an interquartile fence above the third quartile and flagged two unusually large values.
examples.zh: 导师在第三四分位数之上计算了一个「四分位距围栏」，标记两个异常大的值。

examples.en: We chose an interquartile fence for screening before reviewing the observations that exceeded it.
examples.zh: 在复查超过界限的观测值之前，我们先为筛查选定一个「四分位距围栏」。

collocations: flag values outside an interquartile fence

words.enDefinition: A routine run in response to a given interrupt.

examples.en: The simulator ran an interrupt handler after the practice device announced that a transfer had finished.
examples.zh: 练习设备报告传输完成后，模拟器运行了「中断处理程序」。

examples.en: Our tutor showed when the interrupt handler ran relative to the program waiting for data.
examples.zh: 老师展示了「中断处理程序」运行的时刻与程序等待数据的时间关系。

words.enDefinition: An execution stopped before its planned work has been completed

examples.en: The interrupted run left only the first two totals visible on screen.
examples.zh: 「被中断的一次运行」只在屏幕上留下了前两个合计数。

examples.en: We treated the interrupted run as incomplete when comparing the exercise results.
examples.zh: 比较练习结果时，我们把「被中断的一次运行」视为未完成。

collocations: resume work after an interrupted run
a log from an interrupted run

words.enDefinition: the SQL set operator returning rows present in both inputs, with duplicates removed by default

examples.en: The INTERSECT operator found the books that appeared in both the autumn and spring reading lists.
examples.zh: 「INTERSECT 交集运算符」找出了秋季和春季阅读清单上都列出的书。

examples.en: We used the INTERSECT operator to compare the selected room codes across two independently prepared timetables.
examples.zh: 我们用「INTERSECT 交集运算符」比较两份分别编制的日程表中选出的房间代码。

collocations: find common rows with the INTERSECT operator
check column order for the INTERSECT operator

words.enDefinition: giving control over some execution or setup to an external framework or component

examples.en: The classroom framework illustrated inversion of control by choosing when to call our drawing method.
examples.zh: 课堂框架通过决定何时调用我们的绘图方法，展示了「控制反转」。

examples.en: Our tutor used inversion of control to explain why the framework called the sample object.
examples.zh: 导师用「控制反转」说明为什么由框架调用样本对象。

collocations: a framework using inversion of control
an example of inversion of control

words.enDefinition: A unit of data sent using the Internet Protocol, containing an IP header and its payload.

examples.en: The IP datagram shown on the slide contains a header followed by the carried data.
examples.zh: 幻灯片上的「IP 数据报」先是首部，后面跟着它承载的数据。

examples.en: The same IP datagram is drawn inside a link layer frame in the second illustration.
examples.zh: 第二张图把同一个「IP 数据报」画在链路层帧里面。

words.enDefinition: A 32-bit Internet Protocol address commonly written as four decimal numbers separated by dots.

examples.en: The IPv4 address in our worksheet has four decimal numbers separated by three dots.
examples.zh: 练习纸上的「IPv4 地址」由三个点隔开的四个十进制数组成。

examples.en: Mina copied the IPv4 address from the classroom handout into the correct box on her diagram.
examples.zh: 米娜把课堂讲义上的「IPv4 地址」抄到了图中对应的方框里。

words.enDefinition: A 128-bit Internet Protocol address normally written as colon-separated groups of hexadecimal digits.

examples.en: The tutor showed how the same IPv6 address can have a shorter written form.
examples.zh: 老师演示了同一个「IPv6 地址」可以怎样缩写。

examples.en: Our sample IPv6 address uses double colons to shorten a run of zero groups.
examples.zh: 示例「IPv6 地址」用双冒号缩写了连续的全零组。

words.enDefinition: Prediction error that remains even for the best possible predictor given the available information.

examples.en: The simulation included irreducible error because equally sized book batches could take different amounts of time.
examples.zh: 模拟加入了「不可约误差」，因为相同大小的图书批次实际用时也可能不同。

examples.en: Our tutor explained why a more flexible model could not remove the irreducible error in the simulation.
examples.zh: 老师解释了为何更灵活的模型仍无法消除模拟中的「不可约误差」。

collocations: distinguish irreducible error from model error
estimate irreducible error in a simulation

words.enDefinition: a pattern that cannot fail to match any subject in the applicable language

examples.en: The final Python case used an irrefutable pattern to handle any value the earlier cases had missed.
examples.zh: Python 最后一个分支用「不可反驳模式」接收前面分支没匹配的任何值。

examples.en: Our tutor moved the irrefutable pattern to the end because its unguarded case would always match.
examples.zh: 导师把「不可反驳模式」移到末尾，因为它不加守卫就总会匹配。

words.enDefinition: a relationship where one type is a specialised kind of another

examples.en: The diagram showed an is-a relationship between the rectangle type and the general shape type.
examples.zh: 图示表明，矩形类型是通用图形类型的一种，这属于「是一种关系」。

examples.en: Our tutor used an is-a relationship to explain why a circle could be treated as a shape.
examples.zh: 导师用「是一种关系」解释为什么圆可以作为一种图形处理。

words.enDefinition: a SQL test for a null value, evaluated without ordinary equality comparison

examples.en: The query used an IS NULL predicate to find books with no recorded publication date.
examples.zh: 查询使用「IS NULL 判空谓词」查找没有记录出版日期的图书。

examples.en: We used an IS NULL predicate to identify events whose room assignments had not yet been entered.
examples.zh: 我们用「IS NULL 判空谓词」找出还没录入房间分配结果的活动。

collocations: check for missing values with an IS NULL predicate

words.enDefinition: An object exposing a mapping's current entries as key-value pairs without copying them.

examples.en: The dictionary's items view let us see each colour name beside its code in the example.
examples.zh: 例题中，字典的「键值对视图」让我们同时看到各颜色名称及其代码。

examples.en: We looked at the items view again after one value in the original dictionary changed.
examples.zh: 原字典的一项值变化后，我们又看了一次「键值对视图」。

collocations: inspect pairs in an items view

words.enDefinition: an object that can supply an iterator so its values can be visited in order

examples.en: Our exercise accepted any iterable whose elements were numbers we could add together.
examples.zh: 练习接受任何元素都是可相加数值的「可迭代对象」。

examples.en: The tutor used a Python list as an iterable when demonstrating how iteration begins.
examples.zh: 老师演示遍历怎样开始时，用了一个 Python 列表作「可迭代对象」。

collocations: obtain an iterator from an iterable
pass an iterable to a function

words.enDefinition: To visit a collection's elements in their iteration order.

examples.en: The exercise asked us to iterate over a collection of temperatures and print each reading.
examples.zh: 练习要求我们「遍历集合容器」里的温度值，并打印每个读数。

examples.en: Our tutor showed how to iterate over a collection before asking us to total its numeric values.
examples.zh: 老师先演示了怎样「遍历集合容器」，再让我们把里面的数值加总。

collocations: iterate over a collection of values
iterate over a collection without modifying it
use an iterator to iterate over a collection

words.enDefinition: To visit each mapping entry and obtain both its key and its associated value.

examples.en: We needed to iterate over entries because the table showed both each name and its score.
examples.zh: 表格既要显示姓名也要显示分数，因此我们需要「遍历映射条目」。

examples.en: The Python exercise used the dictionary's items method to iterate over entries as pairs.
examples.zh: Python 练习用字典的 items 方法「遍历映射条目」，逐个得到键值对。

collocations: iterate over entries in a map
iterate over entries to read each pair
iterate over entries without changing the keys

words.enDefinition: The order in which a collection's elements are produced during traversal.

examples.en: The iteration order mattered because students compared the printed scores line by line with the example.
examples.zh: 学生要把输出的成绩逐行与示例核对，所以「迭代顺序」很重要。

examples.en: Our tutor asked whether the model guaranteed an iteration order for the set of colours.
examples.zh: 老师问，模型会不会保证这个颜色集合的「迭代顺序」。

words.enDefinition: An object that tracks a traversal's current position and provides successive elements.

examples.en: The iterator returned one card at a time as we stepped through the example.
examples.zh: 我们逐步运行示例时，「迭代器」一次返回一张卡片。

examples.en: Our tutor created a second iterator so two students could read the cards independently.
examples.zh: 老师创建了第二个「迭代器」，让两名学生各自读取卡片。

words.enDefinition: The state in which an iterator has no remaining values to produce.

examples.en: The Python example detected iterator exhaustion after it had returned every colour from the list.
examples.zh: Python 示例已经返回列表中的每种颜色后，检测到了「迭代器耗尽」。

examples.en: We created a new iterator after iterator exhaustion so we could read the sequence again.
examples.zh: 「迭代器耗尽」后，我们创建了一个新的迭代器，以便再次读取这个序列。

words.enDefinition: A change that prevents an existing iterator from being used reliably according to its collection's rules.

examples.en: Our C++ example showed iterator invalidation after a vector grew and moved to new storage.
examples.zh: C++ 示例展示了向量扩展并迁移到新存储位置后出现的「迭代器失效」。

examples.en: The tutor asked which changes caused iterator invalidation for the specific container used in the lab.
examples.zh: 老师问，对于实验课用的这个容器，哪些改动会导致「迭代器失效」。

collocations: check the container's rules for iterator invalidation

words.enDefinition: An array of arrays whose inner arrays may have different lengths.

examples.en: The C# example used a jagged array because some teams had more scores than others.
examples.zh: C# 示例采用「不规则数组」，因为有些队录入的分数比其他队多。

examples.en: We measured each row of the jagged array separately before displaying the practice table.
examples.zh: 显示练习表之前，我们分别测量了「不规则数组」每行的长度。

collocations: store rows in a jagged array
use a jagged array for unequal row lengths

words.enDefinition: A package of tools and runtime facilities for developing Java programs

examples.en: The lab instructions identified the Java Development Kit available on the shared machines.
examples.zh: 实验说明指出了共用机器上可用的「Java 开发工具包」。

examples.en: I checked which Java Development Kit our editor used to compile the example.
examples.zh: 我检查了编辑器用哪个「Java 开发工具包」来编译示例。

collocations: use the Java Development Kit compiler

words.enDefinition: The command-line tool that starts a Java program or source file

examples.en: The Java launcher started our example after its class file had been produced.
examples.zh: 类文件生成后，「Java 程序启动工具」运行了我们的示例。

examples.en: The guide listed the Java launcher separately from the command used for compilation.
examples.zh: 指南把「Java 程序启动工具」与用于编译的命令分开列出。

collocations: start a program with the Java launcher
run a source file with the Java launcher

words.enDefinition: The virtual machine and libraries needed to run compiled Java programs

examples.en: The diagram placed the virtual machine inside the Java Runtime Environment alongside supporting libraries.
examples.zh: 图上把虚拟机和配套库都放在「Java 运行环境」里。

examples.en: We compared the Java Runtime Environment with a package that also provided development tools.
examples.zh: 我们把「Java 运行环境」和还提供开发工具的一套软件作了比较。

collocations: run a program in a Java Runtime Environment
components of the Java Runtime Environment
a Java Runtime Environment for the program

words.enDefinition: A Java launch mode running source without a separate compilation command

examples.en: We ran the small example in Java source-file mode directly from its source file.
examples.zh: 我们用「Java 源文件运行模式」，直接从源文件运行了小示例。

examples.en: The instructions illustrated Java source-file mode with a short classroom program saved as source.
examples.zh: 说明用一个保存为源代码的课堂小程序演示了「Java 源文件运行模式」。

collocations: an example of Java source-file mode

words.enDefinition: the specified execution machine for the Java class-file format, implemented by runtimes that load and execute class files

examples.en: The Java Virtual Machine ran the compiled example after the source was translated.
examples.zh: 源代码翻译完后，「Java 虚拟机」运行了编译好的示例。

examples.en: We identified the Java Virtual Machine in a diagram between bytecode and hardware.
examples.zh: 我们在图中找到了字节码与硬件之间的「Java 虚拟机」。

collocations: run on the Java Virtual Machine
run bytecode in a Java Virtual Machine

words.enDefinition: The JDK command that compiles Java sources into class files

examples.en: We used javac before opening the folder containing the new class file.
examples.zh: 我们先用了「Java 编译命令」，然后打开存放新类文件的文件夹。

examples.en: The handout showed how javac produced files from the Java example.
examples.zh: 讲义展示了「Java 编译命令」怎样根据 Java 示例生成文件。

collocations: compile a source file with javac

words.enDefinition: Software that reads and executes JavaScript code in a supported environment

examples.en: The JavaScript engine evaluated the expression I entered during the demonstration.
examples.zh: 「JS 引擎」求出了我在演示时输入的表达式的值。

examples.en: We read a diagram showing the JavaScript engine inside the browser.
examples.zh: 我们看了一张标出浏览器内「JS 引擎」的图。

collocations: run code in a JavaScript engine

words.enDefinition: An environment providing an engine and support for executing JavaScript

examples.en: The JavaScript runtime in our test provided access to a simple console.
examples.zh: 测试中的「JS 运行时」提供了一个简单控制台。

examples.en: Our tutor distinguished the JavaScript runtime from its engine in the diagram.
examples.zh: 导师用图说明了「JS 运行时」与其中引擎的区别。

collocations: run a script in a JavaScript runtime

words.enDefinition: Points displayed at slightly offset positions so coincident or crowded observations can be seen separately.

examples.en: The jittered points spread sideways just enough to reveal repeated heights in the same group.
examples.zh: 「抖动点」在水平方向上略微分散，显出同一组里重复的株高。

examples.en: We used jittered points so that identical library counts no longer hid behind one another.
examples.zh: 我们用了「抖动点」，让相同的图书馆客流计数能各自显现。

collocations: show jittered points over a box plot

words.enDefinition: To wait until another thread finishes execution.

examples.en: The exercise asked us to join a thread before reading the total that it had calculated.
examples.zh: 练习要求我们先「等待线程结束」，再读取它算出的总数。

examples.en: We needed to join a thread before closing the sample window that displayed its work.
examples.zh: 在关闭显示工作结果的示例窗口前，我们需要先「等待线程结束」。

collocations: join a thread before using its result
join a thread after starting it
decide where to join a thread

words.enDefinition: checking that the uniqueness of join keys on each side matches the intended relationship between inputs

examples.en: Our join cardinality validation failed because the catalogue contained two rows for one product identifier.
examples.zh: 目录里同一个产品标识符出现了两行，因此我们的「联接基数校验」失败。

examples.en: Our join cardinality validation checked that each room code appeared only once on the lookup side.
examples.zh: 我们通过「联接基数校验」，确认用于查找的表中各房间编号只出现一次。

collocations: diagnose a failed join cardinality validation

words.enDefinition: the condition used to determine whether a pair of source rows qualifies as a match

examples.en: The join condition required the room number and building code to agree between the two source records.
examples.zh: 「联接条件」要求两条源记录的房间号和楼宇代码都吻合。

examples.en: We moved one filter into the join condition to keep all rows from the preserved side.
examples.zh: 我们把一个筛选条件移入「联接条件」，以保留指定一侧的所有行。

collocations: add a predicate to a join condition

words.enDefinition: the share of rows or keys from a specified input that find a match in the other input

examples.en: We measured join coverage using the fraction of room codes with a matching approved description.
examples.zh: 我们根据有对应获批描述的房间编号比例测量「联接匹配覆盖率」。

examples.en: The join coverage improved after we repaired inconsistent identifiers in three of the weekly exports.
examples.zh: 我们修复三份周导出文件中不一致的标识符后，「联接匹配覆盖率」有了提高。

collocations: report join coverage for each input

words.enDefinition: a column or expression used to compare records from different inputs in a join

examples.en: The tutor chose the catalogue identifier as the join key because the title was sometimes entered differently.
examples.zh: 标题有时有不同写法，所以导师选目录标识符作「联接键」。

examples.en: We compared the field types on both sides of the join key before running the exercise query.
examples.zh: 运行练习查询前，我们比较了「联接键」两侧的字段类型。

collocations: compare values on a join key

words.enDefinition: The JDK's tool for entering and evaluating Java code interactively

examples.en: The lab used JShell to show how Java handles simple arithmetic.
examples.zh: 实验课用「Java 交互式工具」演示 Java 怎样处理简单算术。

examples.en: I tried the calculation in JShell while my partner edited the file.
examples.zh: 同伴编辑文件时，我在「Java 交互式工具」里试算了那个算式。

words.enDefinition: a table holding pairs of keys to represent links between records in a many-to-many relationship

examples.en: The junction table stored a student identifier and a club identifier for each membership recorded in the exercise.
examples.zh: 对练习记录的每次入会，「关联表」保存一个学生标识符和一个社团标识符。

examples.en: We put the enrolment date in the junction table because the date belonged to a specific registration.
examples.zh: 我们把报名日期放在「关联表」里，因为日期对应某一次具体的报名。

collocations: model a relationship with a junction table

words.enDefinition: Translation of program code into executable instructions during execution

examples.en: The diagram showed just-in-time compilation happening after the JavaScript engine had started running.
examples.zh: 图上显示，JS 引擎开始运行后才发生「即时编译」。

examples.en: Our tutor explained how just-in-time compilation could happen for frequently executed code.
examples.zh: 导师解释了经常执行的代码如何可能触发「即时编译」。

collocations: a language engine with just-in-time compilation

words.enDefinition: Dividing data into k folds and validating each fold once after fitting on the remaining folds.

examples.en: We used k-fold cross-validation so each part of the practice dataset was held out once.
examples.zh: 我们使用「K 折交叉验证」，让练习数据集的每个部分都被留出一次。

examples.en: Our tutor drew five partitions to illustrate k-fold cross-validation for the library exercise.
examples.zh: 老师画出五个分区，说明图书馆练习中的「K 折交叉验证」。

words.enDefinition: partitioning observations into a specified number of clusters by seeking to reduce the sum of squared distances to their assigned centres

examples.en: We used k-means clustering to group leaves by length and width without giving the groups names.
examples.zh: 我们用「K 均值聚类」按叶片长宽分组，未给这些组命名。

examples.en: The tutor repeated k-means clustering with another starting configuration to compare the resulting groups.
examples.zh: 老师更换初始配置再做一次「K 均值聚类」，以比较得到的分组。

collocations: choose the cluster count for k-means clustering

words.enDefinition: A processor mode in which the operating system can perform privileged system operations.

examples.en: The simulator highlighted kernel mode while the operating system handled the request for file data.
examples.zh: 操作系统处理文件数据请求时，模拟器高亮显示「内核态」。

examples.en: Our tutor contrasted code running in kernel mode with the application code shown earlier in the lesson.
examples.zh: 老师把「内核态」运行的代码与课程先前展示的应用代码作了对比。

words.enDefinition: An operation that searches a mapping for the value associated with a specified key.

examples.en: The example used a key lookup to retrieve the score for the requested player.
examples.zh: 示例通过「键查找」取得所查询玩家的分数。

examples.en: Our worksheet traced a key lookup for a book whose catalogue number was already stored.
examples.zh: 练习表跟踪了某本书的「键查找」过程，该书的目录编号早已存入。

words.enDefinition: A key together with the value associated with it in a mapping.

examples.en: The sample program wrote one key-value pair for each name and score in the list.
examples.zh: 示例程序为列表里的每组姓名和分数写入一个「键值对」。

examples.en: We printed every key-value pair so the tutor could see which values belonged to which keys.
examples.zh: 我们输出每个「键值对」，方便老师看出各值对应哪个键。

words.enDefinition: An object exposing the current keys of a mapping without making a separate copy of them.

examples.en: The dictionary's key view showed the new book number as soon as we added the entry.
examples.zh: 我们一加入条目，字典的「键视图」就显示了新的图书编号。

examples.en: We used the key view to read the stored names without copying them into a list.
examples.zh: 我们用「键视图」读出已存的姓名，无需把姓名复制到列表里。

collocations: check membership in a key view

words.enDefinition: The Python exception raised when it receives a user interrupt

examples.en: The demonstration showed KeyboardInterrupt after the user interrupted the running script.
examples.zh: 用户中断运行中的脚本后，演示显示了「键盘中断异常」。

examples.en: The terminal displayed KeyboardInterrupt when I pressed the interrupt shortcut during the classroom calculation.
examples.zh: 课堂计算仍在运行时，我按下中断快捷键，终端显示了「键盘中断异常」。

words.enDefinition: an argument supplied by naming the corresponding parameter, as supported by the language

examples.en: A keyword argument specified the output language while the other settings remained at their default values.
examples.zh: 一个「关键字实参」指定了输出语言，其余设置仍用默认值。

examples.en: We used a keyword argument to make the meaning of the date format clear at the call site.
examples.zh: 我们用「关键字实参」明确调用处设置日期格式的意图。

collocations: specify an option as a keyword argument

words.zhGloss: 仅限按关键字传入的形参
words.enDefinition: a parameter whose argument, if supplied, must be associated with the parameter name instead of its position
acceptedZhAnswers: 仅限按关键字传入的形参

examples.en: The function declared a keyword-only parameter for the output folder to make each call easier to read.
examples.zh: 函数把输出文件夹声明为「仅限按关键字传入的形参」，使每次调用更容易看懂。

examples.en: We used a keyword-only parameter for orientation because callers might forget what a second positional value meant.
examples.zh: 我们用「仅限按关键字传入的形参」表示方向，因为调用方可能忘记第二个位置值的含义。

collocations: pass an argument to a keyword-only parameter

words.enDefinition: A recognised problem that is still present in the software

examples.en: The notes mentioned a known issue affecting the widest report layout.
examples.zh: 说明中提到一个影响最宽报告版式的「已知问题」。

examples.en: Our group added a known issue after checking the problem on a tablet.
examples.zh: 在平板上核实问题后，我们组记录了一个「已知问题」。

collocations: check the list of known issues

words.enDefinition: Building a spanning tree by adding edges by increasing weight, avoiding cycles

examples.en: The example used Kruskal's algorithm to consider edges in increasing weight order.
examples.zh: 示例用「克鲁斯卡尔算法」按权重升序考虑各边。

examples.en: We skipped one edge during Kruskal's algorithm because it would have formed a cycle.
examples.zh: 在执行「克鲁斯卡尔算法」时，我们跳过了一条会产生环的边。

words.enDefinition: A regularization term proportional to the sum of the absolute magnitudes of selected parameters.

examples.en: The regression example used an L1 penalty and several coefficients became exactly zero during fitting.
examples.zh: 回归例题采用了「L1 惩罚项」，拟合过程中有几个系数变为零。

examples.en: We compared validation errors after adding an L1 penalty to the book handling time predictor.
examples.zh: 我们给图书处理用时预测模型加上「L1 惩罚项」，然后比较验证误差。

collocations: fit a model with an L1 penalty
choose the weight of an L1 penalty

words.enDefinition: A regularization term proportional to the sum of squares of selected model parameters.

examples.en: The example applied an L2 penalty to discourage large coefficients in its linear regression model.
examples.zh: 例题用「L2 惩罚项」约束线性回归模型中的较大系数。

examples.en: Our tutor compared the fitted coefficients before and after introducing an L2 penalty.
examples.zh: 老师对比了引入「L2 惩罚项」前后的拟合系数。

collocations: fit a model with an L2 penalty
choose the weight of an L2 penalty

words.enDefinition: selecting data using labels assigned to rows or columns

examples.en: The example used label-based indexing to read the entries whose row labels matched two specific dates.
examples.zh: 示例使用「按标签索引」，读取行标签匹配两个指定日期的条目。

examples.en: We used label-based indexing to select columns by name after another group had rearranged the table.
examples.zh: 另一组重新排列了表格后，我们用「按标签索引」根据列名选列。

collocations: compare label-based indexing with position-based indexing

words.enDefinition: Examples accompanied by known target values or categories.

examples.en: We used labeled data that paired each book description with a category assigned by the librarian.
examples.zh: 我们使用「有标签数据」，每段图书描述都有一项馆员给出的类别。

examples.en: The class kept part of the labeled data aside to evaluate the plant classifier later.
examples.zh: 同学们留出部分「有标签数据」，供之后评估植物分类器。

words.enDefinition: an earlier value aligned with a later observation by a specified number of periods or positions

examples.en: We compared each attendance count with its lagged value from the previous week in the class exercise.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂练习里把每个出勤数与其上周的「滞后值」比较。

examples.en: The first row had no lagged value because the records started on the date shown there.
examples.zh: 第一行没有「滞后值」，因为记录从该行所示日期开始。

collocations: compare an observation with its lagged value

words.enDefinition: an expression that creates a function value using a language's lambda syntax

examples.en: A Python lambda expression returned the second element of each pair as the key for sorting.
examples.zh: Python 的「Lambda 表达式」返回各数据对的第二个元素作为排序键。

examples.en: We replaced the long lambda expression with a named function so the validation logic was easier to read.
examples.zh: 我们把很长的「Lambda 表达式」换成具名函数，让校验逻辑更好读。

collocations: pass a lambda expression as an argument

words.enDefinition: Describing an order in which the item added most recently is the first removed.

examples.en: The stack followed last-in, first-out order, so the last colour added was removed first.
examples.zh: 这个栈遵循「后进先出」顺序，因此最后加入的颜色最先被取出。

examples.en: The teacher used the phrase last in, first out to describe the order of those cards.
examples.zh: 老师用「后进先出」来描述这些卡片的取出顺序。

words.enDefinition: The HTTP field reporting when the origin server believes the selected representation last changed.

examples.en: The Last-Modified header shows when the example timetable was last updated on the catalogue server.
examples.zh: 「Last-Modified 首部字段」显示示例时间表上次在目录服务器上更新的时间。

examples.en: Our worksheet compares the Last-Modified header with the time the response was originally sent.
examples.zh: 练习纸把「Last-Modified 首部字段」与响应最初发出的时间作了比较。

words.enDefinition: Saved settings specifying how an editor starts a program

examples.en: The launch configuration named the script to open when I clicked Run.
examples.zh: 「运行启动配置」指定了我点运行时打开的脚本。

examples.en: We checked whether the launch configuration passed the filename to our program.
examples.zh: 我们核对了「运行启动配置」是否把文件名传给了程序。

collocations: a launch configuration for a program

words.enDefinition: The step in rendering that determines the sizes and positions of elements on a page.

examples.en: Our diagram places layout calculation before the browser paints the text and boxes on screen.
examples.zh: 示意图把「布局计算」放在浏览器绘制屏幕上的文字和方框之前。

examples.en: The narrower catalogue column changes the results of layout calculation in the classroom example.
examples.zh: 在课堂示例中，目录栏变窄会改变「布局计算」的结果。

words.enDefinition: a later value aligned with an earlier observation by a specified number of periods or positions

examples.en: The report used the next week's count as a lead value to compare neighbouring observations in the sequence.
examples.zh: 报告将下周的数量作为「前导值」，以比较序列中相邻观测。

examples.en: We excluded the lead value from the forecasting inputs because it would not yet be available in practice.
examples.zh: 我们没把「前导值」用作预测输入，因为实际预测时还拿不到该值。

collocations: check whether a lead value is available

words.enDefinition: Spaces or tabs before the first visible characters on a line

examples.en: The editor displayed leading whitespace so we could see the copied spaces.
examples.zh: 编辑器显示了「行首空白」，方便我们看清复制过来的空格。

examples.en: In the Python exercise, leading whitespace changed how the lines were grouped.
examples.zh: 在 Python 练习里，「行首空白」改变了代码行的分组方式。

words.enDefinition: A tree node with no children

examples.en: The first search finished at a leaf node with no branches below.
examples.zh: 第一次查找在下方没有分支的「叶节点」结束。

examples.en: Our tutor marked each leaf node with a different colour in the tree.
examples.zh: 导师在树里用另一种颜色标出了所有「叶节点」。

words.enDefinition: In model evaluation, a plot of training and validation performance against the amount of training data.

examples.en: The learning curve showed whether the leaf classifier improved as we added more training examples.
examples.zh: 「学习曲线」展示了增加训练样本后，叶片分类器是否有所改善。

examples.en: Our tutor used a learning curve to compare performance at four different training sample sizes.
examples.zh: 老师用「学习曲线」比较四种训练样本数量下的模型表现。

collocations: compare learning curves for two models

words.enDefinition: A training setting controlling the size of parameter updates in methods such as gradient descent.

examples.en: A smaller learning rate made each update to the model's weights less pronounced.
examples.zh: 较小的「学习率」让模型权重每次更新的幅度减小。

examples.en: We changed the learning rate after seeing the sample model jump past the lowest point repeatedly.
examples.zh: 看到示例模型反复跳过最低点后，我们调整了「学习率」。

words.enDefinition: the bit with the smallest positional weight

examples.en: The class changed the least significant bit to see how the unsigned number would change.
examples.zh: 学生改变「最低有效位」，观察无符号数值会发生什么变化。

examples.en: Our tutor checked the least significant bit to see whether the example integer was odd.
examples.zh: 导师检查「最低有效位」，判断示例整数是不是奇数。

words.enDefinition: Cross-validation that holds out one observation at a time and fits on all the others.

examples.en: We used leave-one-out cross-validation for the tiny workshop dataset containing only eight completed tasks.
examples.zh: 这个很小的工作坊数据集只有八项已完成任务，我们用的是「留一交叉验证」。

examples.en: Our worksheet illustrated leave-one-out cross-validation by moving a single record into the reserved portion each round.
examples.zh: 练习表每轮放一条记录到留出部分，以说明「留一交叉验证」。

collocations: score a model with leave-one-out cross-validation
compare leave-one-out cross-validation with larger folds

words.enDefinition: a join retaining every left row and supplying nulls on the right when no right row matches

examples.en: The left outer join kept books with no recorded loans so they still appeared in the catalogue report.
examples.zh: 「左外联接」保留了没有借阅记录的书，因此它们仍出现在目录报告里。

examples.en: We changed the query to a left outer join before checking which classrooms had no reservations.
examples.zh: 我们先把查询改为「左外联接」，再检查哪些教室没有预订记录。

collocations: inspect unmatched rows from a left outer join

words.enDefinition: moving bits toward higher positions and filling lower positions with zeros

examples.en: The worksheet used a left shift to move the sample bits one position toward the higher end.
examples.zh: 练习表用「左移」把样本位向高位方向移动一位。

examples.en: Our tutor used a left shift on a small Python integer before checking the numeric result.
examples.zh: 导师对一个小的 Python 整数执行「左移」，然后核对数值结果。

collocations: a left shift by one position

words.enDefinition: Visiting tree nodes level by level starting at the root

examples.en: The level-order traversal printed every second-level node before reaching the lower leaves.
examples.zh: 「层序遍历」先打印第二层的全部节点，再到下方的叶节点。

examples.en: Our whiteboard showed which row came next in the level-order traversal.
examples.zh: 白板显示了「层序遍历」接下来访问哪一行。

collocations: a level-order traversal of a tree

words.enDefinition: a function together with access to the bindings in its lexical environment

examples.en: The lexical closure preserved access to the chosen prefix after the function that created it had returned.
examples.zh: 创建它的函数返回之后，「词法闭包」仍能访问已选定的前缀。

examples.en: We built a lexical closure whose inner function read a different display setting for each returned formatter.
examples.zh: 我们构建了一个「词法闭包」，其中的内层函数会为各返回的格式化器读取不同的显示设置。

collocations: explain how a lexical closure retains access to bindings

words.enDefinition: scope determined by where code and declarations are written in the program's source

examples.en: The diagram explained lexical scope by showing which names a nested function could find in the surrounding code.
examples.zh: 示意图展示嵌套函数可以在外层代码中找到哪些名称，以说明「词法作用域」。

examples.en: We used lexical scope rules to tell which version of the same name the formatter would use.
examples.zh: 我们用「词法作用域」规则判断格式化函数会使用同名变量的哪一个版本。

collocations: resolve a name through lexical scope
compare lexical scope with dynamic scope

words.enDefinition: A small recognized unit of source text, such as an operator

examples.en: The parser treated the plus sign as a separate lexical token.
examples.zh: 语法分析器把加号视为一个独立的「词法单元」。

examples.en: Our exercise labelled each lexical token before arranging them into an expression.
examples.zh: 我们在练习中先标记各个「词法单元」，然后把它们组成表达式。

words.enDefinition: Whether the conditions of different licences can be met together for a proposed use.

examples.en: The class examined licence compatibility before combining two public datasets for the report.
examples.zh: 全班在合并报告所需的两个公开数据集之前，检查了「许可兼容性」。

examples.en: The worksheet asks which terms determine licence compatibility when a combined table is shared.
examples.zh: 练习题问共享合并表格时，哪些条款决定「许可兼容性」。

words.enDefinition: A structure with one accessible end where the most recently added item is removed first.

examples.en: The practice editor used a LIFO stack to keep the latest change available for undo.
examples.zh: 练习用的编辑器采用「后进先出栈」，便于优先撤销最近一次改动。

examples.en: We drew a LIFO stack with the newest card above all the cards added earlier.
examples.zh: 我们画了一个「后进先出栈」，最新加入的卡片位于所有早先卡片上方。

collocations: store items in a LIFO stack
remove the top item from a LIFO stack

words.enDefinition: a SQL clause in some dialects that caps the number of rows returned

examples.en: The LIMIT clause returned the five most recent entries after the query sorted the sample reading dates.
examples.zh: 查询对示例读数日期排序后，「LIMIT 限行子句」使其只返回最近五条记录。

examples.en: We removed the LIMIT clause so the class could compare all qualifying readings in the exercise.
examples.zh: 我们移除了「LIMIT 限行子句」，让同学能比较练习中所有符合条件的读数。

collocations: restrict output with a LIMIT clause
use a LIMIT clause with a deterministic ORDER BY

words.enDefinition: output buffered until a line ending or another flush condition sends the accumulated data onward

examples.en: The line-buffered output sent each message onward after its closing newline.
examples.zh: 「按行缓冲的输出」在写入每条消息末尾的换行符后，把消息送出。

examples.en: The diagram used line-buffered output to show why partial lines were delayed.
examples.zh: 图上通过「按行缓冲的输出」说明为什么不完整的行会延迟显示。

words.enDefinition: A chart that connects values along an ordered variable, often time, with line segments.

examples.en: The line chart follows the temperature in the teaching greenhouse over seven consecutive days.
examples.zh: 「折线图」呈现了教学温室连续七天的温度变化。

examples.en: We used a line chart because the order of the weekly readings matters in this exercise.
examples.zh: 练习里每周读数的先后顺序很重要，所以我们用了「折线图」。

words.enDefinition: Extending one logical source line across more than one displayed line

examples.en: The guide explained line continuation by spreading a long Python calculation over two lines.
examples.zh: 指南把一个长 Python 算式写到两行上，说明什么是「续行」。

examples.en: I checked the line continuation rules before wrapping the expression inside the editor.
examples.zh: 我先查了「续行」规则，再在编辑器里替表达式换行。

words.enDefinition: A character or sequence marking the end of a text line

examples.en: The editor showed which line ending each line used in the text file.
examples.zh: 编辑器显示了文本文件中每一行使用的「行结束符」。

examples.en: Our tutor compared files using a different line ending in each case.
examples.zh: 导师比较了采用不同「行结束符」的文件。

words.enDefinition: The appearance of a plotted line, such as solid, dashed, or dotted.

examples.en: We gave each rainfall series a different line style for the black and white handout.
examples.zh: 我们为每个降雨量系列设置不同的「线型」，方便在黑白讲义里辨认。

examples.en: The tutor changed the line style of the reference line to distinguish it from the data.
examples.zh: 老师更改了参考线的「线型」，以便将参考线和数据区分开。

words.enDefinition: estimating an intermediate value from the straight line between two known values

examples.en: The exercise used linear interpolation to estimate the temperature between two readings taken ten minutes apart.
examples.zh: 练习用「线性插值」估计两次间隔十分钟的读数之间的温度。

examples.en: We compared linear interpolation with backup observations that covered the gap left by our primary instrument.
examples.zh: 我们用备用观测值覆盖主仪器留下的缺口，并与「线性插值」的结果作对比。

collocations: estimate a value by linear interpolation

words.enDefinition: Modeling a numerical outcome as a weighted sum of input features, often with an intercept.

examples.en: We used linear regression to predict sorting time from the number of books in each batch.
examples.zh: 我们用「线性回归」根据每批图书的数量预测分拣用时。

examples.en: Our tutor compared linear regression with a more flexible model on the same set of records.
examples.zh: 老师用同一组记录比较了「线性回归」和更灵活的模型。

collocations: evaluate the fit of linear regression

words.enDefinition: A scale on which equal numerical differences take up equal distances.

examples.en: The linear scale on our rainfall graph puts each additional millimetre the same distance apart.
examples.zh: 降雨量图的「线性标度」上，每增加一毫米，所占间距都相同。

examples.en: We kept a linear scale because the class wanted to compare absolute differences in temperature.
examples.zh: 因为全班想比较温度的绝对差值，我们保留了「线性标度」。

words.enDefinition: Searching an item collection sequentially for a specified target

examples.en: The linear search checked each name from the top of the list.
examples.zh: 「线性查找」从列表顶部开始逐一检查姓名。

examples.en: We used linear search because the exercise had only a few items.
examples.zh: 我们用了「线性查找」，因为练习只有几项数据。

collocations: use linear search on an unsorted list

words.enDefinition: A running cost growing proportionally to the number of input items

examples.en: Scanning every score once took linear time in our simple classroom model.
examples.zh: 在课堂简化模型里，将每个分数扫描一遍需要「线性时间」。

examples.en: We found that adding another full pass still took linear time.
examples.zh: 我们发现，再增加一趟完整扫描所需的仍是「线性时间」。

collocations: sort in linear time under specified assumptions

words.enDefinition: The part of a node that stores a pointer or reference connecting it to another node.

examples.en: The link field was blank in the drawing until we connected the card to its neighbour.
examples.zh: 我们把卡片连到相邻卡片之前，图中的「链接字段」是空的。

examples.en: The worksheet separated the link field from the box holding the value of each node.
examples.zh: 练习表把「链接字段」与存放各节点值的方框分开画了。

collocations: inspect the link field in a node

words.enDefinition: The layer that transfers data over a single link or local network segment.

examples.en: The link layer handles the first part of the packet's journey across the classroom network.
examples.zh: 「链路层」负责数据包在教室网络中传输的第一段路程。

examples.en: Our diagram shows the link layer directly beneath the network layer in this model.
examples.zh: 在这个模型里，图上把「链路层」画在网络层的正下方。

words.enDefinition: a collection whose elements are stored in nodes linked in sequence

examples.en: The linked list stored pictures in display order even when their storage locations were different.
examples.zh: 「链表」按显示顺序组织图片，即使图片的存储位置各不相同。

examples.en: Our tutor drew a linked list to show how nodes could hold values and references.
examples.zh: 老师画了一个「链表」，展示节点怎样存放值和引用。

words.enDefinition: a principle requiring subtype instances to satisfy the behavioural expectations of their supertype's clients

examples.en: The class applied the Liskov substitution principle by testing both shapes against the same drawing expectations.
examples.zh: 同学们用同样的绘图预期测试两种图形，应用了「里氏替换原则」。

examples.en: Our tutor discussed the Liskov substitution principle when a subclass changed an established behaviour in the example.
examples.zh: 示例中的子类改变了一项已有行为时，导师讨论了「里氏替换原则」。

collocations: a violation of the Liskov substitution principle

words.enDefinition: A record in a linked list storing an element and one or more connecting links.

examples.en: The diagram showed one list node for each book in the small classroom collection.
examples.zh: 图中给课堂小图书集里的每本书画了一个「链表节点」。

examples.en: We inspected a list node to see both its stored colour and its link.
examples.zh: 我们查看一个「链表节点」，看到了它存的颜色和链接。

collocations: attach a list node to its successor

words.enDefinition: source notation that directly represents a value

examples.en: Our lecturer asked whether the quoted greeting in the example counted as a string literal.
examples.zh: 讲师问，示例里加引号的问候语是否算字符串「字面量」。

examples.en: I replaced a numeric literal with a named constant so the purpose of the number was clear.
examples.zh: 我用一个命名常量替换了数字「字面量」，好说明这个数的用途。

words.enDefinition: a pattern that compares a subject with a literal such as a specified number or string

examples.en: The first literal pattern matched the exact word that meant the museum was closed that day.
examples.zh: 第一个「字面量模式」匹配那个表示博物馆当天闭馆的特定单词。

examples.en: Her example used a literal pattern for zero and a separate guarded case for negative values.
examples.zh: 她的例子用「字面量模式」匹配零，用另一个带守卫的分支处理负数。

collocations: compare a value against a literal pattern

words.enDefinition: storing the least significant byte at the lowest address or first in sequence

examples.en: The little-endian example placed the least significant byte first in the worksheet's two-byte sequence.
examples.zh: 「小端序」示例把最低有效字节放在练习表双字节序列的开头。

examples.en: We identified the little-endian representation by checking where the lowest-weight byte appeared in the example.
examples.zh: 我们检查示例中最低有效字节的位置，识别出了「小端序」表示。

collocations: read a value in little-endian format

words.enDefinition: A state where participants remain active but their repeated reactions prevent useful progress.

examples.en: The simulator showed livelock when the tasks kept changing state without finishing any work.
examples.zh: 任务持续改变状态却没有完成任何工作，模拟器展示了「活锁」。

examples.en: We discussed why both workers could remain active during livelock in the classroom exercise.
examples.zh: 我们讨论了课堂练习出现「活锁」时，两条工作线程为什么仍可能保持活动。

words.enDefinition: The number of stored entries divided by the number of buckets or slots in a hash table.

examples.en: We calculated the load factor using six stored names and eight buckets in the example.
examples.zh: 例题中，我们用六个已存姓名和八个桶计算了「负载因子」。

examples.en: The load factor fell after the practice table gained more buckets without adding any entries.
examples.zh: 练习用的散列表增加了桶数，条目数维持原值，因此「负载因子」下降。

collocations: compare the load factor before and after resizing

words.enDefinition: the region inside a function or other construct where the language resolves a name to a binding declared in that region

examples.en: The formatter kept the temporary text in local scope so the wider program could not refer to it.
examples.zh: 格式化函数把临时文本放在「局部作用域」，使程序其他部分无法引用它。

examples.en: Our example showed how a name in local scope could hide another name used by surrounding code.
examples.zh: 示例演示了「局部作用域」中的一个名字如何遮蔽外层代码所用的同名变量。

collocations: define a name in local scope
resolve a name in local scope
keep a variable in local scope

words.enDefinition: to assign timezone information to a timestamp that lacks it, preserving the local time where it is valid in that zone

examples.en: We could localise a timestamp only after checking which time zone the instrument used in the field.
examples.zh: 我们先确认仪器在现场使用的时区，才可以「给时间戳指定时区」。

examples.en: Our tutor asked us to localise a timestamp before aligning reports from two different countries.
examples.zh: 导师让我们先「给时间戳指定时区」，再对齐来自两个国家的报告。

collocations: localise a timestamp using the recording site's timezone

words.enDefinition: The HTTP response field that identifies a URL associated with the response, such as a redirect target.

examples.en: The Location header points to the new catalogue URL in our example of a redirect.
examples.zh: 在重定向示例中，「Location 首部字段」指向目录的新 URL。

examples.en: Our exercise reads the Location header in a response that identifies a newly created resource.
examples.zh: 练习要求读取一条响应的「Location 首部字段」，它标识一个新创建的资源。

collocations: resolve a URL from the Location header

words.enDefinition: Competition among threads trying to acquire the same lock around the same time.

examples.en: The simulator recorded lock contention when several workers wanted to update the same shared list.
examples.zh: 几条工作线程都想更新同一份共享列表时，模拟器记录了「锁争用」。

examples.en: We compared lock contention before and after the example stopped keeping the lock during unrelated work.
examples.zh: 例题先前做无关工作时也持有锁，我们比较了改动前后的「锁争用」。

words.enDefinition: A rule that specifies the order in which multiple locks should be acquired.

examples.en: The classroom design used a consistent lock ordering for workers that needed both shared lists.
examples.zh: 课堂设计给需要两份共享列表的工作线程规定了统一的「加锁顺序」。

examples.en: Our tutor used the lock ordering diagram to review how the practice program coordinated access.
examples.zh: 老师用「加锁顺序」的示意图，回顾练习程序怎样协调访问。

words.enDefinition: The average negative logarithm of the probability assigned to the class that actually occurred.

examples.en: The classifier received a larger log loss after assigning a very low probability to the correct label.
examples.zh: 分类器给正确标签分配的概率很低，因而「对数损失」更大。

examples.en: We used log loss to compare the two models that returned probabilities for each plant class.
examples.zh: 我们用「对数损失」比较两个会为各植物类别返回概率的模型。

collocations: penalize confident errors with log loss

words.enDefinition: A scale on which equal ratios take up equal distances.

examples.en: The logarithmic scale places each tenfold increase the same distance apart in our example.
examples.zh: 示例的「对数标度」上，每一次十倍增长所占的间距相同。

examples.en: Our class used a logarithmic scale to display values spanning several powers of ten.
examples.zh: 我们班用「对数标度」显示跨越多个数量级的数值。

words.enDefinition: A running cost growing proportionally to a logarithm of input size

examples.en: Binary search took logarithmic time in the comparison model used during class.
examples.zh: 在课上的比较次数模型中，二分查找需要「对数时间」。

examples.en: The exercise used logarithmic time to describe a process repeatedly halving inputs.
examples.zh: 练习用「对数时间」描述不断把输入减半的过程。

words.enDefinition: A mistake that gives incorrect behaviour even though the code runs

examples.en: A logic error made the program print the subtotal instead of the total.
examples.zh: 「逻辑错误」导致程序打印了小计，该打印的总计没显示。

examples.en: We looked for a logic error after the example finished with unexpected numbers.
examples.zh: 示例运行结束给出了意外的数值，我们于是查找「逻辑错误」。

collocations: detect a logic error in the calculation

words.enDefinition: a conjunction true only when both Boolean operands are true

examples.en: The sample used logical AND to combine two true-or-false answers from the practice quiz.
examples.zh: 样本用「逻辑与」合并练习测验中的两个判断题答案。

examples.en: Our tutor checked the logical AND result when only one of the conditions was true.
examples.zh: 导师检查了只有一个条件为真时的「逻辑与」结果。

words.enDefinition: A single source line as understood by a language's syntax rules

examples.en: The Python expression spanned two physical lines but formed one logical line under the grouping rules.
examples.zh: 这段 Python 表达式跨两条物理行，但按分组规则组成一条「逻辑行」。

examples.en: The example joined the parts of the calculation into one logical line.
examples.zh: 示例把算式的各个部分接成了一条「逻辑行」。

collocations: join text into a logical line
the end of a logical line
one logical line across physical lines

words.enDefinition: an operation that reverses a truth value

examples.en: The classroom example applied logical NOT to reverse the result of a comparison.
examples.zh: 课堂示例用「逻辑非」反转比较结果。

examples.en: Our tutor used logical NOT to turn the single false answer into a true one.
examples.zh: 导师用「逻辑非」把唯一的假值转换为真值。

collocations: invert a truth value with logical NOT

words.enDefinition: a disjunction true when at least one Boolean operand is true

examples.en: The worksheet used logical OR to check whether either of the two lights was on.
examples.zh: 练习表用「逻辑或」检查两盏灯中是否至少有一盏亮着。

examples.en: We included the case where both conditions were true in the logical OR exercise.
examples.zh: 在「逻辑或」练习中，我们也考虑了两个条件都为真的情况。

words.enDefinition: moving bits down and filling vacated high positions with zeros

examples.en: The worksheet used a logical right shift to move the bits while inserting zeros at the top.
examples.zh: 练习表用「逻辑右移」移动各位，同时在高位填零。

examples.en: Our tutor compared the logical right shift with a shift that copied the old sign bit.
examples.zh: 导师把「逻辑右移」和一种复制原符号位的移位操作作了比较。

collocations: a logical right shift by one

words.enDefinition: The number of elements actually stored in a collection, regardless of its reserved capacity.

examples.en: The dynamic array had a logical size of four while its storage could hold eight values.
examples.zh: 动态数组的「逻辑大小」是四，而它的存储空间能容纳八个值。

examples.en: Our example updated the logical size immediately after appending a colour to the palette.
examples.zh: 例题在把一种颜色追加到调色板之后，立即更新了「逻辑大小」。

words.enDefinition: a model for class probabilities using logistic or related links applied to scores that are linear in the input features

examples.en: The workshop used logistic regression to estimate whether an image showed an oak leaf or another leaf.
examples.zh: 工作坊用「逻辑回归」估计图像显示的是橡树叶还是其他叶片。

examples.en: Our tutor used logistic regression to show how a classifier can return estimated probabilities.
examples.zh: 老师用「逻辑回归」说明分类器怎样返回估计概率。

words.enDefinition: An extended text alternative that conveys details of a complex image or chart.

examples.en: The long description explains the trend and gives the exact values shown in the figure.
examples.zh: 「详细替代说明」解释了趋势，还给出图中显示的精确数值。

examples.en: The link next to the rainfall chart opens a long description of the key trends.
examples.zh: 降雨量图旁的链接会打开一份说明主要趋势的「详细替代说明」。

collocations: long description for a complex image

words.enDefinition: a layout using separate rows for repeated observations, usually with columns identifying their variable or category

examples.en: We used long format to store each temperature reading with its instrument label and recording date.
examples.zh: 我们用「长表格式」存储每条温度读数及其仪器标签和记录日期。

examples.en: The tutor converted the sheet to long format before grouping all readings by month and instrument.
examples.zh: 导师先将表转换为「长表格式」，再按月和仪器对所有读数分组。

collocations: convert a table to long format

words.enDefinition: the statements inside a loop that are eligible to run on each iteration

examples.en: The loop body printed each student's score before adding it to the total for the class.
examples.zh: 「循环体」先打印每名学生的分数，再把它加进全班总分。

examples.en: We moved the counter update into the loop body so it would happen on each pass.
examples.zh: 我们把计数器更新移进「循环体」，让每次迭代都更新计数。

collocations: skip the rest of the loop body

words.enDefinition: a limit used to determine which values or how many iterations a loop can process

examples.en: An incorrect loop bound made the program stop just before processing the final item in the array.
examples.zh: 错误的「循环边界」使程序在处理数组最后一项之前停了下来。

examples.en: We set the loop bound using the actual number of readings held in the file.
examples.zh: 我们按文件实际保存的读数条数设定了「循环边界」。

words.enDefinition: a condition that controls whether a conditional loop starts or continues another iteration

examples.en: Our loop condition ended the loop after enough valid measurements had been added to the list.
examples.zh: 列表加入足够多的有效测量值后，我们的「循环条件」让程序退出循环。

examples.en: The loop condition now checks the number of samples before starting each pass through the readings.
examples.zh: 现在「循环条件」在每轮处理读数前检查样本数量。

words.enDefinition: a variable used to count repetitions or to control a loop by changing on each pass

examples.en: The loop counter increased after each valid result so the summary recorded the number of completed trials.
examples.zh: 每产生一个有效结果，「循环计数器」就增加一次，因此汇总记录了已完成的试验次数。

examples.en: We reset the loop counter before repeating the exercise with a new set of sample readings.
examples.zh: 我们重置了「循环计数器」，再用一组新的样本读数重复练习。

words.enDefinition: an optional Python clause executed when a loop finishes normally, without exiting through break

examples.en: The loop else clause printed a message saying none of the stored book titles matched the search.
examples.zh: 「循环的 else 子句」输出了一条提示，说所存书目中没有匹配项。

examples.en: We traced why a successful lookup bypassed the loop else clause after the loop executed its break.
examples.zh: 我们跟踪了为什么成功查到结果后，循环执行 break 并跳过了「循环的 else 子句」。

words.enDefinition: the changing position used by a loop to access an item in an indexed sequence

examples.en: Our loop index selected the corresponding price from the array during each pass through the products.
examples.zh: 每轮处理产品时，我们用「循环索引」从数组里选出对应的价格。

examples.en: The tutor checked where the loop index first exceeded the last valid position of the array.
examples.zh: 导师检查了「循环索引」在何处首次超过数组的最后一个有效位置。

collocations: read an item at the loop index
compare the loop index with the array length

words.enDefinition: setting a loop's starting state before its first condition check or iteration

examples.en: The C example used loop initialisation to set the index to zero before checking the first condition.
examples.zh: C 语言示例通过「循环初始化」把索引设为零，再检查第一次循环条件。

examples.en: We moved loop initialisation outside the repeated work so the counter no longer reset on every pass.
examples.zh: 我们把「循环初始化」移出了重复执行的部分，避免计数器在每轮开始时重置。

collocations: set the starting index during loop initialisation

words.enDefinition: a property established before a loop and preserved through every iteration

examples.en: Our loop invariant stated that the prefix already processed was in order.
examples.zh: 我们的「循环不变式」说明，已处理的前缀是有序的。

examples.en: We checked the loop invariant again after moving one more item.
examples.zh: 再移动一项后，我们重新验证了「循环不变式」。

words.enDefinition: one pass through the repeated body or work of a loop

examples.en: Each loop iteration added one day's rainfall figure to the total for the whole month.
examples.zh: 每次「循环迭代」都把一天的降雨量加到整月总量里。

examples.en: We recorded the value of the counter at the end of each loop iteration in the exercise.
examples.zh: 练习时我们记下每次「循环迭代」结束时计数器的值。

words.enDefinition: the event of leaving a loop because its work is complete or another exit condition occurs

examples.en: We demonstrated loop termination by processing the final valid entry in the supplied list of names.
examples.zh: 我们处理了给定姓名列表中最后一条有效记录，以演示「循环终止」。

examples.en: The assignment asked us to justify loop termination when the counter started at any positive integer.
examples.zh: 作业要求我们说明计数器从任意正整数开始时，为何能够实现「循环终止」。

words.enDefinition: a variable whose value is set or updated as a loop moves through iterations

examples.en: The loop variable held a room name each time the Python example processed another booking.
examples.zh: 每处理下一条预订，Python 示例的「循环变量」就保存一个房间名。

examples.en: We renamed the loop variable to make it clear that each value represented a temperature.
examples.zh: 我们给「循环变量」改名，让读者看得出每个值都表示温度。

collocations: assign a value to a loop variable

words.enDefinition: An IP address that lets a device send network traffic back to itself.

examples.en: The classroom diagram uses a loopback address for a service running on the same computer.
examples.zh: 课堂示意图用「环回地址」指向同一台电脑上运行的服务。

examples.en: In this lab, a request to the loopback address stays on the student's own machine.
examples.zh: 在这次实验中，发送到「环回地址」的请求始终留在学生自己的电脑上。

words.enDefinition: a design in which components rely on little knowledge of each other

examples.en: The worksheet used loose coupling so the same drawing tool could accept another palette implementation.
examples.zh: 练习表采用「松耦合」，让同一个绘图工具可以接收另一种调色板实现。

examples.en: Our tutor compared loose coupling with a version using one fixed helper inside every shape.
examples.zh: 导师比较了「松耦合」版本和每个图形都内置同一个固定辅助对象的版本。

words.enDefinition: JavaScript equality testing that applies conversion rules to some operands

examples.en: The exercise used loose equality to compare the number zero with a string containing zero.
examples.zh: 练习用「宽松相等」比较数字零与含字符零的字符串。

examples.en: Our tutor asked which conversion took place before loose equality gave its result in JavaScript.
examples.zh: 导师问，JavaScript 的「宽松相等」给出结果前发生了哪种转换。

words.enDefinition: A function that measures prediction error or penalty given the model's outputs and the observed targets.

examples.en: The loss function gave a larger penalty to predictions that differed greatly from the recorded times.
examples.zh: 「损失函数」对与记录用时相差较大的预测施加了更大的惩罚。

examples.en: We compared two models after using the same loss function to evaluate their sorting time predictions.
examples.zh: 我们用同一个「损失函数」评估两种模型对分拣用时的预测后，再比较模型。

collocations: evaluate the loss function on predictions

words.enDefinition: a decomposition in which joining the projected relations reconstructs every original relation instance satisfying the stated constraints, without spurious rows

examples.en: The tutor illustrated lossless decomposition by joining the projected tables in our sample instance.
examples.zh: 导师通过联接样本实例投影得到的表，演示了什么是「无损分解」。

examples.en: We checked whether the shared identifier was sufficient to guarantee lossless decomposition under the stated dependencies.
examples.zh: 我们核查在给定依赖下，共有的标识符是否足以保证「无损分解」。

words.enDefinition: a concurrency outcome in which one update overwrites or fails to incorporate another update to the same data

examples.en: The diagram illustrated a lost update after both sessions calculated a replacement from the same original total.
examples.zh: 两个练习会话都用同一个原始合计算出替代值，图中展示了因此产生的「丢失更新」。

examples.en: We compared the two recorded changes to see how the lost update affected the final classroom total.
examples.zh: 我们比较记录的两项更改，查看「丢失更新」如何影响课堂练习的最终合计。

words.zhGloss: 首个不小于目标值的查找
words.enDefinition: Finding the first position in sorted data whose value meets or exceeds target
acceptedZhAnswers: 首个不小于目标值的查找

examples.en: A lower-bound search stopped at the first equal value in our sorted list.
examples.zh: 「首个不小于目标值的查找」停在有序列表里第一个相等的值上。

examples.en: The lower-bound search returned the next larger value’s position when none matched exactly.
examples.zh: 没有完全相等的项时，「首个不小于目标值的查找」返回了下一个更大值的位置。

collocations: a lower-bound search for duplicate keys

words.enDefinition: The deepest tree node containing both selected nodes in its subtree

examples.en: The lowest common ancestor was the parent shared by two neighbouring leaves.
examples.zh: 「最近公共祖先」是两个相邻叶节点共用的父节点。

examples.en: We found the lowest common ancestor by comparing the paths from the root.
examples.zh: 我们比较了从根节点出发的两条路径，找出了「最近公共祖先」。

collocations: a query for the lowest common ancestor

words.enDefinition: A link-layer identifier used to address a network interface on networks such as Ethernet.

examples.en: The diagram shows a MAC address in the Ethernet header next to the address label.
examples.zh: 示意图把「MAC 地址」标在以太网首部里，就在地址标签旁边。

examples.en: Our worksheet asks which MAC address belongs to the receiving interface on the local link.
examples.zh: 练习题问的是哪个「MAC 地址」属于本地链路上的接收接口。

words.enDefinition: Building systems that learn patterns from data to make predictions or find useful structure.

examples.en: The class used machine learning to predict how long different library sorting tasks would take.
examples.zh: 同学们用「机器学习」预测图书馆不同分拣任务需要多长时间。

examples.en: Our first machine learning assignment asked us to group books from their catalogue descriptions.
examples.zh: 我们的第一次「机器学习」作业要求根据目录描述给图书分组。

words.enDefinition: A mean of per-class scores that gives each class equal weight.

examples.en: We used a macro average so every book category counted equally in the reported F1 value.
examples.zh: 我们用「宏平均」，让图书的各类别在报告的 F1 值中权重相同。

examples.en: The tutor explained why the macro average fell after the classifier missed a rare plant species.
examples.zh: 老师解释了为什么分类器漏掉一种稀少的植物后，「宏平均」下降了。

collocations: compare a macro average with a weighted average

words.zhGloss: 含义不明的硬编码数字
words.enDefinition: a numeric literal whose purpose is unclear from its context
acceptedZhAnswers: 含义不明的硬编码数字

examples.en: The number looked like a magic number until the class learned that it represented minutes.
examples.zh: 在同学们知道那个数表示分钟之前，它看起来像一个「含义不明的硬编码数字」。

examples.en: I replaced the magic number with a name that explained why the limit was set there.
examples.zh: 我把「含义不明的硬编码数字」改成了一个能说明限制用途的名称。

words.enDefinition: A Python condition restricting code to runs as the main program

examples.en: The main guard kept the example's input prompt tied to running the file directly.
examples.zh: 「主程序入口判断」让示例只在直接运行文件时提示输入。

examples.en: Our tutor added a main guard before reusing the calculation in another exercise.
examples.zh: 导师在另一个练习复用计算代码之前，加了「主程序入口判断」。

collocations: place code under the main guard

words.enDefinition: A Java method called to start execution of an application

examples.en: The Java application displayed a message from its main method when started.
examples.zh: Java 应用启动时，在「Java 程序入口方法」中显示了一条消息。

examples.en: We marked the main method before following the program into another method.
examples.zh: 跟着程序走到另一个方法之前，我们先标出了「Java 程序入口方法」。

words.enDefinition: The initial thread of execution in an application or process.

examples.en: The sample kept the main thread available to respond while another thread prepared the preview.
examples.zh: 示例让另一个线程准备预览，这样「主线程」可以继续响应。

examples.en: We waited for the main thread to print the summary after both workers finished their calculations.
examples.zh: 两条工作线程都完成计算后，我们等「主线程」打印摘要。

words.enDefinition: the first number of a semantic version, increased for incompatible public API changes after the initial development series

examples.en: The class example changed its major version after altering the public API incompatibly.
examples.zh: 课堂示例进行了不兼容的公开 API 修改，因此变更了「主版本号」。

examples.en: We compared the first numbers to identify the major version of each package.
examples.zh: 我们比较了首位数字，确定每个包的「主版本号」。

words.enDefinition: The category with the most observations in the data being considered.

examples.en: Novels formed the majority class because they accounted for most of the examples in our exercise.
examples.zh: 小说是「多数类」，因为它们在练习中占样本的大部分。

examples.en: The simple baseline predicted the majority class for every book in the sample catalogue.
examples.zh: 简单的基准模型把示例目录中的每本书都预测为「多数类」。

collocations: count examples in the majority class
predict the majority class as a baseline

words.enDefinition: a record whose layout or representation does not follow the expected input format

examples.en: The reader flagged a malformed record where an unclosed quote combined fields from two separate addresses.
examples.zh: 一处引号未闭合，把两个地址的字段连到了一起，读取程序标记了这条「格式有误的记录」。

examples.en: We inspected the malformed record before deciding whether its fields could be recovered from the file.
examples.zh: 我们先查看「格式有误的记录」，再决定是否能从文件恢复其中字段。

words.enDefinition: A software check performed by a person following a procedure

examples.en: Our manual test involved clicking through the report screen and checking each label.
examples.zh: 我们的「手动测试」逐个点击报告界面的功能并核对各项标签。

examples.en: We logged a manual test while checking the larger layout on a tablet.
examples.zh: 我们在平板上检查大尺寸布局时，记录了一项「手动测试」。

collocations: record results from a manual test
a manual test of the interface

words.enDefinition: an association allowing several records on either side to be linked with several records on the other

examples.en: The many-to-many relationship let students register for several clubs and each club accept multiple students.
examples.zh: 「多对多关系」允许学生加入多个社团，也允许每个社团接收多个学生。

examples.en: We used a separate table to represent the many-to-many relationship between articles and their topic labels.
examples.zh: 我们用一个独立表表示文章与主题标签之间的「多对多关系」。

collocations: resolve a many-to-many relationship with an intermediate table

words.enDefinition: a pattern that matches a mapping by looking for specified keys and matching their associated values

examples.en: The mapping pattern matched records with a title and captured the corresponding title for printing.
examples.zh: 「映射模式」匹配包含标题的记录，并捕获对应的标题用于输出。

examples.en: Our Python example used a mapping pattern to find entries containing both room and time fields.
examples.zh: 我们的 Python 示例用「映射模式」查找同时含有房间和时间字段的条目。

collocations: look for keys in a mapping pattern

words.enDefinition: a total for one row or column of a table across the categories displayed in the other dimension

examples.en: The row's marginal total showed how many respondents selected the option across all four sessions.
examples.zh: 该行的「边际合计」显示四场活动共有多少名答复者选择这个选项。

examples.en: We checked the marginal total at the bottom of each column against the original session counts.
examples.zh: 我们用活动原始人数核查每列底部的「边际合计」。

collocations: display marginal totals around a cross-tabulation

words.enDefinition: an interface used to mark a type without declaring operations

examples.en: The Java worksheet showed a marker interface attached to types needing special treatment in the exercise.
examples.zh: Java 练习表展示了用于标示练习中需特殊处理类型的「标记接口」。

examples.en: Our tutor asked what the marker interface conveyed even though it declared no methods.
examples.zh: 导师问，「标记接口」没有声明方法，但它传达了什么信息。

collocations: a type with a marker interface

words.enDefinition: a Python statement that tries ordered patterns against a subject and runs the first applicable case

examples.en: Our match statement picked a drawing command by comparing the record with several permitted shapes.
examples.zh: 我们的「match 匹配语句」将记录与若干允许的结构比较，据此挑选绘图指令。

examples.en: The teacher added a final case to the match statement for inputs with unrecognised structures.
examples.zh: 老师给「match 匹配语句」加了最后一个分支，处理无法识别结构的输入。

collocations: add a case to a match statement

words.enDefinition: a database object that stores the result of a query so it can be read without recomputing it each time

examples.en: The workshop report used a materialized view containing the totals calculated when it was last refreshed.
examples.zh: 工作坊报告使用「物化视图」，读取上次刷新时计算出的合计。

examples.en: We checked the materialized view after entering new sample data to see whether its cached totals had changed.
examples.zh: 我们录入新的示例数据后核查了「物化视图」，确认存储的合计是否已变化。

words.enDefinition: A workflow job run separately for each selected settings combination

examples.en: The matrix job repeated our checks for two supported interpreter versions.
examples.zh: 「矩阵作业」对两个受支持的解释器版本分别运行了同一组检查。

examples.en: We read one result from the matrix job after testing both platforms.
examples.zh: 两种平台都测过后，我们读了「矩阵作业」的一项结果。

collocations: view results from a matrix job
a matrix job for multiple versions

words.enDefinition: An HTTP caching directive stating an age limit, used in responses to specify a freshness lifetime.

examples.en: The max-age directive in our response example sets the freshness lifetime of the saved timetable.
examples.zh: 响应示例中的「max-age 指令」设定了时间表的缓存新鲜度有效期。

examples.en: The tutor pointed out that the value of the max-age directive is expressed in seconds.
examples.zh: 老师指出，「max-age 指令」的值以秒为单位。

words.enDefinition: The largest packet size that a particular link can carry without fragmentation at the relevant layer.

examples.en: The slide lists the maximum transmission unit for each link in the illustrated route.
examples.zh: 幻灯片列出了图中路径上每条链路的「最大传输单元」。

examples.en: In the exercise, the maximum transmission unit is given in bytes next to the link.
examples.zh: 练习把「最大传输单元」用字节表示，写在链路旁边。

words.enDefinition: The average absolute difference between numerical predictions and their observed values.

examples.en: The mean absolute error showed the typical size of the sorting time errors in minutes.
examples.zh: 「平均绝对误差」用分钟表示分拣用时预测的平均误差幅度。

examples.en: We calculated mean absolute error after converting the predictions and observations to the same unit.
examples.zh: 把预测值和观测值换成同一种单位后，我们计算了「平均绝对误差」。

collocations: compare mean absolute error across models
report mean absolute error in original units

words.enDefinition: replacing missing numeric entries with the mean of a specified set of observed values

examples.en: The practice report used mean imputation to fill a few blanks and explained why variability might shrink.
examples.zh: 练习报告用「均值插补」填补几处空白，并说明数据变异可能缩小的原因。

examples.en: We applied mean imputation using only the readings assigned to the reference sample before the comparison.
examples.zh: 比较前，我们仅用参考样本的读数进行「均值插补」。

collocations: use mean imputation for a numeric field
assess the effect of mean imputation

words.enDefinition: The arithmetic mean of the squared differences between numerical predictions and observations.

examples.en: The mean squared error rose sharply when one predicted sorting time was far from its observed value.
examples.zh: 某次分拣时间的预测值与观测值相差很大时，「均方误差」显著上升。

examples.en: We used mean squared error to compare time models while emphasizing larger mistakes in the classroom results.
examples.zh: 我们用「均方误差」比较用时模型，着重反映课堂结果中幅度较大的错误。

collocations: compare mean squared error across models

words.enDefinition: A standardized label identifying the format of content in a message or resource.

examples.en: The server labels the sample timetable with a media type that identifies it as HTML.
examples.zh: 服务器用「媒体类型」给示例时间表加标签，表明其格式是 HTML。

examples.en: We checked the media type before reading the example response as a plain text file.
examples.zh: 我们查看「媒体类型」后，才把示例响应作为纯文本文件来读。

words.enDefinition: The middle value of the absolute errors across examples, using the median convention.

examples.en: The class calculated median absolute error to describe a typical mistake despite one very unusual sorting time.
examples.zh: 尽管有一次分拣用时非常异常，大家还是用「绝对误差中位数」描述典型误差。

examples.en: We compared median absolute error across the models using the same set of recorded completion times.
examples.zh: 我们依据同一组已记录的完成用时比较各模型的「绝对误差中位数」。

collocations: compare median absolute error with the mean

words.enDefinition: replacing missing numeric entries with the median of a specified set of observed values

examples.en: Our lesson illustrated median imputation using a table whose observed waiting times included one extremely long delay.
examples.zh: 课堂用一张等待时长表演示「中位数插补」，其中有一次等待特别长。
