examples.en: The team documented the reference group used for median imputation so the results could be reproduced.
examples.zh: 团队记录了「中位数插补」所用的参考组，使结果可复现。

collocations: compare median imputation with mean imputation
record the source values for median imputation

words.enDefinition: a design centralising coordination among objects in a dedicated component

examples.en: The mediator pattern let the sample drawing panels coordinate through a single classroom controller.
examples.zh: 「中介者模式」让样本的各绘图面板通过一个课堂控制器协调。

examples.en: Our tutor used the mediator pattern to trace how a selection reached the other components.
examples.zh: 导师用「中介者模式」追踪某个选择如何传到其他组件。

collocations: interactions managed through the mediator pattern

words.enDefinition: An operation checking whether a requested element belongs to a collection.

examples.en: The example used a membership test to check whether blue belonged to the allowed colour set.
examples.zh: 示例做了「成员测试」，检查蓝色是否属于允许使用的颜色集合。

examples.en: Our tutor compared a membership test on a set with scanning the original list of names.
examples.zh: 老师对比了在集合上做「成员测试」和逐项搜索原来的姓名列表。

collocations: a membership test on a set

words.enDefinition: a design saving an object's state so it can later be restored

examples.en: The memento pattern let the drawing example restore the earlier positions of its shapes.
examples.zh: 「备忘录模式」让绘图示例可以恢复图形先前的位置。

examples.en: Our tutor used the memento pattern to illustrate one level of undo in the sample.
examples.zh: 导师用「备忘录模式」演示样本中的一次撤销。

collocations: restore state using the memento pattern

words.enDefinition: Saving computed subproblem results for reuse when the same inputs recur

examples.en: The memoization example reused an answer when the same subproblem appeared again.
examples.zh: 「记忆化」示例在同一个子问题再次出现时复用了答案。

examples.en: We compared the number of calls before and after adding memoization.
examples.zh: 我们比较了添加「记忆化」前后的调用次数。

words.enDefinition: The set of rules defining acceptable observations of memory operations across threads or processors.

examples.en: The lecturer introduced a memory consistency model to explain which results the two threads could observe.
examples.zh: 老师介绍了「内存一致性模型」，以说明两条线程各能观察到哪些结果。

examples.en: Our worksheet asked which observations the memory consistency model allowed for the two classroom workers.
examples.zh: 练习表问，「内存一致性模型」允许两条课堂示例的工作线程观察到哪些结果。

collocations: reason under a memory consistency model

words.enDefinition: Wasted memory capacity caused by allocation gaps or unused space within allocated units.

examples.en: The drawing illustrated memory fragmentation by showing several small gaps between blocks of allocated space.
examples.zh: 图中把已分配空间块之间的几个小空隙画出来，说明「内存碎片化」。

examples.en: Our example showed memory fragmentation even though the total amount of free space seemed large.
examples.zh: 虽然空闲空间总量看起来很大，例题仍然出现了「内存碎片化」。

words.enDefinition: A file whose contents are accessible through a mapped range of virtual memory addresses.

examples.en: The practice viewer used a memory-mapped file so it could read parts of the sample document.
examples.zh: 练习用的查看器使用「内存映射文件」，以便读取示例文档的各个部分。

examples.en: Our tutor drew the link between the memory-mapped file and the process's address space.
examples.zh: 老师画出了「内存映射文件」与进程地址空间之间的关联。

collocations: use a memory-mapped file in an example

words.enDefinition: An association between a virtual address range and memory pages or another backing object.

examples.en: The diagram showed a memory mapping between part of the file and the program's address space.
examples.zh: 图中展示了文件的一部分和程序地址空间之间的「内存映射」。

examples.en: Our lab checked which region a memory mapping covered before reading the sample file contents.
examples.zh: 读取示例文件内容前，实验先查看「内存映射」覆盖了哪个区域。

words.enDefinition: Constraints on the order in which memory operations may be observed by concurrent threads.

examples.en: The lecture introduced memory ordering to explain when another thread could observe a saved result.
examples.zh: 课上介绍了「内存顺序」，说明另一条线程何时能观察到已保存的结果。

examples.en: We read the library description of memory ordering before discussing the classroom example's shared variables.
examples.zh: 讨论课堂例题里的共享变量前，我们先读了库文档对「内存顺序」的说明。

words.enDefinition: A fixed-size unit in which a virtual memory system manages addresses and data.

examples.en: The simulator coloured each memory page differently so we could follow the addresses on screen.
examples.zh: 模拟器给每个「内存页」涂上不同颜色，方便我们跟踪屏幕上的地址。

examples.en: We saw one memory page fill with data from the small file used in the exercise.
examples.zh: 我们看到，练习中那个小文件的数据填满了一个「内存页」。

collocations: refer to the same memory page

words.enDefinition: Demand for memory that strains the amount currently available to the system.

examples.en: The memory simulator showed more page reclamation once several large jobs produced memory pressure.
examples.zh: 几项大型作业引发「内存压力」后，内存模拟器显示回收了更多页。

examples.en: We noticed memory pressure when several classroom programs loaded their large samples at the same time.
examples.zh: 几个课堂程序同时加载各自的大样本时，我们注意到了「内存压力」。

words.enDefinition: A best common ancestor used to compare two lines of history

examples.en: We found the merge base before comparing the branches' different title edits.
examples.zh: 我们先找出「合并基点」，再比较两个分支对标题的不同修改。

examples.en: The diagram marked the merge base where the two example branches diverged.
examples.zh: 示意图在两个示例分支分叉处标出了「合并基点」。

collocations: compare changes from the merge base

words.enDefinition: A commit recording a merge with more than one parent

examples.en: We opened the merge commit to see where the two histories met.
examples.zh: 我们打开「合并提交」，查看两段历史记录在哪里会合。

examples.en: The merge commit appeared after our team's two versions were combined.
examples.zh: 我们组的两个版本合并后，出现了「合并提交」。

words.enDefinition: A conflict Git cannot resolve automatically when combining different changes

examples.en: The merge conflict occurred because both groups edited the same table heading.
examples.zh: 两个小组都改了同一个表格标题，因此出现「合并冲突」。

examples.en: We reviewed both proposed headings before resolving the merge conflict.
examples.zh: 解决「合并冲突」之前，我们审阅了两种提议的标题。

collocations: a merge conflict in a file

words.enDefinition: an output field identifying whether rows in a data merge came from the left input, right input or both

examples.en: We used a merge indicator after an outer merge to identify attendee records without a match.
examples.zh: 我们在外联接后使用「合并来源标记」，找出没有匹配项的出席记录。

examples.en: The merge indicator showed that several classroom codes existed only in the newer inventory.
examples.zh: 「合并来源标记」显示，有几个教室编号只在较新的清单里出现。

words.enDefinition: Sorting by dividing input into parts and merging their sorted results

examples.en: We used merge sort to order the scores, then examined the final merge.
examples.zh: 我们用「归并排序」给分数排序，再观察最后一次归并。

examples.en: The merge sort example showed the separate lists before joining them.
examples.zh: 「归并排序」示例先显示各个列表，再把它们合起来。

words.enDefinition: The stage that combines sorted parts into one ordered result

examples.en: The merge step chose the next item from the front of either list.
examples.zh: 「归并步骤」从两个列表之一的开头选出下一项。

examples.en: We traced the merge step after ordering each half of the data.
examples.zh: 我们把两半数据各自排好后，跟踪了「归并步骤」。

words.enDefinition: The point that separates one complete message from the next.

examples.en: The UDP illustration has a clear message boundary around each reading from the classroom sensor.
examples.zh: 在 UDP 示意图中，教室传感器每次读数都有明确的「消息边界」。

examples.en: The application uses its own format to find the message boundary within the TCP stream.
examples.zh: 应用通过自身规定的格式在 TCP 字节流里找到「消息边界」。

words.enDefinition: calling methods in sequence on the values returned by previous calls

examples.en: The worksheet used method chaining to set the report title and add its first section.
examples.zh: 练习表用「方法链式调用」设置报告标题，并添加第一节。

examples.en: Our tutor showed which returned value made the next call possible in the method chaining example.
examples.zh: 导师展示了「方法链式调用」示例中，哪个返回值使下一次调用成为可能。

words.enDefinition: taking a method from an object and storing it separately

examples.en: The JavaScript sample used method extraction to save a drawing method in a separate variable.
examples.zh: JavaScript 样本通过「提取对象方法」，把一个绘图方法保存到单独的变量里。

examples.en: Our tutor asked how method extraction affected this when the saved function was later called.
examples.zh: 导师问，稍后调用保存的函数时，「提取对象方法」会怎样影响 this。

collocations: separate a method by method extraction

words.enDefinition: a subclass declaration obscuring an inherited method without dynamic overriding

examples.en: The Java example showed method hiding when both classes declared a static method named describe.
examples.zh: 当两个类都声明名为 describe 的静态方法时，Java 示例展示了「方法隐藏」。

examples.en: Our tutor used method hiding to explain why the reference type mattered for that static call.
examples.zh: 导师用「方法隐藏」解释为什么引用的类型对那次静态调用很重要。

words.enDefinition: declaring methods with one name and different parameter lists

examples.en: The Java exercise used method overloading to accept a pair of coordinates or a point.
examples.zh: Java 练习用「方法重载」接收一对坐标值或一个点对象。

examples.en: Our tutor compared the parameter types that distinguished the methods in the method overloading example.
examples.zh: 导师比较了「方法重载」示例中用来区分各方法的参数类型。

words.enDefinition: providing a subclass implementation for an inherited instance method

examples.en: The Java worksheet used method overriding to give the rectangle its own implementation of drawing.
examples.zh: Java 练习表用「方法重写」为矩形提供了自己的绘制实现。

examples.en: Our tutor explained how method overriding affected the operation chosen for the subclass instance.
examples.zh: 导师解释了「方法重写」如何影响为子类实例选择的操作。

words.enDefinition: the object or class a method call acts on

examples.en: The diagram linked the method receiver to the particular shape that moved in our example.
examples.zh: 示例图把「方法接收者」与实际移动的那个图形连了起来。

examples.en: Our tutor asked which object was the method receiver when the program called the stored method.
examples.zh: 导师问，程序调用保存的方法时，哪个对象是「方法接收者」。

collocations: the receiver of a method call

words.enDefinition: the order in which a language searches classes for a method

examples.en: Our Python exercise printed the method resolution order before tracing a call to the sample method.
examples.zh: Python 练习先打印了「方法解析顺序」，再追踪对样本方法的调用。

examples.en: The tutor used method resolution order to locate the first implementation in the classroom hierarchy.
examples.zh: 导师用「方法解析顺序」在课堂示例的类层次结构中找到了第一个实现。

words.enDefinition: the information identifying a method under a language's declaration rules

examples.en: The Java worksheet changed a parameter type to create a different method signature in the example.
examples.zh: Java 练习表修改了一个参数的类型，从而在示例中形成不同的「方法签名」。

examples.en: The Java example changed only the return type, so the method signature stayed the same.
examples.zh: Java 示例只改了返回类型，因此「方法签名」保持不变。

collocations: a method signature with two parameters

words.enDefinition: A score computed by pooling the underlying classification counts across classes before applying the metric.

examples.en: We obtained the micro average by combining the classification counts before calculating the final precision score.
examples.zh: 我们先汇总分类计数，再计算最终精确率，得到「微平均」。

examples.en: The report gave a micro average for the book labels along with a score for each class.
examples.zh: 报告给出了图书标签的「微平均」，并列出了各类别的得分。

collocations: compare a micro average with per-class scores

words.enDefinition: Record-level data about individual units such as people, households, or establishments.

examples.en: The class compared microdata with a summary table to see what each row represents.
examples.zh: 全班比较了「微观数据」和汇总表，看看每行各自代表什么。

examples.en: The example microdata contain one fictional record for each household in the training exercise.
examples.zh: 示例「微观数据」为练习中的每户家庭提供一条虚构记录。

words.enDefinition: The index chosen near the middle of the current search range

examples.en: We recalculated the midpoint index after discarding the left part of the list.
examples.zh: 排除列表左侧部分后，我们重新计算了「中点下标」。

examples.en: The value at the midpoint index was too large in this step.
examples.zh: 这一步里，「中点下标」处的值太大了。

words.enDefinition: A small subset of training examples processed together for a training update.

examples.en: Each mini-batch contained a few photographs whose prediction errors contributed to the next update.
examples.zh: 每个「小批量」含有几张照片，对应的预测误差会参与下一次更新。

examples.en: Our tutor compared using a mini-batch with processing the entire training set for every update.
examples.zh: 老师对比了每次更新时使用一个「小批量」和处理整个训练集的做法。

collocations: compute the loss for a mini-batch

words.enDefinition: A small self-contained example that still demonstrates a particular problem

examples.en: We built a minimal reproducible example using just two dates and the formatter.
examples.zh: 我们只用两个日期和格式化器就做出了「最小可复现示例」。

examples.en: The tutor ran my minimal reproducible example before looking at the full worksheet.
examples.zh: 导师先运行了我的「最小可复现示例」，再看完整的练习表。

collocations: reduce code to a minimal reproducible example

words.enDefinition: a tree spanning a connected, undirected weighted graph with minimum total edge weight

examples.en: The minimum spanning tree connected all the rooms with the lowest total walkway cost.
examples.zh: 「最小生成树」用总成本最低的步道连接了所有房间。

examples.en: We compared two graphs before finding a minimum spanning tree for each one.
examples.zh: 我们先比较了两个图，再分别求出各自的「最小生成树」。

collocations: the weight of a minimum spanning tree

words.enDefinition: the second number of a semantic version, increased for backward-compatible new functionality or when public functionality is marked deprecated

examples.en: The example increased its minor version after adding a compatible formatting option.
examples.zh: 示例新增一个兼容的格式化选项后，提高了「次版本号」。

examples.en: We pointed to the middle number while explaining the minor version in class.
examples.zh: 我们在课上说明「次版本号」时指着中间那个数字。

words.enDefinition: A category with relatively few examples in an imbalanced dataset.

examples.en: Poetry formed the minority class because only a few books in the sample carried that label.
examples.zh: 诗歌是「少数类」，因为样本里只有几本书带有该标签。

examples.en: We reported errors for the minority class separately after noticing how rarely those books appeared.
examples.zh: 发现这类书很少出现后，我们单独报告了「少数类」的错误。

collocations: evaluate recall for the minority class
count examples from the minority class

words.enDefinition: A requested key for which the mapping contains no entry.

examples.en: The mapping returned the default score when the example asked for a missing key.
examples.zh: 例题查询一个「不存在的键」时，映射返回了默认分数。

examples.en: We tested a missing key using a colour name that the program had never stored.
examples.zh: 我们用程序从未存过的一种颜色名称测试了「不存在的键」。

collocations: return a default for a missing key

words.enDefinition: an entry for which a value has not been observed or recorded

examples.en: The missing value marked an afternoon session for which the data sheet contained no recorded reading.
examples.zh: 这处「缺失值」对应一场没有在数据表中留下读数的下午活动。

examples.en: We kept the missing value separate from zero because they represented different results in the classroom study.
examples.zh: 由于二者在课堂研究中表示不同情况，我们把「缺失值」与零区分开。

words.enDefinition: a code, token or special value indicating that a data entry is missing

examples.en: The reader recognised the configured missing value marker and did not treat it as a measurement.
examples.zh: 读取程序识别了配置的「缺失值标记符」，没有把它当成测量值。

examples.en: We listed each missing value marker used by the three surveys before combining their files.
examples.zh: 合并三个调查的文件前，我们列出各调查使用的每种「缺失值标记符」。

words.enDefinition: a variable marking whether another value is missing for each observation

examples.en: We added a missingness indicator to track which survey responses originally lacked an answer to that question.
examples.zh: 我们添加「缺失指示变量」，追踪哪些问卷答复最初漏答了那道题。

examples.en: The tutor counted the missingness indicator values separately for the morning and afternoon groups in the study.
examples.zh: 导师在研究中分别统计上午组和下午组的「缺失指示变量」取值。

collocations: use a missingness indicator in an analysis

words.enDefinition: the distribution or combination of missing values across observations, variables or groups

examples.en: The missingness pattern showed that several measurements were absent together near the end of the same session.
examples.zh: 「数据缺失模式」显示，几次读数缺失集中在同一场活动快结束时。

examples.en: We looked for a missingness pattern before deciding whether to exclude incomplete records from the comparison.
examples.zh: 我们先查看是否存在「数据缺失模式」，再决定是否从比较中排除不完整的记录。

collocations: check a missingness pattern before analysis

words.enDefinition: more than one kind of value, such as text and numbers, appearing in an expected homogeneous column

examples.en: The mixed data types caused a totals calculation to skip values that had been stored as text.
examples.zh: 由于存在「混合的数据类型」，求合计时跳过了以文本存储的数值。

examples.en: We traced the mixed data types to two groups that exported the same question in different formats.
examples.zh: 我们查到「混合的数据类型」源于两个小组以不同格式导出了同一道题。

collocations: scan a column for mixed data types

words.enDefinition: Tabs and spaces used together to indent the same code

examples.en: The editor marked mixed tabs and spaces after I pasted in the copied code.
examples.zh: 我粘贴复制的代码后，编辑器标出了「制表符和空格混用」的位置。

examples.en: We checked whether mixed tabs and spaces explained the indentation complaint in our Python exercise.
examples.zh: 我们核对了 Python 练习中的缩进报错是否由「制表符和空格混用」造成。

words.enDefinition: A test replacement used to check expected calls or interactions

examples.en: The mock object verified that the example requested the record only once.
examples.zh: 「模拟对象」验证了示例只请求了一次记录。

examples.en: Our mock object checked that the formatter sent the expected label to the output handler.
examples.zh: 我们的「模拟对象」检查了格式化器是否向输出处理程序发送了预期标签。

collocations: set expectations on a mock object
check calls to a mock object

words.enDefinition: filling a missing value with the most frequently occurring value in a specified observed set

examples.en: The classroom report tested mode imputation for the missing entries in a field of venue categories.
examples.zh: 课堂报告对一列场地类别中的缺失条目试用了「众数插补」。

examples.en: We checked whether two categories were tied before using mode imputation in the practice dataset.
examples.zh: 在练习数据集中使用「众数插补」前，我们核查了是否有两个类别的频数并列最高。

collocations: apply mode imputation to a category
handle tied modes in mode imputation

words.enDefinition: In bias–variance analysis, the difference between a model's average prediction and the underlying target function.

examples.en: The simulation showed model bias because the average fitted line missed the curve that generated the data.
examples.zh: 模拟中，平均拟合线偏离了生成数据的曲线，体现了「模型偏差」。

examples.en: Our tutor used a known target function to show how model bias could be estimated.
examples.zh: 老师用一个已知的目标函数展示了怎样估计「模型偏差」。

collocations: explain model bias with a known target function

words.enDefinition: How flexible a model is in the patterns it can represent.

examples.en: We increased model complexity by letting the practice tree ask more questions before predicting a category.
examples.zh: 我们允许练习决策树在预测类别前提出更多判断问题，提高了「模型复杂度」。

examples.en: The tutor discussed model complexity while comparing a straight line with a much more flexible curve.
examples.zh: 老师将直线与更灵活的曲线作对比时，讨论了「模型复杂度」。

words.enDefinition: Using a trained model to produce outputs for supplied inputs.

examples.en: The app ran model inference when we presented a new leaf photograph during the demonstration.
examples.zh: 演示中，我们给应用一张新的叶片照片时，它执行了「模型推理」。

examples.en: Our report timed model inference separately from the work of fitting the classifier in class.
examples.zh: 报告分别计量了「模型推理」与课堂上拟合分类器的耗时。

collocations: perform model inference on new data

words.enDefinition: Values learned during fitting that determine how a model produces its outputs.

examples.en: The model parameters changed when the regression was fitted to the larger set of workshop records.
examples.zh: 用更大的一组工作坊记录拟合回归模型后，「模型参数」发生了变化。

examples.en: We compared the model parameters to see how two features contributed to the predicted times.
examples.zh: 我们比较了「模型参数」，看两个特征分别怎样影响用时预测。

words.enDefinition: Choosing a modeling approach or fitted configuration based on a specified comparison procedure.

examples.en: We used validation results for model selection before evaluating the chosen approach on the test set.
examples.zh: 我们先依据验证结果进行「模型选择」，再在测试集上评估选定的方法。

examples.en: The tutor asked us to describe the model selection criteria used in the library classification exercise.
examples.zh: 老师让我们说明图书馆分类练习所采用的「模型选择」标准。

collocations: use validation data for model selection
keep test data separate from model selection

words.enDefinition: Variation in a model's predictions across different training samples drawn under comparable conditions.

examples.en: The simulation showed high model variance when small changes in the sample produced very different fitted curves.
examples.zh: 样本稍有变化就得到差异很大的拟合曲线，模拟因此显示较高的「模型方差」。

examples.en: We compared model variance by examining the predictions from several independent training samples in the exercise.
examples.zh: 我们查看了用练习中几个独立训练样本拟合后得到的预测，比较「模型方差」。

collocations: illustrate model variance across training samples

words.enDefinition: a design separating the model and its behaviour, the view that presents it, and the controller handling input

examples.en: The classroom reading app used model-view-controller to keep the view separate from book data.
examples.zh: 课堂阅读应用使用「模型视图控制器模式」，把视图与书籍数据分开。

examples.en: Our tutor drew a model-view-controller diagram to show which part handled the student's action.
examples.zh: 导师画了「模型视图控制器模式」示意图，说明哪个部分处理学生的操作。

words.enDefinition: a unit of code that groups related definitions and can expose them for use elsewhere

examples.en: We put the date helpers into one module so that the worksheet and report scripts could share them.
examples.zh: 我们把日期辅助函数放进同一「模块」，让练习表脚本和报告脚本共用。

examples.en: The module provided functions for formatting dates but left the menu generation to another part of the program.
examples.zh: 该「模块」提供日期格式化函数，将生成菜单的工作交给程序的另一部分。

words.enDefinition: the set of names bound to objects within a module

examples.en: The names in the module namespace included the helper we defined and the library we imported earlier.
examples.zh: 「模块命名空间」中的名称包括我们定义的辅助函数和之前导入的库。

examples.en: We checked whether the identifier had been added to our module namespace before trying to use it.
examples.zh: 尝试使用该标识符前，我们先检查它是否已加入我们的「模块命名空间」。

collocations: add a name to a module namespace
resolve a name in a module namespace

words.enDefinition: a string in a JavaScript import or export statement that identifies another module for resolution

examples.en: The module specifier identified the nearby file that supplied the chart labels for our course example.
examples.zh: 「模块标识符」指向附近提供课程示例图表标签的文件。

examples.en: We corrected the module specifier after finding that the file name still referred to an older example.
examples.zh: 发现文件名仍指向旧示例后，我们修正了「模块标识符」。

words.enDefinition: an operator giving the nonnegative residue for a positive modulus

examples.en: The Python worksheet used the modulo operator to find the position within a repeating sequence.
examples.zh: Python 练习表用「模运算符」找出某项在循环序列中的位置。

examples.en: With a positive divisor, Python's modulo operator returned a nonnegative result in the sample calculation.
examples.zh: 除数为正时，样本计算中的 Python「模运算符」给出非负结果。

collocations: the modulo operator with a positive divisor

words.enDefinition: the bit with the greatest weight magnitude in a positional representation

examples.en: The worksheet marked the most significant bit before we interpreted the sample as an unsigned integer.
examples.zh: 在我们把样本解读为无符号整数前，练习表标出了「最高有效位」。

examples.en: Our tutor moved the most significant bit to a separate column so students could compare its weight.
examples.zh: 导师把「最高有效位」放进单独一栏，以便学生比较它的位权。

collocations: the weight of the most significant bit

words.enDefinition: an index whose labels contain several levels, such as a year and a month

examples.en: We set a multi-level index so the attendance data could be located by building and room together.
examples.zh: 我们设置「多级索引」，以便同时用楼宇和房间定位出勤数据。

examples.en: The multi-level index kept months under their corresponding years in the reshaped workshop summary.
examples.zh: 重塑后的工作坊汇总表通过「多级索引」把各月归到对应年份下面。

collocations: select a level of a multi-level index

words.enDefinition: Assigning one category to each example from more than two mutually exclusive categories.

examples.en: The team used multiclass classification to assign each sample to one of four plant species.
examples.zh: 团队用「多类别分类」将每个样本归到四种植物中的一种。

examples.en: Our tutor used multiclass classification when each book could have only one of five catalogue labels.
examples.zh: 每本书只能有五种编目标签之一时，老师用了「多类别分类」。

words.enDefinition: A task that can assign several labels to the same example.

examples.en: We used multilabel classification because each classroom document could cover both science and local history.
examples.zh: 我们用「多标签分类」，因为一份课堂文档可能同时涉及科学和地方历史。

examples.en: Our tutor contrasted multilabel classification with assigning only one catalogue label to every book.
examples.zh: 老师把「多标签分类」与为每本书只分配一个编目标签的做法作了比较。

words.enDefinition: a string containing text on more than one line

examples.en: The Python worksheet stored the three-line poem as one multiline string for the exercise.
examples.zh: Python 练习表把一首三行诗存为一个「多行字符串」供练习使用。

examples.en: We displayed the multiline string and counted the line breaks in the resulting text.
examples.zh: 我们显示了「多行字符串」，并数了结果文本中的换行。

words.enDefinition: deriving one class directly from more than one base class

examples.en: The Python example used multiple inheritance to combine two independent features in a classroom object.
examples.zh: Python 示例用「多重继承」把两个独立功能结合到一个课堂对象里。

examples.en: Our tutor asked which base class supplied the method in the multiple inheritance exercise.
examples.zh: 导师问，「多重继承」练习中哪个基类提供了这个方法。

words.enDefinition: a notation at one end of a class diagram's association showing how many instances may be linked

examples.en: The multiplicity indicator beside the classrooms showed that a tutor could be assigned to several rooms.
examples.zh: 教室一端的「关联多重性标记」显示，一名导师可获分配多间教室。

examples.en: Our class used a multiplicity indicator to show that some visitors had no associated booking in the example.
examples.zh: 我们班用「关联多重性标记」表示示例中有些访客没有关联的预订。

collocations: place a multiplicity indicator on an association
check the bounds of a multiplicity indicator

words.enDefinition: a value whose contents can change after creation

examples.en: Our Python list was a mutable value, so adding an item changed the same list.
examples.zh: 我们的 Python 列表是「可变值」，因此添加一项会改变原来的列表。

examples.en: Two labels referred to a mutable value, and both reflected the change made in class.
examples.zh: 两个标签都指向同一个「可变值」，因此两边都反映了课堂上作出的修改。

words.enDefinition: A synchronization object that lets only one thread hold access to a protected region at a time.

examples.en: The example used a mutex to protect the list where both workers recorded completed jobs.
examples.zh: 示例用「互斥锁」保护列表，两条工作线程都在该列表里记录已完成的作业。

examples.en: Our tutor marked the mutex next to the shared whiteboard in the classroom diagram.
examples.zh: 老师在课堂图示的共享白板旁标出了「互斥锁」。

collocations: protect shared data with a mutex

words.enDefinition: A guarantee that at most one participant can use a protected resource or code section at a time.

examples.en: The classroom example used mutual exclusion to allow only one worker to update the list at once.
examples.zh: 课堂例题用「互斥」确保每次只有一条工作线程可以更新列表。

examples.en: Our tutor used two coloured cards to demonstrate mutual exclusion around one shared box.
examples.zh: 老师用两张不同颜色的卡片演示了访问同一个共享方框时的「互斥」。

collocations: verify mutual exclusion in a test

words.enDefinition: recursion in which two or more functions call each other, directly or through a cycle

examples.en: Our tutor used mutual recursion to show how two routines could alternate as they processed the same sequence.
examples.zh: 导师用「相互递归」演示两个例程可以如何交替处理同一序列。

examples.en: The parser used mutual recursion so its helpers could take turns processing nested parts of an expression.
examples.zh: 解析器用「相互递归」让两个辅助函数交替处理表达式的嵌套部分。

collocations: replace mutual recursion with an iterative routine

words.enDefinition: a date and time value that does not carry timezone or offset information

examples.en: We found a naive timestamp in each row and asked the lab which local time was used.
examples.zh: 我们在每一行都找到了「无时区信息的时间戳」，于是询问实验室使用哪个当地时间。

examples.en: The migration converted the naive timestamp only after we identified the location of the original recording device.
examples.zh: 我们确定原始记录设备的位置后，迁移程序才转换「无时区信息的时间戳」。

collocations: attach timezone information to a naive timestamp

words.enDefinition: associating a program name with a value or object

examples.en: In the Python exercise, name binding associated the label with the string on the right.
examples.zh: 在 Python 练习中，「名称绑定」将标签名与右边的字符串关联起来。

examples.en: Our diagram illustrated name binding by drawing an arrow from the name to the object.
examples.zh: 我们的图从名称画一条箭头指向对象，用来说明「名称绑定」。

words.enDefinition: finding which binding a reference to a name should use under the language's scope rules

examples.en: The exercise traced name lookup from the innermost function to a matching declaration in the surrounding function.
examples.zh: 练习演示了从最内层函数向外进行「名称查找」，直到在其外层函数中找到匹配的声明。

examples.en: We reviewed the name lookup rules to explain why the code kept finding the value from the module.
examples.zh: 我们查阅了「名称查找」规则，解释代码为什么总是找到模块里的值。

words.enDefinition: changing certain identifiers systematically to reduce name collisions

examples.en: The Python tutor used name mangling to discuss accidental name clashes between related classes.
examples.zh: Python 导师用「名称改写」说明相关类之间如何避免意外命名冲突。

examples.en: Our worksheet traced name mangling for a double-underscore attribute declared inside the sample class.
examples.zh: 练习表对样本类中声明的双下划线属性追踪了「名称改写」。

collocations: a name affected by name mangling

words.enDefinition: using the same name for an inner binding so references there no longer select an outer binding

examples.en: The tutor demonstrated name shadowing by giving a local variable the same name as a module constant.
examples.zh: 导师给局部变量取了与模块常量相同的名字，以演示「名称遮蔽」。

examples.en: We avoided name shadowing by choosing a parameter name different from the name used by the outer function.
examples.zh: 我们选择与外层函数所用名称不同的形参名，避免「名称遮蔽」。

words.enDefinition: a symbolic name for a value intended to remain unchanged

examples.en: The student used a named constant for the number of minutes in an hour.
examples.zh: 学生把一小时的分钟数写成了「命名常量」。

examples.en: Our Python exercise used an uppercase name for the named constant that represented the daily limit.
examples.zh: Python 练习用大写名称表示代表每日上限的「命名常量」。

collocations: replace a literal with a named constant

words.enDefinition: an export made available under a specific name other than default in an ES module

examples.en: The named export let the other module import the date converter by the name used in its documentation.
examples.zh: 「具名导出」让另一模块可以按文档所用名称导入日期转换器。

examples.en: We added a second named export for the alternate formatting routine without changing the existing import.
examples.zh: 我们给备用格式化例程加了第二个「具名导出」，原有的导入不需要更改。

words.enDefinition: A Python exception raised when a referenced name cannot be found

examples.en: A misspelled variable name caused a NameError in the short exercise.
examples.zh: 这个短练习中，变量名写错引起了「Python 名称错误」。

examples.en: The tutor showed which name appeared in the NameError message.
examples.zh: 导师指出「Python 名称错误」信息里出现了哪个名称。

collocations: a NameError for an undefined name

words.enDefinition: a Python package that can combine portions from more than one import location without a package initializer file

examples.en: We used a namespace package to let two independent distributions contribute separate modules under one package name.
examples.zh: 我们用「命名空间包」，使两个独立发行包能在同一个包名下提供不同模块。

examples.en: The example's namespace package had parts in two folders that Python could see on its import path.
examples.zh: 示例的「命名空间包」分布在 Python 导入路径可见的两个文件夹中。

collocations: distribute parts of a namespace package
import a module from a namespace package

words.enDefinition: a special numeric value representing an invalid or undefined numeric result

examples.en: The JavaScript demonstration produced NaN when it tried to convert the sample word into a number.
examples.zh: JavaScript 演示尝试把样本单词转成数字时，得到「非数值」。

examples.en: Our tutor used a dedicated test to detect NaN in the results of the exercise.
examples.zh: 导师用专门的检测方法从练习结果中找出「非数值」。

words.enDefinition: Instructions encoded for direct execution by a particular processor architecture

examples.en: The diagram showed native machine code as the form a processor could execute directly.
examples.zh: 图上显示，「原生机器代码」是处理器可以直接执行的形式。

examples.en: Our tutor contrasted native machine code with intermediate instructions produced in the first step.
examples.zh: 导师把「原生机器代码」与第一步生成的中间指令作了对比。

collocations: translate bytecode to native machine code

words.enDefinition: an existing meaningful attribute or combination of attributes used to identify rows uniquely

examples.en: The tutor used a full vehicle registration code as the natural key in the model records.
examples.zh: 导师在示例记录中用完整车辆登记代码作为「自然键」。

examples.en: We tested whether the natural key would still identify each record after the naming convention changed.
examples.zh: 我们检验命名规则改变后，「自然键」是否仍能标识每条记录。

collocations: use an existing attribute as a natural key

words.enDefinition: A classifier predicting from the labels of nearby training examples under a chosen similarity or distance measure.

examples.en: The nearest-neighbor classifier compared each new leaf with similar leaves that already had known labels.
examples.zh: 「最近邻分类器」将每片新叶子与标签已知的相似叶片作比较。

examples.en: Our tutor asked how the nearest-neighbor classifier would behave if different measurements used very different scales.
examples.zh: 老师问，如果各项测量的取值尺度差异很大，「最近邻分类器」的表现会怎样。

collocations: change the settings of a nearest-neighbor classifier

words.enDefinition: The other category in binary classification, outside the chosen event of interest.

examples.en: The negative class contained all the garden leaves that were not from oak trees.
examples.zh: 「负类」包含花园里所有非橡树的叶片。

examples.en: The tutor asked why the model assigned this particular leaf to the negative class.
examples.zh: 老师问，模型为什么把这片叶子分到了「负类」。

collocations: count examples in the negative class

words.enDefinition: A cycle whose edge weights sum to less than zero

examples.en: The distance fell on every repetition through the same negative cycle in class.
examples.zh: 课上，每重复经过同一个「负权环」一次，距离就再减少。

examples.en: I added the edge weights to check for a negative cycle.
examples.zh: 我把边权相加，检查是否存在「负权环」。

collocations: a graph containing a negative cycle

words.enDefinition: An edge value less than zero in a weighted graph

examples.en: The example assigned a negative edge weight to the edge representing a rebate.
examples.zh: 示例给表示返还额的那条边赋了一个「负边权」。

examples.en: We checked whether a negative edge weight affected the choice of algorithm.
examples.zh: 我们检查了「负边权」是否会影响算法选择。

collocations: a path with a negative edge weight

words.enDefinition: In languages that support it, using negative indexes to address positions relative to the end of a sequence.

examples.en: We used negative indexing in Python to read the last colour in the palette.
examples.zh: 我们用 Python 的「负索引」读取调色板中的最后一种颜色。

examples.en: The tutorial explained negative indexing by counting backwards from the final entry in the list.
examples.zh: 教程从列表的最后一项往前数，以说明「负索引」。

collocations: explain negative indexing with a list

words.enDefinition: A check that software handles invalid inputs or unsupported situations appropriately

examples.en: The negative test checked the message shown for a calendar date that could not exist.
examples.zh: 「无效输入处理测试」检查输入一个不存在的日期时会显示什么消息。

examples.en: We wrote a negative test for an empty name in the exercise.
examples.zh: 我们给练习中姓名为空的情形写了「无效输入处理测试」。

words.enDefinition: a conditional statement placed within one of the branches of another conditional statement

examples.en: The nested conditional checked the discount only after the program had confirmed the customer's membership.
examples.zh: 程序确认顾客的会员资格之后，「嵌套条件语句」才会检查折扣。

examples.en: We drew a diagram of the nested conditional to see which messages could appear together.
examples.zh: 我们画了「嵌套条件语句」的流程图，查看哪些消息可能一起出现。

words.enDefinition: Cross-validation with inner splits for tuning and separate outer splits for estimating the tuned procedure's performance.

examples.en: The assignment used nested cross-validation to separate choosing tree settings from estimating the resulting model's performance.
examples.zh: 作业使用「嵌套交叉验证」，把选择树的设置与估计所得模型的表现分开。

examples.en: We marked the inner and outer folds before running nested cross-validation on the practice records.
examples.zh: 我们先标出内层和外层各折，再在练习记录上跑「嵌套交叉验证」。

collocations: report outer scores from nested cross-validation

words.enDefinition: A list that contains one or more lists as elements.

examples.en: Our Python exercise stored the board in a nested list with one inner list per row.
examples.zh: Python 练习用「嵌套列表」存放棋盘，每行对应一个内层列表。

examples.en: The program printed the two inner groups of the nested list on different lines.
examples.zh: 程序把「嵌套列表」内部的两组元素打印在不同行上。

collocations: store rows in a nested list

words.enDefinition: a loop contained within another loop

examples.en: The nested loop processed every seat in each row of the diagram for the theatre.
examples.zh: 「嵌套循环」处理剧院示意图中每一排的每个座位。

examples.en: We traced the nested loop by writing down which row and column were visited at each step.
examples.zh: 我们记录每一步访问的行和列，以跟踪「嵌套循环」。

words.enDefinition: The layer that handles logical addresses and forwards packets between networks.

examples.en: The network layer helps the packet reach a service on a different campus network.
examples.zh: 「网络层」帮助数据包抵达另一个校园网络里的服务。

examples.en: In the worksheet, the network layer chooses a route using the packet's destination address.
examples.zh: 在练习中，「网络层」根据数据包的目的地址选择路由。

words.enDefinition: The developer tools view that lists network requests and responses made while a web page loads or runs.

examples.en: The network panel lists separate requests for the example catalogue document and its stylesheet.
examples.zh: 「网络面板」分别列出了示例目录文档与其样式表的请求。

examples.en: We opened the network panel to check the status of the classroom page's image request.
examples.zh: 我们打开「网络面板」，查看课堂页面中图片请求的状态。

collocations: inspect a request in the network panel
filter entries in the network panel

words.enDefinition: A set of networking protocols arranged in layers that work together to exchange data.

examples.en: The network protocol stack diagram traces a catalogue request from the browser to the local link.
examples.zh: 「网络协议栈」示意图一路追踪目录请求从浏览器到本地链路的过程。

examples.en: For the quiz, we labelled the network protocol stack with the protocols shown in class.
examples.zh: 做小测时，我们用课堂上讲过的协议给「网络协议栈」作了标注。

collocations: diagram of a network protocol stack

words.enDefinition: The next node to receive a packet along its route, often a router.

examples.en: In the diagram, the next hop for this destination is the router outside our lab.
examples.zh: 图中，这个目的地对应的「下一跳」是实验室外的路由器。

examples.en: Two different destination prefixes point to the same next hop in this simplified routing table.
examples.zh: 这张简化路由表里，两个不同的目的前缀指向同一个「下一跳」。

words.enDefinition: A pointer or reference that identifies a node's immediate successor.

examples.en: The next pointer led from the blue node to the green node in our diagram.
examples.zh: 在我们的图中，「后继指针」从蓝色节点指向绿色节点。

examples.en: We changed the next pointer so the new node appeared between two existing colours.
examples.zh: 我们更新了「后继指针」，使新节点出现在两个原有颜色节点之间。

collocations: set the next pointer of a node

words.enDefinition: a constructor that takes no arguments from its caller

examples.en: The Java class declared a no-argument constructor that assigned an empty label to each new shape.
examples.zh: Java 类声明了「无参构造方法」，给每个新图形赋予空标签。

examples.en: Our tutor used the no-argument constructor when the example did not supply any starting values.
examples.zh: 示例不提供任何初始值时，导师使用了「无参构造方法」。

collocations: a class with a no-argument constructor

words.enDefinition: The number of edges from a tree's root to a node

examples.en: The node depth increased by one whenever we followed a child link.
examples.zh: 每沿一个子节点链接向下走，「节点深度」就增加一。

examples.en: We recorded node depth beside every marked node in the worksheet.
examples.zh: 我们在练习表标记过的每个节点旁记录了「节点深度」。

words.enDefinition: The data carried by a node, apart from its structural links.

examples.en: We changed one node value without changing any of the arrows between the cards.
examples.zh: 我们改了一个「节点值」，卡片之间的箭头维持原样。

examples.en: Our tutor compared the node value with the number written on the separate answer sheet.
examples.zh: 老师把「节点值」与另一张答题纸上写的数字作了比较。

words.enDefinition: the contrast of an essential graphic or visible interface component against its adjacent colours

examples.en: We checked non-text contrast to ensure the pale bars remained visible against the chart background.
examples.zh: 我们检查「非文本对比度」，确认浅色条形在图表背景上仍看得清。

examples.en: The tutor demonstrated non-text contrast by comparing two outlines around identical bars on the screen.
examples.zh: 老师对比屏幕上相同条形的两种轮廓，演示「非文本对比度」。

words.enDefinition: Input or output that returns promptly if it cannot proceed, rather than waiting for readiness.

examples.en: With nonblocking I/O, the demo returned from the read promptly when no sample was ready.
examples.zh: 采用「非阻塞式 I/O」时，如果样本还未就绪，演示程序会立即从读取调用返回。

examples.en: We compared nonblocking I/O with a read that waited until the sample data was ready.
examples.zh: 我们把「非阻塞式 I/O」与等样本数据就绪才返回的读取作比较。

collocations: try a read with nonblocking I/O
handle an unavailable result with nonblocking I/O

words.enDefinition: the Python singleton commonly used to represent an absent value

examples.en: The classroom function returned a None value when the requested label could not be found.
examples.zh: 课堂函数找不到所需标签时，返回了一个「Python 的空值」。

examples.en: Our tutor distinguished the None value from the empty string shown beside it in the exercise.
examples.zh: 导师让我们区分练习中并排列出的「Python 的空值」和空字符串。

collocations: use a None value as a default

words.enDefinition: a name association in an enclosing function scope, accessed with nonlocal when rebinding it in Python

examples.en: The nested Python function used a nonlocal binding to update the count shared with its outer function.
examples.zh: 嵌套 Python 函数通过「非局部名称绑定」更新与外层函数共享的计数。

examples.en: We marked the nonlocal binding to distinguish it from a variable local to the inner function.
examples.zh: 我们标出了「非局部名称绑定」，把它与内层函数自己的局部变量区别开。

words.enDefinition: a read pattern in which repeated access to an item in the same transaction observes another transaction's committed modification

examples.en: The example illustrated a nonrepeatable read when a repeated lookup saw another transaction's committed room update.
examples.zh: 示例演示了「不可重复读」，同一查询再次执行时看到了另一事务已提交的房间更新。

examples.en: We distinguished a nonrepeatable read from a read of an update that had not yet been committed.
examples.zh: 我们区分了「不可重复读」和读到尚未提交的更新。

words.enDefinition: A returned code other than zero, often indicating unsuccessful execution

examples.en: The sample returned a nonzero exit status when its data file was missing.
examples.zh: 示例找不到数据文件时，返回了「非零退出状态码」。

examples.en: The tutor explained why a nonzero exit status appeared in the execution summary.
examples.zh: 导师解释了为什么执行摘要中出现「非零退出状态码」。

collocations: a run with a nonzero exit status

words.enDefinition: the Unicode form obtained by canonical decomposition and reordering followed by canonical composition where allowed

examples.en: We applied normalization form C so canonically equivalent strings used the same composed form.
examples.zh: 我们应用「规范化形式 C」，使规范等价的字符串使用相同的组合形式。

examples.en: The tutor showed which code points could combine under normalization form C in the example.
examples.zh: 导师展示了示例中哪些码点可以在「规范化形式 C」下重新组合。

collocations: convert text to normalization form C

words.enDefinition: the Unicode form obtained by canonical decomposition and canonical ordering of the resulting code points

examples.en: The worksheet used normalization form D to separate the example's accented letter into its components.
examples.zh: 练习表用「规范化形式 D」把示例中的带重音字母分解成各个成分。

examples.en: Our tutor inspected the code points produced by normalization form D for the sample word.
examples.zh: 导师查看样本单词经「规范化形式 D」处理之后产生的码点。

collocations: convert text to normalization form D

words.enDefinition: a designated value showing that a question or field does not apply to a particular record

examples.en: The not applicable code meant that the participant had skipped a follow-up question by design.
examples.zh: 「不适用编码」表示按问卷设计，这名参与者不需要回答后续题。

examples.en: We kept the not applicable code distinct from a blank for a required question.
examples.zh: 我们将「不适用编码」与必答题未填的空白分开保留。

collocations: distinguish a not applicable code from a blank

words.enDefinition: a rule prohibiting null values in a column

examples.en: The not-null constraint stopped the practice database from saving a workshop booking without an assigned date.
examples.zh: 「非空约束」使练习数据库无法保存未指定日期的工作坊预订。

examples.en: We added a not-null constraint after confirming that every existing catalogue entry had a recorded title.
examples.zh: 确认现有每条目录记录都存有标题后，我们加了「非空约束」。

words.enDefinition: The sequence in which the code cells in a computational notebook are run.

examples.en: The notebook execution order matters because the last cell needs values created in earlier cells.
examples.zh: 「笔记本执行顺序」很重要，因为最后一个单元格要用到先前单元格生成的值。

examples.en: We checked notebook execution order after the same notebook produced different charts in class.
examples.zh: 同一个笔记本在课堂上生成不同图表后，我们核查了「笔记本执行顺序」。

collocations: notebook execution order from top to bottom

words.enDefinition: The process that executes code in a computational notebook

examples.en: The notebook kernel kept my earlier results in memory between calculations.
examples.zh: 「交互笔记本执行内核」在两次计算之间把前一次的结果保留在内存里。

examples.en: Our tutor checked which notebook kernel the classroom exercise was using.
examples.zh: 导师确认了课堂练习在用哪个「交互笔记本执行内核」。

words.enDefinition: A link with no target, often marking the end of a non-circular linked list.

examples.en: The final box contained a null link because there was no node after the last colour.
examples.zh: 最后一种颜色之后已没有节点，所以最后一个方框里是「空链接」。

examples.en: We stopped when the diagram showed a null link where the next node would have been.
examples.zh: 图中原本应指向后继节点的地方是「空链接」，我们就停止了遍历。

collocations: use a null link at the tail

words.enDefinition: a design providing an object with default behaviour for an absent collaborator

examples.en: The null object pattern supplied a label formatter that simply returned the original text.
examples.zh: 「空对象模式」提供一个直接返回原文本的标签格式化对象。

examples.en: Our tutor used the null object pattern so the drawing exercise could call the optional helper consistently.
examples.zh: 导师使用「空对象模式」，让绘图练习始终以同样的方式调用可选辅助对象。

collocations: a default collaborator in the null object pattern

words.enDefinition: a comparison in which null inputs have defined equality or difference treatment instead of producing an unknown result

examples.en: We used a null-safe comparison to treat two missing workshop dates as equal in the class example.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂示例里用「能处理空值的比较」，把两个缺失的工作坊日期视为相同。

examples.en: The tutor demonstrated a null-safe comparison when checking whether an optional note had changed between two versions.
examples.zh: 导师在检查两版之间可选备注是否改变时，演示了「能处理空值的比较」。

words.enDefinition: a designated value representing the absence of a meaningful value

examples.en: The JavaScript example used a null value until the student selected a display colour.
examples.zh: JavaScript 示例在学生选择显示颜色之前使用「空值」。

examples.en: I checked whether the null value in the worksheet indicated an unknown answer or a deliberate omission.
examples.zh: 我核对练习表中的「空值」表示答案未知，还是特意留空。

collocations: a field with a null value

words.enDefinition: a type that permits a designated null value

examples.en: The worksheet used a nullable type so the field could hold a number or null.
examples.zh: 练习表用「可空类型」表示该字段既可以存数字，也可以存空值。

examples.en: Our tutor marked the score field with a nullable type because some results were unknown.
examples.zh: 因为有些成绩未知，导师用「可空类型」标示成绩字段。

collocations: a value of a nullable type

words.zhGloss: 两值相等时返回空值的函数
words.enDefinition: a SQL function-like expression returning null if its two arguments compare equal, otherwise returning its first argument
acceptedZhAnswers: 两值相等时返回空值的函数

examples.en: The NULLIF function turned a zero attendance count into null before the exercise computed an average per attendee.
examples.zh: 在练习计算人均值之前，「两值相等时返回空值的函数」把零出勤人数转成了空值。

examples.en: We used the NULLIF function to treat an empty note as missing while keeping other note text.
examples.zh: 我们用「两值相等时返回空值的函数」把空备注视为缺失，同时保留其他备注内容。

collocations: return null using the NULLIF function
protect a divisor with the NULLIF function

words.enDefinition: a test that a numeric value falls within permitted bounds

examples.en: The numeric range check found a negative count in the file containing event registrations.
examples.zh: 「数值范围检查」在活动报名文件中发现了一处负数计数。

examples.en: We added a numeric range check after confirming the minimum and maximum supported by the device.
examples.zh: 确认设备支持的最小值与最大值之后，我们加入了「数值范围检查」。

words.enDefinition: a whole-part relationship in which parts can exist independently of the whole

examples.en: The UML example used object aggregation because the players could exist apart from any team.
examples.zh: UML 示例使用「对象聚合」，因为选手可以脱离任何队伍独立存在。

examples.en: Our tutor marked object aggregation on a diagram linking a reading group to its members.
examples.zh: 导师在阅读小组与成员的关系图上标出「对象聚合」。

collocations: a relationship based on object aggregation
show object aggregation on a diagram

words.enDefinition: building an object out of other objects that provide parts of its behaviour

examples.en: The classroom app used object composition to give each drawing a separate colour palette.
examples.zh: 课堂应用用「对象组合」为每幅画配一套独立的调色板。

examples.en: Our tutor used object composition to combine a shape with a separate label object.
examples.zh: 导师用「对象组合」把一个图形和独立标签对象放在一起。

words.enDefinition: having one object ask a collaborator to perform part of its work

examples.en: The app used object delegation to give label formatting to a separate helper object.
examples.zh: 应用通过「对象委派」把标签格式化工作交给了一个独立的辅助对象。

examples.en: Our tutor demonstrated object delegation when the drawing let its palette choose a colour.
examples.zh: 绘图对象把颜色选择交给调色板时，导师演示了「对象委派」。

words.enDefinition: a network of objects connected by references

examples.en: The object graph showed a reading list linked to its books and their shared formatter.
examples.zh: 「对象图」展示了阅读清单与书籍及其共用格式化对象之间的连接。

examples.en: Our tutor traced the object graph to find which objects shared the same example palette.
examples.zh: 导师沿着「对象图」查找哪些对象共用同一个示例调色板。

words.enDefinition: the property of being the very same individual object

examples.en: The tutor used Python's is operator to check object identity for two names in the demonstration.
examples.zh: 导师用 Python 的 is 运算符检查演示中两个名称所指对象的「对象同一性」。

examples.en: We examined object identity after both names were made to refer to the same example list.
examples.zh: 两个名称都指向同一个示例列表后，我们考察了「对象同一性」。

words.enDefinition: the stages from an object's creation through use to its disposal

examples.en: The object lifecycle diagram showed when the classroom drawing tool created and released each shape.
examples.zh: 「对象生命周期」图说明课堂绘图工具何时创建和释放各个图形。

examples.en: Our tutor divided the object lifecycle into creation, use, and cleanup for the example.
examples.zh: 导师把示例的「对象生命周期」分为创建、使用和清理三个阶段。

collocations: a stage of an object's lifecycle

words.enDefinition: organising a program around objects that hold data and provide behaviour

examples.en: Our course introduced object-oriented programming through a small drawing app with several shape classes.
examples.zh: 课程通过一个包含几种图形类的小绘图应用介绍了「面向对象编程」。

examples.en: The tutor used object-oriented programming to keep each game piece's position with its movement rules.
examples.zh: 导师用「面向对象编程」把每个游戏棋子的当前位置和移动规则放在一起。

words.enDefinition: a value or connection that points to a particular object

examples.en: The Python diagram showed an object reference from each name to the same shared object.
examples.zh: Python 图演示了每个名称都通过「对象引用」指向同一个共享对象。

examples.en: Our exercise copied an object reference, so both variables could still reach the same object.
examples.zh: 练习复制了一个「对象引用」，所以两个变量仍能访问同一个对象。

words.enDefinition: the current values and relationships held by an object

examples.en: Our drawing exercise printed the object state before and after moving the sample rectangle.
examples.zh: 绘图练习在移动样本矩形之前和之后分别打印了「对象状态」。

examples.en: The tutor asked which part of the object state changed after a book was returned.
examples.zh: 导师问，还书后「对象状态」中的哪部分发生了变化。

words.enDefinition: an observable effect beyond returning a result, such as writing output or changing shared state

examples.en: Writing a row to the file was an observable side effect of calling the example function.
examples.zh: 调用示例函数会向文件写一行，这是一个「可观察的副作用」。

examples.en: The test checked for an observable side effect by comparing the shared list before and after the call.
examples.zh: 测试通过对比调用前后的共享列表，检查是否有「可观察的副作用」。

words.zhGloss: 样本中实际出现的类别
words.enDefinition: the category labels that occur in the selected observations, excluding defined labels with no recorded occurrences
acceptedZhAnswers: 样本中实际出现的类别

examples.en: The observed categories did not include the last option, although it appeared on every printed survey form.
examples.zh: 尽管每张纸质问卷都有最后一个选项，「样本中实际出现的类别」并不包含它。

examples.en: We checked which observed categories changed when the report filtered the data to show morning sessions only.
examples.zh: 我们检查只保留上午活动时，「样本中实际出现的类别」发生了哪些变化。

words.enDefinition: a design notifying interested objects when another object changes

examples.en: The observer pattern updated both classroom displays after the sample score changed in the game.
examples.zh: 游戏样本的分数改变后，「观察者模式」更新了两个课堂显示组件。

examples.en: Our tutor drew the observer pattern to show which objects received the update message.
examples.zh: 导师画出「观察者模式」，说明哪些对象收到了更新消息。

collocations: objects notified through the observer pattern

words.enDefinition: base-eight representation using the digits zero through seven

examples.en: Our tutor grouped the binary digits in threes to illustrate conversion to octal notation.
examples.zh: 导师把二进制数字每三位分成一组，展示如何转为「八进制记数法」。

examples.en: The exercise displayed a small number in octal notation next to its original decimal representation.
examples.zh: 练习把一个小数字按「八进制记数法」列在它原来的十进制表示旁。

collocations: write a value in octal notation
express a number in octal notation

words.enDefinition: a mistake in which a boundary, count or index is one above or below the intended value

examples.en: An off-by-one error let the program try to read one position past the last recorded result.
examples.zh: 一处「差一错误」让程序尝试读取最后一个记录结果之后的位置。

examples.en: We found the off-by-one error after the report counted the opening day twice in its total.
examples.zh: 报告把开放首日计入总数两次后，我们找到了这处「差一错误」。

words.enDefinition: a SQL clause specifying how many leading rows to skip before returning results

examples.en: The OFFSET clause skipped the first ten records from the sorted result for the worksheet preview.
examples.zh: 练习表预览使用「OFFSET 跳行子句」跳过排序结果的前十条记录。

examples.en: We used a separate OFFSET clause when comparing the first and second pages of example data.
examples.zh: 比较示例数据第一页和第二页时，我们使用不同值的「OFFSET 跳行子句」。

collocations: set the number in an OFFSET clause
apply an OFFSET clause after sorting

words.enDefinition: A numbering convention in which the first element has index one.

examples.en: The MATLAB example used one-based indexing, so index one referred to the first recorded value.
examples.zh: MATLAB 示例采用「从一开始的索引」，因此索引一指向第一个记录值。

examples.en: We checked the language's one-based indexing convention before changing the row access in our exercise.
examples.zh: 在修改练习里读取表格行的代码前，我们先核对了该语言「从一开始的索引」规则。

collocations: compare one-based indexing with zero-based indexing

words.enDefinition: an association in which one record on the single side may correspond to many records on the other side

examples.en: A one-to-many relationship connected one department with the multiple workshops shown in the course listing.
examples.zh: 「一对多关系」把一个院系和课程清单所列的多场工作坊联系起来。

examples.en: We drew a one-to-many relationship from the book table to the records of its separate borrowing events.
examples.zh: 我们画了「一对多关系」，把图书表和同一本书的多次借阅记录关联起来。

words.enDefinition: an association that allows at most one counterpart for each record on either side

examples.en: We represented a one-to-one relationship between a locker and the one student currently assigned to it.
examples.zh: 我们用「一对一关系」表示储物柜与当前获分配该柜的一名学生之间的关联。

examples.en: The example used a one-to-one relationship so no two case records pointed to the same optional detail row.
examples.zh: 示例使用「一对一关系」，使两条案例记录不会同时指向同一个可选明细行。

words.enDefinition: The elapsed time for data to travel from the sender to the receiver in one direction.

examples.en: The graph shows one-way delay from the example sender to the receiver without the return leg.
examples.zh: 图表显示示例数据从发送方到接收方的「单向时延」，省去了返回过程。

examples.en: The class recorded one-way delay separately for each direction because the two paths were different.
examples.zh: 由于两个方向使用的路径不同，全班分别记录了各自的「单向时延」。

words.enDefinition: Resolving collisions by checking alternative positions within the table itself for insertion or lookup.

examples.en: The example used open addressing and looked for another slot when the first one was occupied.
examples.zh: 示例采用「开放寻址法」，第一个位置已被占用时就找另一个位置。

examples.en: Our tutor drew arrows across the array to explain how open addressing chose alternative positions.
examples.zh: 老师在数组上画出跨越各位置的箭头，说明「开放寻址法」怎样选备用位置。

collocations: find an empty slot with open addressing

words.enDefinition: the principle of designing components so supported new behaviour can be added through extension without modifying their established implementations

examples.en: The tutor applied the open-closed principle when adding a new shape through the existing interface.
examples.zh: 导师通过现有接口添加新图形，运用了「开闭原则」。

examples.en: Our worksheet used the open-closed principle to add another format while keeping the display class unchanged.
examples.zh: 练习表运用「开闭原则」添加另一种格式，同时保持显示类不变。

collocations: a design illustrating the open-closed principle

words.enDefinition: the property that an optimal solution can be built using optimal solutions to relevant subproblems

examples.en: The tutor used optimal substructure to combine shorter optimal routes into a solution.
examples.zh: 导师利用「最优子结构」把较短区段的最优路线组合成解。

examples.en: We checked for optimal substructure before choosing an approach for the scheduling task.
examples.zh: 选择排程任务的解决办法前，我们检查它是否有「最优子结构」。

words.enDefinition: a parameter for which a caller is allowed to omit the corresponding argument

examples.en: An optional parameter let us include the building address when the schedule needed more detail.
examples.zh: 日程表需要更多细节时，可通过一个「可选形参」纳入建筑地址。

examples.en: We made the frame colour an optional parameter because most callers used the same colour.
examples.zh: 我们把边框颜色设成「可选形参」，因为大部分调用方都用同一种颜色。

collocations: read the default for an optional parameter

words.enDefinition: a pattern that succeeds when any of its component patterns matches

examples.en: The OR pattern let the same branch handle records that contained either of two approved labels.
examples.zh: 「或模式」让同一个分支处理含有两个准许标签之一的记录。

examples.en: We combined the two literal alternatives into one OR pattern before rerunning the class exercise.
examples.zh: 再次运行课堂练习前，我们把两个字面量选项合成一个「或模式」。

collocations: combine alternatives in an OR pattern

words.enDefinition: the SQL clause specifying how rows of a query result should be sorted

examples.en: The ORDER BY clause placed the most recent additions first in the sample list of borrowed books.
examples.zh: 「ORDER BY 排序子句」把借书示例列表中最近添加的记录排在前面。

examples.en: We added an explicit ORDER BY clause before comparing the order of results across two runs.
examples.zh: 比较两次查询的结果顺序之前，我们先加了明确的「ORDER BY 排序子句」。

collocations: sort results with an ORDER BY clause
list multiple expressions in an ORDER BY clause

words.enDefinition: data whose values are categories with a defined order, without assuming equal intervals between categories

examples.en: The survey stored response options as ordered categorical data to keep low, medium and high in order.
examples.zh: 问卷将选项存为「有序类别数据」，使低、中、高保持正确顺序。

examples.en: The tutor sorted the ordered categorical data before printing the table of responses for each training session.
examples.zh: 导师先对「有序类别数据」排序，再打印每场培训的答复表。

collocations: define the levels of ordered categorical data

words.enDefinition: The server capable of providing the authoritative response for a particular resource.

examples.en: The origin server provides the original catalogue response in the classroom diagram of cached copies.
examples.zh: 在课堂的缓存副本示意图中，「源服务器」提供最初的目录响应。

examples.en: In this example, the origin server supplies the new stylesheet after the design team changes it.
examples.zh: 在这个例子里，设计组改了样式表后，由「源服务器」提供新版。

words.enDefinition: The number of directed edges leaving a specified vertex

examples.en: The last task had an out-degree of zero in our diagram.
examples.zh: 图中最后一个任务顶点的「出度」为零。

examples.en: I counted the arrows leaving each point to find its out-degree.
examples.zh: 我数了从各点发出的箭头，求出各自的「出度」。

words.enDefinition: a performance estimate obtained from ensemble members that left each evaluated observation out of their bootstrap sample

examples.en: The model report listed an out-of-bag score for the forest fitted to the sample leaf measurements.
examples.zh: 模型报告列出了根据示例叶片测量值拟合的森林的「袋外得分」。

examples.en: We compared the out-of-bag score with performance on a separate set of examples from another garden.
examples.zh: 我们把「袋外得分」与模型在另一个花园的独立样本集上的表现作了比较。

collocations: compare the out-of-bag score with held-out performance

words.enDefinition: Predictions for each example made by a model fitted without that example's validation fold.

examples.en: We collected out-of-fold predictions so each leaf's predicted label came from a fit that excluded it.
examples.zh: 我们收集了「折外预测」，使每片叶子的预测标签都由未用到它的拟合模型给出。

examples.en: Our tutor compared the out-of-fold predictions with the fitted model's predictions on all training examples.
examples.zh: 老师把「折外预测」与拟合模型在全部训练样本上的预测作了比较。

collocations: inspect out-of-fold predictions for individual examples

words.enDefinition: The arrival of transport units in a different sequence from the one in which they were sent.

examples.en: The simulator shows out-of-order arrival when the later segment reaches the receiver ahead of the earlier one.
examples.zh: 后发的报文段比先发的先到接收方时，模拟器显示了「乱序到达」。

examples.en: The class discussed why out-of-order arrival of TCP segments need not change the application's byte order.
examples.zh: 课堂讨论了为什么 TCP 报文段「乱序到达」未必改变应用收到的字节顺序。

words.enDefinition: Prediction error on observations that were not used to fit the model.

examples.en: We estimated out-of-sample error by testing the time predictor on a fresh set of workshop records.
examples.zh: 我们用一组新的工作坊记录测试用时预测模型，以估计「样本外误差」。

examples.en: The tutor compared the out-of-sample error with the error the model recorded during training.
examples.zh: 老师比较了「样本外误差」与模型在训练期间记录的误差。

collocations: report out-of-sample error on held-out data

words.enDefinition: the loop containing another loop within its body

examples.en: The outer loop selected a worksheet while the inner code read the rows belonging to that sheet.
examples.zh: 「外层循环」选择工作表，内层代码则读取所选表中的行。

examples.en: We moved the row total into the outer loop so each department would get a separate result.
examples.zh: 我们把行合计移入「外层循环」，让每个部门得到独立的结果。

collocations: break out of the outer loop

words.enDefinition: a stored indicator identifying an observation for review because it was unusually far from other values

examples.en: The outlier flag marked a reading for review without removing the observation from the original data table.
examples.zh: 「异常值标记」指出一条读数需要复查，但原始数据表仍保留该观测结果。

examples.en: We checked the outlier flag against the source form before interpreting the unusually high temperature.
examples.zh: 解读异常偏高的温度前，我们对照原表核对了「异常值标记」。

collocations: clear an outlier flag after checking

words.enDefinition: looking for unusually distant observations using predefined rules or visual inspection before deciding how to treat them

examples.en: The outlier screening identified one extremely long wait, which the supervisor confirmed had actually occurred.
examples.zh: 「异常值筛查」发现一次异常漫长的等待，主管核实这次等待确实发生过。

examples.en: We performed outlier screening to find measurements that needed a closer check against the original records.
examples.zh: 我们做了「异常值筛查」，找出需要和原始记录进一步核对的测量值。

words.enDefinition: Temporary storage holding output data before it is sent onward

examples.en: The message stayed in the output buffer until the example sent it onward.
examples.zh: 示例把消息传出去前，消息留在「输出缓冲区」里。

examples.en: Our tutor used the output buffer diagram to explain the delayed display.
examples.zh: 导师用「输出缓冲区」示意图解释了为什么会延迟显示。

words.enDefinition: A file created or updated to hold a program's results

examples.en: The program put the calculated totals in an output file for class.
examples.zh: 程序把算出的合计值放在课上要用的「输出文件」里。

examples.en: I reopened the output file after the run to check its headings.
examples.zh: 运行后，我重新打开「输出文件」来核对标题。

words.enDefinition: Learning details specific to the training data that do not transfer well to unseen examples.

examples.en: The team suspected overfitting because the model predicted familiar leaves well but struggled with new ones.
examples.zh: 模型很擅长预测熟悉的叶片，却难以判断新叶片，因此团队怀疑存在「过拟合」。

examples.en: Our tutor compared scores on training and validation examples when discussing possible overfitting in the experiment.
examples.zh: 老师讨论实验中可能的「过拟合」时，比较了训练样本和验证样本上的得分。

words.enDefinition: Smaller problems that recur when solving different parts of a task

examples.en: The diagram highlighted overlapping subproblems that appeared on more than one branch.
examples.zh: 图中标出了在不止一条分支上出现的「重叠子问题」。

examples.en: We recognised overlapping subproblems when two choices led to the same smaller task.
examples.zh: 两个不同选择通向同一个较小任务时，我们认出了「重叠子问题」。

words.enDefinition: The obscuring of data patterns when many marks overlap in the same region of a chart.

examples.en: Overplotting makes the dense cluster of repeated plant heights look like just a few points.
examples.zh: 由于「数据点重叠」，大量重复的株高看起来只有几个点。

examples.en: The class found overplotting where several days had the same rainfall and temperature readings.
examples.zh: 全班发现有几天的降雨量与温度读数相同，出现了「数据点重叠」。

words.enDefinition: To replace the value stored at a position without inserting a new position.

examples.en: We needed to overwrite an element when the lab corrected a temperature already stored in the array.
examples.zh: 实验课要更正数组里已有的一个温度值时，我们需要「覆盖原有元素」。

examples.en: The program could overwrite an element without changing the number of entries in the working list.
examples.zh: 程序可以「覆盖原有元素」，同时保持工作列表的条目数不变。

collocations: overwrite an element in an array
overwrite an element at a specified index
overwrite an element without changing the length

words.enDefinition: in a regular Python package, the file whose top-level code can run when that package is first imported

examples.en: Python loaded the package initializer before the example script accessed a function from one of its modules.
examples.zh: Python 先加载「包初始化文件」，示例脚本才访问包内某个模块中的函数。

examples.en: We kept the package initializer small so loading the package did not perform unrelated work.
examples.zh: 我们让「包初始化文件」保持简洁，避免加载包时做无关的工作。

words.enDefinition: Java access limited to declarations within the same package

examples.en: Our Java worksheet used package-private access for a helper shared by classes in one package.
examples.zh: Java 练习表给同一个包内供多个类共享的辅助方法设了「包级访问权限」。

examples.en: The tutor showed how moving a class to another package affected package-private access in the example.
examples.zh: 导师演示了把类移到另一个包后，示例中的「包级访问权限」有什么变化。

words.enDefinition: The control information at the beginning of a packet, such as addresses or protocol fields.

examples.en: Our lab handout highlights the destination address in the packet header with a blue box.
examples.zh: 实验讲义用蓝色方框标出了「数据包首部」里的目的地址。

examples.en: The packet header includes information the router needs even when it ignores the carried data.
examples.zh: 就算路由器不查看包内数据，「数据包首部」也含有所需信息。

words.enDefinition: The content carried in a packet apart from that packet's own header.

examples.en: In the diagram, the packet payload starts immediately after the last field of the header.
examples.zh: 图中「数据包有效载荷」紧接在首部最后一个字段之后。

examples.en: The packet payload carries a transport segment in the example on the first page.
examples.zh: 第一页的示例中，「数据包有效载荷」携带的是一个传输层报文段。

words.enDefinition: Memory used by an operating system to keep file data available in page-sized units.

examples.en: The second read was faster because the sample's file data was still in the page cache.
examples.zh: 第二次读取较快，因为样本文件数据仍在「页缓存」里。

examples.en: Our tutor pointed to the page cache when explaining why the storage device was idle.
examples.zh: 老师在解释存储设备为何空闲时，指向了图上的「页缓存」。

collocations: store file data in the page cache

words.enDefinition: The removal of a resident page from physical memory to free its storage.

examples.en: The trace recorded page eviction when the simulator made room for a more recently requested page.
examples.zh: 模拟器给较新请求的页腾出空间时，跟踪记录显示发生了「页面逐出」。

examples.en: Our tutor showed that page eviction affected which sample pages were currently kept in memory.
examples.zh: 老师展示了「页面逐出」如何影响当时留在内存中的样本页。

collocations: trigger page eviction in a memory simulator

words.enDefinition: an exception raised for a virtual memory access that cannot be handled directly with the current mapping or permissions

examples.en: The simulator reported a page fault when the program first touched a page that was not yet loaded.
examples.zh: 程序第一次访问尚未载入的页时，模拟器报告了「缺页异常」。

examples.en: Our tutor showed how a page fault could be handled before the original instruction resumed.
examples.zh: 老师演示了怎样处理「缺页异常」，再继续执行原指令。

collocations: resume execution after a page fault

words.enDefinition: A page-sized region of physical memory that can hold a virtual memory page.

examples.en: The simulator placed the first data page in an available page frame before reading its contents.
examples.zh: 模拟器在读取内容前，将第一个数据页放入空闲的「物理页框」。

examples.en: Our diagram showed a page frame and the virtual page currently stored inside it.
examples.zh: 图中展示了一个「物理页框」及当时存放在里面的虚拟页。

collocations: map a page to a page frame

words.enDefinition: Choosing a resident page to remove when physical memory is needed for another page.

examples.en: The simulation demonstrated page replacement after all the memory frames assigned to the example were occupied.
examples.zh: 分给例题的内存页框全部用完后，模拟演示了「页面置换」。

examples.en: We recorded the page replacement decisions as the program read another series of sample values.
examples.zh: 程序读取另一串样本值时，我们记录了「页面置换」的选择。

words.enDefinition: The number of bytes in a memory page.

examples.en: The simulation used a small page size so the example fit on one sheet of paper.
examples.zh: 模拟采用较小的「页大小」，让例题能放在一张纸上。

examples.en: We compared the page size in two diagrams before calculating how many pages the data occupied.
examples.zh: 计算数据占多少页之前，我们比较了两张图的「页大小」。

words.enDefinition: A structure that records virtual memory mappings and associated page information.

examples.en: The page table showed which virtual pages had corresponding storage in our classroom diagram.
examples.zh: 「页表」显示了课堂图示中的哪些虚拟页有相应的存储位置。

examples.en: We followed the page table when tracing how the simulator located the requested data.
examples.zh: 我们跟着「页表」追踪模拟器怎样找到所请求的数据。

collocations: store a mapping in the page table

words.enDefinition: A record in a page table describing a virtual page's mapping and related attributes.

examples.en: The worksheet used a page table entry to show where one virtual page was stored.
examples.zh: 练习表用一个「页表项」说明其中一个虚拟页存放在哪里。

examples.en: We checked the page table entry after the simulator placed the requested page in memory.
examples.zh: 模拟器把请求的页放入内存后，我们核查了「页表项」。

collocations: read the mapping in a page table entry

words.zhGloss: 按变量对删除缺失记录
words.enDefinition: excluding incomplete observations separately for each pair of variables involved in a calculation
acceptedZhAnswers: 按变量对删除缺失记录

examples.en: The pairwise deletion method used different numbers of records for two correlations shown in the results.
examples.zh: 结果中两组相关性用了不同数量的记录，这是因为采用了「按变量对删除缺失记录」。

examples.en: Our tutor checked the sample count for each estimate after the worksheet applied pairwise deletion.
examples.zh: 练习表采用「按变量对删除缺失记录」之后，导师核查了每个估计使用的样本数。

collocations: report sample counts after pairwise deletion
compare pairwise deletion with complete-case analysis

words.enDefinition: a one-dimensional pandas data object containing values and an associated index of labels

examples.en: We extracted a pandas Series containing daily attendance totals and checked its first three dates.
examples.zh: 我们提取一个包含每日出勤总数的「pandas 一维带标签数组」，核对了其中最早的三个日期。

examples.en: The tutor used a pandas Series to show that row labels could differ from numerical positions.
examples.zh: 导师用「pandas 一维带标签数组」说明行标签可以与数值位置不同。

words.enDefinition: Executing two or more tasks at the same time on separate processing resources.

examples.en: The worksheet showed parallel execution by placing two tasks on separate processor cores at the same time.
examples.zh: 练习表把两项任务同时放到不同处理器核心上，展示「并行执行」。

examples.en: Our example used parallel execution to process two independent sample images at the same time.
examples.zh: 例题采用「并行执行」，同时处理两张彼此独立的示例图片。

collocations: compare parallel execution on two cores

words.enDefinition: A file that supplies values used to configure a run of a program or analysis.

examples.en: The parameter file sets the date range for generating the classroom library attendance chart.
examples.zh: 「参数文件」设置生成课堂图书馆客流图的日期范围。

examples.en: We kept the analysis code unchanged and selected a different month in the parameter file.
examples.zh: 我们在「参数文件」中改选另一个月份，沿用同一份分析代码。

words.enDefinition: a constructor with parameters for values supplied during object creation

examples.en: The sample class used a parameterized constructor to receive the title and starting page number.
examples.zh: 样本类用「带参构造方法」接收标题和起始页码。

examples.en: Our tutor asked which values the parameterized constructor needed to create the example rectangle.
examples.zh: 导师问，用「带参构造方法」创建示例矩形时需要哪些值。

words.enDefinition: One test definition executed with several separate sets of parameters

examples.en: The parameterized test used three temperatures with corresponding results for each case.
examples.zh: 「参数化测试」使用三个温度，每种情况都有对应结果。

examples.en: We replaced repeated checks with one parameterized test for our classroom converter.
examples.zh: 我们用一个「参数化测试」替换了课堂换算器里的重复检查。

words.enDefinition: A tree node one level above and directly linked to another

examples.en: We moved back to the parent node after finishing the left branch.
examples.zh: 走完左分支之后，我们回到了「父节点」。

examples.en: The diagram showed a parent node above two nodes at the same level.
examples.zh: 图上，同一层的两个节点上方有一个「父节点」。

collocations: a parent node with two children

words.enDefinition: A process that creates another process.

examples.en: The parent process started a second program to convert the photographs used in our classroom exercise.
examples.zh: 「父进程」启动了另一个程序，转换课堂练习中使用的照片。

examples.en: We checked whether the parent process waited for both image conversions before showing the summary.
examples.zh: 我们核查「父进程」是否等两项图像转换完成后才显示摘要。

collocations: the parent process starts a child

words.enDefinition: to interpret a textual or raw time representation as a date and time value

examples.en: We could parse a timestamp only after confirming whether the source used day before month.
examples.zh: 我们确认原数据是否把日在月前，才可以「解析时间戳」。

examples.en: The worksheet showed how to parse a timestamp and keep the offset supplied with the reading.
examples.zh: 练习表演示怎样「解析时间戳」并保留读数附带的时区偏移。

collocations: parse a timestamp using a format
parse a timestamp with an offset

words.enDefinition: A program component that analyses input according to its grammatical structure

examples.en: The parser noticed that I had forgotten to close the parentheses.
examples.zh: 「语法分析器」发现我忘了补上右括号。

examples.en: Our tutor explained which part of the interpreter acted as a parser.
examples.zh: 导师解释了解释器的哪个部分充当「语法分析器」。

words.enDefinition: a failure to interpret input according to its expected grammar or data format

examples.en: The parsing error pointed to a line in the sample file with one more field than expected.
examples.zh: 「解析错误」指向示例文件中比预期多出一个字段的那一行。

examples.en: We logged the parsing error with its original record before checking whether the format had changed.
examples.zh: 我们记录「解析错误」及其原始记录，再检查格式是否改变。

collocations: handle a parsing error during import

words.enDefinition: The guarantee of correct results if the algorithm eventually stops

examples.en: We checked partial correctness before asking whether the algorithm always finished.
examples.zh: 我们先检查「部分正确性」，再问算法是否一定能结束。

examples.en: The worksheet separated partial correctness from the argument that execution eventually ends.
examples.zh: 练习表把「部分正确性」与执行最终会结束的论证分开列出。

words.enDefinition: a functional dependency in which an attribute depends on a proper subset of the stated determinant

examples.en: The partial dependency existed because the instructor's name depended on the instructor identifier alone within the composite key.
examples.zh: 教师姓名只依赖复合键中的教师标识符，因此存在「部分函数依赖」。

examples.en: We removed the partial dependency by putting course descriptions in a table keyed by course identifier.
examples.zh: 我们把课程描述放进以课程标识符为键的表，消除了「部分函数依赖」。

collocations: a partial dependency on a composite key

words.enDefinition: A write that accepts only some of the bytes the caller asked it to transfer.

examples.en: The simulator reported a partial write when its practice device accepted only the first four bytes.
examples.zh: 模拟器的练习设备只接收了前四个字节，因此报告了一次「部分写入」。

examples.en: Our worksheet used a partial write to show why the returned byte count mattered.
examples.zh: 练习表用「部分写入」说明为什么返回的字节数很重要。

words.enDefinition: A stage separating items into groups according to a chosen criterion

examples.en: The partitioning step placed smaller keys together in the quicksort example.
examples.zh: 快速排序示例中的「划分步骤」把较小的键放到一组。

examples.en: We recorded both groups after completing the partitioning step on the worksheet.
examples.zh: 完成练习表上的「划分步骤」后，我们记录了两组数据。

words.enDefinition: the third number of a semantic version, increased for backward-compatible bug fixes in a normal release

examples.en: The exercise increased the patch version after correcting the reported label display.
examples.zh: 练习修正了报告中的标签显示问题后，提高了「修订版本号」。

examples.en: I identified the patch version before comparing the package with its earlier build.
examples.zh: 我先找出「修订版本号」，再把该软件包与之前的构建版本比较。

words.enDefinition: The sum of the edge weights along a chosen path

examples.en: The path cost increased after we added a slower section to the route.
examples.zh: 我们给路线加了一段速度较慢的路后，「路径代价」增加了。

examples.en: Our tutor checked the path cost by adding the numbers on each edge.
examples.zh: 导师把路径上各边的数字相加，核对了「路径代价」。

words.enDefinition: The number of edges along a path in an unweighted graph
