examples.en: I counted three edges to find the path length in our maze.
examples.zh: 我在迷宫里数了三条边，得出「路径长度」。

examples.en: The path length changed after the exercise removed the shortest connection.
examples.zh: 练习移去最短的连接后，「路径长度」变了。

words.enDefinition: Recovering an ordered route from stored search results or links

examples.en: The exercise used path reconstruction after working out the distance to the exit.
examples.zh: 练习先计算到出口的距离，再做「路径重建」。

examples.en: We started path reconstruction at the destination and followed each link backwards.
examples.zh: 我们从目的地开始「路径重建」，沿各连接反向追踪。

collocations: use predecessor links for path reconstruction

words.enDefinition: an extra condition checked after a pattern matches to determine whether its branch runs

examples.en: The pattern guard checked that the captured width was positive before running the matching case.
examples.zh: 「模式守卫」先检查捕获的宽度是否大于零，再决定是否执行匹配分支。

examples.en: We wrote a pattern guard to accept paired coordinates only when they described a point inside the page.
examples.zh: 我们写了一个「模式守卫」，只接收表示页面内位置的坐标对。

words.enDefinition: in Python, checking a value against a described structure and optionally binding its components to names

examples.en: The Python example used pattern matching to unpack a coordinate only when it had two elements.
examples.zh: 这个 Python 示例用「模式匹配」，只在坐标包含两个元素时才解包。

examples.en: We used pattern matching to select different code for rectangles and circles in the drawing exercise.
examples.zh: 我们在绘图练习里用「模式匹配」为矩形与圆形选择不同代码。

collocations: apply pattern matching to a value

words.enDefinition: To inspect the top item of a stack without removing it.

examples.en: Our code could peek at the top before deciding whether to remove the latest colour.
examples.zh: 代码可以先「查看栈顶元素」，再决定是否移除最后加入的颜色。

examples.en: The exercise asked us to peek at the top and record the size before and after.
examples.zh: 练习让我们「查看栈顶元素」，并记录查看前后的栈大小。

collocations: peek at the top before removing an item
peek at the top of a stack
peek at the top without changing the stack

words.enDefinition: the proportion of expected data positions with no recorded value, expressed as a percentage

examples.en: The percentage missing was highest for the optional comments field on the workshop evaluation forms.
examples.zh: 工作坊评价表中，选填的备注字段「缺失比例」最高。

examples.en: We calculated the percentage missing for each group using its own number of expected answers.
examples.zh: 我们分别用各组应有的答复数，计算各组的「缺失比例」。

collocations: compare the percentage missing across columns

words.enDefinition: A binary tree with two children per internal node and equally deep leaves

examples.en: Every leaf in the perfect binary tree appeared on the same bottom level.
examples.zh: 「完美二叉树」的所有叶节点都在最底下的同一层。

examples.en: We drew a perfect binary tree with all available positions completely filled.
examples.zh: 我们画了一棵填满所有可用位置的「完美二叉树」。

collocations: levels of a perfect binary tree

words.enDefinition: the defined labels a categorical field is allowed to contain

examples.en: The list of permitted categories contained one entry for each location used in the study.
examples.zh: 「允许的类别」清单为研究用到的每个地点各设一个条目。

examples.en: We compared the submitted labels with the permitted categories before reporting the number of invalid entries.
examples.zh: 报告无效条目的数量前，我们将已提交的标签与「允许的类别」作了比较。

words.enDefinition: A connection kept open so that multiple exchanges can take place without opening a new one each time.

examples.en: The browser uses a persistent connection to request the next page in our classroom example.
examples.zh: 在课堂示例中，浏览器使用「持久连接」请求下一页。

examples.en: The tutor drew one persistent connection beneath several requests for catalogue pages and stylesheets.
examples.zh: 老师在几条目录页面和样式表请求的下方画出一条「持久连接」。

words.enDefinition: A stable reference assigned to a digital object so that it can remain identifiable over time.

examples.en: The dataset has a persistent identifier that remains the same when its download page moves.
examples.zh: 该数据集有一个「持久标识符」，即使下载页面迁移也保持不变。

examples.en: We copied the persistent identifier from the citation to locate the exact teaching example.
examples.zh: 我们从引文复制「持久标识符」，以定位指定的教学示例。

words.enDefinition: Information about a person who is identified or could be identified.

examples.en: The fictional survey asks students to identify which fields would contain personal data in practice.
examples.zh: 虚构调查练习要求学生找出实际调查中哪些字段会含有「个人数据」。

examples.en: Our example release avoids personal data by showing only totals for the library branches.
examples.zh: 示例发布表只列各图书馆分馆的总量，避免包含「个人数据」。

words.enDefinition: a repeated predicate query seeing a changed set of qualifying rows because of another committed transaction

examples.en: A phantom read occurred when the second search found a reservation inserted and committed by another session.
examples.zh: 另一个会话插入并提交了一条预订，第二次搜索发现这条记录，出现了「幻读」。

examples.en: The tutor used a phantom read to illustrate why repeating the same filter could add a result row.
examples.zh: 导师用「幻读」说明为什么重复执行同一筛选可能多出一行。

collocations: distinguish a phantom read from an update to one row

words.enDefinition: An address identifying a location in the system's physical address space.

examples.en: The memory simulator displayed a physical address after translating the number used by the running program.
examples.zh: 内存模拟器转换正在运行的程序所用的数字后，显示了一个「物理地址」。

examples.en: Our worksheet traced the physical address of each access in the small memory example.
examples.zh: 练习表跟踪了小型内存例题中每次访问的「物理地址」。

words.enDefinition: A source line separated from the next by an actual newline

examples.en: The comment ended at the end of the first physical line in Python.
examples.zh: 在 Python 中，该注释到第一条「物理行」末尾就结束了。

examples.en: I moved part of the expression onto another physical line in the file.
examples.zh: 我把表达式的一部分移到文件中的另一条「物理行」上。

collocations: continue onto the next physical line

words.enDefinition: The actual working memory available to the processor, typically RAM.

examples.en: The diagram showed two programs using different regions of physical memory while running together.
examples.zh: 图中显示，两个程序同时运行时使用同一片「物理内存」中的不同区域。

examples.en: We checked available physical memory before loading the largest image in our lab exercise.
examples.zh: 在实验课载入最大的一张图片之前，我们核查了可用的「物理内存」。

words.enDefinition: A circular chart whose slices represent the shares that categories contribute to a whole.

examples.en: The pie chart shows how the sample library's total loans are divided among book categories.
examples.zh: 「饼图」展示示例图书馆的借阅总量在各类图书之间的分布。

examples.en: We labelled each slice of the pie chart with its percentage of the total.
examples.zh: 我们在「饼图」的每一块扇区上标出它占总量的百分比。

words.enDefinition: To specify an exact dependency version instead of allowing a choice among versions.

examples.en: We decided to pin a dependency because its latest version drew tick labels differently.
examples.zh: 我们决定「固定依赖版本」，因为这个依赖的最新版绘制刻度标签的方式不同。

examples.en: The tutorial shows when to pin a dependency in a project with shared analysis scripts.
examples.zh: 教程展示了在共享分析脚本的项目中何时「固定依赖版本」。

collocations: pin a dependency to a version
pin a dependency in the environment file

words.enDefinition: A chosen value used to separate items during a partition

examples.en: The pivot element was the middle value in our first sorting example.
examples.zh: 我们的第一个排序示例用中间的值作为「枢轴元素」。

examples.en: I checked which items were smaller than the pivot element on the board.
examples.zh: 我在白板上检查了哪些项比「枢轴元素」小。

words.enDefinition: to move multiple columns into rows, using new fields for the original column labels and their values

examples.en: We used tidyr to pivot longer because monthly readings were originally stored in twelve separate columns.
examples.zh: 原来的月度读数分开存于十二列，因此我们用 tidyr「转为更长的表」。

examples.en: The instructor chose to pivot longer and keep the former column headings in a new category field.
examples.zh: 讲师决定「转为更长的表」，将原来的列标题存入新建的类别字段。

collocations: choose labels when you pivot longer

words.enDefinition: a table summarising values by categories arranged along one or both axes

examples.en: The pivot table showed total reservations for each room and weekday in the practice calendar.
examples.zh: 「数据透视表」按房间和星期几显示练习日历上的预订总数。

examples.en: We changed the pivot table to display average attendance instead of totals for the different event types.
examples.zh: 我们更改了「数据透视表」，按活动类型显示平均出勤人数，替换原先的合计。

collocations: choose a summary function for a pivot table

words.enDefinition: to turn categories stored across rows into separate columns associated with the same observation keys

examples.en: The tidyr tutorial asked us to pivot wider so each test date appeared as a column.
examples.zh: tidyr 教程要求我们「转为更宽的表」，让各测试日期分别占一列。

examples.en: We could pivot wider only after deciding what to do with repeated measures for the same date.
examples.zh: 我们先决定怎样处理同一日期的重复测量，才可以「转为更宽的表」。

words.enDefinition: checking whether data are credible in context even if they meet the required technical format

examples.en: The plausibility check flagged a negative duration even though the database had accepted it as numeric.
examples.zh: 尽管数据库把负时长当作数字接受了，「合理性检查」还是标出了它。

examples.en: We added a plausibility check for return dates that came before the corresponding loan dates.
examples.zh: 我们增加了「合理性检查」，找出早于对应借出日期的归还日期。

words.enDefinition: The region of a chart where the data marks are drawn.

examples.en: The note sits above the plot area and leaves the data points easy to see.
examples.zh: 注释放在「绘图区」上方，数据点依然清楚可见。

examples.en: We widened the plot area to make more room for the weekly data on the right.
examples.zh: 我们加宽了「绘图区」，给右侧的周数据留出更多空间。

words.enDefinition: The degree to which a plotted point blocks what is behind it.

examples.en: Lower point opacity lets overlapping marks darken where the classroom observations are most concentrated.
examples.zh: 降低「点的不透明度」后，课堂观测值较集中的位置会由于标记重叠而显得更深。

examples.en: We adjusted point opacity so the pale gridlines stayed visible through the printed marks.
examples.zh: 我们调整了「点的不透明度」，使印出的标记下仍能看见浅色网格线。

words.enDefinition: To repeatedly check whether an input source has data or an event available.

examples.en: The practice program had to poll for input while waiting for the next simulated keystroke.
examples.zh: 练习程序等待下一次模拟按键时，需要「轮询输入」。

examples.en: Our example chose to poll for input every few moments and then update the display.
examples.zh: 例题每隔片刻就「轮询输入」，接着更新显示内容。

collocations: poll for input from a device
check how often to poll for input

words.enDefinition: using a common operation with objects that provide different behaviour

examples.en: The drawing app used polymorphism to call the same operation for circles and rectangles.
examples.zh: 绘图应用利用「多态」对圆形和矩形调用同一个操作。

examples.en: Our tutor explained polymorphism after the two example shapes responded differently to the same request.
examples.zh: 两种示例图形对同一个请求作出不同行为后，导师解释了「多态」。

words.enDefinition: To remove the top item from a stack and usually return it.

examples.en: Each time we pop from a stack in the example, its top card is removed.
examples.zh: 在例题中每次「从栈中弹出」时，取出的都是栈顶卡片。

examples.en: Our worksheet asked which card would be removed first if we chose to pop from a stack.
examples.zh: 练习表问，如果选择「从栈中弹出」，最先被移除的是哪张卡片。

collocations: pop from a stack after checking it
decide when to pop from a stack

words.enDefinition: To remove the last item from a collection that permits removal at that end.

examples.en: The most recent card was at the back, so we chose to pop from the back.
examples.zh: 最后加入的卡片在队尾，所以我们选择「从队尾弹出元素」。

examples.en: We could pop from the back of the deque without moving any of the other items.
examples.zh: 我们可以从双端队列的「队尾弹出元素」，其他各项都无需移动。

collocations: pop from the back of a deque
pop from the back after checking the size
decide when to pop from the back

words.enDefinition: selecting data by numerical row or column position rather than assigned labels

examples.en: We used position-based indexing to inspect the first two rows regardless of their date labels.
examples.zh: 我们用「按位置索引」查看前两行，无需关心它们的日期标签。

examples.en: The tutor explained position-based indexing after sorting moved the largest observation to a different row number.
examples.zh: 排序把最大观测值移到另一个行号后，导师讲解了「按位置索引」。

collocations: slice a table using position-based indexing

words.enDefinition: an argument matched to a parameter according to its position in the call

examples.en: The first positional argument supplied the starting date for the schedule generated by the example function.
examples.zh: 第一个「位置实参」给出了示例函数生成日程表所用的开始日期。

examples.en: We swapped two positional argument values and noticed that the meeting's start time changed in the output.
examples.zh: 我们调换两个「位置实参」的值后，发现输出里的会议开始时间改变了。

words.zhGloss: 仅限按位置传入的形参
words.enDefinition: a parameter that must be supplied by position and may not be named as a keyword argument
acceptedZhAnswers: 仅限按位置传入的形参

examples.en: The tutor marked the first input as a positional-only parameter so callers had to pass it by position.
examples.zh: 导师把第一个输入标为「仅限按位置传入的形参」，因此调用方必须按位置传入它。

examples.en: The example raised an error when we supplied the positional-only parameter by name instead of by position.
examples.zh: 我们尝试按名称传入「仅限按位置传入的形参」时，示例抛出了错误。

collocations: pass a value to a positional-only parameter

words.enDefinition: The category chosen as the event of interest in binary classification.

examples.en: The worksheet treated oak leaves as the positive class because those were the examples we wanted to find.
examples.zh: 练习表将橡树叶作为「正类」，因为它们是我们要找的样本。

examples.en: We had to state the positive class before explaining the errors made by our classifier.
examples.zh: 解释分类器的错误之前，我们必须先说明哪个类别是「正类」。

collocations: count examples in the positive class

words.enDefinition: A check that software performs its intended behaviour under valid conditions

examples.en: The positive test saved a booking whose date and location were valid.
examples.zh: 「正常输入测试」保存了一笔日期和地点都有效的预订。

examples.en: We added a positive test for a correctly formatted text record.
examples.zh: 我们为格式正确的一条文本记录加了「正常输入测试」。

collocations: a positive test for valid input

words.enDefinition: An HTTP request asking the server to process the supplied content according to the target resource's own rules.

examples.en: The teaching form sends a POST request with a fictional reading suggestion for the class catalogue.
examples.zh: 教学表单用「POST 请求」向课堂用的目录提交一条虚构的阅读推荐。

examples.en: We marked the POST request on the diagram to show which exchange processes the form data.
examples.zh: 我们在图上标出「POST 请求」，说明是哪一次交互在处理表单数据。

words.enDefinition: A tree traversal visiting child subtrees before the current node

examples.en: The postorder traversal processed the children before recording the parent's label.
examples.zh: 「后序遍历」先处理子节点，再记录父节点的标签。

examples.en: We used postorder traversal to add branch totals before computing the root value.
examples.zh: 我们用「后序遍历」先把分支合计相加，再计算根节点的值。

words.enDefinition: A version identified as preceding its corresponding final software release

examples.en: The pre-release version let us try the new layout before its final release.
examples.zh: 「预发行版本」让我们在最终发行前能先试用新版式。

examples.en: I used a pre-release version for the exercise while reporting its known limitations.
examples.zh: 我用「预发行版本」做练习，同时报告了已知限制。

words.enDefinition: loss of finer numerical distinctions during storage, conversion, or calculation

examples.en: The JavaScript worksheet showed precision loss after converting a sufficiently large BigInt into a Number.
examples.zh: JavaScript 练习表演示了把一个足够大的 BigInt 转为 Number 后的「精度损失」。

examples.en: Our tutor identified precision loss when two nearby results became identical in the storage format.
examples.zh: 两个相近结果在存储格式中变得相同时，导师确认发生了「精度损失」。

words.enDefinition: A plot showing precision and recall at different classification thresholds.

examples.en: The precision-recall curve showed what happened to precision when the classifier found more poetry books.
examples.zh: 「精确率—召回率曲线」展示了分类器找出更多诗歌书籍时精确率如何变化。

examples.en: We used the precision-recall curve to examine different thresholds for finding the rarer plant species.
examples.zh: 我们用「精确率—召回率曲线」考察检测较少见植物物种的不同阈值。

collocations: choose a point on the precision-recall curve

words.enDefinition: Among examples predicted as a given class, the proportion that actually belong to that class.

examples.en: The precision score fell because many books flagged as poetry were actually other kinds of writing.
examples.zh: 不少被标为诗歌的图书实际上是其他文体，因此「精确率」下降。

examples.en: Our tutor calculated the precision score using only the books the classifier had labelled as poetry.
examples.zh: 老师只用分类器标为诗歌的图书计算「精确率」。

collocations: compare a precision score with recall

words.enDefinition: a mapping recording a previous vertex for reached vertices other than the source where a path has been found

examples.en: The program updated the predecessor map after finding a shorter path to the exit.
examples.zh: 程序找到通往出口的更短路径后，更新了「前驱映射表」。

examples.en: We used the predecessor map to trace the route backwards to the source.
examples.zh: 我们用「前驱映射表」反向追踪这条路径，直到回到源顶点。

collocations: reconstruct a path using a predecessor map

words.enDefinition: The category a fitted classifier assigns to a particular example.

examples.en: The report listed the predicted class beside the librarian's label for each book in the exercise.
examples.zh: 报告把每本练习用书的「预测类别」列在馆员所给标签旁边。

examples.en: We checked the predicted class for a leaf whose shape resembled those of two species.
examples.zh: 我们检查了那片外形与两种植物叶片都相像的叶片的「预测类别」。

collocations: compare the predicted class with the true class

words.enDefinition: A model's estimate of how likely a specified class or event is for an example.

examples.en: The model assigned a predicted probability of eighty percent to the oak label for this leaf.
examples.zh: 模型预测这片叶子属于橡树叶的「预测概率」为百分之八十。

examples.en: Our group compared the predicted probability with the outcome observed for each group of similar cases.
examples.zh: 我们组把「预测概率」和每组相似样本中观察到的结果作了比较。

words.enDefinition: The observed numerical outcome minus the model's fitted value for that example.

examples.en: The prediction residual was positive because the sorting task took longer than the model had predicted.
examples.zh: 分拣任务实际用时比模型预测的长，所以「预测残差」为正。

examples.en: We inspected each prediction residual before deciding whether larger batches were systematically taking longer than predicted.
examples.zh: 在判断较大批次是不是普遍比预测用时更长之前，我们逐条检查了「预测残差」。

collocations: inspect prediction residuals for a pattern
compare the sign of each prediction residual

words.enDefinition: Scheduling in which the scheduler may pause a running task to let a different task run.

examples.en: With preemptive scheduling, the simulator could pause a long calculation and let a second task run.
examples.zh: 在「抢占式调度」下，模拟器可以暂停一段长运算，让第二项任务运行。

examples.en: Our tutor used a timeline to show when preemptive scheduling interrupted the task already on the processor.
examples.zh: 老师用时间线展示「抢占式调度」在什么时候会打断处理器上正在运行的任务。

collocations: illustrate preemptive scheduling on a timeline

words.enDefinition: The number of initial bits that make up an IP address prefix.

examples.en: In the worksheet, the prefix length tells us how many leading bits belong to the network prefix.
examples.zh: 在练习中，「前缀长度」说明开头有多少位属于网络前缀。

examples.en: We wrote the prefix length after the slash on each of the sample address blocks.
examples.zh: 我们把「前缀长度」写在每个示例地址块的斜杠后面。

words.enDefinition: A tree traversal visiting each node before its child subtrees

examples.en: The preorder traversal recorded the root label before the two branches below.
examples.zh: 「前序遍历」先记录根节点的标签，再记录下方的两个分支。

examples.en: We used preorder traversal to print the folder label before its contents.
examples.zh: 我们用「前序遍历」先打印文件夹标签，再打印里面的内容。

words.enDefinition: To add an item before the first item in a collection.

examples.en: The code needed to prepend an element so the heading would appear before the existing entries.
examples.zh: 代码需要「在开头添加元素」，这样标题就会出现在原有条目之前。

examples.en: Our tutor asked whether it was easier to prepend an element using a list with links.
examples.zh: 老师问，用带链接的列表「在开头添加元素」是否更方便。

collocations: prepend an element to a list
prepend an element at the front
prepend an element before existing entries

words.enDefinition: A pointer or reference that identifies a node's immediate predecessor.

examples.en: The previous pointer led towards the first node when students traced the sample list backwards.
examples.zh: 学生倒着追踪示例链表时，「前驱指针」指向靠近第一个节点的方向。

examples.en: We checked the previous pointer after inserting a card between two cards that were already linked.
examples.zh: 在已链接的两张卡片之间插入一张卡片后，我们核对了「前驱指针」。

collocations: update the previous pointer of the successor

words.enDefinition: Growing a spanning tree by repeatedly choosing its lightest edge to outside vertices

examples.en: Our tutor used Prim's algorithm to connect one new vertex at a time.
examples.zh: 导师用「普里姆算法」每次接入一个新顶点。

examples.en: We traced Prim's algorithm from a chosen starting vertex on the board.
examples.zh: 我们在白板上从选定的起点跟踪了「普里姆算法」。

collocations: an edge chosen by Prim's algorithm

words.enDefinition: the selected column or set of columns used to identify each row uniquely, with null values disallowed

examples.en: The primary key let our query refer to the correct loan even when two people had identical names.
examples.zh: 即使两个人同名，「主键」也让查询指向正确的借阅记录。

examples.en: We assigned each workshop a numeric primary key so changing its title would leave its identity unchanged.
examples.zh: 我们给每场工作坊分配一个数字「主键」，这样标题变了也不影响它的标识。

words.enDefinition: a value belonging to a language's basic non-object types

examples.en: Our JavaScript example treated the short label as a primitive value of the String type.
examples.zh: JavaScript 示例把短标签视为 String 类型的「原始值」。

examples.en: Students identified the primitive value in a JavaScript exercise that also contained two objects.
examples.zh: 在一个同时含有两个对象的 JavaScript 练习中，学生找出了「原始值」。

words.enDefinition: A linear transformation that finds orthogonal directions ordered by the variance they explain.

examples.en: We used principal component analysis to summarise several related leaf measurements before exploring the sample groups.
examples.zh: 探索样本分组前，我们用「主成分分析」概括几项相关的叶片测量值。

examples.en: The lab used principal component analysis to see how much variation the first two components captured.
examples.zh: 实验用「主成分分析」查看前两个成分能解释多少变异。

collocations: fit principal component analysis on training data
choose components for principal component analysis

words.enDefinition: The practice of considering and building in privacy protections from the start of a project or system.

examples.en: The privacy by design exercise asks students to consider confidentiality before building the example dashboard.
examples.zh: 「隐私保护融入设计」练习要求学生先考虑保密问题，再搭建示例仪表板。

examples.en: Our team discussed privacy by design while deciding what the classroom tool needed to collect.
examples.zh: 团队在决定课堂工具需要采集哪些信息时，讨论了「隐私保护融入设计」。

words.enDefinition: A review of how planned data handling or reporting could affect people's privacy.

examples.en: Our privacy risk assessment considers who can see the files at each stage of the exercise.
examples.zh: 我们的「隐私风险评估」会考虑在练习各阶段有哪些人能看到这些文件。

examples.en: The project team documented its privacy risk assessment before deciding how to publish the summaries.
examples.zh: 项目团队决定如何公布汇总信息前，记录了自己的「隐私风险评估」。

collocations: scope of a privacy risk assessment

words.enDefinition: a member with access restricted to its declaring class context

examples.en: The Java example exposed the title through a method while keeping its field a private member.
examples.zh: Java 示例通过方法提供标题，同时让保存标题的字段保持为「私有成员」。

examples.en: Our tutor identified the private member used by the class to remember its current position.
examples.zh: 导师指出，类用哪个「私有成员」保存当前位置。

collocations: read a private member within its class
a private member of a class

words.enDefinition: the alignment of predicted probabilities with observed event frequencies, or the process of improving that alignment

examples.en: We checked probability calibration by comparing the average predicted probability with the observed frequency within each group.
examples.zh: 我们比较了每组的平均预测概率与实际观测频率，以检查「概率校准」情况。

examples.en: Our tutor used probability calibration to discuss whether predictions of eighty percent were consistent with observed outcomes.
examples.zh: 老师用「概率校准」讨论预测概率为百分之八十的结果是否与实际情况一致。

collocations: check probability calibration on held-out data

words.enDefinition: The probability cutoff used to make a classification decision.

examples.en: We lowered the probability threshold and the classifier marked more pictures as containing oak leaves.
examples.zh: 我们调低「概率阈值」后，分类器把更多图片标为含有橡树叶。

examples.en: The tutor asked us to choose a probability threshold using the validation results from the exercise.
examples.zh: 老师要求我们根据练习的验证结果选择一个「概率阈值」。

collocations: compare results at different probability thresholds

words.enDefinition: A running instance of a program together with its execution state and resources.

examples.en: The task viewer showed a separate process when we opened another copy of the drawing app.
examples.zh: 我们又打开一份绘图应用时，任务查看器显示了一个单独的「进程」。

examples.en: Our example used one process for the editor and another for the image conversion tool.
examples.zh: 例题为编辑器使用一个「进程」，并给图像转换工具使用另一个。

words.enDefinition: A kernel record that stores management information and execution state for a process.

examples.en: The tutor drew a process control block next to each process in the scheduling example.
examples.zh: 老师在调度例题的每个进程旁画了一个「进程控制块」。

examples.en: We used the process control block to explain how the simulator remembered where a process stopped.
examples.zh: 我们用「进程控制块」解释模拟器怎样记住进程上次停在何处。

collocations: save state in a process control block

words.enDefinition: The operating system's work of setting up a new process and its resources.

examples.en: The lab traced process creation when the sample launcher opened a helper for each image.
examples.zh: 当示例启动器给每张图片打开一个辅助程序时，实验跟踪了「进程创建」。

examples.en: Our tutor explained why process creation involved setting up more than a new program counter.
examples.zh: 老师解释了为什么「进程创建」涉及的工作多于设置一个新的程序计数器。

collocations: measure the cost of process creation
observe process creation in a task viewer

words.enDefinition: A number the operating system uses to identify a particular active process.

examples.en: The monitor displayed a process identifier next to each copy of the sample text editor.
examples.zh: 监视器在示例文本编辑器的每个实例旁显示了「进程标识符」。

examples.en: We matched the process identifier from the log with the one shown in the task viewer.
examples.zh: 我们把日志中的「进程标识符」与任务查看器显示的标识对应起来。

words.enDefinition: The program code, data, and other memory contents associated with a process's current execution.

examples.en: The diagram showed code and data in different regions of the same process image.
examples.zh: 图中显示，代码和数据位于同一个「进程映像」的不同区域。

examples.en: Our tutor used a process image to explain what memory the program had while it ran.
examples.zh: 老师用「进程映像」说明程序运行时有哪些内存区域。

collocations: inspect the layout of a process image

words.enDefinition: An operating system component that selects runnable work for a CPU to execute.

examples.en: The process scheduler gave another task time to run while the first waited for input.
examples.zh: 第一项任务等待输入时，「进程调度器」让另一项任务占用 CPU 运行。

examples.en: Our simulator recorded which task the process scheduler selected each time a processor became available.
examples.zh: 每次处理器空闲时，模拟器都记录「进程调度器」选中了哪项任务。

collocations: decisions made by the process scheduler

words.enDefinition: a classification of a process in an operating system or teaching model, such as ready, running, waiting or terminated

examples.en: The simulator showed the process state changing when the image program began waiting for a file.
examples.zh: 图像程序开始等待文件时，模拟器显示「进程状态」发生变化。

examples.en: Our worksheet asked which process state applied after the task finished waiting for input.
examples.zh: 练习表问，任务结束对输入的等待后会进入哪种「进程状态」。

words.enDefinition: An operating system structure holding records about processes it is managing.

examples.en: The diagram showed a process table with a record for each job in the exercise.
examples.zh: 图中展示了一个「进程表」，练习中的每项作业各有一条记录。

examples.en: We located the editor's entry in the process table before checking the recorded process state.
examples.zh: 我们先在「进程表」找到编辑器的记录，再核查记载的进程状态。

collocations: look up a process in the process table
store an entry in the process table

words.enDefinition: The end of a process's execution, when the operating system can release associated resources.

examples.en: The trace recorded process termination after the preview helper had finished all three requested conversions.
examples.zh: 预览辅助程序完成所要求的三项转换后，跟踪记录记下了「进程终止」。

examples.en: We checked the time of process termination before comparing the two recordings of the classroom demonstration.
examples.zh: 我们先核对「进程终止」时间，再比较课堂演示的两份记录。

words.enDefinition: A design where one part creates items and another consumes them, usually through an intermediate buffer.

examples.en: The preview demo used the producer-consumer pattern to pass newly resized images to the display worker.
examples.zh: 预览演示用「生产者—消费者模式」把刚调好尺寸的图像交给显示工作线程。

examples.en: Our worksheet showed the producer-consumer pattern with one shared queue between the two sets of workers.
examples.zh: 练习表展示了两组工作线程通过一个共享队列连接的「生产者—消费者模式」。

collocations: explain the producer-consumer pattern with a queue

words.enDefinition: The time a signal takes to travel across the distance between two points on a link.

examples.en: The longer link has a higher propagation delay because the signal has farther to travel.
examples.zh: 信号要走更远的距离，因此较长链路的「传播时延」更高。

examples.en: Our diagram labels propagation delay separately from the time needed to send every bit.
examples.zh: 图中分别标出「传播时延」以及发送所有比特所需的时间。

words.enDefinition: A set contained in another set that has at least one additional element.

examples.en: The practice palette was a proper subset of the full palette because it lacked several colours.
examples.zh: 练习调色板是完整调色板的「真子集」，因为里面少了几种颜色。

examples.en: Our tutor asked why a set could never be a proper subset of itself.
examples.zh: 老师问，为什么一个集合永远不能成为它自己的「真子集」。

collocations: draw a proper subset on a diagram

words.enDefinition: Checking specified properties using many automatically generated inputs

examples.en: The lab used property-based testing to check whether sorting preserved the number of records.
examples.zh: 实验课用「基于性质的测试」检查排序后记录数是否保持不变。

examples.en: We introduced property-based testing after discussing which result properties should always hold.
examples.zh: 我们讨论了结果应始终满足哪些性质，再介绍「基于性质的测试」。

collocations: explore a property with property-based testing

words.enDefinition: a member accessible in specified class, subclass, or package contexts

examples.en: The Java example let the subclass use a protected member while setting up the sample object.
examples.zh: Java 示例允许子类在初始化样本对象时使用一个「受保护成员」。

examples.en: Our tutor compared two references to the protected member in different Java package contexts.
examples.zh: 导师比较了两个 Java 包环境中对同一个「受保护成员」的引用。

collocations: a protected member inherited by a subclass

words.enDefinition: the linked prototypes searched when resolving an object's property in JavaScript

examples.en: The JavaScript example found the drawing method farther up the object's prototype chain.
examples.zh: JavaScript 示例沿对象的「原型链」向上，在更远处找到了绘图方法。

examples.en: Our tutor sketched the prototype chain to show where the shared method was stored.
examples.zh: 导师画出「原型链」，说明共用方法存储在哪里。

collocations: an inherited method on the prototype chain

words.enDefinition: a design that creates new objects by copying an existing example

examples.en: The prototype pattern created a second border by copying the classroom example's configured border object.
examples.zh: 「原型模式」通过复制课堂示例中已配置的边框对象创建第二个边框。

examples.en: Our tutor compared the copied shape with its original in the prototype pattern exercise.
examples.zh: 导师在「原型模式」练习中比较了复制后的图形和原图形。

collocations: clone an object using the prototype pattern
an example of the prototype pattern

words.enDefinition: An individual entry that documents the origin, handling, or processing history of a data item.

examples.en: The provenance record lists the source file, download date, and translation of the column labels.
examples.zh: 「溯源记录」列出了源文件、下载日期和列标签的翻译。

examples.en: We created a provenance record for the survey table supplied by our fictional community group.
examples.zh: 我们为虚构社区小组提供的问卷表建立了一份「溯源记录」。

words.enDefinition: An informal description of program logic using code-like language

examples.en: We wrote pseudocode before opening the editor for the price exercise.
examples.zh: 我们为价格练习写了「伪代码」，然后才打开编辑器。

examples.en: The worksheet used pseudocode to describe the steps without a specific language.
examples.zh: 练习表用「伪代码」描述步骤，写法不受某门语言限制。

words.enDefinition: The replacement of identifiers with substitutes so linking records to a person requires separately held information.

examples.en: Our pseudonymisation example uses invented study codes and keeps the matching list in a separate worksheet.
examples.zh: 「假名化」示例用了虚构研究编号，并把对应清单保存在另一张工作表里。

examples.en: The report explains why pseudonymisation alone does not make the classroom records suitable for public release.
examples.zh: 报告解释了为何仅做「假名化」，还不足以让课堂记录适合公开。

words.enDefinition: a member declared publicly accessible under its language's rules

examples.en: The Java worksheet asked which public member a separate display class used to obtain the title.
examples.zh: Java 练习表问，另一个显示类使用哪个「公有成员」来获取标题。

examples.en: Our tutor checked whether the public member appeared in the available operations for the example.
examples.zh: 导师检查示例的可用操作里是否列出了该「公有成员」。

words.enDefinition: Data released for use by the general public, subject to any applicable terms of use.

examples.en: The class selected public-use data for the exercise so everyone could access the same records.
examples.zh: 全班为练习选了「公开使用数据」，方便每个人都能取得相同记录。

examples.en: The documentation for the public-use data explains how the example dataset differs from the original records.
examples.zh: 「公开使用数据」的文档解释示例数据集与原始记录之间的区别。

words.enDefinition: Fetch remote work and integrate it into the current branch

examples.en: Our tutor showed how to pull remote changes into the classroom's example branch.
examples.zh: 导师演示了怎样把远程端的工作「拉取并整合」进课堂示例分支。

examples.en: We agreed to pull remote changes after finishing the shared comparison in class.
examples.zh: 我们商定在课上完成共同比较后「拉取并整合远程改动」。

collocations: pull remote changes into a branch
pull remote changes before starting work

words.enDefinition: A proposal to merge a set of changes into another branch

examples.en: My pull request described how the new example handled repeated names.
examples.zh: 我的「拉取请求」说明了新示例怎样处理重复的姓名。

examples.en: The tutor left a note on the pull request before class ended.
examples.zh: 下课前，导师在「拉取请求」里留了条备注。

words.enDefinition: a function that produces the same result for the same inputs and has no observable side effects

examples.en: The pure function converted the temperatures without updating the list that the caller had passed into it.
examples.zh: 「纯函数」换算了温度，没有修改调用方传入的列表。

examples.en: We tested the pure function with the same measurements twice and received the same formatted result.
examples.zh: 我们用相同测量值对「纯函数」测试两次，得到同一格式化结果。

collocations: test a pure function in isolation
refactor a calculation into a pure function

words.enDefinition: The principle of using data only for specified purposes or compatible purposes that have been justified.

examples.en: The purpose limitation in our case study confines the data use to the agreed teaching exercise.
examples.zh: 案例里的「目的限制」规定，数据只用于约定的教学练习。

examples.en: The class discussed purpose limitation when a group suggested using survey responses for another project.
examples.zh: 有小组建议把问卷回答用于另一项项目时，全班讨论了「目的限制」。

words.enDefinition: Send a branch's commits to a remote and update its reference

examples.en: I wanted to push a branch containing the updated example for my partner.
examples.zh: 我想给同伴「推送分支」，里面有更新后的示例。

examples.en: The tutor showed where each group could push a branch for the exercise.
examples.zh: 导师指出了每个小组可以把练习代码的「分支推送」到哪里。

collocations: push a branch to a remote

words.enDefinition: To insert a new item at the front of a collection supporting that operation.

examples.en: The exercise let us push at the front so the new card became the first item.
examples.zh: 练习允许我们「在队列前端加入元素」，这样新卡片就成了第一项。

examples.en: Our tutor used a deque to show when we could push at the front.
examples.zh: 老师用双端队列演示什么时候可以「在队列前端加入元素」。

collocations: push at the front of a deque
push at the front of a container
choose when to push at the front

words.enDefinition: To insert an item at the top of a stack.

examples.en: The tutor showed us which end to use when we push onto a stack.
examples.zh: 老师演示了「压入栈」的时候应该用哪一端。

examples.en: We compared what happens when we push onto a stack with adding to a queue.
examples.zh: 我们比较了「压入栈」与加入队列时分别会发生什么。

collocations: push onto a stack after reading an item
push onto a stack in order
keep track of what you push onto a stack

words.enDefinition: the ordered locations Python consults when looking for importable modules

examples.en: The tutor checked the Python module search path because the interpreter could not locate the example package.
examples.zh: 解释器找不到示例包，导师检查了「Python 模块搜索路径」。

examples.en: We inspected the Python module search path to see which directory the interpreter searched before our project folder.
examples.zh: 我们查看了「Python 模块搜索路径」，了解解释器在查看项目文件夹之前先查哪个目录。

collocations: inspect the Python module search path
find a directory on the Python module search path
explain the Python module search path

words.enDefinition: A running cost proportional to the square of the input size

examples.en: Checking every pair of scores took quadratic time in the class example.
examples.zh: 在课堂示例中，检查每对分数需要「二次时间」。

examples.en: Our tutor used a square grid to illustrate how quadratic time grows.
examples.zh: 导师用方形网格说明「二次时间」下工作量如何增长。

words.enDefinition: a column reference naming its table or table alias along with the column

examples.en: A qualified column reference resolved the ambiguity between two columns both labelled title in the source tables.
examples.zh: 两个源表各有一列叫 title，「带表限定的列引用」消除了歧义。

examples.en: We used a qualified column reference to specify which of the joined tables supplied the recorded date.
examples.zh: 我们使用「带表限定的列引用」，说明记录日期来自联接的哪张表。

collocations: check the prefix of a qualified column reference

words.enDefinition: A named item in a URL's query component, commonly used as input to a web application.

examples.en: The year query parameter filters the catalogue exercise to books published in the chosen year.
examples.zh: 名为 year 的「查询参数」将目录练习的结果限定为所选年份出版的书。

examples.en: Our worksheet gives each query parameter its own column to distinguish the name from the value.
examples.zh: 练习纸为每个「查询参数」单独设一列，以区分参数的名称和值。

words.enDefinition: The query part of a URL, often used to carry parameters to a web application.

examples.en: The query string in our example holds the selected subject and year for the catalogue search.
examples.zh: 示例中的「查询字符串」保存了目录搜索选定的主题和年份。

examples.en: We changed the query string on paper while keeping the path of the sample URL unchanged.
examples.zh: 我们在纸上修改了「查询字符串」，同时保持示例 URL 的路径不变。

words.enDefinition: the number of items currently stored in a queue

examples.en: The simulator displayed the queue length so we could see how many cards were waiting.
examples.zh: 模拟器显示「队列长度」，让我们看到有多少张卡片在等待。

examples.en: We compared the queue length before and after the printer accepted the next example job.
examples.zh: 我们对比了打印机接收下一项示例作业前后的「队列长度」。

words.enDefinition: Trying to remove an item from a queue when it is empty.

examples.en: The exercise reported queue underflow after we tried to remove a card from an empty queue.
examples.zh: 我们尝试从空队列取出卡片后，练习报告了「队列下溢」。

examples.en: Our tutor drew an empty case to show the conditions that could cause queue underflow.
examples.zh: 老师画了一个空队列的例子，说明怎样会发生「队列下溢」。

collocations: handle queue underflow in a test

words.enDefinition: The time a packet spends waiting before it can be processed or sent onward.

examples.en: The worksheet shows queuing delay increasing as more packets wait for the same outgoing link.
examples.zh: 练习纸显示，等待使用同一条出链路的数据包越多，「排队时延」越长。

examples.en: At the quietest point in the simulation, the packets experienced almost no queuing delay.
examples.zh: 在模拟中最空闲的时候，数据包几乎没有经历「排队时延」。

words.enDefinition: Sorting by partitioning around a pivot and sorting the resulting parts

examples.en: Our quicksort split the list around a value chosen for comparison.
examples.zh: 我们的「快速排序」以一个选定的比较值为基准把列表划分开来。

examples.en: We compared the partitions made by quicksort on two different inputs.
examples.zh: 我们比较了「快速排序」对两种输入划出的各部分。

words.enDefinition: a delimited-file field enclosed by quote markers, often to preserve separators or line breaks inside its value

examples.en: The parser treated the full address as a quoted field even though the address contained two commas.
examples.zh: 尽管地址含两个逗号，解析程序仍将完整地址当作一个「带引号的字段」。

examples.en: We checked the quoted field rules before importing notes that included actual quote characters in the text.
examples.zh: 导入文本中含实际引号的备注前，我们查了「带引号的字段」的规则。

collocations: escape a quote inside a quoted field

words.enDefinition: one minus the ratio of squared prediction error to squared deviation from the observed mean, when the observed target varies

examples.en: The R-squared score was negative when the predictions were worse than using the observed mean.
examples.zh: 预测结果还不如直接用观测均值时，「决定系数」为负。

examples.en: Our tutor checked the R-squared score against the error in minutes reported for the same model.
examples.zh: 老师把「决定系数」与同一模型按分钟报告的误差作了对照。

collocations: report the R-squared score on test data

words.enDefinition: A correctness problem that depends on how concurrent actions are timed or ordered.

examples.en: The test report described a race condition after the classroom program produced inconsistent progress totals.
examples.zh: 课堂程序算出的进度总数不一致，测试报告记录了一项「竞态条件」。

examples.en: Our tutor discussed why a race condition might explain differences between otherwise identical classroom runs.
examples.zh: 老师解释，为什么一次「竞态条件」可能导致本来相同的课堂运行出现不同结果。

words.enDefinition: Sorting keys by successively grouping them according to individual digits or positions

examples.en: Our radix sort example grouped the numbers by their last digit first.
examples.zh: 我们的「基数排序」示例先按数字的最后一位分组。

examples.en: We traced radix sort using labels that all had the same length.
examples.zh: 我们用长度相同的标签跟踪了「基数排序」。

words.enDefinition: a Python statement that raises an exception or reraises one currently being handled

examples.en: The raise statement signalled that the supplied date range ended before its beginning in our classroom example.
examples.zh: 在课堂示例里，「raise 抛出语句」指出提供的日期范围结束早于开始。

examples.en: We moved the raise statement before formatting so the caller could correct the missing room number first.
examples.zh: 我们把「raise 抛出语句」移到格式化之前，让调用方先补全缺少的房间编号。

collocations: raise an exception with a raise statement

words.enDefinition: An ensemble of randomized decision trees whose outputs are combined for prediction.

examples.en: The random forest combined predictions from several trees to categorise the sample book descriptions.
examples.zh: 「随机森林」汇总了多棵树的预测，对示例图书描述进行归类。

examples.en: Our group compared a random forest with a single tree on the same validation data.
examples.zh: 我们组在同一批验证数据上比较了「随机森林」和单棵决策树。

collocations: adjust the size of a random forest

words.enDefinition: Increasing the number of training examples from a class by randomly drawing existing examples again.

examples.en: The exercise used random oversampling to give poetry examples more representation in the training portion.
examples.zh: 练习用「随机过采样」增加诗歌样本在训练部分中的占比。

examples.en: Our tutor applied random oversampling only after separating the training examples from the reserved ones.
examples.zh: 老师先把训练样本和留出样本分开，才应用「随机过采样」。

collocations: apply random oversampling to training data
use random oversampling for a rare class

words.enDefinition: Evaluating configurations sampled at random from specified settings or distributions.

examples.en: We used random search to try a limited number of settings from a larger candidate space.
examples.zh: 我们用「随机搜索」从较大的候选空间里试验数量有限的设置。

examples.en: Our tutor used random search when checking every possible combination would take too long.
examples.zh: 逐一检查所有可能组合耗时太久，老师因此用了「随机搜索」。

collocations: set the budget for random search
compare random search with grid search

words.enDefinition: An initial value used to set up a pseudorandom generator so its sequence can be produced again under the same conditions.

examples.en: We recorded the random seed so the class could reproduce the same simulated rainfall values.
examples.zh: 我们记录了「随机种子」，让全班都能复现同一组模拟降雨量。

examples.en: The worksheet shows where the random seed is set before the example data are generated.
examples.zh: 练习纸标出生成示例数据前设置「随机种子」的位置。

words.enDefinition: Reducing a class's training examples by selecting a random subset to keep.

examples.en: We used random undersampling to keep fewer common leaf examples while comparing the two training approaches.
examples.zh: 我们用「随机欠采样」减少常见叶片样本的保留数量，再比较两种训练方法。

examples.en: The worksheet recorded how many novel descriptions remained after random undersampling in the training data.
examples.zh: 练习表记录了训练数据经「随机欠采样」后还剩多少条小说描述。

collocations: compare before and after random undersampling
use random undersampling on the majority class

words.zhGloss: 并列后跳号的排名函数
words.enDefinition: a SQL window function assigning tied rows the same rank and leaving gaps after ties
acceptedZhAnswers: 并列后跳号的排名函数

examples.en: The RANK function gave two rows first place and the following row third place in the example.
examples.zh: 示例中的「并列后跳号的排名函数」给两行并列第一，把下一行排为第三。

examples.en: Our tutor used the RANK function to show how equal scores affected the next position in the list.
examples.zh: 导师用「并列后跳号的排名函数」说明相同分数怎样影响列表的下一个名次。

collocations: sort scores for the RANK function
handle ties using the RANK function

words.enDefinition: a literal in which backslashes generally remain in the text

examples.en: The Python worksheet used a raw string literal to preserve the backslashes in the example.
examples.zh: Python 练习表用「原始字符串字面量」保留示例中的反斜杠。

examples.en: Our tutor highlighted the prefix marking the raw string literal in the Python sample.
examples.zh: 导师高亮了 Python 样本中标记「原始字符串字面量」的前缀。

words.enDefinition: A question about whether one vertex can be reached from another

examples.en: We made a reachability query to check whether the exit could be reached.
examples.zh: 我们发起一次「可达性查询」，检查是否到得了出口。

examples.en: The reachability query gave a different result after one directed link was removed.
examples.zh: 删去一条有向连接后，「可达性查询」给出了不同结果。

words.enDefinition: Loading additional data in anticipation of later requests.

examples.en: The simulation used read-ahead to load the next page while our program examined the current page.
examples.zh: 程序查看当前页时，模拟借助「预读」加载下一页。

examples.en: We compared read-ahead in a sequential file example with reads requested at irregular positions.
examples.zh: 我们把顺序读取文件例题中的「预读」与在不规则位置发出的读取作了比较。

words.enDefinition: an isolation level under which a transaction reads committed data, while successive statements may see different committed states

examples.en: Under read committed isolation, our second PostgreSQL query saw a change committed after our first query had finished.
examples.zh: 在「读已提交隔离级别」下，PostgreSQL 的第二次查询看到了第一次查询结束后提交的更改。

examples.en: The sample showed that read committed isolation prevented one session from seeing the other session's uncommitted change.
examples.zh: 示例表明，「读已提交隔离级别」让一个会话看不到另一个会话尚未提交的更改。

collocations: compare read committed isolation with repeatable read
run a transaction under read committed isolation

words.enDefinition: An interactive cycle that reads, evaluates, and displays results from input

examples.en: The diagram showed how a read-eval-print loop handled each line I entered.
examples.zh: 图上展示了「读取求值打印循环」怎样处理我输入的每条指令。

examples.en: We tried a simple expression in the read-eval-print loop before opening a file.
examples.zh: 打开文件前，我们在「读取求值打印循环」里试了一个简单表达式。

collocations: run code in a read-eval-print loop
the stages of a read-eval-print loop

words.enDefinition: In a buffer, the position from which the next unread item is taken.

examples.en: The read index pointed to the next sample that the toy buffer would return.
examples.zh: 「读取索引」指向示例缓冲区下一次要返回的样本。

examples.en: We moved the read index after taking one colour card from the buffer.
examples.zh: 从缓冲区取出一张颜色卡后，我们移动了「读取索引」。

words.enDefinition: Read one complete line at a time from a text source

examples.en: The program could read line by line and print each entry as it arrived.
examples.zh: 程序可以「逐行读取」，每读到一条就打印出来。

examples.en: Our worksheet showed how to read line by line before adding up the numbers.
examples.zh: 练习表展示了怎样先「逐行读取」，再把数字相加。

collocations: read line by line from a file
decide to read line by line
open a source to read line by line

words.enDefinition: The shared access mode of a read-write lock, which ordinarily permits multiple readers together.

examples.en: Both preview workers held a read lock while they copied the current settings for display.
examples.zh: 两条预览工作线程在复制当前设置以供显示时，都持有「读锁」。

examples.en: The diagram showed a thread waiting for a read lock while the writer was active.
examples.zh: 图中展示了写入者工作期间，一条线程等待「读锁」。

words.enDefinition: A file opening mode allowing the program to read existing contents

examples.en: We opened the file in read mode to inspect the saved list.
examples.zh: 我们以「读取模式」打开文件，看看保存的列表。

examples.en: The example used read mode when it only needed to count lines.
examples.zh: 示例只需要统计行数，因此采用「读取模式」。

collocations: a file opened in read mode

words.enDefinition: a binding that cannot be reassigned after initialisation

examples.en: In our JavaScript example, a read-only binding kept referring to the same object throughout the exercise.
examples.zh: 在 JavaScript 示例中，「只读绑定」在整个练习过程中始终指向同一个对象。

examples.en: The object contents could change while the read-only binding continued pointing at the same object.
examples.zh: 对象内容可以改变，而「只读绑定」仍指向同一个对象。

collocations: a read-only binding to an object

words.enDefinition: a property exposed for reading without a supported way to assign it

examples.en: The Python example exposed the total as a read-only property calculated from the scores.
examples.zh: Python 示例把从分数算出的总分作为「只读属性」提供给调用方。

examples.en: Our tutor used a read-only property when the exercise only needed to display the total.
examples.zh: 练习只需要显示总数时，导师使用了「只读属性」。

words.enDefinition: A lock that can allow concurrent readers while giving writers exclusive access.

examples.en: The example used a read-write lock so several workers could read the same catalogue at once.
examples.zh: 例题使用「读写锁」，让几条工作线程可以同时读取同一目录。

examples.en: Our tutor drew the read-write lock states for a reader arriving while another thread was writing.
examples.zh: 老师画出了另一条线程正在写入时，有读取者到达所对应的「读写锁」状态。

collocations: protect data with a read-write lock
compare a read-write lock with a mutex

words.enDefinition: a notification that a resource currently appears ready for an input or output operation

examples.en: The example received a readiness notification before trying to read the next available sample.
examples.zh: 例题收到「就绪通知」后，才尝试读取下一个可用样本。

examples.en: Our tutor placed the readiness notification before the read on the classroom timeline.
examples.zh: 老师在课堂时间线上把「就绪通知」放在读取操作之前。

words.enDefinition: A scheduler's collection of tasks eligible to run but waiting for CPU time.

examples.en: The ready queue contained three tasks waiting for time on the single simulated processor.
examples.zh: 「就绪队列」里有三项任务，都在等待同一个模拟处理器分配时间。

examples.en: We watched one job leave the ready queue when the simulator selected it to run.
examples.zh: 模拟器选中一项作业运行时，我们看到它离开了「就绪队列」。

collocations: add a task to the ready queue
select a task from the ready queue

words.enDefinition: Put temporarily stored Git changes back into a working tree

examples.en: I could reapply a stash after switching back to the formatting exercise.
examples.zh: 切回格式练习的分支后，我就可以「恢复搁置的改动」。

examples.en: The tutor showed when to reapply a stash while discussing temporary edits in Git.
examples.zh: 导师讨论 Git 中的临时编辑时，演示了何时可以「恢复搁置的改动」。

collocations: reapply a stash after switching back
reapply a stash to a branch

words.enDefinition: The item currently at the end where new items are added to a FIFO queue.

examples.en: The rear element changed when we put one more card into the practice queue.
examples.zh: 我们往练习用的队列再放入一张卡片后，「队尾元素」发生了变化。

examples.en: Our diagram placed the arrow for insertion directly after the current rear element in the queue.
examples.zh: 图中把入队箭头画在当前「队尾元素」的正后方。

collocations: add an item after the rear element

words.enDefinition: assigning a different value to an existing target

examples.en: The Python exercise showed reassignment when the same name later referred to a different score.
examples.zh: 当同一个名称后来指向不同分数时，Python 练习展示了「重新赋值」。

examples.en: The tutor traced the effects of reassignment by writing the previous and current values side by side.
examples.zh: 导师把先前的值和当前值并排列出，以追踪「重新赋值」的影响。

words.enDefinition: Replay a branch's commits on top of a different starting commit

examples.en: The tutor showed how to rebase a branch onto the updated classroom example.
examples.zh: 导师演示了怎样把分支放到更新后的课堂示例上「变基」。

examples.en: I practised how to rebase a branch on a copy of the project.
examples.zh: 我在项目副本上练习怎样「对分支变基」。

collocations: rebase a branch onto newer history

words.enDefinition: Among examples that truly belong to a given class, the proportion successfully identified as that class.

examples.en: The recall score was low because the classifier missed many of the actual oak leaves.
examples.zh: 分类器漏掉了许多真正的橡树叶，因此「召回率」很低。

examples.en: We calculated the recall score from all the books that the librarian had marked as poetry.
examples.zh: 我们依据馆员标为诗歌的全部图书计算「召回率」。

words.enDefinition: The span of bytes a TCP receiver advertises it is prepared to accept, starting at its next expected byte.

examples.en: The receive window shrinks when the receiving program temporarily stops reading in the experiment.
examples.zh: 实验中，接收程序暂时停止读取时，「接收窗口」缩小了。

examples.en: The instructor explained how the sender uses the advertised receive window to limit outstanding data.
examples.zh: 老师讲解了发送方如何利用通告的「接收窗口」限制尚未确认的数据量。

words.enDefinition: Translate edited source code again to generate updated executable material

examples.en: We had to recompile the source after changing the text that Java displayed.
examples.zh: 改变 Java 显示的文字后，我们得「重新编译源代码」。

examples.en: I remembered to recompile the source before trying the example with new input.
examples.zh: 给示例试用新的输入前，我记得「重新编译源代码」。

words.enDefinition: identifying records from one or more sources that refer to the same underlying entity

examples.en: The project used record linkage to match official room entries with an older handwritten inventory.
examples.zh: 项目通过「记录链接」把正式房间条目与一份较早的手写清单对应起来。

examples.en: We reviewed borderline record linkage results by checking the building codes recorded alongside similar names.
examples.zh: 我们核对相近名称旁记录的楼宇代码，以复查拿不准的「记录链接」结果。

words.enDefinition: the number of simultaneously active recursive levels of a computation at a given point

examples.en: We recorded the recursion depth to see how many calls were still active at the deepest point.
examples.zh: 我们记录了「递归深度」，了解在最深处有多少层调用仍未返回。

examples.en: The program reached its recursion depth limit because the input caused too many calls before returning.
examples.zh: 输入导致调用在返回之前嵌套过多，因此程序达到了「递归深度」上限。

words.enDefinition: a call in which a function invokes itself directly or through another function

examples.en: Each recursive call handled a smaller portion of the input before combining its result with the remaining work.
examples.zh: 每次「递归调用」先处理更小的一部分输入，再把结果与余下工作合并。

examples.en: The tutor traced another recursive call to see when the routine first reached a single remaining item.
examples.zh: 导师跟踪了下一次「递归调用」，查看例程何时首次只剩一项要处理。

words.enDefinition: the part of a recursive definition that invokes the same task again with a different input

examples.en: The recursive case processed the remaining items after taking the first item from the list.
examples.zh: 「递归情形」让函数从列表中取走首项之后继续处理余下条目。

examples.en: In the recursive case, each call received a smaller number until the routine reached the stopping condition.
examples.zh: 在「递归情形」下，每次调用接到一个更小的数，直到例程达到终止条件。

collocations: reduce the input in the recursive case

words.enDefinition: a common table expression that uses earlier iterations of its own result to compute additional rows

examples.en: The recursive common table expression followed the sample folders from their common parent through each successive level.
examples.zh: 「递归公用表表达式」从共有的父文件夹出发，逐层找出示例中的文件夹。

examples.en: We checked when the recursive common table expression stopped adding rows to the list of workshop subgroups.
examples.zh: 我们核查「递归公用表表达式」何时不再向工作坊子组清单添加行。

collocations: write a recursive common table expression
trace a recursive common table expression
limit the depth of a recursive common table expression

words.enDefinition: A DNS service that answers client queries using its cache or by querying other servers as needed.

examples.en: The recursive resolver already had a valid answer in its cache in the first example.
examples.zh: 第一个例子中，「递归解析器」的缓存里已经有一个有效答案。

examples.en: The arrows show the recursive resolver contacting another name server while the browser waits.
examples.zh: 箭头表示浏览器等待期间，「递归解析器」在联系另一个域名服务器。

collocations: send a query to a recursive resolver

words.enDefinition: A stack of previously undone changes used to reapply the most recently undone change first.

examples.en: The practice editor put the undone colour change on the redo stack until we reapplied it.
examples.zh: 练习用的编辑器把已撤销的颜色改动放到「重做栈」中，等我们重新应用该改动。

examples.en: Our sample cleared the redo stack when the player made a different edit to the shape.
examples.zh: 玩家改用另一种方式编辑图形时，示例清空了「重做栈」。

collocations: push an undone change onto the redo stack
restore a change from the redo stack

words.enDefinition: A line drawn at a particular value to guide comparisons in a chart.

examples.en: The reference line marks the average monthly visitor count on the class example chart.
examples.zh: 课堂示例图中的「参考线」标出月均访客数量。

examples.en: We drew a reference line at the garden's usual rainfall level for this month.
examples.zh: 我们在花园本月的通常降雨量处画了一条「参考线」。

words.enDefinition: the table containing the target columns of a foreign key, possibly the same table as the referencing table

examples.en: We checked the referenced table to see whether the classroom identifier on the booking was valid.
examples.zh: 我们核查「被引用表」，确认预订记录上的教室标识符是否有效。

examples.en: The diagram drew a line from each foreign key to the corresponding key in its referenced table.
examples.zh: 图中从每个外键画一条线，连到「被引用表」里对应的键。

collocations: look up a value in the referenced table
delete a row from the referenced table

words.enDefinition: A JavaScript exception raised when a name cannot currently be referenced

examples.en: The console showed a ReferenceError for a name our example never defined.
examples.zh: 示例从未定义那个名称，所以控制台显示了「JS 引用错误」。

examples.en: We read the ReferenceError before checking spelling in the rest of the file.
examples.zh: 我们先看了「JS 引用错误」，再查文件其他部分的拼写。

words.enDefinition: the table containing a foreign key that points to a target key

examples.en: The referencing table stored each reservation alongside the identifier of the instructor responsible for it.
examples.zh: 「引用表」存放各条预订记录，并记录负责它的讲师标识符。

examples.en: We found duplicate room identifiers in the referencing table because several bookings used the same room.
examples.zh: 有几条预订使用同一教室，所以我们在「引用表」里发现重复出现的教室标识符。

collocations: insert rows into the referencing table
find dependent rows in the referencing table

words.enDefinition: a foreign key rule specifying what happens to dependent references when the target row changes or is deleted

examples.en: The diagram identified the referential action that would run when a sample parent record was removed.
examples.zh: 图中标明了删除示例父记录时会触发的「引用操作」。

examples.en: We compared each referential action before choosing what should happen to notes attached to a deleted workshop.
examples.zh: 我们先比较各种「引用操作」，再决定工作坊被删除后如何处理关联备注。

words.enDefinition: consistency of relationships so stored references point to valid records according to the defined foreign key rules

examples.en: Our database maintained referential integrity by rejecting a new loan for a book absent from the catalogue.
examples.zh: 数据库通过拒绝为目录中不存在的书新增借阅记录，维护了「引用完整性」。

examples.en: The tutor checked referential integrity after loading the sample classes and the associated registration records.
examples.zh: 加载示例课程及其选课记录后，导师检查了「引用完整性」。

words.enDefinition: To fit the chosen model again, often on all development data after its settings are selected.

examples.en: We decided to refit the model on all development records after selecting the tree settings.
examples.zh: 选定树的设置后，我们决定用所有开发数据「重新拟合模型」。

examples.en: The worksheet asked us to refit the model before measuring performance on the untouched test set.
examples.zh: 练习表要求我们先「重新拟合模型」，再在未使用的测试集上测量表现。

collocations: refit the model with the chosen settings
refit the model on all development data
refit the model before final testing

words.enDefinition: Predicting a numerical target, such as a measurement or duration, from input values.

examples.en: The regression exercise predicted the number of minutes needed to complete a classroom sorting activity.
examples.zh: 「回归」练习预测完成一项课堂分拣活动需要的分钟数。

examples.en: We chose regression because the target was a temperature measurement rather than a named category.
examples.zh: 目标是温度测量值，因此我们选择了「回归」。

words.enDefinition: A test checking that an existing behaviour still works after changes

examples.en: We added a regression test for the date format that had previously broken.
examples.zh: 我们给先前出问题的日期格式加了一个「回归测试」。

examples.en: The regression test checked that the revised converter still handled whole numbers.
examples.zh: 「回归测试」检查修改后的换算器是否仍能处理整数。

collocations: a regression test for a fix

words.enDefinition: Constraining a model or its fitting to limit excessive flexibility and improve generalization.

examples.en: We applied regularization to keep the regression coefficients small in the sorting time exercise.
examples.zh: 我们在分拣用时练习中应用「正则化」，限制回归系数的大小。

examples.en: Our tutor compared regularization settings after finding that the flexible model had fitted the training noise.
examples.zh: 老师发现灵活模型拟合了训练噪声后，对比了几种「正则化」设置。

words.enDefinition: The setting that controls how strongly fitting penalizes or restricts model complexity.

examples.en: We varied regularization strength to see which setting worked best on held-out plant examples.
examples.zh: 我们改变「正则化强度」，查看哪个设置在留出的植物样本上效果最好。

examples.en: The tutor increased regularization strength in the example and showed how its coefficients changed.
examples.zh: 老师提高例题的「正则化强度」，展示模型系数随之怎样变化。

words.enDefinition: To redistribute existing entries in a hash table by calculating their bucket positions again.

examples.en: We chose to rehash a table after adding more buckets in the classroom example.
examples.zh: 课堂示例增加桶数后，我们选择「对散列表重新散列」。

examples.en: Our tutor asked where the green entry would land when we needed to rehash a table.
examples.zh: 老师问，需要「对散列表重新散列」时，绿色条目会落在哪个位置。

collocations: rebuild buckets when you rehash a table
check the entries after you rehash a table

words.enDefinition: a database representing data as relations, commonly displayed as rows and columns in tables

examples.en: The class used a relational database to store separate tables for classrooms, bookings and the people making reservations.
examples.zh: 我们班用「关系数据库」分别存放教室、预订记录以及预订人信息。

examples.en: We designed a relational database so every loan could point to the existing record for its book.
examples.zh: 我们设计了一个「关系数据库」，使每条借阅记录都能指向所借图书的现有记录。

collocations: store records in a relational database

words.enDefinition: software that creates and manages relational databases and processes queries and changes to their data

examples.en: Our course used a relational database management system to check the links between products and orders.
examples.zh: 课程用「关系数据库管理系统」检查产品与订单之间的关联。

examples.en: The tutor compared how each relational database management system handled an attempt to add the same key twice.
examples.zh: 导师比较了各「关系数据库管理系统」遇到两次添加同一个键时的处理方式。

collocations: use a relational database management system
choose a relational database management system
install a relational database management system

words.enDefinition: an import that specifies the target relative to the importing module's package or location

examples.en: The relative import located a formatting helper in a neighbouring module of the same Python package.
examples.zh: 「相对导入」找到了同一 Python 包中相邻模块里的格式化辅助函数。

examples.en: We changed the relative import after moving the importing file one level deeper inside the package.
examples.zh: 把发起导入的文件在包内下移一级后，我们修改了「相对导入」。

words.enDefinition: A URL reference whose meaning is determined using a base URL.

examples.en: The relative URL points to a stylesheet next to the catalogue document in our sample folder.
examples.zh: 「相对 URL」指向示例文件夹里与目录文档放在一起的样式表。

examples.en: We resolved the relative URL against the page address in an exercise done on paper.
examples.zh: 在纸上做练习时，我们根据页面地址解析了「相对 URL」。

words.enDefinition: To stop holding a lock so that other eligible callers can acquire it.

examples.en: After saving the new label, the editor needed to release a lock so previews could continue.
examples.zh: 保存新标签后，编辑器需要「释放锁」，让预览继续进行。

examples.en: Our tutor asked where the worker should release a lock after finishing the shared update.
examples.zh: 老师问，完成共享更新后，工作线程应当在哪里「释放锁」。

words.enDefinition: A packaged file made available as part of a software release

examples.en: The release artifact contained the application and a short classroom guide.
examples.zh: 「发行产物」包含应用和一份简短的课堂指南。

examples.en: We inspected the release artifact before sharing the sample version with classmates.
examples.zh: 把示例版本分享给同学前，我们先检查了「发行产物」。

collocations: check the contents of a release artifact

words.enDefinition: A branch used to prepare and stabilise a particular software release

examples.en: The release branch held small corrections for our final classroom package.
examples.zh: 「发行分支」存放了为最终课堂软件包所做的小修改。

examples.en: We left the new feature off the release branch for that exercise.
examples.zh: 那次练习里，我们没把新功能放进「发行分支」。

collocations: a fix on a release branch

words.enDefinition: A prerelease build that may become final if validation succeeds

examples.en: Our release candidate still needed the final check on the classroom computer.
examples.zh: 我们的「候选发行版」还需要在教室电脑上做最后一项检查。

examples.en: We compared the release candidate with the build used in the previous class.
examples.zh: 我们把「候选发行版」与上一堂课所用的构建版本作了比较。

words.enDefinition: A named stream delivering versions with a particular level of readiness

examples.en: The guide assigned preview builds to a separate release channel.
examples.zh: 指南把预览构建版本放在一个独立的「发行渠道」里。

examples.en: I checked which release channel supplied the version shown in our worksheet.
examples.zh: 我查看了练习表所示版本由哪个「发行渠道」提供。

words.enDefinition: To change the links among existing nodes without replacing their stored values.

examples.en: The diagram showed how to relink nodes after putting the picture cards in a different order.
examples.zh: 图中展示了把图片卡片换个顺序后如何「重新连接节点」。

examples.en: The worksheet showed how to relink nodes without changing the values inside any of them.
examples.zh: 练习表展示了怎样在保持各节点内原值的同时「重新连接节点」。

collocations: relink nodes in a different order
relink nodes without copying their values

words.enDefinition: an operator giving a division remainder, with JavaScript preserving the dividend's sign

examples.en: The JavaScript remainder operator gave negative two for negative five divided by three in class.
examples.zh: 在课堂上，负五除以三用 JavaScript「余数运算符」得到负二。

examples.en: Our tutor contrasted the remainder operator in JavaScript with Python's modulo operator using negative values.
examples.zh: 导师用负数对比了 JavaScript 的「余数运算符」和 Python 的模运算符。

collocations: apply the remainder operator to integers

words.enDefinition: A project history store accessed at a separate location

examples.en: Our team used a remote repository to share the campus map exercise.
examples.zh: 我们用「远程版本库」共享校园地图练习。

examples.en: The remote repository held both versions that our classmates had submitted.
examples.zh: 「远程版本库」保存了同学提交的两个版本。

words.enDefinition: A local reference recording the last known state of a remote branch

examples.en: Our diagram labelled a remote-tracking branch beside the local branch we edited.
examples.zh: 我们在图上所编辑的本地分支旁标出了「远程跟踪分支」。

examples.en: We compared the remote-tracking branch with the snapshot currently in our editor.
examples.zh: 我们把「远程跟踪分支」与编辑器当前的快照作了比较。

collocations: update a remote-tracking branch by fetching

words.zhGloss: 移除指定索引处的元素
words.enDefinition: To remove the item occupying a specified position without choosing it by value.
acceptedZhAnswers: 移除指定索引处的元素

examples.en: Our exercise let us remove at an index even when two entries had the same value.
examples.zh: 即使两个条目的值相同，练习也能让我们「移除指定索引处的元素」。

examples.en: The tutor showed how to remove at an index and shift the later entries left.
examples.zh: 老师演示了怎样「移除指定索引处的元素」，再将后续条目左移。

collocations: remove at an index in a list
remove at an index instead of by value
check the position before you remove at an index

words.enDefinition: To take away the first data node and update where the linked list begins.

examples.en: We updated the starting reference before we could remove the head node in our sample.
examples.zh: 在例题中「移除头节点」之前，我们先更新了起始引用。

examples.en: The worksheet asked what remained if we chose to remove the head node from a one-item list.
examples.zh: 练习表问，如果从只有一项的链表中「移除头节点」，还会剩下什么。

collocations: remove the head node of a list
update the start when you remove the head node

words.enDefinition: to change the labels of table columns without changing their values

examples.en: We needed to rename columns before joining files whose authors used different headings for the same measurements.
examples.zh: 文件作者用不同标题表示同一测量项，我们需要先「重命名列」再合并。

examples.en: Our instructor asked us to rename columns so each label identified both the field and its unit.
examples.zh: 讲师让我们「重命名列」，让各标签同时标明字段和单位。

collocations: rename columns by their old labels

words.enDefinition: an isolation level preventing a later read of the same item from seeing an intervening change by another transaction

examples.en: The PostgreSQL exercise used repeatable read isolation so both catalogue queries saw the same snapshot within one transaction.
examples.zh: PostgreSQL 练习使用「可重复读隔离级别」，使同一事务内的两次目录查询都读取同一个快照。

examples.en: We compared repeatable read isolation with a mode in which two statements could see different committed room details.
examples.zh: 我们将「可重复读隔离级别」与允许两条语句看到不同已提交房间详情的模式进行了比较。

collocations: run a query under repeatable read isolation
compare repeatable read isolation with serializable isolation

words.enDefinition: a design exposing domain objects through a collection-like storage interface

examples.en: The repository pattern let the reading app request books without specifying where they were stored.
examples.zh: 「仓储模式」让阅读应用可以请求书籍，无需指明书籍存在哪里。

examples.en: Our tutor used the repository pattern to replace the sample storage with an in-memory collection.
examples.zh: 导师用「仓储模式」把样本的存储实现换成内存集合。

collocations: a storage interface using the repository pattern

words.enDefinition: A check that compares the results from repeating an analysis under the documented conditions.

examples.en: Our reproducibility check compared the totals and figures generated from the same public library data.
examples.zh: 我们的「可复现性检查」比较了用同一组公开图书馆数据生成的总量和图表。

examples.en: The team scheduled a reproducibility check before adding the final figures to the shared report.
examples.zh: 团队安排在把最终图表加进共享报告前做一次「可复现性检查」。

words.enDefinition: A collection of code, data or input references, and instructions for reproducing a reported result.

examples.en: The reproducibility package includes the scripts and a reference to the archived public data.
examples.zh: 「复现材料包」包含脚本和一条指向已归档公开数据的引用。

examples.en: We tested the reproducibility package on a different classroom computer before submitting the report.
examples.zh: 我们提交报告前，在教室的另一台电脑上测试了「复现材料包」。

words.enDefinition: A scripted chain of analysis steps that can regenerate outputs from recorded inputs and settings.

examples.en: A reproducible analytical pipeline generated the garden statistics and the corresponding chart for our report.
examples.zh: 「可复现分析流程」为我们的报告生成了花园统计数据和对应图表。

examples.en: We drew the reproducible analytical pipeline as three stages with the input and output labelled.
examples.zh: 我们把「可复现分析流程」画成三个阶段，并标明输入和输出。

words.enDefinition: The content carried by an HTTP request apart from its control information and headers.

examples.en: The practice form sends the fictional book title in the request body for the catalogue exercise.
examples.zh: 练习表单把虚构书名放进「请求体」，发送给目录练习服务。

examples.en: The instructor showed where the request body begins beneath the headers in the printed example.
examples.zh: 老师在印发的示例上指出了首部下方「请求体」的起始位置。

words.enDefinition: A named field in an HTTP request that carries additional information about the message or client preferences.

examples.en: A request header tells the example server which media types the classroom browser can accept.
examples.zh: 一个「请求首部字段」告诉示例服务器课堂浏览器可以接受哪些媒体类型。

examples.en: On the worksheet, we highlighted the request header that lists the browser's preferred language.
examples.zh: 我们在练习纸上标出了列出浏览器首选语言的「请求首部字段」。

words.enDefinition: The opening line of an HTTP/1.1 request, containing the method, request target, and protocol version.

examples.en: The request line at the top of the handout shows a GET for the library timetable.
examples.zh: 讲义顶部的「请求行」显示一条获取图书馆时间表的 GET 请求。

examples.en: Our tutor asked us to underline the request target found on the request line.
examples.zh: 老师让我们给「请求行」里的请求目标画下划线。

words.enDefinition: The part of an HTTP request that specifies what action the client asks the server to perform.

examples.en: The request method is GET when the browser simply retrieves the sample library timetable.
examples.zh: 浏览器仅获取示例图书馆时间表时，「请求方法」是 GET。

examples.en: In the lesson, we checked the request method before reading the body of the message.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们先看「请求方法」，再读消息内容。

words.enDefinition: The part of an HTTP request that identifies the resource or other target of the operation.

examples.en: The request target in the diagram identifies the catalogue listing that the browser wants to retrieve.
examples.zh: 图中的「请求目标」标识浏览器想获取的目录列表。

examples.en: Our example uses the same request target for GET and HEAD when referring to one page.
examples.zh: 对于同一页面，示例里的 GET 和 HEAD 使用相同的「请求目标」。

collocations: a request target containing a query

words.enDefinition: a parameter for which the caller must supply an argument for the call to be valid

examples.en: The timetable routine used the date as a required parameter when generating the list of available rooms.
examples.zh: 生成可用房间列表时，日程表例程把日期设为「必填形参」。

examples.en: We checked the documentation and saw that the room number was a required parameter for this function.
examples.zh: 我们查了文档，发现房间编号是这个函数的「必填形参」。

collocations: provide a value for a required parameter

words.enDefinition: A configured check that must meet result criteria before a merge

examples.en: A required status check showed that the class project still needed its tests.
examples.zh: 一项「必需的状态检查」显示，课堂项目的测试还没完成。

examples.en: We reviewed the required status check associated with the proposed label change.
examples.zh: 我们审阅了与拟修改标签有关的「必需的状态检查」。

collocations: wait for a required status check

words.enDefinition: allowing the exception currently being handled to continue propagating by raising it again

examples.en: The helper cleaned up its temporary data before reraising an exception for the caller to handle.
examples.zh: 辅助函数先清理临时数据，再「重新抛出异常」交由调用方处理。

examples.en: We discussed reraising an exception after recording which input row had caused the conversion to fail.
examples.zh: 我们记录了哪一行输入导致转换失败，接着讨论了「重新抛出异常」。

collocations: log an error before reraising an exception
finish cleanup before reraising an exception
keep the original traceback when reraising an exception

words.enDefinition: to represent time-indexed observations at a new frequency, often by aggregating or filling intervals

examples.en: We learned to resample a time series by combining hourly rainfall values into daily totals.
examples.zh: 我们将每小时降雨量合计为每日总量，以学习如何「对时间序列重采样」。

examples.en: The tutor asked us to resample a time series so two devices could be compared at matching intervals.
examples.zh: 导师要求我们「对时间序列重采样」，使两台设备的数据能按相同时间间隔比较。

collocations: resample a time series by month
resample a time series to a weekly frequency
resample a time series using a mean

words.enDefinition: To make storage available for future entries without adding any elements yet.

examples.en: The example used a library method to reserve capacity before any of the scores arrived.
examples.zh: 十个分数都还未传入时，示例先调用预留函数「预留容量」。

examples.en: We decided to reserve capacity for the readings while leaving the collection logically empty.
examples.zh: 我们选择为读数「预留容量」，同时在逻辑上保持集合为空。

collocations: reserve capacity without changing the size

words.enDefinition: to replace the current index with a new default index, optionally preserving old labels as columns

examples.en: We had to reset the index after filtering left the remaining rows with gaps in their numbers.
examples.zh: 筛选使剩余行的编号不连续，所以我们需要「重置索引」。

examples.en: The tutor chose to reset the index and keep the old labels for later comparison.
examples.zh: 导师决定「重置索引」，并保留旧标签供之后比较。

collocations: reset the index without dropping the labels
choose when to reset the index

words.enDefinition: A virtual page whose contents are currently held in physical memory.

examples.en: The worksheet marked each resident page in green so we could distinguish it from unloaded pages.
examples.zh: 练习表把每个「驻留页」标为绿色，便于区分尚未加载的页。

examples.en: We compared the time to access a resident page with the time for a page awaiting loading.
examples.zh: 我们比较了访问「驻留页」与访问等待加载的页所需的时间。

words.enDefinition: The amount of a process's memory currently resident in physical memory under the platform's accounting rules.

examples.en: The monitor showed a larger resident set size after the program loaded the example images.
examples.zh: 程序加载示例图片后，监视器显示更大的「驻留集大小」。

examples.en: We plotted resident set size while the program repeatedly opened and closed the sample document.
examples.zh: 程序反复打开和关闭示例文档时，我们绘制了「驻留集大小」的变化曲线。

words.enDefinition: To replace a collection's internal array with one of a different capacity while retaining its stored elements.

examples.en: We had to resize the backing array before the collection could accept another reading.
examples.zh: 集合再接收一个读数之前，我们得先「调整底层数组大小」。

examples.en: The diagram showed why we copy existing colours when we resize the backing array.
examples.zh: 图中说明了为什么「调整底层数组大小」时要复制原有颜色。

collocations: resize the backing array when full
resize the backing array before appending
copy entries when you resize the backing array

words.enDefinition: Data and associated metadata that express the state of a resource in a particular form.

examples.en: The HTML version of the timetable is one resource representation offered by the example server.
examples.zh: HTML 版时间表是示例服务器提供的一种「资源表示」。

examples.en: In the lesson, the browser receives a resource representation suitable for display as a formatted page.
examples.zh: 课堂示例中，浏览器收到一种适合显示为格式化页面的「资源表示」。
