words.enDefinition: The content carried by an HTTP response apart from the status information and headers.

examples.en: The browser displays the sample timetable using the HTML supplied in the response body.
examples.zh: 浏览器用「响应体」提供的 HTML 显示示例时间表。

examples.en: The response body in the exercise contains the two opening times shown on the catalogue page.
examples.zh: 练习中的「响应体」包含目录页上显示的两个开放时间。

words.enDefinition: A named field in an HTTP response that carries metadata about the message or its content.

examples.en: The response header identifies the media type of the illustrated timetable returned by the server.
examples.zh: 「响应首部字段」标明服务器返回的图文时间表所用的媒体类型。

examples.en: The class added a response header to specify how long the sample page stays fresh.
examples.zh: 全班增加了一个「响应首部字段」，说明示例页面在多长时间内保持新鲜。

words.enDefinition: in JavaScript, the final parameter declared with an ellipsis to collect remaining arguments into an array

examples.en: The rest parameter collected all the labels supplied after the first argument named the worksheet in the call.
examples.zh: 这次调用的第一个实参指定工作表名称，「剩余形参」收集了其后传入的所有标签。

examples.en: We iterated over the rest parameter to display every note the caller had supplied after the date.
examples.zh: 我们遍历「剩余形参」，显示调用方在日期之后给出的每条备注。

words.enDefinition: Stop and start a notebook's code execution process to reset state

examples.en: I had to restart the kernel before checking whether the notebook worked from scratch.
examples.zh: 在确认笔记本能否从头运行之前，我得先「重启笔记本内核」。

examples.en: We chose to restart the kernel after the calculation stopped responding during class.
examples.zh: 课上的计算停止响应后，我们选择「重启笔记本内核」。

collocations: restart the kernel before running again
restart the kernel from the menu

words.enDefinition: Data available only to people who meet specified conditions or have obtained specific approval.

examples.en: The practice scenario reserves restricted-use data for approved analysts under a written agreement.
examples.zh: 练习情境规定，只有受书面协议约束的获准分析人员才能使用「限用数据」。

examples.en: We compared the documentation for restricted-use data with the notes accompanying the public file.
examples.zh: 我们比较了「限用数据」的文档和公开文件随附的说明。

collocations: apply for access to restricted-use data

words.enDefinition: the rows returned by a query, including any duplicate rows allowed by the query

examples.en: The result set contained one row for each book loan that met the date and location conditions.
examples.zh: 符合日期和地点条件的每条借阅记录，在「结果集」里各占一行。

examples.en: We counted the rows in the result set before adding the query output to our worksheet.
examples.zh: 把查询输出加入练习表之前，我们数了「结果集」的行数。

words.enDefinition: sending a segment or other data again because its prior transmission may not have been received

examples.en: The simulator shows a retransmission after the sender decides that the earlier segment was lost.
examples.zh: 发送方判断先前的报文段丢失后，模拟器显示了一次「重传」。

examples.en: A dotted arrow marks the retransmission of the missing segment in our classroom diagram.
examples.zh: 课堂示意图用虚线箭头标出丢失报文段的「重传」。

words.enDefinition: The interval after which a transport sender may resend data that has not been acknowledged.

examples.en: The diagram shows the retransmission timeout expiring before the missing segment is sent again.
examples.zh: 图中「重传超时」期限先到，丢失的报文段随后重新发出。

examples.en: Our exercise compares the retransmission timeout with the estimated round-trip time for the sample connection.
examples.zh: 练习把示例连接的「重传超时」时长与估算的往返时间作了比较。

words.enDefinition: a statement ending the current function call and optionally supplying a result to its caller

examples.en: The return statement sent the calculated average back to the part of the program displaying the report.
examples.zh: 「return 返回语句」把计算出的平均值传回程序中负责显示报告的部分。

examples.en: We moved the return statement outside the loop so the function could process every row first.
examples.zh: 我们把「return 返回语句」移到循环外面，让函数先处理完所有行。

words.enDefinition: the value delivered to the caller when a function call completes normally

examples.en: We used the return value as the title for the page generated from the selected date.
examples.zh: 我们把「返回值」用作根据所选日期生成的页面标题。

examples.en: The test compared the return value with the expected temperature in the units requested by the caller.
examples.zh: 测试把「返回值」与调用方所要求单位下的预期温度作了比较。

collocations: compare a return value with the expected result

words.enDefinition: A condition that limits how people can use data after receiving or accessing it.

examples.en: One reuse restriction limits the teaching data to the exercises described in the course handout.
examples.zh: 一项「再利用限制」规定，教学数据只用于课程讲义所述的练习。

examples.en: We recorded the reuse restriction next to the source citation so it would be easy to find.
examples.zh: 我们把「再利用限制」记在资料引用旁边，以便查找。

words.enDefinition: To change the order of a linked list so it starts with its previous last element.

examples.en: Our diagram showed how the arrows changed when we chose to reverse a linked list.
examples.zh: 图中展示了选择「反转链表」后箭头怎样变化。

examples.en: The exercise asked what the first item would be after we used code to reverse a linked list.
examples.zh: 练习问，用代码「反转链表」之后，第一项会是什么。

collocations: reverse a linked list in place
reverse a linked list by updating links
test a function that can reverse a linked list

words.enDefinition: An iterator that visits elements in the reverse of a collection's usual iteration order.

examples.en: The example used a reverse iterator to display the newest saved measurements before the oldest.
examples.zh: 示例用「反向迭代器」先显示最新保存的测量值，再显示更早的值。

examples.en: Our tutor compared a reverse iterator with making a separate reversed copy of the card list.
examples.zh: 老师对比了使用「反向迭代器」与另建一份倒序卡片列表的做法。

words.enDefinition: Create a new commit reversing changes introduced by an earlier commit

examples.en: Our group chose to revert a commit after the example lost a label.
examples.zh: 示例少了一个标签后，我们组选择「以新提交撤回改动」。

examples.en: We learned why we might revert a commit rather than remove history entries.
examples.zh: 我们了解了什么时候会「以新提交撤回改动」来保留历史记录。

collocations: revert a commit without deleting history

words.enDefinition: a join retaining every right row and supplying nulls on the left when no left row matches

examples.en: The right outer join retained rooms in the second table even when the first table held no bookings.
examples.zh: 即使第一张表没有相应预订，「右外联接」也保留第二张表里的房间。

examples.en: We rewrote the right outer join with the inputs swapped to demonstrate the equivalent left join.
examples.zh: 我们交换输入表后重写「右外联接」，以演示等价的左联接。

collocations: rewrite a right outer join as a left join

words.enDefinition: A fixed-capacity storage area that reuses positions in a cycle, often as part of a queue.

examples.en: The tiny sensor simulator used a ring buffer to retain the last few readings.
examples.zh: 小型传感器模拟器采用「环形缓冲区」保留最近的几个读数。

examples.en: Our diagram showed how a ring buffer could reuse the same five storage positions.
examples.zh: 图中展示了「环形缓冲区」怎样重复利用同样的五个存储位置。

collocations: write readings into a ring buffer

words.enDefinition: The area under the ROC curve, summarizing how well scores separate positives from negatives across thresholds.

examples.en: We compared ROC AUC to judge how well each model ranked oak leaves above other leaves.
examples.zh: 我们对比了「ROC 曲线下面积」，判断各模型将橡树叶排在其他叶片之前的能力。

examples.en: The tutor reported ROC AUC separately from accuracy at the single threshold chosen for classification.
examples.zh: 老师将「ROC 曲线下面积」与分类所选单一阈值下的准确率分开报告。

collocations: report ROC AUC on held-out examples

words.enDefinition: a plot with false positive rate on the horizontal axis and true positive rate on the vertical axis across thresholds

examples.en: The ROC curve showed how correct detections and false alarms changed as we moved the threshold.
examples.zh: 「ROC 曲线」展示了我们改变阈值时正确识别率和误报率如何变化。

examples.en: Our tutor checked the axes before comparing the ROC curve for each of the leaf classifiers.
examples.zh: 对比各叶片分类器的「ROC 曲线」之前，老师先核对了坐标轴。

collocations: choose a point on an ROC curve

words.enDefinition: the median recomputed at each position over the currently selected moving window

examples.en: The rolling median remained steady when a single unusually high reading entered the five-value window.
examples.zh: 一条特别高的读数进入包含五个值的窗口时，「滚动中位数」仍保持稳定。

examples.en: We compared the rolling median across two window lengths before interpreting the change in typical waiting time.
examples.zh: 解释典型等待时长的变化之前，我们比较了两种窗口长度下的「滚动中位数」。

collocations: choose a window for the rolling median

words.enDefinition: a moving group of adjacent observations used to recalculate a statistic as the current position changes

examples.en: The rolling window held the current observation and four preceding values for each median calculation.
examples.zh: 每次计算中位数时，「滚动窗口」包含当前观测值和之前四个值。

examples.en: We made the rolling window shorter so the reported statistic would respond sooner to an abrupt change.
examples.zh: 我们缩短了「滚动窗口」，使报告的统计量更快反映突变。

collocations: compute a statistic within a rolling window

words.enDefinition: The square root of the mean squared error, expressed in the target's original units.

examples.en: The root mean squared error was reported in minutes for every model in the workshop comparison.
examples.zh: 工作坊比较中的所有模型都以分钟报告「均方根误差」。

examples.en: Our tutor computed root mean squared error after squaring the prediction errors and averaging those squares.
examples.zh: 老师先对各个预测误差平方并求平均，再计算「均方根误差」。

collocations: compare root mean squared error across models
report root mean squared error in minutes

words.enDefinition: The distinguished starting node of a tree that has no parent

examples.en: The traversal starts at the root node before exploring the children below.
examples.zh: 遍历从「根节点」开始，再探索下方的子节点。

examples.en: I marked the root node at the top of the diagram.
examples.zh: 我在图的顶部标出了「根节点」。

words.enDefinition: A hierarchical structure with one designated starting node called the root

examples.en: Our worksheet represented family relationships as a rooted tree with one starting point.
examples.zh: 练习表把亲属关系表示为有一个起点的「有根树」。

examples.en: We drew a rooted tree before examining the nodes below its top.
examples.zh: 我们先画了一棵「有根树」，再看顶部节点下方有哪些节点。

collocations: a rooted tree with three levels

words.enDefinition: To shift the items cyclically so entries leaving one end reappear at the other.

examples.en: We could rotate a deque one step to bring the last card around to the front.
examples.zh: 我们可以把「双端队列旋转」一步，让最后一张卡片回到前端。

examples.en: The Python exercise asked us to rotate a deque without adding or removing any cards overall.
examples.zh: Python 练习要求我们「旋转双端队列」，保持卡片总数不变。

collocations: rotate a deque to the left
use a method to rotate a deque

words.enDefinition: to round an exact halfway value to the even candidate

examples.en: We had to round half to even, so the exact halfway value of 2.5 became two.
examples.zh: 我们采用「舍入中点时取偶」的规则，把刚好在中点的 2.5 舍入为二。

examples.en: The tutor asked us to round half to even for both ties in the example.
examples.zh: 导师要求我们对示例中两个刚好在中点的数都采用「舍入中点时取偶」。

collocations: round half to even at a tie
the round half to even rule
choose to round half to even

words.enDefinition: A scheduling policy that cyclically gives runnable tasks turns for limited intervals.

examples.en: The simulator used round-robin scheduling to give each runnable task a turn on the same processor.
examples.zh: 模拟器用「轮转调度」让每项可运行任务轮流使用同一个处理器。

examples.en: Our tutor drew round-robin scheduling as a repeating sequence of turns for three ready tasks.
examples.zh: 老师把「轮转调度」画成三个就绪任务轮流运行的循环序列。

collocations: draw a timeline for round-robin scheduling

words.enDefinition: A test that converts data and checks it survives conversion back

examples.en: The round-trip test saved a small timetable and then read it back.
examples.zh: 「往返转换测试」保存了一张小课表，再把它读回来。

examples.en: We added a round-trip test to check whether accented letters survived export and reload.
examples.zh: 我们加了「往返转换测试」，检查带重音符号的字母能否在导出和重新加载后保留。

collocations: a round-trip test for saved records

words.enDefinition: The elapsed time for a signal or message to go to an endpoint and for a reply to return.

examples.en: The plotted round-trip time includes both the outgoing journey and the return of the reply.
examples.zh: 图上标出的「往返时间」包括发出信号和收到应答的两个过程。

examples.en: We compared the round-trip time of two example routes using the timing chart in our lecture.
examples.zh: 我们用课堂上的时序图比较了两条示例路径的「往返时间」。

words.enDefinition: the difference introduced when a result is rounded to available precision

examples.en: A small rounding error appeared after the worksheet added several decimal fractions in binary floating point.
examples.zh: 练习表用二进制浮点相加几个十进制小数后，出现了很小的「舍入误差」。

examples.en: Our tutor asked how rounding error could accumulate when the same calculation was repeated many times.
examples.zh: 导师问，同一个计算做很多次时，「舍入误差」可能怎样累积。

words.enDefinition: A set of route entries used to decide where to send packets for particular destinations.

examples.en: The routing table on our worksheet lists three destination prefixes and their corresponding next hops.
examples.zh: 练习纸上的「路由表」列出了三个目的前缀以及各自的下一跳。

examples.en: The tutor added another row to the routing table before discussing the second example.
examples.zh: 老师讲解第二个例子之前，在「路由表」里又加了一行。

words.enDefinition: a check explaining how rows are added, combined or removed between two stages in a data process

examples.en: Our row count reconciliation explained why the final worksheet contained fewer records than the initial export.
examples.zh: 我们的「行数核对」说明了为什么最终练习表的记录比最初导出的少。

examples.en: We added a row count reconciliation after the join returned more records than our group had expected.
examples.zh: 联接返回的记录超过我们组的预期后，我们加了一次「行数核对」。

words.enDefinition: the label used to identify or select a row in a data structure with labelled axes

examples.en: The row label recorded the experiment date, even though the observations were entered out of order.
examples.zh: 「行标签」记录实验日期，尽管观测结果是乱序录入的。

examples.en: We checked the row label before replacing the reading that had been assigned to the wrong date.
examples.zh: 替换被填到错误日期的读数之前，我们核对了「行标签」。

collocations: select a row by its row label

words.enDefinition: using locks on individual rows to coordinate access or changes by concurrent database transactions

examples.en: The example used row-level locking to protect the record being edited while other classrooms remained available for updates.
examples.zh: 示例通过「行级锁定」保护正在编辑的记录，其他教室的记录仍可以更新。

examples.en: We compared row-level locking with locking a whole table in the model for the library checkout exercise.
examples.zh: 我们在图书借阅练习的模型中比较了「行级锁定」和锁住整张表。

words.enDefinition: A storage or traversal order that places elements from each row together before moving to the next row.

examples.en: The C example stored its table in row-major order, with each row followed by the next.
examples.zh: C 示例按「行优先顺序」存储表格，一行紧接着下一行。

examples.en: Our drawing labelled the one-dimensional positions in row-major order before converting them back to grid coordinates.
examples.zh: 我们在图中按「行优先顺序」标出一维位置，再换回网格坐标。

collocations: traverse a grid in row-major order
convert an index to row-major order

words.enDefinition: a SQL window function numbering partition rows consecutively, following any specified window order

examples.en: We used the ROW_NUMBER function to give each classroom booking a separate position in the displayed schedule.
examples.zh: 我们用「行号函数」给显示的日程里各条教室预订分配不同的位置编号。

examples.en: The ROW_NUMBER function started at one for each product category after we changed the partitioning expression.
examples.zh: 我们修改分区表达式后，「行号函数」在各个产品类别内都从一开始编号。

collocations: partition rows for the ROW_NUMBER function
add a tie breaker for the ROW_NUMBER function

words.enDefinition: an operation applied separately to each row using values associated with the row

examples.en: A row-wise operation compared the start and finish recorded in each row to calculate its duration.
examples.zh: 「逐行操作」比较每行记录的起止时间，计算其时长。

examples.en: We checked whether the row-wise operation returned one scalar per row or a new set of column values.
examples.zh: 我们确认这个「逐行操作」对每行返回一个标量还是一组新的列值。

words.enDefinition: A value that uniquely identifies one execution of a workflow within its recording system.

examples.en: The output folder includes a run identifier so we can match it to the correct log.
examples.zh: 输出文件夹含有「运行标识符」，让我们能把它与正确的日志对应起来。

examples.en: We recorded the run identifier beside the date and dataset version in the project notes.
examples.zh: 我们把「运行标识符」记在项目笔记的日期和数据集版本旁边。

words.enDefinition: A record of the events, messages, and timing from an individual program or workflow run.

examples.en: The run log shows when the rainfall calculation finished and when the chart was created.
examples.zh: 「运行日志」记载了降雨量计算完成和图表生成的时间。

examples.en: We saved the run log to explain why the table appeared before the chart in class.
examples.zh: 我们保存了「运行日志」，用它说明为什么课堂上先输出了表格。

words.enDefinition: An editor action for executing the currently selected part of a program

examples.en: I chose run selection to try the arithmetic without starting the entire program.
examples.zh: 我选了「运行选中的代码」，单独试算这一小段。

examples.en: The lab instructions showed where to find run selection in the editor.
examples.zh: 实验说明指明了编辑器里「运行选中的代码」在哪里。

collocations: use Run Selection in an editor

words.enDefinition: A task eligible to use a CPU because it is not blocked on an event.

examples.en: The simulator marked the print job as a runnable task after its input had arrived.
examples.zh: 输入到达后，模拟器把打印作业标为「可运行任务」。

examples.en: We checked why the runnable task still had to wait even though its data was available.
examples.zh: 即使数据已经就绪，我们还检查了为什么这项「可运行任务」仍需等待。

collocations: place a runnable task in the ready queue

words.enDefinition: in a scheduling model distinguishing ready from running, the state of a task currently executing on a processor

examples.en: The diagram used a green box for the process in the running state on that core.
examples.zh: 图中用绿色方框标示在该核心上处于「运行状态」的进程。

examples.en: Our simulator marked a task as being in the running state when it was executing instructions.
examples.zh: 任务正在执行指令时，模拟器将它标为「运行状态」。

collocations: mark a task as being in the running state

words.enDefinition: a sum reflecting the current value and preceding values in a specified order

examples.en: The query calculated a running total of reservations after arranging the records by their creation dates.
examples.zh: 查询按创建日期排列记录后，计算了预订条数的「累计合计」。

examples.en: We checked the running total after filtering out the cancelled bookings in our practice data.
examples.zh: 筛去练习数据里已取消的预订记录后，我们核对了「累计合计」。

collocations: reset a running total at a group boundary

words.enDefinition: verification of a value's type while a program is running

examples.en: The Python example used a runtime type check before treating the supplied value as text.
examples.zh: Python 示例先执行「运行时类型检查」，再把传进来的值当作文本处理。

examples.en: Our tutor demonstrated how a runtime type check could identify an unexpected integer in the data.
examples.zh: 导师演示了「运行时类型检查」如何识别数据中意料之外的整数。

words.enDefinition: the type a value actually has while a program runs

examples.en: The Python worksheet printed the runtime type after replacing a number with a string.
examples.zh: Python 练习表在用字符串替换数字后打印了值的「运行时类型」。

examples.en: Our tutor checked the runtime type before deciding which operation the sample value supported.
examples.zh: 导师先检查「运行时类型」，再判断样本值支持哪种运算。

words.enDefinition: a JavaScript Number integer with magnitude at most two to the fifty-third power minus one, so no other integer rounds to it

examples.en: The worksheet checked whether the computed JavaScript Number was a safe integer after combining large values.
examples.zh: 练习表在组合多个大数后，检查算得的 JavaScript Number 值是否为「安全整数」。

examples.en: Our tutor used Number.isSafeInteger to check that the result remained a safe integer in JavaScript.
examples.zh: 导师用 Number.isSafeInteger 检查 JavaScript 的计算结果是否仍为「安全整数」。

words.enDefinition: An HTTP method whose defined purpose is read-only from the client's point of view.

examples.en: For the quiz, we classified GET as a safe method because it requests a page.
examples.zh: 小测里我们把 GET 归为「安全方法」，因为它在这里请求读取页面。

examples.en: The tutor noted that the server could still log requests that use a safe method.
examples.zh: 老师指出，服务器仍然可以记录采用「安全方法」的请求。

collocations: classify GET as a safe method

words.enDefinition: a named point inside a transaction to which later changes can be rolled back while retaining earlier work

examples.en: We set a savepoint before the optional change so we could undo that part of the practice transaction.
examples.zh: 我们在可选变更前设置「保存点」，这样可以撤销练习事务的那一部分。

examples.en: The tutor rolled back to the savepoint before adding the corrected room number in the same transaction.
examples.zh: 导师先回滚到「保存点」，再在同一事务中添加更正后的房间号。

words.enDefinition: a subquery used in a scalar expression that returns at most one row with one column

examples.en: Our scalar subquery calculated the overall mean as a single value for comparison with each location's mean.
examples.zh: 我们的「标量子查询」计算一个总体平均值，供各地点的平均值与其比较。

examples.en: The tutor showed why returning two rows was invalid for the scalar subquery in the worksheet.
examples.zh: 导师说明了为什么返回两行在练习表的「标量子查询」中无效。

collocations: use a scalar subquery as an expression
check that a scalar subquery returns one column

words.enDefinition: A chart that positions points using paired numerical values to show a relationship or pattern.

examples.en: The scatter plot shows the relationship between hours of sunlight and plant height in our exercise.
examples.zh: 「散点图」展示了练习中光照时长和植物高度之间的关系。

examples.en: In the scatter plot, each greenhouse plant contributes one point with a height and a leaf count.
examples.zh: 在「散点图」中，每株温室植物对应一个点，具有高度和叶片数两个数值。

words.enDefinition: The delay between a task becoming eligible to run and actually starting or resuming execution.

examples.en: We measured scheduling latency from the moment the job became runnable until the CPU started it.
examples.zh: 我们从作业变为可运行时计到 CPU 实际开始执行时，测量了「调度延迟」。

examples.en: The interactive demo showed higher scheduling latency when several other tasks were ready at once.
examples.zh: 几个其他任务同时就绪时，交互演示显示较高的「调度延迟」。

words.enDefinition: A ranking a scheduler considers when choosing which task to run.

examples.en: The simulator considered scheduling priority when two tasks became ready at the same time.
examples.zh: 两项任务同时就绪时，模拟器会考虑「调度优先级」。

examples.en: We changed one job's scheduling priority and compared its position on the new timeline.
examples.zh: 我们修改了一项作业的「调度优先级」，然后比较它在新时间线上的位置。

words.enDefinition: an object name written with its containing schema to identify which object is meant

examples.en: Our PostgreSQL example used a schema-qualified name because two schemas contained tables with the same name.
examples.zh: PostgreSQL 示例里有两个模式都包含同名表，我们使用了「带模式限定的名称」。

examples.en: The tutor used a schema-qualified name to show which copy of the sample table was being read.
examples.zh: 导师用「带模式限定的名称」准确指明正在读取哪一份示例表。

collocations: refer to a table by its schema-qualified name

words.enDefinition: writing a number as a coefficient multiplied by a power of ten

examples.en: The worksheet used scientific notation to write a small measurement without a long string of zeros.
examples.zh: 练习表用「科学计数法」写一个很小的测量值，省去一长串零。

examples.en: Our tutor rewrote the same value in scientific notation before entering it in the example.
examples.zh: 导师先用「科学计数法」改写同一数值，再将其输入示例。

collocations: write a number in scientific notation

words.enDefinition: A way of running instructions from a saved program file

examples.en: Our exercise used script mode after we saved the code for reading input.
examples.zh: 保存了读取输入的代码后，我们在练习中用了「脚本模式」。

examples.en: I switched to script mode to run all the instructions together.
examples.zh: 为了把所有指令放在一起运行，我切换到「脚本模式」。

words.enDefinition: Discovered vertices still waiting for their outgoing connections to be explored

examples.en: The search frontier contained two rooms after we explored the starting room.
examples.zh: 探索完起点房间后，「搜索前沿」中有两个房间。

examples.en: Our trace crossed out each vertex after removing it from the search frontier.
examples.zh: 我们在跟踪表里划掉从「搜索前沿」移出的每个顶点。

collocations: add a vertex to the search frontier

words.enDefinition: The part of an ordered sequence still considered during a search

examples.en: The search interval shrank after we compared the key with the middle item.
examples.zh: 我们把键和中间元素比较后，「查找区间」缩小了。

examples.en: Our diagram showed the search interval after each comparison in binary search.
examples.zh: 图里显示了二分查找每次比较后的「查找区间」。

words.enDefinition: The value used to identify an item during a search

examples.en: I changed the search key and followed a different branch of the tree.
examples.zh: 我改了「查找键」，然后沿树的另一条分支继续找。

examples.en: The search key matched the value stored at the root in our example.
examples.zh: 示例中的「查找键」与根节点存的值相同。

collocations: compare a search key with a node's key

words.enDefinition: first normal form with every attribute outside all candidate keys fully dependent on each candidate key

examples.en: The tutor checked second normal form after spotting a product name determined by just part of the key.
examples.zh: 导师发现产品名只由键的一部分确定，于是检查设计是否符合「第二范式」。

examples.en: We separated the course title from the registrations table to bring the classroom design into second normal form.
examples.zh: 我们把课程标题与登记表分开，使课堂设计达到「第二范式」。

collocations: move a relation into second normal form
identify a violation of second normal form

words.enDefinition: A field used to order records whose primary sorting values match

examples.en: We used the first name as a secondary sort key after the surname.
examples.zh: 姓氏相同时，我们用名字作为「次级排序键」。

examples.en: The spreadsheet used a secondary sort key to distinguish records with identical scores.
examples.zh: 电子表格用「次级排序键」来区分同分记录。

collocations: a secondary sort key for ties

words.enDefinition: Choose the installed language implementation that will execute a program

examples.en: I had to select an interpreter after opening the class project on a new machine.
examples.zh: 在新机器上打开课堂项目后，我得「选择解释器」。

examples.en: Our tutor showed how to select an interpreter for the small Python script.
examples.zh: 导师演示了怎样为这个 Python 小脚本「选择解释器」。

collocations: select an interpreter in the editor
select an interpreter for the project

words.enDefinition: the expressions after SELECT that determine the columns or values returned by a query

examples.en: The select list showed the title and publication year but left other catalogue fields outside the results.
examples.zh: 「查询选择列表」显示标题和出版年份，其他目录字段不在结果中。

examples.en: We added a calculated expression to the select list so that the report displayed the price per item.
examples.zh: 我们在「查询选择列表」里加入计算表达式，使报告显示每件商品的价格。

collocations: add a column to the select list
evaluate expressions in the select list

words.enDefinition: a SQL statement that retrieves rows or computes values according to a query

examples.en: Our SELECT statement returned the dates of the workshops that still had enough seats for another team.
examples.zh: 这条「SELECT 查询语句」返回了还有足够空位接收另一组人的工作坊日期。

examples.en: We checked the SELECT statement against the expected result before submitting the class exercise on relational databases.
examples.zh: 提交关系数据库课堂练习前，我们对照预期结果检查了「SELECT 查询语句」。

words.enDefinition: Sorting by repeatedly selecting the smallest remaining item for the next position

examples.en: The selection sort put the smallest remaining score in the next position.
examples.zh: 「选择排序」把剩余最低分放到下一个位置。

examples.en: I counted the comparisons made by selection sort during the first pass.
examples.zh: 我数了「选择排序」在第一趟中作了多少次比较。

collocations: compare selection sort with insertion sort

words.enDefinition: importing specific named members provided by a module rather than making the module itself or all its public names available

examples.en: A selective import brought in only the routine needed to convert the dates stored in the table.
examples.zh: 「选择性导入」只引入了换算表格里日期所需的例程。

examples.en: We used a selective import in the Python exercise so that formatting had one clearly identified dependency.
examples.zh: 我们在 Python 练习中使用「选择性导入」，让格式化功能只有一个清楚标明的依赖。

collocations: replace a wildcard import with a selective import

words.enDefinition: a join in which two references to the same table serve as separate inputs

examples.en: We used a self join to find pairs of catalogue items that had the same publication year.
examples.zh: 我们用「自联接」查找出版年份相同的目录条目对。

examples.en: The tutor assigned a different alias to each table reference in the self join for the sample timetable.
examples.zh: 导师给示例日程查询「自联接」中的各处表引用分别分配了不同的别名。

collocations: alias inputs to a self join
compare rows with a self join

words.enDefinition: An edge whose source and destination are the same vertex

examples.en: The self-loop led back to the same room in our puzzle.
examples.zh: 在我们的谜题中，「自环」回到了同一个房间。

examples.en: We marked the self-loop before checking which links reached different rooms.
examples.zh: 我们先标出「自环」，再检查哪些连接通往别的房间。

words.enDefinition: A scheme using version number changes to signal compatibility and updates

examples.en: The handout used semantic versioning to explain three parts of a version number.
examples.zh: 讲义用「语义化版本管理」解释版本号的三个部分。

examples.en: We checked the compatibility rule before assigning a number under semantic versioning.
examples.zh: 按「语义化版本管理」分配版本号前，我们检查了兼容性规则。

words.enDefinition: an operation returning a row from one input if a match exists in the other, without repeating it for additional matches

examples.en: The semi-join listed each workshop with a booking once even when several groups had registered for it.
examples.zh: 「半联接」把每场有预订的工作坊列一次，即使已有多组完成报名。

examples.en: We used a semi-join to check which books appeared at least once in the sample loan table.
examples.zh: 我们用「半联接」检查哪些书至少在示例借阅表里出现过一次。

collocations: filter one input with a semi-join

words.enDefinition: A training approach using both labeled and unlabeled examples for a prediction task.

examples.en: Our exercise used semi-supervised learning because only a few of the plant pictures had labels.
examples.zh: 我们在练习中采用「半监督学习」，因为只有少量植物图片带标签。

examples.en: The tutor asked whether adding the uncategorised books helped the semi-supervised learning approach in this experiment.
examples.zh: 老师问，在这次实验中，加入未分类图书是否改善了「半监督学习」的效果。

collocations: compare semi-supervised learning with supervised learning

words.enDefinition: Personal data whose nature or context calls for particular care because disclosure could cause substantial harm.

examples.en: The privacy exercise describes health information as an example of sensitive personal data requiring extra care.
examples.zh: 隐私练习把健康信息列为需要额外保护的「敏感个人数据」示例。

examples.en: Our classroom case asks why sensitive personal data should be kept out of the public attachment.
examples.zh: 我们的课堂案例要求解释为什么公开附件应避免包含「敏感个人数据」。

words.enDefinition: a loop that continues until it encounters a designated value indicating that processing should stop

examples.en: The sentinel-controlled loop read scores until a reserved input indicated there were no more entries to process.
examples.zh: 「哨兵控制循环」持续读取分数，直到保留的输入表示没有下一条记录。

examples.en: We added a prompt before each read in the sentinel-controlled loop used for the classroom exercise.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂练习的「哨兵控制循环」里，每次读取前都加了一条提示。

words.enDefinition: An extra node marking a position in a structure and carrying no ordinary collection element.

examples.en: The sentinel node simplified the example because every data node then had a predecessor.
examples.zh: 有了「哨兵节点」，每个数据节点都有前驱，使例题更简单。

examples.en: We drew a sentinel node in grey so nobody would count it as a stored score.
examples.zh: 我们把「哨兵节点」画成灰色，以免有人把它算作已存成绩。

collocations: use a sentinel node to handle an empty list
link a sentinel node to the first element

words.enDefinition: a special value marking a particular condition within data

examples.en: The worksheet used a sentinel value to mark the end of the sample list.
examples.zh: 练习表用一个「哨兵值」标记样本列表的末尾。

examples.en: We chose a sentinel value outside the range of valid scores in the class exercise.
examples.zh: 在课堂练习中，我们选择了一个不在有效分数区间内的「哨兵值」。

collocations: a sentinel value marking the end

words.enDefinition: a hash table technique that stores entries assigned to each bucket in an associated collection such as a linked list

examples.en: The classroom example used separate chaining to keep both colour entries together in one bucket.
examples.zh: 课堂示例用「链地址法」把两个颜色条目保存在同一个桶中。

examples.en: With separate chaining, we checked the entries in one bucket to find the matching name.
examples.zh: 使用「链地址法」时，我们核对同一个桶中的条目来找匹配名称。

collocations: implement a table with separate chaining

words.enDefinition: a pattern that matches a sequence by the structure and patterns of its ordered elements

examples.en: The sequence pattern accepted pairs and bound their two elements to the horizontal and vertical coordinates.
examples.zh: 「序列模式」接受成对的数据，并分别将两个元素绑定为横纵坐标。

examples.en: We used a sequence pattern to distinguish a list of three scores from a single value.
examples.zh: 我们用「序列模式」把含三个分数的列表与单个值区分开。

collocations: use a starred name in a sequence pattern

words.enDefinition: A colour scale for ordered values that typically changes smoothly from lighter to darker shades.

examples.en: The sequential colour scale uses darker shades for greater rainfall in the garden chart.
examples.zh: 花园图的「顺序色标」用较深的颜色表示较大的降雨量。

examples.en: We added a key to explain how the sequential colour scale represents increasing library attendance.
examples.zh: 我们加了一个图例，说明「顺序色标」如何表示图书馆客流量的递增。

words.enDefinition: reading table rows directly without using an index to locate the rows needed by the query

examples.en: The sequential scan was reasonable because the classroom report needed almost every record in the small table.
examples.zh: 课堂报表需要小表中的几乎所有记录，因此使用「顺序扫描」是合理的。

examples.en: We checked where the sequential scan applied its filter in the plan for the sample query.
examples.zh: 我们在示例查询的执行计划中检查了「顺序扫描」在哪一步应用筛选条件。

collocations: filter rows during a sequential scan

words.enDefinition: an isolation level making successfully committed transactions equivalent in effect to running them in some serial order

examples.en: The tutor used serializable isolation to explain why concurrent reservations had to agree with some sequential order.
examples.zh: 导师用「可串行化隔离级别」解释了并发预订结果为什么必须与某一种顺序执行结果一致。

examples.en: We examined whether both practice transactions could commit under serializable isolation after they made conflicting decisions.
examples.zh: 两个练习事务作出冲突决定后，我们检查在「可串行化隔离级别」下它们能否都提交。

collocations: test a transaction under serializable isolation

words.enDefinition: A data structure that stores distinct elements for membership checks and related operations.

examples.en: We put the selected colours in a set so duplicate choices counted only once.
examples.zh: 我们把选出的颜色放进「集合」，这样重复选择的颜色只计一次。

examples.en: The tutor asked how many elements a set would have after adding blue twice.
examples.zh: 老师问，两次添加蓝色后，「集合」里有多少元素。

collocations: add an element to a set
check whether a set contains an element

words.enDefinition: Mark a position where the debugger should pause program execution

examples.en: I needed to set a breakpoint on the line before the result was printed.
examples.zh: 我需要在打印结果前的那行「设置断点」。

examples.en: Our tutor asked us to set a breakpoint near the instruction that reads input.
examples.zh: 导师请我们在读取输入的指令附近「设置断点」。

collocations: set a breakpoint on a line
set a breakpoint before a call
set a breakpoint in the debugger

words.enDefinition: The elements in the first specified set that do not belong to the second set.

examples.en: We used a set difference to find colours chosen on Monday but not on Tuesday.
examples.zh: 我们用「集合的差集」找出周一选了、周二没选的颜色。

examples.en: The instructor reversed the two sets to show how the set difference could change.
examples.zh: 老师调换了两个集合的次序，展示「集合的差集」可能怎样变化。

collocations: check the order of operands in a set difference

words.enDefinition: A set containing only elements that belong to both of the original sets.

examples.en: The set intersection showed the colours that both teams selected during the classroom exercise.
examples.zh: 「集合的交集」显示课堂练习中两队都选到的颜色。

examples.en: We checked whether the set intersection was empty after comparing the choices for both days.
examples.zh: 比较两天的选择之后，我们查看「集合的交集」是否为空。

collocations: take the set intersection of two groups

words.enDefinition: Source-code notation that directly creates a set from its specified elements.

examples.en: We wrote a nonempty set literal in Python to represent the three colours on the board.
examples.zh: 我们用 Python 写了一个非空「集合字面量」，表示板上的三种颜色。

examples.en: The example used a set literal containing repeated names, then printed the number of distinct entries.
examples.zh: 示例用了一个包含重复姓名的「集合字面量」，然后打印不同条目的数量。

collocations: initialize data with a set literal
use a set literal in an example

words.enDefinition: a SQL operator combining rows from two query results according to a union, intersection or difference rule

examples.en: The tutor chose a set operator to return rows appearing in both lists of workshop attendees.
examples.zh: 导师选择一个「集合运算符」，返回同时出现在两份工作坊出席名单中的行。

examples.en: We checked column types before using the set operator to combine results from the separate source tables.
examples.zh: 使用「集合运算符」合并不同源表的查询结果前，我们检查了列类型。

collocations: combine results with a set operator
check column compatibility for a set operator

words.enDefinition: A set containing every element present in either or both of the original sets.

examples.en: We used a set union to list every colour chosen by either team in the activity.
examples.zh: 我们用「集合的并集」列出活动中两队选过的所有颜色。

examples.en: Our diagram shaded both circles to show the complete set union for the two groups.
examples.zh: 图中把两个圆都涂上颜色，展示两组的整个「集合的并集」。

collocations: take the set union of two groups

words.enDefinition: supplying a dependency through a setter after constructing the object

examples.en: The example used setter injection to supply an optional label formatter after creating the shape.
examples.zh: 示例用「设值方法注入」，在创建图形之后提供可选的标签格式化对象。

examples.en: Our tutor asked which setter injection call gave the sample object its formatting helper.
examples.zh: 导师问，哪次「设值方法注入」调用为样本对象提供了格式化辅助对象。

collocations: provide a collaborator through setter injection

words.enDefinition: a method that changes a stored property through a defined interface

examples.en: The Java example used a setter method to update the label on a classroom shape.
examples.zh: Java 示例用「设值方法」更新课堂图形上的标签。

examples.en: Our tutor added a small validation check before the setter method assigned its new value.
examples.zh: 导师在「设值方法」写入新值之前加了一项简单的有效性检查。

collocations: validate input in a setter method

words.enDefinition: An axis or scale used by more than one plot to make the displays comparable.

examples.en: The two plots use a shared axis for time so the same weeks line up.
examples.zh: 两幅图的时间维度采用「共用坐标轴」，因此相同周次的位置对齐。

examples.en: We retained a shared axis when dividing the rainfall chart into separate panels for each garden.
examples.zh: 我们把降雨量图按花园分为不同子图时，保留了「共用坐标轴」。

words.enDefinition: A memory region made accessible to more than one execution context.

examples.en: The two example processes used shared memory to pass the latest temperature reading between them.
examples.zh: 例题中的两个进程用「共享内存」在彼此之间传递最近的温度读数。

examples.en: We drew one shared memory region with arrows from both parts of the demonstration.
examples.zh: 我们画了一个「共享内存」区域，由演示的两个部分分别用箭头指向它。

collocations: attach to a shared memory region

words.enDefinition: Data that multiple tasks or threads can access and that may change during execution.

examples.en: The classroom editor used shared mutable state for a list of shapes being updated on screen.
examples.zh: 课堂编辑器用「可变共享状态」保存正在屏幕上更新的图形列表。

examples.en: Our tutor discussed shared mutable state while reviewing how two workers reported their progress.
examples.zh: 老师在回顾两条工作线程如何报告进度时，讨论了「可变共享状态」。

collocations: reduce the use of shared mutable state

words.enDefinition: To move a group of elements by one or more index positions within an ordered collection.

examples.en: The diagram showed how to shift elements right before placing a new value at index two.
examples.zh: 图中展示了在索引二放入新值之前如何向右「移动元素位置」。

examples.en: We had to shift elements left so the array would have no gap after the removal.
examples.zh: 删除之后，我们得向左「移动元素位置」，这样数组中间才不会留下空位。

collocations: shift elements one position to the right

words.enDefinition: skipping a later operand when the result is already determined

examples.en: A JavaScript AND expression used short-circuit evaluation to skip its second test when the first was false.
examples.zh: 一个 JavaScript 逻辑与表达式采用「短路求值」，第一个测试为假时就跳过第二个测试。

examples.en: Our tutor illustrated short-circuit evaluation by marking only the expressions that the program had evaluated.
examples.zh: 导师只标出了程序实际求值的表达式，用来说明「短路求值」。

words.enDefinition: A successful read returning fewer bytes than requested.

examples.en: The sample returned a short read because only three bytes remained in the example file.
examples.zh: 示例文件只剩三个字节，所以这次「读取字节数不足」。

examples.en: We checked the returned byte count after the simulator produced a short read near the end.
examples.zh: 模拟器在文件末尾附近出现「读取字节数不足」后，我们核对了返回的字节数。

collocations: expect a short read near the end of a file

words.enDefinition: A route with minimum total length or cost between specified vertices

examples.en: The shortest path reached the exit using fewer steps than our route.
examples.zh: 「最短路径」比我们选的路线用更少步数到达出口。

examples.en: We marked one shortest path between the entrances on the graph.
examples.zh: 我们在图上标出了两个入口之间的一条「最短路径」。

collocations: a shortest path through the graph

words.enDefinition: A different tree node that shares the same immediate parent

examples.en: The sibling node shared a parent with the leaf we just visited.
examples.zh: 「兄弟节点」与我们刚访问的叶节点有同一个父节点。

examples.en: We drew a sibling node beside the original branch in the example.
examples.zh: 我们在示例原有分支旁画了一个「兄弟节点」。

collocations: compare keys with a sibling node

words.enDefinition: a bit that indicates the sign of a value in a specified format

examples.en: The sign bit was set in the worksheet's encoding of a negative signed integer.
examples.zh: 练习表对负的有符号整数进行编码时，设置了「符号位」。

examples.en: Our tutor pointed out the sign bit in two floating-point values with equal magnitudes.
examples.zh: 导师指出了两个绝对值相等的浮点值中的「符号位」。

collocations: the position of the sign bit

words.enDefinition: To notify a waiting thread that it may wake and check the associated condition again.

examples.en: The worksheet showed when the producer should signal a condition variable after adding an item.
examples.zh: 练习表展示生产者添加一项后，何时应当「向条件变量发出信号」。

examples.en: Our tutor asked which thread should signal a condition variable when the new image became available.
examples.zh: 老师问，新图片可用时，应由哪条线程「向条件变量发出信号」。

collocations: signal a condition variable after changing state
signal a condition variable when work arrives
ask the producer to signal a condition variable

words.enDefinition: an integer that can represent negative and nonnegative values

examples.en: We used a signed integer because the temperature readings could fall below zero in January.
examples.zh: 我们使用「有符号整数」，因为一月份的气温读数可能低于零。

examples.en: The worksheet asked what the same bits meant when interpreted as a signed integer.
examples.zh: 练习表问，同一组位按「有符号整数」解读时表示什么。

words.enDefinition: zero represented with a positive or negative sign in some numeric formats

examples.en: The tutor used signed zero to show why two equal numeric results could have different representations.
examples.zh: 导师用「带符号的零」说明为什么两个相等的数值结果可以用不同方式表示。

examples.en: Our JavaScript worksheet showed signed zero by comparing positive zero and negative zero with Object.is.
examples.zh: JavaScript 练习表用 Object.is 比较正零和负零，以展示「带符号的零」。

words.enDefinition: the significant digits of a floating-point value before exponent scaling

examples.en: The worksheet separated the significand from the exponent in a small floating-point example.
examples.zh: 练习表在一个小型浮点示例中把「有效数字部分」与指数分开列出。

examples.en: Our tutor asked which value had more bits available for its significand in the comparison.
examples.zh: 导师问，在这项比较中，哪个值的「有效数字部分」有更多可用位。

words.enDefinition: a per-observation score comparing its mean distance to its own cluster with the smallest mean distance to another cluster

examples.en: The leaf had a negative silhouette coefficient because it was closer on average to the other group.
examples.zh: 这片叶子平均而言更接近另一组，因此它的「单样本轮廓系数」为负。

examples.en: We checked the silhouette coefficient for the book description positioned between two groups in the exercise.
examples.zh: 我们检查了练习中位于两组之间的图书描述的「单样本轮廓系数」。

words.enDefinition: The mean of the per-example silhouette coefficients for a clustering result.

examples.en: The silhouette score helped us compare two possible groupings of the same set of leaf measurements.
examples.zh: 「平均轮廓系数」帮助我们比较同一组叶片测量值的两种可能分组。

examples.en: Our tutor reported the silhouette score alongside individual scores for observations lying near group boundaries.
examples.zh: 老师报告了「平均轮廓系数」，同时列出了靠近分组边界的观测值的单独得分。

words.enDefinition: in Python, a statement expressed within a single logical line without a nested statement suite

examples.en: The Python exercise asked us to replace the simple statement assigning a total with a function call.
examples.zh: Python 练习要求我们把给总数赋值的「简单语句」改为函数调用。

examples.en: The tutor showed a simple statement that used two physical lines inside a parenthesised calculation.
examples.zh: 导师展示了一条「简单语句」，其括号内的计算跨两行书写。

words.enDefinition: A comment whose text ends at the current line's boundary

examples.en: I wrote a single-line comment above the instruction that printed the answer.
examples.zh: 我在打印答案的指令上方写了一条「单行注释」。

examples.en: The teacher used a single-line comment to explain why the example starts at zero.
examples.zh: 老师用一条「单行注释」解释示例从零开始的原因。

words.enDefinition: A linked list containing exactly one ordinary node.

examples.en: In our single-node list, the same card was both the first and the last item.
examples.zh: 这个「单节点链表」里，同一张卡片既是第一项也是最后一项。

examples.en: The tutor used a single-node list to test what happened when the only item was removed.
examples.zh: 老师拿「单节点链表」测试删除唯一一项时会发生什么。

collocations: remove an item from a single-node list

words.enDefinition: floating-point precision commonly implemented with the binary32 format

examples.en: The worksheet used single precision to show how a smaller format retained fewer significant bits.
examples.zh: 练习表用「单精度」来演示，较小的格式能保留的有效位更少。

examples.en: In the JavaScript demo, a Float32Array stored our sample readings rounded to single precision.
examples.zh: 在 JavaScript 演示中，Float32Array 将样本读数舍入至「单精度」后存储。

collocations: convert a value to single precision

words.enDefinition: the principle that a component should have one main reason to change

examples.en: The example followed the single responsibility principle by putting display and formatting in separate classes.
examples.zh: 示例将显示和格式化分到不同的类，遵循了「单一职责原则」。

examples.en: Our tutor applied the single responsibility principle when the two features changed for different reasons.
examples.zh: 两项功能因不同原因发生变化时，导师运用了「单一职责原则」。

words.enDefinition: Minimum-cost routes from one starting vertex to other vertices

examples.en: The program computed single-source shortest paths from the reading room to every other location.
examples.zh: 程序计算了从阅览室通往其他各地的「单源最短路径」。

examples.en: Our worksheet kept the same starting point for single-source shortest paths in both examples.
examples.zh: 我们练习表的两个「单源最短路径」示例用了同一个起点。

collocations: an algorithm for single-source shortest paths
a table of single-source shortest paths

words.enDefinition: a design controlling object creation so there is one instance within a defined scope, with a way to access it

examples.en: The classroom example used the singleton pattern to share one colour registry across its drawing panels.
examples.zh: 课堂示例用「单例模式」，让各绘图面板共用一个颜色登记对象。

examples.en: Our tutor traced the singleton pattern to see which part controlled creation of the shared object.
examples.zh: 导师追踪「单例模式」，查看哪部分控制共享对象的创建。

collocations: a shared instance in the singleton pattern

words.enDefinition: A linked list in which each ordinary node carries a link to its successor only.

examples.en: The singly linked list could move from the first colour to the second by following one link.
examples.zh: 这个「单向链表」沿一条链接就能从第一种颜色移到第二种。

examples.en: We used a singly linked list because the exercise only needed movement towards the end.
examples.zh: 我们用了「单向链表」，因为练习只需要向表尾方向遍历。

collocations: insert into a singly linked list

words.enDefinition: A test intentionally left unexecuted because a condition or setting applies

examples.en: The skipped test needed a display that the lab machine did not have.
examples.zh: 这项「已跳过的测试」需要实验室机器没有配备的显示设备。

examples.en: I read the explanation for the skipped test in the test report.
examples.zh: 我读了测试报告里关于「已跳过的测试」的说明。

collocations: the reason for a skipped test

words.enDefinition: The start and stop positions that define the range selected by a slice.

examples.en: We moved the slice bounds by one position to select the next group of sample readings.
examples.zh: 我们把「切片边界」移动一个位置，来选取下一组样本读数。

examples.en: The diagram labelled the slice bounds separately so the excluded endpoint was easy to identify.
examples.zh: 图中单独标出了「切片边界」，以便辨认不含在内的端点。

words.enDefinition: A chart that connects values at two positions to show how several items changed between them.

examples.en: The slope chart connects spring and autumn totals for each of the three reading groups.
examples.zh: 「斜率图」用线段连接三个阅读小组各自的春季和秋季总量。

examples.en: Our slope chart makes it easy to see which garden moved ahead of the others.
examples.zh: 我们的「斜率图」让人容易看出哪个花园后来超过了其他花园。

words.enDefinition: A low count in a statistical table cell that may require special review before release.

examples.en: The reviewer flagged a small cell count before the sample district table was made public.
examples.zh: 示例区域表公开前，审查员标记了一个「单元格低计数」。

examples.en: We discussed when a small cell count in a classroom table might warrant an extra check.
examples.zh: 我们讨论了课堂表格出现「单元格低计数」时，哪些情况可能需要额外核查。

words.enDefinition: A set of comparable charts using the same design for different subsets or categories.

examples.en: Small multiples let us compare four gardens without drawing every rainfall line on the same axes.
examples.zh: 借助「小多图」，我们可以比较四个花园，无需把所有降雨量线条画在同一组坐标轴上。

examples.en: The report uses small multiples to give each month its own panel with the same scale.
examples.zh: 报告用「小多图」给每个月单独安排一幅子图，并保持标度一致。

words.enDefinition: A quick check that a build's essential functions are working

examples.en: The smoke test checked whether the classroom app could open and create a draft.
examples.zh: 「冒烟测试」检查课堂应用能否打开并新建草稿。

examples.en: We used a smoke test before spending time on the longer checks.
examples.zh: 在花时间做更长的检查之前，我们先做了「冒烟测试」。

words.enDefinition: A test comparing current output with an already saved reference representation

examples.en: The snapshot test compared the new report headings with a saved copy.
examples.zh: 「快照测试」把新报告的标题与已保存的副本作了对照。

examples.en: Our snapshot test showed a change after the label order was revised.
examples.zh: 修改标签顺序后，我们的「快照测试」发现了变化。

collocations: review a change found by a snapshot test

words.enDefinition: A change causing software behaviour that previously worked to become worse

examples.en: The new formatter caused a software regression by dropping the last line.
examples.zh: 新格式化器漏掉最后一行，造成了「软件回归缺陷」。

examples.en: We confirmed a software regression after comparing the report with last week's version.
examples.zh: 与上周版本对照报告后，我们确认存在「软件回归缺陷」。

words.enDefinition: five design principles for organising and evolving object-oriented code

examples.en: The class used the SOLID principles to review how the drawing example divided its work.
examples.zh: 同学们用「SOLID 五项原则」检查绘图示例怎样划分工作。

examples.en: Our tutor pointed to two SOLID principles that explained the changes to the sample classes.
examples.zh: 导师指出，可以用「SOLID 五项原则」中的两条来解释样本类的改动。

collocations: a design following the SOLID principles

words.enDefinition: Arrange values from the smallest or earliest to the largest or latest

examples.en: The guide asked us to sort in ascending order before comparing the two lists.
examples.zh: 指南让我们先「按升序排列」，再比较两个列表。

examples.en: We chose to sort in ascending order so the earliest appointment appeared on top.
examples.zh: 我们选择「按升序排列」，这样最早的预约显示在顶部。

collocations: sort in ascending order by date
sort in ascending order by score
choose to sort in ascending order

words.enDefinition: An ordered section of a sequence starting at its beginning

examples.en: The sorted prefix grew after we inserted one more name in order.
examples.zh: 把又一个姓名按顺序插入后，「已排序前缀」变长了。

examples.en: We underlined the sorted prefix before tracing the next insertion in class.
examples.zh: 课上跟踪下一次插入之前，我们给「已排序前缀」画了下划线。

words.enDefinition: A consecutive stretch of values already ordered within a sequence

examples.en: We found a sorted run within the list of partly ordered dates.
examples.zh: 我们在部分有序的日期列表中找到了一个「有序段」。

examples.en: The diagram showed a sorted run that ended just before a smaller key.
examples.zh: 图里有一个「有序段」，恰好在一个更小的键前结束。

words.enDefinition: The field or value used to determine how items are ordered

examples.en: We used the submission date as the sorting key for the exercise.
examples.zh: 我们在练习中用提交日期作为「排序键」。

examples.en: The list changed order when I replaced its sorting key with the title.
examples.zh: 我把「排序键」改成标题后，列表顺序变了。

collocations: sort records by a sorting key

words.enDefinition: program text written in a programming language, as used by a programmer or translated by tools

examples.en: We opened the source code to see how the program read temperatures.
examples.zh: 我们打开「源代码」，想看程序怎样读取温度数据。

examples.en: The instructor distributed the source code along with the worksheet for Friday.
examples.zh: 老师连同周五的练习表一起发了「源代码」。

words.enDefinition: A release package with source and metadata for building the software

examples.en: The source distribution included the source files used in our classroom demonstration.
examples.zh: 「源代码发行包」包含我们课堂演示中使用的源文件。

examples.en: We opened the source distribution before reading its instructions for building the example.
examples.zh: 我们先打开「源代码发行包」，再读里面关于构建示例的说明。

words.enDefinition: The character encoding used to read the text of a source file

examples.en: The Python handout explained source encoding before showing names with accents.
examples.zh: Python 讲义先介绍了「源文件编码」，再举出带重音符号的名字。

examples.en: The editor reopened the file after I corrected its source encoding setting.
examples.zh: 我修正「源文件编码」设置后，编辑器重新打开了文件。

words.enDefinition: A file storing programming language instructions before their execution or translation

examples.en: I saved the source file before running the exercise in the terminal.
examples.zh: 我先保存「源文件」，再在终端里运行练习程序。

examples.en: The sample source file contained instructions for printing a weekly timetable.
examples.zh: 「源文件」样本含有打印一周课表的指令。

words.enDefinition: A computed value used to check whether the contents of an input file match the recorded copy.

examples.en: The source file checksum matched the one recorded with the public rainfall data we downloaded.
examples.zh: 我们下载的公开降雨量数据的「源文件校验和」与记录的数值一致。

examples.en: We saved the source file checksum next to the input filename in the course archive.
examples.zh: 我们在课程档案中把「源文件校验和」保存在输入文件名旁边。

words.enDefinition: A note that identifies the source of the data in a chart, table, or report.

examples.en: The source note names the municipal dataset used for the example map in our report.
examples.zh: 「来源说明」列出报告示例地图使用的市政数据集名称。

examples.en: We added the edition date to the source note beneath the example library chart.
examples.zh: 我们在示例图书馆图表下方的「来源说明」里加了版本日期。

collocations: cite data in a source note

words.enDefinition: The transport header field identifying the port at the sending endpoint.

examples.en: The source port on the sample request belongs to the browser side of the exchange.
examples.zh: 示例请求的「源端口」属于这次交换中的浏览器一端。

examples.en: For the reply, the worksheet places the browser's source port in the destination field.
examples.zh: 在应答示例里，练习纸把浏览器的「源端口」填入目的端口字段。

words.enDefinition: The chosen starting vertex for computing distances or exploring connections

examples.en: The source vertex represented the entrance at the north end in our example.
examples.zh: 在示例中，「源顶点」表示北端的入口。

examples.en: We changed the source vertex before repeating the shortest path calculation.
examples.zh: 重新计算最短路径前，我们换了「源顶点」。

words.enDefinition: A graph containing relatively few edges among its possible vertex pairs

examples.en: The sparse graph showed few routes between the many rooms in our example.
examples.zh: 示例里的房间很多，「稀疏图」只画出了少量相连的路线。

examples.en: We used a neighbour list for the sparse graph on the worksheet.
examples.zh: 我们用邻居列表表示练习表上的「稀疏图」。

collocations: an adjacency list for a sparse graph

words.enDefinition: a Python method that defines behaviour for built-in language operations

examples.en: The tutor used a Python special method to customise how the sample object was displayed.
examples.zh: 导师用 Python 的「特殊方法」自定义样本对象的显示方式。

examples.en: Our worksheet connected the plus operator to a special method on the example measurement class.
examples.zh: 练习表把加号运算符与示例测量类上的一个「特殊方法」联系起来。

words.enDefinition: The proportion of actual negative examples correctly predicted as negative.

examples.en: The tutor calculated specificity using only leaves that were not oak leaves in the test sample.
examples.zh: 老师仅根据测试样本里的非橡树叶计算「特异度」。

examples.en: The worksheet showed higher specificity when fewer non-oak leaves were incorrectly flagged as oak leaves.
examples.zh: 错误标为橡树叶的非橡树叶变少时，练习表显示「特异度」提升了。

words.enDefinition: To transfer existing nodes within or between linked lists by changing their connections.

examples.en: The classroom example showed how to splice a list into the middle of another list.
examples.zh: 课堂示例演示了怎样在另一个链表的中间「拼接链表节点」。

examples.en: We could splice a list of songs into the playlist without recreating any song entries.
examples.zh: 我们可以把一组歌曲的「链表节点拼接」到播放列表中，无需重新创建歌曲条目。

collocations: splice a list into another list
splice a list without copying its elements
decide where to splice a list

words.enDefinition: to create separate columns from the components stored together in one column

examples.en: We had to split a column that contained both the room code and the time slot.
examples.zh: 有一列同时存放教室编号和时间段，我们必须「拆分一列」。

examples.en: The tutor chose to split a column using the first comma so later commas remained in the notes.
examples.zh: 导师决定用第一个逗号「拆分一列」，这样后面的逗号仍保留在备注里。

collocations: split a column at a delimiter
split a column into two fields

words.enDefinition: a workflow that divides data into groups, applies a function to each group and combines their results

examples.en: The tutor demonstrated split-apply-combine by computing one attendance average for each room in the practice dataset.
examples.zh: 导师对练习数据集中的每间教室各算一个出勤均值，以演示「分组、应用、合并」。

examples.en: Our split-apply-combine workflow kept each site separate until its monthly figures had been calculated.
examples.zh: 我们的「分组、应用、合并」流程先分开各地点，算出各自的月度数字再汇总。

words.enDefinition: A wait returning without the notification or other event it was intended to wait for.

examples.en: The diagram showed a spurious wakeup with no new item available in the classroom queue.
examples.zh: 图中出现了一次「虚假唤醒」，但课堂队列中没有新的可用项。

examples.en: Our tutor explained why a spurious wakeup did not prove that the shared condition was true.
examples.zh: 老师解释了为什么发生「虚假唤醒」不能证明共享条件已经成立。

collocations: check the condition after a spurious wakeup

words.enDefinition: Combining branch changes into a single new commit on the target branch

examples.en: Our group used a squash merge for the two related label corrections.
examples.zh: 我们组把两项相关标签更正放在一起进行「压缩合并」。

examples.en: The squash merge left one new commit in the example history.
examples.zh: 「压缩合并」在示例历史中留下一条新提交。

collocations: a commit created by a squash merge

words.enDefinition: A sort preserving the original relative order of equal keys

examples.en: The stable sort preserved the original order of students with equal scores.
examples.zh: 「稳定排序」保留了同分学生的原有相对顺序。

examples.en: We chose a stable sort so entries with matching dates stayed in order.
examples.zh: 我们选了「稳定排序」，使日期相同的条目保持原有顺序。

collocations: check whether a sort is stable
choose a stable sort for duplicate keys

words.enDefinition: A call stack entry representing one active function or method call

examples.en: I selected a stack frame to see what values that call received.
examples.zh: 我选了一个「栈帧」，查看那次调用接收了哪些值。

examples.en: We checked which stack frame belonged to the helper in our exercise.
examples.zh: 我们核对了哪个「栈帧」对应练习中的辅助函数。

words.enDefinition: Memory used for execution stack storage, such as function-call records and temporary values.

examples.en: The drawing showed separate stack memory for each thread in the two-worker classroom demonstration.
examples.zh: 示意图显示，双工作线程课堂演示中的各线程有独立的「栈内存」。

examples.en: We compared stack memory with the region containing dynamically allocated images in the sample layout.
examples.zh: 我们对比了「栈内存」和示例布局中存放动态分配图片的区域。

collocations: reserve stack memory for a thread

words.enDefinition: a report of frames on a call stack at a particular point, such as when an exception arose

examples.en: The Java stack trace showed which helper method was running when the class exercise raised an exception.
examples.zh: Java 的「调用栈跟踪」显示，课堂练习抛出异常时正在运行哪个辅助方法。

examples.en: I looked through the stack trace to find the first line from my file.
examples.zh: 我查看「调用栈跟踪」，找第一条来自我文件的记录。

collocations: a stack trace for an exception

words.enDefinition: Trying to remove an item from a stack that contains no items.

examples.en: The practice stack reported stack underflow when we tried removing a card after taking the last one.
examples.zh: 我们取走最后一张卡片后又试着取卡，练习用的栈报告「栈下溢」。

examples.en: Our tutor added an empty check so the example could report stack underflow clearly.
examples.zh: 老师加了一个判空检查，让例题能清楚地报告「栈下溢」。

words.enDefinition: A bar chart in which the segments within each bar show parts of its total.

examples.en: The stacked bar chart shows how fiction and nonfiction loans contribute to each month's total.
examples.zh: 「堆叠条形图」显示小说和非小说借阅量分别占月度总量的多少。

examples.en: Our stacked bar chart uses a separate pattern for each section of the sample library.
examples.zh: 我们的「堆叠条形图」用不同的图案表示示例图书馆的各个区域。

words.enDefinition: File versions or edits already selected for the next commit

examples.en: The staged changes included the rewritten heading but excluded the edits to my notes.
examples.zh: 「已暂存的改动」包括重写后的标题，笔记里的编辑没有选进去。

examples.en: We checked the staged changes to see which file would be recorded.
examples.zh: 我们查看「已暂存的改动」，确认哪份文件会被记录。

collocations: compare staged changes with the last commit

words.enDefinition: The place where selected changes are prepared for the next commit

examples.en: The staging area contained only the edits intended for our next commit.
examples.zh: 「暂存区」里只有我们计划放进下次提交的编辑内容。

examples.en: I reviewed the staging area before recording the correction to the sample report.
examples.zh: 我先检查「暂存区」，再记录对报告样本的更正。

collocations: add changes to the staging area
remove a file from the staging area

words.zhGloss: 已过有效期的缓存响应
words.enDefinition: A stored HTTP response whose age has reached or exceeded its freshness lifetime.
acceptedZhAnswers: 已过有效期的缓存响应

examples.en: The diagram marks a stale response once the stored timetable reaches the end of its freshness lifetime.
examples.zh: 缓存的时间表到了新鲜期末尾，示意图便把它标为「已过有效期的缓存响应」。

examples.en: In the second example, the browser checks whether the stale response still matches the current page.
examples.zh: 第二个示例中，浏览器检查「已过有效期的缓存响应」是否仍与当前页面一致。

words.enDefinition: A program's default stream for reporting errors and diagnostic messages

examples.en: The script wrote its file warning to standard error in our example.
examples.zh: 在示例中，脚本把有关文件的警告写到了「标准错误输出」。

examples.en: Our tutor displayed standard error separately from the program's main results.
examples.zh: 导师把「标准错误输出」和程序的主要结果分开显示。

collocations: a message sent to standard error

words.enDefinition: A program's default stream for reading incoming text or other data

examples.en: The exercise read a number from standard input before printing the result.
examples.zh: 练习程序先从「标准输入」读取一个数字，再打印结果。

examples.en: I replaced typed standard input with a file for the same example.
examples.zh: 我对同一个示例改用文件内容作为「标准输入」，原先是手动输入。

words.enDefinition: a module supplied as part of a programming language's standard library

examples.en: We used a standard library module to calculate the number of days between two dates.
examples.zh: 我们用「标准库模块」计算两个日期之间的天数。

examples.en: Our example used a standard library module for generating a summary of the recorded measurements.
examples.zh: 我们的示例用「标准库模块」生成所记录测量值的汇总。

collocations: read the documentation for a standard library module

words.enDefinition: A program's default stream for sending its normal results or messages

examples.en: The sample script wrote the total to standard output after reading both numbers.
examples.zh: 示例脚本读完两个数字后，把合计值写入「标准输出」。

examples.en: We compared standard output with messages printed to the error stream.
examples.zh: 我们把「标准输出」与写入错误流的消息作了比较。

words.enDefinition: to make different spellings or names for the same category use one agreed label

examples.en: We chose to standardise category labels after finding both Library and library in the same list.
examples.zh: 发现同一清单里同时出现 Library 和 library 后，我们决定「统一类别标签」。

examples.en: The exercise asked us to standardise category labels before comparing survey responses across two classes.
examples.zh: 练习要求我们先「统一类别标签」，再比较两个班的问卷答复。

collocations: use a lookup table to standardise category labels

words.enDefinition: Indefinite postponement of a task's access to a resource while other tasks continue making progress.

examples.en: The simulator showed starvation when one eligible job kept waiting while other jobs regularly ran.
examples.zh: 一项符合条件的作业始终等待，而其他作业不断获得运行机会，模拟器展示了「饥饿」。

examples.en: Our tutor discussed starvation after showing a timeline where one task never received a turn.
examples.zh: 老师先展示一项任务从未轮到的时间线，接着讨论了「饥饿」。

collocations: show starvation in a scheduling trace

words.enDefinition: Temporarily store uncommitted edits separately from the current working tree

examples.en: I had to stash changes before opening the tutor's version for comparison.
examples.zh: 我要先「搁置未提交的改动」，才能打开导师的版本作对照。

examples.en: We chose to stash changes while checking the older course example.
examples.zh: 查看较早的课程示例时，我们选择「搁置未提交的改动」。

words.enDefinition: a design delegating behaviour to an object representing the current state

examples.en: The state pattern changed which operations a classroom ticket offered after it was marked used.
examples.zh: 一张课堂示例票标为已使用后，「状态模式」改变了它提供的操作。

examples.en: Our lending model used the state pattern to make returned books available for new loans.
examples.zh: 借阅模型通过「状态模式」，让已经归还的书可以重新借出。

words.enDefinition: a group of statements treated as a unit by a programming language

examples.en: The statement block after the condition runs only when a seat remains available in the example.
examples.zh: 在这个例子中，只有还有空位时才会运行条件后面的「语句块」。

examples.en: She put both updates in the same statement block to run them after a successful lookup.
examples.zh: 她把两个更新放进同一「语句块」，让它们在成功查到结果后执行。

collocations: enclose a statement block in braces

words.enDefinition: The proportion of executable statements exercised during the tests

examples.en: The statement coverage improved after the error message line was executed.
examples.zh: 执行到显示错误消息的语句后，「语句覆盖率」提高了。

examples.en: We calculated statement coverage from the statements marked during the exercise.
examples.zh: 我们根据练习期间标记的语句计算了「语句覆盖率」。

words.enDefinition: a class-level method that supplies an instance to callers

examples.en: The Java sample used a static factory method to create an object from two coordinate values.
examples.zh: Java 样本用「静态工厂方法」根据两个坐标值创建对象。

examples.en: Our tutor showed that the static factory method could return an existing immutable point in the exercise.
examples.zh: 导师展示了练习中的「静态工厂方法」可以返回已有的不可变点对象。

collocations: an instance returned by a static factory method

words.enDefinition: a method associated with a class that can be called without an instance

examples.en: The Java example used a static method to compare two measurements without creating a measurement object.
examples.zh: Java 示例直接用「静态方法」比较两个测量值，不需要先创建测量对象。

examples.en: The Python static method received only the measurement passed by our classroom script.
examples.zh: Python 的「静态方法」只接收课堂脚本显式传入的测量值。

words.enDefinition: a type discipline that assigns and checks types using program information available before ordinary execution

examples.en: The tutor introduced static typing by showing a type mismatch caught before the program ran.
examples.zh: 导师通过一个在程序运行前发现的类型不匹配演示「静态类型机制」。

examples.en: Our class compared static typing across two teaching languages using the same small example.
examples.zh: 我们班用同一个小示例比较两种教学语言中的「静态类型机制」。

words.enDefinition: Measures that reduce the chance that published statistics reveal confidential information about individual units.

examples.en: Statistical disclosure control helps protect confidentiality in the example table of attendance by neighbourhood.
examples.zh: 「统计披露控制」有助于保护示例社区客流表中的信息机密性。

examples.en: The course notes describe statistical disclosure control before introducing the exercise on public summary tables.
examples.zh: 课程讲义先说明「统计披露控制」，再介绍公开汇总表的练习。

collocations: statistical disclosure control for tabular data

words.enDefinition: A category of HTTP responses indicated by the first digit of the status code.

examples.en: The tutor asked which status code class includes the response for a missing catalogue page.
examples.zh: 老师问目录页面不存在时，服务器返回的响应属于哪个「状态码类别」。

examples.en: We recorded the status code class for each response before discussing the individual codes.
examples.zh: 我们讨论各个状态码之前，先记录了每种响应的「状态码类别」。

collocations: group responses by status code class

words.enDefinition: The opening line of an HTTP/1.1 response, containing the protocol version and status code.

examples.en: The status line in this HTTP/1.1 example gives the protocol version and the three-digit code.
examples.zh: 这个 HTTP/1.1 示例的「状态行」给出了协议版本和三位数的状态码。

examples.en: We copied the status line first and then looked at the response headers below it.
examples.zh: 我们先抄下「状态行」，然后看下面的响应首部字段。

words.enDefinition: Follow the current call into the called code using a debugger

examples.en: We chose step into to follow the program into the calculation helper.
examples.zh: 我们选了「单步进入调用」，跟着程序进入计算用的辅助函数。

examples.en: I used step into because I wanted to see the method's first instruction.
examples.zh: 我用了「单步进入调用」，想看到该方法的第一条指令。

words.enDefinition: Run the current debugger line without tracing into its function calls

examples.en: I chose step over to run the call without entering its body.
examples.zh: 我选了「单步跳过」，让调用直接执行完，不进入函数内部。

examples.en: The tutor used step over because we were only checking the caller.
examples.zh: 导师选择「单步跳过」，因为我们只需要检查调用者。

words.enDefinition: A sequence of actions showing how a reported software issue occurs

examples.en: The report listed steps to reproduce for the duplicate title in the preview.
examples.zh: 报告写了预览出现重复标题的「问题复现步骤」。

examples.en: We followed the steps to reproduce using the example's three sample records in class.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂上用示例的三条样本记录按「问题复现步骤」操作。

words.enDefinition: The amount of data transferred by a storage system per unit of time.

examples.en: We measured storage throughput while the practice program copied a large set of sample images.
examples.zh: 练习程序复制一大组样图时，我们测量了「存储吞吐量」。

examples.en: The report gave storage throughput in megabytes per second for each simulated read pattern.
examples.zh: 报告以每秒兆字节给出各模拟读取模式的「存储吞吐量」。

words.enDefinition: a design making alternative algorithms interchangeable through a common interface

examples.en: The strategy pattern let the reading app use different operations for sorting the same titles.
examples.zh: 「策略模式」让阅读应用能用不同方式对同一批标题进行排序。

examples.en: Our tutor switched the selected algorithm during the strategy pattern demonstration without altering the caller.
examples.zh: 导师在「策略模式」演示中切换所选算法，调用方保持不变。

collocations: choose an algorithm through the strategy pattern

words.zhGloss: 分层 K 折交叉验证
words.enDefinition: K-fold validation that aims to keep class proportions similar in each fold.
acceptedZhAnswers: 分层 K 折交叉验证

examples.en: We used stratified k-fold cross-validation because the sample contained far fewer oak leaves than other leaves.
examples.zh: 样本中的橡树叶远少于其他叶片，因此我们使用了「分层 K 折交叉验证」。

examples.en: Our tutor checked whether stratified k-fold cross-validation kept each class represented across the practice folds.
examples.zh: 老师核查了「分层 K 折交叉验证」是否让各类别在各折中都得到覆盖。

collocations: choose a fold count for stratified k-fold cross-validation
inspect class coverage under stratified k-fold cross-validation

words.enDefinition: A partition designed to preserve class proportions approximately across the resulting subsets.

examples.en: We used a stratified split so the rarer plant species still appeared in both portions.
examples.zh: 我们用「分层拆分」，使较少见的植物物种在两部分都仍有样本。

examples.en: Our tutor inspected class counts after the stratified split to confirm the proportions were similar.
examples.zh: 老师在「分层拆分」之后检查各类别的数量，以确认比例接近。

collocations: preserve class proportions with a stratified split
compare a stratified split with an ordinary split

words.enDefinition: The sharing of a single connection by several independent logical streams.

examples.en: The HTTP/2 diagram uses stream multiplexing to carry a page and its stylesheet concurrently.
examples.zh: HTTP/2 示意图用「流多路复用」同时传输一个页面和它的样式表。

examples.en: We coloured each pair of request and response messages separately to show stream multiplexing in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上我们用不同颜色标注各组请求和响应，以展示「流多路复用」。

words.enDefinition: JavaScript equality testing without type coercion

examples.en: The JavaScript worksheet used strict equality to compare a number with a string containing the same digits.
examples.zh: JavaScript 练习表用「严格相等」比较一个数字和包含相同数字字符的字符串。

examples.en: Our tutor asked why strict equality returned false for the two values in the sample.
examples.zh: 导师问，为什么样本中的两个值作「严格相等」比较会得到假。

words.enDefinition: A JavaScript mode enforcing stricter rules for some language behaviour

examples.en: The tutor enabled strict mode before comparing two versions of the JavaScript example.
examples.zh: 导师先启用「严格模式」，再比较 JavaScript 示例的两个版本。

examples.en: We checked which behaviour changed under strict mode in the classroom program.
examples.zh: 我们核对了课堂程序在「严格模式」下哪些行为有变化。

words.enDefinition: joining text sequences end to end

examples.en: The worksheet used string concatenation to join a first name and a surname with a space.
examples.zh: 练习表用「字符串拼接」把名字和姓氏连接起来，中间加一个空格。

examples.en: The JavaScript tutor showed when the plus operator performed string concatenation in the sample.
examples.zh: JavaScript 导师演示了样本中的加号运算符在何时执行「字符串拼接」。

words.enDefinition: a marker showing where a string literal begins or ends

examples.en: The editor highlighted the opening string delimiter after I omitted the closing quote in the example.
examples.zh: 我漏写示例中的结束引号后，编辑器高亮了开头的「字符串定界符」。

examples.en: Our tutor pointed to the backtick used as a string delimiter in the JavaScript demonstration.
examples.zh: 导师指出 JavaScript 演示中作为「字符串定界符」的反引号。

collocations: a quote used as a string delimiter

words.enDefinition: accessing a position in a string using an index

examples.en: The Python example used string indexing to read the first letter of the sample word.
examples.zh: Python 示例通过「字符串索引」读取样本单词的首字母。

examples.en: Our tutor showed how JavaScript string indexing accesses code units in the illustrated example.
examples.zh: 导师演示了 JavaScript「字符串索引」在所示示例中如何访问码元。

words.enDefinition: embedding evaluated values into surrounding text

examples.en: The classroom website used string interpolation to place a name inside its welcome message.
examples.zh: 课堂网站用「字符串插值」在欢迎消息里插入姓名。

examples.en: Our tutor traced string interpolation by showing the expression and the text it produced.
examples.zh: 导师把表达式和它产生的文本一起展示，以追踪「字符串插值」。

collocations: an expression used in string interpolation

words.enDefinition: source notation that directly represents a string

examples.en: The Python worksheet used a string literal to supply the greeting printed by the program.
examples.zh: Python 练习表用「字符串字面量」给出程序打印的问候语。

examples.en: I added the closing quote after the editor marked the unfinished string literal on line three.
examples.zh: 编辑器标出第三行未结束的「字符串字面量」后，我补上了结束引号。

collocations: the end of a string literal

words.enDefinition: A maximal set of mutually reachable vertices in a directed graph

examples.en: The three tasks formed a strongly connected component because each could reach the others.
examples.zh: 三个任务顶点彼此可达，所以组成一个「强连通分量」。

examples.en: We marked the strongly connected component before looking for edges leading outside it.
examples.zh: 我们先标出「强连通分量」，再找通往分量外的边。

collocations: assign vertices to a strongly connected component

words.enDefinition: a design pattern concerned with how objects or classes are organised together

examples.en: The class treated the adapter as a structural pattern for connecting two incompatible interfaces.
examples.zh: 同学们把适配器看作一种用于连接两个不兼容接口的「结构型模式」。

examples.en: Our tutor picked a structural pattern to connect the drawing tool to its old display component.
examples.zh: 导师选用一种「结构型模式」，把绘图工具接到旧的显示组件上。

collocations: an example of a structural pattern

words.enDefinition: A collection of rules that describe how a web document or other structured content should be presented.

examples.en: The stylesheet gives headings and book titles different colours on the example catalogue page.
examples.zh: 「样式表」让示例目录页里的标题和书名用不同颜色显示。

examples.en: Our class moved the colour rules into a separate stylesheet shared by the two sample pages.
examples.zh: 我们班把颜色规则移到独立的「样式表」中，让两个示例页面共用。

words.enDefinition: a class derived from another class through inheritance

examples.en: The worksheet defined a rectangle subclass that reused the sample shape's label handling.
examples.zh: 练习表定义了矩形「子类」，复用样本图形处理标签的逻辑。

examples.en: Our tutor checked which methods the subclass received when it extended the base class.
examples.zh: 导师核对「子类」继承基类时获得了哪些方法。

collocations: override a method in a subclass

words.enDefinition: a nonzero float smaller in magnitude than the smallest normal value

examples.en: The exercise located a subnormal number between zero and the smallest positive normal floating-point number.
examples.zh: 练习在零和最小正正规浮点数之间找到了一个「次正规数」。

examples.en: Our tutor explained why a subnormal number could retain fewer significant bits in the illustrated format.
examples.zh: 导师解释了为什么在所示格式中，「次正规数」可能保留更少的有效位。

words.enDefinition: a query appearing inside another SQL statement

examples.en: The subquery selected the events at the location specified before the outer query counted their bookings.
examples.zh: 外层查询对预订计数之前，「子查询」先选出指定地点举办的活动。

examples.en: We placed the subquery in the condition so the calculation could compare each class with the overall average.
examples.zh: 我们把「子查询」放进条件中，使计算能比较各班与总体平均值。

collocations: nest a subquery inside a statement

words.enDefinition: An additional resource fetched for use by a document or another main resource.

examples.en: The catalogue's stylesheet is a subresource that the browser loads for use by the page.
examples.zh: 目录样式表是浏览器为页面加载的一个「子资源」。

examples.en: The diagram gives each subresource, including the sample cover image, its own row below the document.
examples.zh: 示意图在文档下方分别为每个「子资源」安排一行，其中包括示例封面图片。

words.enDefinition: a contiguous sequence taken from within a string

examples.en: We extracted a substring containing the month from the short date shown in class.
