examples.zh: 我们从课堂展示的简短日期里提取了包含月份的「子字符串」。

examples.en: Our tutor asked whether the same substring appeared twice in the sample word.
examples.zh: 导师问，同一个「子字符串」是否在样本单词中出现了两次。

words.enDefinition: A tree formed by a node and all its descendants

examples.en: The search skipped a subtree whose keys were all too small.
examples.zh: 查找跳过了一棵键值全都太小的「子树」。

examples.en: We drew the subtree separately to see how many nodes remained.
examples.zh: 我们把「子树」单独画出来，看还有多少节点。

words.enDefinition: The number of nodes in a subtree rooted at a given node

examples.en: The subtree size increased when we attached another leaf beneath its root.
examples.zh: 我们在子树根节点下添加一片叶节点后，「子树大小」增加了。

examples.en: We recorded the subtree size next to the highlighted node on our diagram.
examples.zh: 我们在图中高亮的节点旁记录了「子树大小」。

words.enDefinition: a relation allowing values of one type where another type is expected

examples.en: The assignment used subtyping when a specific drawing type was accepted as a general shape.
examples.zh: 在作业中，程序根据「子类型关系」把某个具体绘图类型当作通用图形接收。

examples.en: Our tutor illustrated subtyping with a Java class that implemented the required shape interface.
examples.zh: 导师用实现了所需图形接口的 Java 类说明「子类型关系」。

words.enDefinition: a set of attributes whose combined values uniquely identify a row, whether or not all of them are needed

examples.en: The tutor called the room identifier and name a superkey because the identifier alone already distinguished each row.
examples.zh: 因为单靠房间标识符就能区分各行，导师把标识符和名称的组合称为「超键」。

examples.en: We tested whether the chosen attributes formed a superkey before checking if any of them could be removed.
examples.zh: 我们先检验选出的属性能否组成「超键」，再检查是否可移除其中某些属性。

collocations: check whether an attribute set forms a superkey
distinguish a superkey from a candidate key

words.enDefinition: Learning from examples that include known targets for the model to predict.

examples.en: The plant exercise used supervised learning because each training image came with a species label.
examples.zh: 植物练习使用「监督学习」，因为每张训练图像都带有物种标签。

examples.en: We used supervised learning to predict packing times from records that included the actual durations.
examples.zh: 我们使用「监督学习」，根据记录了实际用时的数据预测打包时长。

collocations: train a model with supervised learning

words.zhGloss: 按类样本数加权的平均值
words.enDefinition: An average of per-class scores weighted by the numbers of actual examples in those classes.
acceptedZhAnswers: 按类样本数加权的平均值

examples.en: The support-weighted average gave the common novel category more influence than the smaller poetry category.
examples.zh: 「按类样本数加权的平均值」让常见的小说类比数量较少的诗歌类产生更大的影响。

examples.en: Our tutor checked the class counts before calculating the support-weighted average for the exercise.
examples.zh: 老师先核对各类别样本数，再计算练习中「按类样本数加权的平均值」。

collocations: compare the support-weighted average with the macro average

words.enDefinition: A character used in a table to indicate that a value has been withheld.

examples.en: The footnote explains that the suppression symbol marks a withheld value in the example table.
examples.zh: 表下注解释「抑制标记」表示示例表中有一个数值未公开。

examples.en: Our class distinguished the suppression symbol from the zero shown for another category.
examples.zh: 全班区分了「抑制标记」和另一个类别显示的零。

words.enDefinition: an introduced identifier whose value has no independent business meaning

examples.en: The database assigned a surrogate key to each book record when it imported the catalogue.
examples.zh: 数据库导入目录时，给每条图书记录分配了一个「代理键」。

examples.en: We kept the public ticket number separate from the surrogate key used internally to identify each sale.
examples.zh: 我们将公开的票号与内部用于识别每笔交易的「代理键」分开。

words.enDefinition: a high and low UTF-16 surrogate in sequence representing a supplementary scalar

examples.en: The exercise used a surrogate pair to represent the supplementary symbol shown on the screen.
examples.zh: 练习用一个「代理对」表示屏幕上显示的补充平面符号。

examples.en: We counted two code units for the surrogate pair in the sample JavaScript string.
examples.zh: 我们在 JavaScript 样本字符串里把一个「代理对」计为两个码元。

collocations: represent a character with a surrogate pair

words.enDefinition: To bring a page back into physical memory from its location in swap storage.

examples.en: The simulator had to swap in a page before the example could read the old value.
examples.zh: 模拟器需要先「将页换入内存」，示例才能读取旧值。

examples.en: We watched the system swap in a page that the program had not accessed recently.
examples.zh: 我们观察到，系统会把程序近期没有访问过的一页「换入内存」。

collocations: swap in a page when requested
swap in a page from disk
wait for the system to swap in a page

words.enDefinition: To move a page from physical memory into swap storage to reclaim its frame.

examples.en: The simulator chose to swap out a page when its available memory frames ran out.
examples.zh: 可用内存页框耗尽时，模拟器选择「将页换出内存」。

examples.en: We drew an arrow to the backing store when the system needed to swap out a page.
examples.zh: 系统需要「将页换出内存」时，我们画了一条指向后备存储的箭头。

collocations: swap out a page under memory pressure
swap out a page to reclaim a frame
decide when to swap out a page

words.enDefinition: Storage set aside to hold memory pages that have been moved out of RAM.

examples.en: The simulator used swap space to keep modified pages after moving them out of physical memory.
examples.zh: 模拟器用「交换空间」保存移出物理内存后仍需保留的已修改页。

examples.en: We checked whether the example had enough swap space before starting the next memory exercise.
examples.zh: 开始下一项内存练习之前，我们检查示例环境的「交换空间」是否充足。

collocations: move a page into swap space

words.enDefinition: Change which branch supplies the files currently checked out

examples.en: I had to switch branches to read the tutor's copy of the example.
examples.zh: 我要「切换分支」才能读到导师那份示例。

examples.en: We planned to switch branches after reviewing the saved edits in class.
examples.zh: 我们计划在课上审阅保存好的编辑后「切换分支」。

words.enDefinition: a statement that selects code to execute from several cases based on a value or pattern

examples.en: The switch statement selected a label based on the category code stored in each product record.
examples.zh: 「switch 多路选择语句」按每条产品记录所存的类别代码来选取标签。

examples.en: We rewrote the switch statement after two groups of products needed to display the same icon.
examples.zh: 两组产品需要显示同一个图标后，我们重写了「switch 多路选择语句」。

collocations: add a case to a switch statement

words.enDefinition: The elements that belong to exactly one of two sets.

examples.en: The symmetric difference contained colours chosen by just one of the two teams in the game.
examples.zh: 「对称差集」包含游戏中仅有其中一队选过的颜色。

examples.en: We compared the symmetric difference with the union before colouring the worksheet's diagram.
examples.zh: 给练习表上的图涂色前，我们对照了「对称差集」和并集。

collocations: take the symmetric difference of two sets

words.enDefinition: Input or output where the initiating call returns the operation's result upon completion.

examples.en: The file example used synchronous I/O, so the worker returned from the call with its result.
examples.zh: 文件示例采用「同步 I/O」，因此工作线程从调用返回时已拿到结果。

examples.en: Our worksheet showed synchronous I/O completing before the example proceeded to display the new record.
examples.zh: 练习表显示，「同步 I/O」完成后，示例才继续显示新记录。

collocations: wait for a synchronous I/O operation

words.enDefinition: A problem caused by code violating a language's grammar

examples.en: The syntax error prevented the incomplete instruction from running in our example.
examples.zh: 在示例中，「语法错误」导致没写完整的指令无法运行。

examples.en: The tutor fixed a syntax error and ran the example again before class.
examples.zh: 课前导师修正了一处「语法错误」，再次运行了示例。

collocations: a syntax error in the file

words.enDefinition: Coloured formatting that makes different parts of code easier to distinguish

examples.en: The syntax highlighting made comments easier to find in the Java example.
examples.zh: 「语法高亮」让 Java 示例里的注释更好找。

examples.en: My syntax highlighting changed after I selected the language for the new file.
examples.zh: 我给新建文件选择语言后，「语法高亮」的显示变了。

words.enDefinition: Artificially generated data used in place of actual observations to serve a particular purpose.

examples.en: The course uses synthetic data to teach plotting without including any actual students' attendance records.
examples.zh: 课程使用「合成数据」教授绘图，示例中没有任何学生的真实出勤记录。

examples.en: We labelled the figures as synthetic data so readers would recognise the numbers as simulated.
examples.zh: 我们标注图中数值来自「合成数据」，让读者知道这些数据是模拟的。

words.enDefinition: A request made by a program for the operating system kernel to perform a service.

examples.en: The example made a system call to request data from the sample file on disk.
examples.zh: 示例通过一次「系统调用」请求磁盘上示例文件中的数据。

examples.en: We followed the system call on the diagram from the application to the operating system.
examples.zh: 我们沿图中的「系统调用」从应用一路追踪到操作系统。

words.enDefinition: A Python exception caused by inconsistent indentation using tabs and spaces

examples.en: A TabError appeared after I pasted lines with inconsistent leading whitespace.
examples.zh: 粘贴了行首空白不一致的几行后，出现了「缩进混用异常」。

examples.en: The TabError led us to inspect how that block was indented.
examples.zh: 「缩进混用异常」让我们去检查那块代码是怎么缩进的。

words.enDefinition: a name assigned in a query to a table reference for use within that query

examples.en: We assigned a table alias to each copy of the same table in our classroom join.
examples.zh: 在课堂联接查询里，同一张表的每处引用都被赋予一个「表别名」。

examples.en: The table alias made it clear which department record supplied the supervisor's name in the result.
examples.zh: 「表别名」明确了结果里的主管姓名来自哪条部门记录。

collocations: refer to a table by a table alias
qualify a column with a table alias

words.enDefinition: combining tables along a selected axis, such as appending rows while aligning columns

examples.en: The table concatenation added February's survey rows beneath January's after checking that the fields matched.
examples.zh: 核查字段一致后，「表拼接」把二月的问卷行添到一月的下方。

examples.en: We used table concatenation to attach two sets of columns with matching row labels in the example.
examples.zh: 在示例中，我们用「表拼接」并排连接两组行标签相同的列。

collocations: check the result of table concatenation

words.enDefinition: the specification of a table's name, columns and relevant constraints

examples.en: The table definition allowed international phone numbers because the contact information was stored as text.
examples.zh: 「表定义」允许录入国际电话号码，因为联系信息以文本形式存储。

examples.en: We reviewed the table definition before choosing where to store the date each workshop had been completed.
examples.zh: 选定在哪里存储各场工作坊的完成日期前，我们检查了「表定义」。

words.enDefinition: data organised into rows and columns where columns normally describe distinct fields

examples.en: We converted the booking log into tabular data with one row for each recorded reservation.
examples.zh: 我们把预订日志转换为「表格数据」，每条已记录预订占一行。

examples.en: The exercise took tabular data from a small catalogue and calculated the number of items in each category.
examples.zh: 练习从一份小型目录读取「表格数据」，计算每个类别的条目数。

words.enDefinition: The node at the end of a linked list, excluding any separate sentinel.

examples.en: The tail node held the last recipe in the practice list before we added another.
examples.zh: 添加新食谱之前，「尾节点」保存了练习列表的最后一个食谱。

examples.en: Our worksheet asked where the tail node would be after deleting the final entry.
examples.zh: 练习表问，删除最后一项后「尾节点」会在哪里。

words.enDefinition: A pointer or reference to the end of a linked list.

examples.en: We kept a tail pointer so the example could find the last node without walking the list.
examples.zh: 我们保留了一个「尾指针」，让例题不必遍历链表就能找到最后一个节点。

examples.en: Our tutor changed the tail pointer after appending a new book to the practice list.
examples.zh: 在练习链表末尾加了一本书后，老师更新了「尾指针」。

words.enDefinition: A chart title that states the main finding the author wants readers to notice.

examples.en: The takeaway title tells readers that library visits nearly doubled during the final week.
examples.zh: 「结论式图表标题」告诉读者，最后一周的图书馆到访量几乎翻倍。

examples.en: We wrote a takeaway title after checking whether the chart supported our main point.
examples.zh: 确认图表能支持主要观点后，我们写了一个「结论式图表标题」。

words.enDefinition: Use of a feature that reveals the outcome through information unavailable at prediction time.

examples.en: The tutor found target leakage because the predictor used a completion note written after the task ended.
examples.zh: 老师发现了「目标泄漏」，因为预测模型用了任务结束后才写下的完成记录。

examples.en: We removed a column that directly encoded the final category after identifying target leakage in the exercise.
examples.zh: 在练习中识别出「目标泄漏」后，我们移除了直接编码最终类别的一列。

collocations: remove a feature causing target leakage

words.enDefinition: The quantity or category a supervised model is trained to predict.

examples.en: The target variable was the number of minutes needed to finish sorting each batch of books.
examples.zh: 「目标变量」是完成每批图书分拣所需的分钟数。

examples.en: Our tutor asked us to write down the target variable before we selected the input features.
examples.zh: 老师要求我们先写出「目标变量」，再选择输入特征。

words.enDefinition: a TCP header field containing the next sequence number expected by the endpoint sending the acknowledgment, when that field is valid

examples.en: The TCP acknowledgment number on the slide identifies the next byte expected by the receiver.
examples.zh: 幻灯片中的「TCP 确认号」标识接收方期待的下一个字节。

examples.en: We compared the TCP acknowledgment number with the sequence numbers marked in the earlier diagram.
examples.zh: 我们把「TCP 确认号」与前一张图中标出的序列号作了比较。

words.enDefinition: The usual three-message exchange that establishes a TCP connection and synchronizes initial sequence numbers.

examples.en: We numbered the arrows of the TCP handshake on the worksheet before discussing the data transfer.
examples.zh: 我们讨论数据传输前，先给练习纸上「TCP 握手」的箭头编号。

examples.en: The TCP handshake appears above the first catalogue request in the protocol sequence diagram.
examples.zh: 在协议时序图中，「TCP 握手」画在首次目录请求的上方。

words.enDefinition: A unit sent by TCP that includes a TCP header and may also carry stream bytes.

examples.en: One TCP segment in the classroom diagram carries the first part of the catalogue response.
examples.zh: 课堂图中的一个「TCP 报文段」承载目录响应的第一部分。

examples.en: We compared a TCP segment carrying data with one containing only control information in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们比较了承载数据的「TCP 报文段」和只含控制信息的报文段。

words.enDefinition: A TCP header value that identifies a position in the numbered stream of bytes.

examples.en: The TCP sequence number in this example marks the first byte carried by the segment.
examples.zh: 例子中的「TCP 序列号」标识该报文段携带的第一个字节。

examples.en: The worksheet asks how the TCP sequence number changes after the next block of data.
examples.zh: 练习题问的是传输下一块数据后，「TCP 序列号」会如何变化。

words.enDefinition: JavaScript backtick syntax for strings with optional embedded expressions

examples.en: The JavaScript example used a template literal to insert the score into a short message.
examples.zh: JavaScript 示例用「模板字面量」把分数放进一条简短消息。

examples.en: Our tutor showed how the template literal kept the line break in the sample greeting.
examples.zh: 导师演示了「模板字面量」如何保留样本问候语里的换行。

collocations: an expression inside a template literal

words.enDefinition: a design keeping an operation's main sequence while subclasses supply selected steps

examples.en: The template method pattern kept the worksheet's steps in order while each subclass supplied different questions.
examples.zh: 「模板方法模式」保持练习表步骤的顺序，让各子类提供不同题目。

examples.en: Our tutor marked the shared steps before applying the template method pattern to the sample.
examples.zh: 导师先标出共用步骤，再将「模板方法模式」应用到样本。

collocations: shared steps in a template method pattern

words.enDefinition: The best distance found so far before it is confirmed

examples.en: The tentative distance fell when we found a shorter route through another room.
examples.zh: 我们找到一条经由另一房间的更短路线后，「暂定距离」降低了。

examples.en: I copied the tentative distance for each place before processing the next vertex.
examples.zh: 处理下一个顶点前，我抄下了各地点的「暂定距离」。

words.enDefinition: Finish program execution without being stopped by an exception or interruption

examples.en: The example could terminate normally after printing the final line of results.
examples.zh: 示例打印最后一行结果后就能「正常结束」。

examples.en: Our tutor watched the short program terminate normally after it completed the calculation.
examples.zh: 导师看着这个短程序做完计算后「正常结束」。

collocations: expect a program to terminate normally

words.enDefinition: Reasoning that an algorithm must eventually stop on allowed inputs

examples.en: The termination argument showed that the search interval shrank on every iteration.
examples.zh: 「终止性论证」说明，每轮迭代都会缩小查找区间。

examples.en: Our tutor asked for a termination argument after checking what the loop preserved.
examples.zh: 导师检查了循环保持的性质之后，要求给出「终止性论证」。

collocations: a termination argument for a loop

words.enDefinition: A check in a test specifying a condition that must hold

examples.en: The test assertion checked that the exported table contained the stored room name.
examples.zh: 「测试断言」检查导出的表格是否包含已存的房间名。

examples.en: We placed one test assertion after the example called the date helper.
examples.zh: 示例调用日期辅助函数后，我们加了一条「测试断言」。

words.enDefinition: Settings determining how a framework chooses and runs software checks

examples.en: I changed the test configuration to include the folder with file checks.
examples.zh: 我改了「测试配置」，把含文件检查的文件夹也加进去。

examples.en: The test configuration controlled which checks ran when class began.
examples.zh: 「测试配置」控制上课时执行哪些检查。

words.enDefinition: The extent to which a set of tests exercises specified software parts

examples.en: We checked test coverage after adding tests for both date formats.
examples.zh: 添加两种日期格式的测试后，我们核对了「测试覆盖程度」。

examples.en: The tutor explained how test coverage related to the paths tested.
examples.zh: 导师讲了「测试覆盖程度」与实际测试过的路径有何关系。

words.enDefinition: Input values or example records used to check software behaviour

examples.en: Our test data included a single room and bookings on two dates.
examples.zh: 我们的「测试数据」只有一个房间，以及两个日期的预订。

examples.en: I kept test data in a separate folder for the course exercises.
examples.zh: 我把课程练习的「测试数据」放在单独的文件夹里。

words.enDefinition: The process of locating tests available to run in a project

examples.en: The editor showed two checks after test discovery finished for the example project.
examples.zh: 示例项目的「测试发现」结束后，编辑器显示了两项检查。

examples.en: We checked the file name when test discovery failed to find our test.
examples.zh: 「测试发现」没找到我们的测试时，我们检查了文件名。

words.enDefinition: A replacement for a real dependency used during software testing

examples.en: The test double provided a predictable clock time for the schedule formatter.
examples.zh: 「测试替身」向日程格式化器提供了一个可预期的时刻。

examples.en: Our tutor inserted a test double where the program usually requested a record.
examples.zh: 导师在程序通常会请求记录的位置放入了一个「测试替身」。

collocations: replace a service with a test double

words.enDefinition: The software, settings, and resources used while running a test

examples.en: The test environment stored the sample records in a separate temporary folder.
examples.zh: 「测试环境」把样本记录存放在一个独立的临时文件夹中。

examples.en: Our group checked which interpreter was installed in the test environment.
examples.zh: 我们组检查了「测试环境」安装的是哪个解释器。

words.enDefinition: Prepared data, objects, or state that tests can use reliably

examples.en: The test fixture supplied the same sample schedule to both file checks.
examples.zh: 「测试夹具」给两项文件检查提供了同一份日程样本。

examples.en: Our tutor created a test fixture containing three records for the report tests.
examples.zh: 导师为报告测试创建了一个包含三条记录的「测试夹具」。

collocations: provide data through a test fixture

words.enDefinition: A function containing an executable software check or group of checks

examples.en: The test function checked how the converter handled dates in two different years.
examples.zh: 「测试函数」检查换算器如何处理两个不同年份的日期。

examples.en: I kept the second test function separate because it examined a different behaviour.
examples.zh: 我保留了独立的第二个「测试函数」，因为它检查的是另一种行为。

words.enDefinition: Keeping a test independent of state changes caused by other tests

examples.en: We improved test isolation by starting each check with a fresh schedule.
examples.zh: 我们让每项检查都从一张新的日程表开始，改善了「测试隔离」。

examples.en: The lesson illustrated test isolation by running the two checks in either order.
examples.zh: 这节课通过用两种顺序运行同样两项检查来说明「测试隔离」。

words.enDefinition: A table of combinations of conditions under which tests will run

examples.en: The test matrix listed two browsers and two sizes for the exercise.
examples.zh: 这项练习的「测试矩阵」列出了两种浏览器和两种尺寸。

examples.en: We compared which combinations had been tested against the test matrix.
examples.zh: 我们对照「测试矩阵」，看看哪些组合已经测试过。

collocations: a row of the test matrix

words.enDefinition: A source or method identifying whether a test result is correct

examples.en: The manual calculation served as a test oracle for the example program.
examples.zh: 手算结果是示例程序的「测试判定依据」。

examples.en: We chose an independent spreadsheet as the test oracle for the comparison.
examples.zh: 我们选择一份独立电子表格作为比对时的「测试判定依据」。

collocations: the output of a test oracle

words.enDefinition: A condition in which test results depend on their execution order

examples.en: We found test order dependence when both checks reused the same editable schedule.
examples.zh: 两个检查复用同一张可编辑日程表时，我们发现了「测试顺序依赖」。

examples.en: The report described test order dependence after reversing the positions of two tests.
examples.zh: 报告在对换两项测试的位置后指出了「测试顺序依赖」。

words.enDefinition: A document or output summarising tests executed and their outcomes

examples.en: The test report listed the skipped checks below the passing ones.
examples.zh: 「测试报告」把跳过的检查列在通过的检查下方。

examples.en: I opened the test report to see which formatting example had failed.
examples.zh: 我打开「测试报告」，看是哪个格式示例没通过。

words.enDefinition: One execution of a selected collection of software tests

examples.en: The test run took longer after we added two file handling checks.
examples.zh: 添加两项文件处理检查后，「一轮测试执行」花的时间更长了。

examples.en: I saved the results from a test run before changing the example data.
examples.zh: 修改示例数据之前，我保存了「一轮测试执行」的结果。

words.enDefinition: Software that runs tests and reports their statuses or results

examples.en: The test runner listed several checks that completed before the class ended.
examples.zh: 「测试运行器」列出了下课前完成的几项检查。

examples.en: We used a test runner to execute only the checks for date formatting.
examples.zh: 我们用「测试运行器」只执行日期格式相关检查。

words.enDefinition: A set of examples reserved for assessing a model after development and selection are complete.

examples.en: We left the test set untouched until the library classification model and its settings were settled.
examples.zh: 我们保持「测试集」未被使用，直到图书馆分类模型及其设置确定下来。

examples.en: The report gave the accuracy on the test set after selecting the final leaf classifier.
examples.zh: 选定最终的叶片分类器后，报告给出了模型在「测试集」上的准确率。

words.enDefinition: Work done before a test to prepare the conditions it needs

examples.en: During test setup, we created a blank schedule before checking how the application handled a new entry.
examples.zh: 「测试准备」期间，我们创建一张空白日程表，再检查应用如何处理新条目。

examples.en: I moved the sample directory creation into test setup for the file tests.
examples.zh: 我把创建示例目录的操作移到了文件测试的「测试准备」阶段。

words.enDefinition: A replacement dependency returning predetermined responses for a test

examples.en: The test stub returned a fixed room name whenever the example requested one.
examples.zh: 示例每次请求房间名时，「测试桩」都返回一个固定名称。

examples.en: We changed the test stub to return an empty list for another check.
examples.zh: 我们修改了「测试桩」，让它为另一项检查返回空列表。

collocations: replace a dependency with a test stub
a fixed response from a test stub

words.enDefinition: Work done after a test to release resources or restore state

examples.en: The temporary report disappeared during test teardown after the test recorded its result.
examples.zh: 测试记录结果后，临时报告在「测试清理」阶段被删除。

examples.en: Our test teardown returned the settings to their original values before the next check.
examples.zh: 下一项检查开始前，我们的「测试清理」把设置恢复为原值。

words.enDefinition: A result indicating that a test exceeded its allowed execution time

examples.en: The report showed a test timeout while the exercise waited for a file.
examples.zh: 练习等待文件时，报告显示出现了「测试超时」。

examples.en: We checked which calculation had caused the test timeout on the shared machine.
examples.zh: 我们查看是哪项计算在共用机器上导致了「测试超时」。

collocations: a test timeout in a report

words.enDefinition: A file mode treating content as characters through decoding or encoding

examples.en: The program opened the names file in text mode for the exercise.
examples.zh: 在练习中，程序以「文本模式」打开姓名文件。

examples.en: Our tutor explained why text mode returned readable characters from the file.
examples.zh: 导师解释了为什么「文本模式」从文件读出的是可读字符。

collocations: open a file in text mode
read a file in text mode

words.enDefinition: an ordered sequence of units representing text

examples.en: The classroom program stored the student's short display name as a text string.
examples.zh: 课堂程序把学生的简短显示名称存为「文本字符串」。

examples.en: Our tutor drew a text string as a row of adjacent positions on the board.
examples.zh: 导师在黑板上把「文本字符串」画成了一排相邻的位置。

words.enDefinition: a normal form allowing a nontrivial dependency only when its determinant is a superkey or its dependent attribute is part of a candidate key

examples.en: The tutor used third normal form to explain why storing the building address in each booking caused redundancy.
examples.zh: 导师用「第三范式」说明为何在每条预订里保存楼宇地址会造成冗余。

examples.en: We checked each proposed table for third normal form using the dependencies recorded beside the class diagram.
examples.zh: 我们用课堂图旁列出的依赖，检查各拟定表是否符合「第三范式」。

collocations: decompose a relation into third normal form
check dependencies against third normal form

words.enDefinition: the association determining the value of this in a JavaScript call

examples.en: The worksheet traced how the call to a JavaScript method determined its this binding.
examples.zh: 练习表追踪了 JavaScript 方法调用如何确定「this 绑定」。

examples.en: Our tutor compared the this binding in a normal call with an explicitly bound call.
examples.zh: 导师把正常调用和显式绑定调用中的「this 绑定」作了比较。

collocations: the this binding of a JavaScript method

words.enDefinition: A value that distinguishes a thread within the scope defined by its operating system or runtime.

examples.en: The program printed a thread identifier beside each completed photo conversion in the example log.
examples.zh: 程序在示例日志中每项已完成的照片转换旁打印了「线程标识符」。

examples.en: We used the thread identifier to tell which worker had produced each line in the report.
examples.zh: 我们用「线程标识符」判断是哪个工作线程生成了报告中的各行。

collocations: match output to a thread identifier

words.enDefinition: Storage giving each thread its own instance of a variable or value.

examples.en: The example used thread-local storage to keep each worker's temporary counter separate from the others.
examples.zh: 例题使用「线程局部存储」为各条工作线程分别保存临时计数器。

examples.en: Our tutor showed why one worker's update to thread-local storage did not change another worker's value.
examples.zh: 老师演示了为什么某条工作线程更新「线程局部存储」后，另一条线程的值不会改变。

collocations: read a value from thread-local storage
store a counter in thread-local storage

words.enDefinition: A sequence of instructions that can be scheduled independently within a process.

examples.en: Each thread of execution had a separate position in the code shown in the diagram.
examples.zh: 在图示代码中，每个「执行线程」都有自己独立的执行位置。

examples.en: The sample app used a separate thread of execution to prepare a preview while editing continued.
examples.zh: 示例应用使用另一个「执行线程」准备预览，让编辑工作可以继续。

words.enDefinition: A group of threads managed together to take on tasks, usually with workers reused between tasks.

examples.en: The thread pool reused the same workers to resize several batches of sample photographs.
examples.zh: 「线程池」重复使用同一批工作线程来调整几批示例照片的大小。

examples.en: Our tutor showed how one thread pool handled jobs from two different parts of the application.
examples.zh: 老师展示了一个「线程池」怎样处理应用中两个不同部分提交的作业。

collocations: submit a task to a thread pool

words.enDefinition: Correct behavior when an object or operation is used concurrently according to its documented rules.

examples.en: The library notes explained thread safety for the collection used by both workers in the exercise.
examples.zh: 库文档说明了练习中两条工作线程共用的集合的「线程安全」特性。

examples.en: We reviewed thread safety before allowing several workers to use the sample results object together.
examples.zh: 让多条工作线程同时使用示例结果对象前，我们检查了它的「线程安全」特性。

collocations: discuss the thread safety of an object

words.enDefinition: a logic with true, false and unknown as possible outcomes, as used in SQL conditions

examples.en: The tutor explained three-valued logic after a comparison with a missing score returned an unknown result.
examples.zh: 一次与缺失分数的比较返回未知结果后，导师讲解了「三值逻辑」。

examples.en: We used three-valued logic to predict which rows survived a filter containing two comparisons joined by AND.
examples.zh: 我们用「三值逻辑」预测筛选条件把两个比较用 AND 连接时会保留哪些行。

collocations: reason about nulls with three-valued logic

words.enDefinition: Merging two versions using their common ancestor as a third input

examples.en: The three-way merge used the shared earlier version to compare both edits.
examples.zh: 「三方合并」用双方共用的早期版本来比较两项编辑。

examples.en: We drew three snapshots before explaining the three-way merge in class.
examples.zh: 我们在课上先画了三份快照，再讲解「三方合并」。

collocations: a common ancestor in a three-way merge

words.enDefinition: The printed number or category name next to a marked position on an axis.

examples.en: The last tick label shows December at the far right of the rainfall graph.
examples.zh: 降雨量图最右侧的「刻度标签」显示十二月。

examples.en: The tutor shortened a tick label because it overlapped the next month on the axis.
examples.zh: 一个「刻度标签」与轴上下一个月份的文字重叠了，老师便缩短了它。

words.enDefinition: A small line on an axis marking a position on its scale.

examples.en: Each tick mark on the plot shows a ten-minute step on the time scale.
examples.zh: 图上每条「刻度线」表示时间标度上的十分钟间隔。

examples.en: We added a tick mark at zero to make the baseline easier to locate.
examples.zh: 我们在零处加了一条「刻度线」，让基线更容易找到。

words.enDefinition: data arranged so each variable has a column, each observation has a row and each value has a cell

examples.en: The tutor showed tidy data with one row per measurement and separate columns for the value and unit.
examples.zh: 导师展示了「整齐数据」，每次测量各占一行，数值和单位分别占列。

examples.en: We checked whether the table qualified as tidy data after splitting a combined date and score column.
examples.zh: 拆开同时存日期和分数的一列后，我们检查表是否符合「整齐数据」的要求。

collocations: organise a dataset as tidy data
explain the principles of tidy data
convert a table to tidy data

words.enDefinition: a secondary sorting column used to order rows whose earlier sort values are equal

examples.en: We added a tie-breaker column to show events sharing a start time in a predictable order.
examples.zh: 我们增加「用于打破并列的列」，使两个同一时间开始的活动每次都按可预测的顺序显示。

examples.en: The tie-breaker column used each catalogue number to resolve entries with identical publication years in the result.
examples.zh: 查询结果中的出版年份相同时，「用于打破并列的列」按目录编号决定顺序。

words.zhGloss: 按时间确定的滚动窗口
words.enDefinition: a moving group of observations selected by elapsed time rather than by a fixed number of rows
acceptedZhAnswers: 按时间确定的滚动窗口

examples.en: The time-based rolling window included all readings during the previous hour even when some readings were delayed.
examples.zh: 「按时间确定的滚动窗口」包含过去一小时内的所有读数，即使有些读数延迟了。

examples.en: We chose a time-based rolling window because the intervals between measurements were different across the files.
examples.zh: 各文件的测量间隔不同，因此我们采用「按时间确定的滚动窗口」。

collocations: set the duration of a time-based rolling window
compare time-based and count-based rolling windows

words.enDefinition: A partition that respects the time order, training on earlier observations and evaluating on later ones.

examples.en: We used a time-series split so the model trained on earlier weeks and predicted later ones.
examples.zh: 我们用「时间序列拆分」，让模型在较早几周的数据上训练，再预测之后几周。

examples.en: The tutor checked the dates in the time-series split before we compared the forecast errors.
examples.zh: 老师核对了「时间序列拆分」中的日期，我们随后比较预测误差。

collocations: use a time-series split for evaluation
check the dates in a time-series split

words.enDefinition: The limited interval during which a scheduler allows a task to run before reconsidering its choice.

examples.en: Each simulated task got a time slice before the next eligible task could take its turn.
examples.zh: 下一项符合条件的任务轮到之前，每项模拟任务都有一个「时间片」。

examples.en: Our worksheet changed the time slice to show how often the simulator switched between the two tasks.
examples.zh: 练习表改变「时间片」的长度，展示模拟器在两项任务之间的切换频率。

collocations: choose the length of a time slice

words.enDefinition: the level of time detail recorded or represented by a timestamp

examples.en: The timestamp granularity was one minute, so the example could not order events within the same minute.
examples.zh: 「时间戳粒度」是一分钟，因此示例不能确定同一分钟内各事件的顺序。

examples.en: We checked timestamp granularity before comparing logs from a device that reported only the current hour.
examples.zh: 与一台只报告当前小时的设备日志比较之前，我们核对了「时间戳粒度」。

words.enDefinition: a timestamp carrying timezone or offset information that can identify an instant when interpreted under the applicable rules

examples.en: We stored a timezone-aware timestamp so readings collected abroad could be placed on the same timeline.
examples.zh: 我们存储「带时区信息的时间戳」，让在海外采集的读数也能排在同一时间轴上。

examples.en: The tutor converted a timezone-aware timestamp to UTC before comparing it with the time in another file.
examples.zh: 导师将「带时区信息的时间戳」转换为 UTC，再与另一文件中的时间比较。

words.enDefinition: Finding the requested address translation in the processor's translation lookaside buffer.

examples.en: The simulator recorded a TLB hit when the next access reused the same cached translation.
examples.zh: 下一次访问复用同一个缓存的地址转换结果时，模拟器记录了一次「地址转换缓存命中」。

examples.en: Our tutor used a TLB hit to explain why a page table lookup could be skipped.
examples.zh: 老师用「地址转换缓存命中」解释为什么可以跳过一次页表查询。

words.enDefinition: Failing to find a requested address translation in the processor's translation lookaside buffer.

examples.en: A TLB miss occurred because the simulator had no cached translation for the new page.
examples.zh: 由于模拟器没有缓存新页的地址转换结果，发生了一次「地址转换缓存未命中」。

examples.en: We traced the additional lookup after a TLB miss in the classroom memory exercise.
examples.zh: 在课堂内存练习中，我们跟踪了「地址转换缓存未命中」后的额外查询。

words.enDefinition: A check accepting numeric results within a permitted difference from expectation

examples.en: Our tolerance-based assertion allowed a small difference after the two conversions.
examples.zh: 两次换算后，我们的「按容差判断的断言」允许有少量偏差。

examples.en: The tutor chose a tolerance-based assertion for the exercise with decimal measurements.
examples.zh: 导师为含小数测量值的练习选择了「按容差判断的断言」。

collocations: set a limit for a tolerance-based assertion

words.enDefinition: Instructions written outside the bodies of defined functions or classes

examples.en: The top-level code in the example printed a banner when the file ran.
examples.zh: 运行文件时，示例中的「顶层代码」打印了一条横幅消息。

examples.en: We moved the second print instruction out of the top-level code.
examples.zh: 我们把第二条打印指令移出了「顶层代码」。

collocations: place a statement in top-level code

words.enDefinition: The end of a stack where items are added, inspected, and removed.

examples.en: The last score we entered appeared at the top of the stack in the diagram.
examples.zh: 我们最后输入的分数显示在图中的「栈顶」。

examples.en: Our example checked the top of the stack before deciding whether to remove the card.
examples.zh: 例题先查看「栈顶」，再决定是否取出那张卡片。

collocations: read the top of the stack
add an item to the top of the stack
remove an item from the top of the stack

words.enDefinition: Ordering vertices so each directed edge points from earlier to later

examples.en: The topological sort put all prerequisite tasks before the tasks requiring them.
examples.zh: 「拓扑排序」把所有前置任务排在依赖它们的任务之前。

examples.en: We tried a topological sort after checking the dependency diagram for cycles.
examples.zh: 我们先检查依赖关系图中有没有环，再试做「拓扑排序」。

words.enDefinition: The guarantee that an algorithm terminates and meets its specification

examples.en: The final proof combined two arguments to show total correctness for the loop.
examples.zh: 最后的证明合并两个论证，说明该循环满足「完全正确性」。

examples.en: For total correctness, we needed to show that execution terminated on every allowed input.
examples.zh: 为证明「完全正确性」，我们需要说明每种有效输入都能让程序结束。

words.enDefinition: A Python error report showing calls leading up to an exception

examples.en: The traceback pointed to my exercise file and a particular line.
examples.zh: 「Python 异常回溯」指明了我的练习文件和其中的一行。

examples.en: Our tutor read the traceback to see how the calls were connected.
examples.zh: 导师读了「Python 异常回溯」，了解各次调用之间的关系。

collocations: examine the last line of a traceback

words.enDefinition: A newline character at the end of some text or output

examples.en: The comparison highlighted a missing trailing newline at the end of the file.
examples.zh: 比较结果标出了文件最后缺少的「末尾换行符」。

examples.en: I kept the trailing newline when comparing what both examples had printed.
examples.zh: 比较两个示例打印的内容时，我保留了「末尾换行符」。

words.enDefinition: Partitioning observations into separate portions for fitting and final evaluation.

examples.en: We made a train-test split before fitting the model to the workshop completion records.
examples.zh: 我们先进行了「训练与测试拆分」，才用工作坊完成记录拟合模型。

examples.en: Our tutor checked the train-test split to verify that no plant appeared in both portions.
examples.zh: 老师检查「训练与测试拆分」，确认没有任何一株植物同时出现在两部分。

collocations: check a train-test split for overlap
use the same train-test split for comparisons

words.enDefinition: One full pass through the training examples during a fitting procedure.

examples.en: The report showed the classifier's loss after each training epoch in the leaf recognition exercise.
examples.zh: 报告展示了叶片识别练习中每个「训练轮次」之后分类器的损失。

examples.en: One training epoch took longer after we added more book descriptions to the practice dataset.
examples.zh: 把更多图书描述加入练习数据集后，一个「训练轮次」用时更长了。

collocations: evaluate the model after a training epoch

words.enDefinition: An individual observation used to fit a model, optionally paired with a target.

examples.en: Each training example recorded the number of books sorted and the time required to sort them.
examples.zh: 每条「训练样本」记录了分拣的图书数量和所需时间。

examples.en: Our tutor removed one training example after discovering that it belonged to the practice test set.
examples.zh: 老师发现其中一条「训练样本」属于练习测试集，于是将其移除。

words.enDefinition: Loss evaluated on observations used to fit the model.

examples.en: The training loss dropped as the model's predicted sorting times approached the recorded training values.
examples.zh: 随着模型预测的分拣时间接近训练数据中的实测用时，「训练损失」下降了。

examples.en: Our report listed training loss separately from errors measured on the held-out examples.
examples.zh: 报告把「训练损失」与在留出样本上测得的误差分开列出。

words.enDefinition: The portion of a dataset used to fit a model's learned parameters.

examples.en: We used the training set to fit a model that predicted sorting times for book batches.
examples.zh: 我们用「训练集」拟合一个预测每批图书分拣用时的模型。

examples.en: The training set contained photographs from six different garden beds in our classroom exercise.
examples.zh: 课堂练习的「训练集」含有六块不同花坛的照片。

collocations: reserve examples outside the training set

words.enDefinition: the point where a unit of database work begins or ends

examples.en: The diagram marked the transaction boundary after the final change and before the classroom connection closed.
examples.zh: 示意图在最后一项更改之后、课堂数据库连接关闭之前标出了「事务边界」。

examples.en: We moved the transaction boundary to include the two timetable updates in the same unit of work.
examples.zh: 我们移动了「事务边界」，把两项日程更新纳入同一个工作单元。

words.enDefinition: successfully ending a transaction and making its changes permanent according to the database's guarantees

examples.en: After the transaction commit, the other session saw our updates in its next read committed query.
examples.zh: 「事务提交」后，另一个会话在下一条读已提交查询中看到了我们更新的数据。

examples.en: Our diagram showed a transaction commit after both new catalogue entries had passed the usual checks.
examples.zh: 示意图在两条新目录记录通过常规检查后标出了「事务提交」。

words.enDefinition: the rules governing how concurrent transactions observe each other's work and which interactions are allowed

examples.en: The class compared transaction isolation settings using two sessions on a small database of invented room bookings.
examples.zh: 同学们在存有虚构房间预订的小型数据库上开了两个会话，比较「事务隔离」设置。

examples.en: The tutor explained transaction isolation after two readers saw different versions of the same sample record.
examples.zh: 两个读取方看到同一示例记录的不同版本后，导师解释了「事务隔离」。

words.enDefinition: undoing the uncommitted effects of a database transaction

examples.en: The transaction rollback removed both draft updates after the second one failed a check in the practice exercise.
examples.zh: 练习中的第二项更新没通过检查，「事务回滚」撤销了两项草稿更新。

examples.en: We used a transaction rollback to return the temporary practice table to its initial state after testing.
examples.zh: 测试后，我们用「事务回滚」让临时练习表恢复到初始状态。

collocations: explain the effects of transaction rollback

words.enDefinition: a view identifying which row versions from other transactions can be seen at a particular point

examples.en: The transaction snapshot let our query read consistent table versions while another practice session added data.
examples.zh: 另一练习会话新增数据时，「事务快照」让课堂查询能读取各表一致的版本。

examples.en: We checked whether both catalogue lookups used the same transaction snapshot within the example transaction.
examples.zh: 我们检查示例事务内的两次目录查找是否使用同一个「事务快照」。

collocations: maintain a transaction snapshot for a transaction

words.enDefinition: an indirect functional dependency in which one determinant reaches an attribute through an intermediate set of attributes

examples.en: The tutor illustrated a transitive dependency with a room code determining a building code and then its address.
examples.zh: 导师用房间编号确定楼宇编号、楼宇编号再确定地址的例子说明「传递函数依赖」。

examples.en: We removed the transitive dependency by recording the building address only in the table listing buildings.
examples.zh: 我们只在楼宇清单表里记录楼宇地址，从而消除了「传递函数依赖」。

words.enDefinition: A processor cache that stores recently used virtual-to-physical address translations.

examples.en: The translation lookaside buffer already held the mapping for the next access in the example.
examples.zh: 「地址转换后备缓冲器」已经存着例题下一次访问所用的映射。

examples.en: Our diagram placed the translation lookaside buffer beside the processor that used its cached translations.
examples.zh: 图中把「地址转换后备缓冲器」画在使用其缓存转换结果的处理器旁。

collocations: cache mappings in a translation lookaside buffer
a hit in the translation lookaside buffer

words.enDefinition: The Internet transport protocol that provides applications with a reliable, ordered stream of bytes.

examples.en: The Transmission Control Protocol gives the catalogue application an ordered stream of response bytes.
examples.zh: 「传输控制协议」为目录应用提供有序的响应字节流。

examples.en: Our worksheet compares the Transmission Control Protocol with a protocol that preserves individual messages.
examples.zh: 练习纸把「传输控制协议」和一种保留独立消息的协议作了比较。

words.enDefinition: The time required to put all the bits of a packet onto a link.

examples.en: The transmission delay grows when the packet contains more bits at the same link rate.
examples.zh: 在链路速率相同的情况下，数据包包含更多比特时，「传输时延」随之增加。

examples.en: We calculated the transmission delay using the packet length and the link rate on the worksheet.
examples.zh: 我们用练习纸上的包长度和链路速率计算了「传输时延」。

words.enDefinition: The layer that provides communication between applications on different endpoints.

examples.en: Our diagram places the transport layer between the application layer and the network layer.
examples.zh: 图中把「传输层」画在应用层和网络层之间。

examples.en: The transport layer can offer different delivery guarantees depending on which protocol is used.
examples.zh: 使用的协议不同，「传输层」所提供的交付保证也会不同。

words.enDefinition: A numbered identifier that helps a transport protocol direct traffic to the appropriate application endpoint.

examples.en: The transport port in the diagram helps direct the request to the catalogue application.
examples.zh: 图中的「传输层端口」帮助把请求交给目录应用。

examples.en: We labelled the transport port beside the interface address in our classroom networking diagram.
examples.zh: 在课堂网络图中，我们在接口地址旁标出了「传输层端口」。

words.enDefinition: To visit the nodes of a linked list in sequence by following their links.

examples.en: We needed to traverse a linked list to print the stored names in their recorded order.
examples.zh: 为了按记录顺序输出已存姓名，我们需要「遍历链表」。

examples.en: Our tutor showed how to traverse a linked list from its first node to its last.
examples.zh: 老师演示了怎样从第一个节点到最后一个节点「遍历链表」。

collocations: traverse a linked list from the head
traverse a linked list to read its values
traverse a linked list in reverse

words.enDefinition: The length of a longest path from the root downward

examples.en: We measured tree height by counting edges along the longest downward path.
examples.zh: 我们通过数最长向下路径上的边来测量「树高」。

examples.en: The tree height grew after we added a child to the deepest leaf.
examples.zh: 我们给最深的叶节点加了一个子节点后，「树高」增加了。

words.enDefinition: A local rearrangement that preserves a search tree's in-order key sequence

examples.en: The tree rotation changed the shape without changing the order of the keys.
examples.zh: 「树旋转」改变了形状，键的顺序保持不变。

examples.en: We drew the tree rotation before checking whether the branches were balanced.
examples.zh: 我们先画出「树旋转」的过程，再检查分支是否平衡。

collocations: a tree rotation around a node

words.enDefinition: A systematic way of visiting nodes in a tree

examples.en: The tree traversal recorded the letters in the order the nodes were visited.
examples.zh: 「树遍历」按访问节点的顺序记录了字母。

examples.en: We compared two versions of the tree traversal using the same small diagram.
examples.zh: 我们用同一张小图比较了「树遍历」的两种方式。

collocations: the order of a tree traversal

words.enDefinition: A chart that uses nested rectangles sized by value to show parts within a hierarchy.

examples.en: The treemap shows the space occupied by different categories of books on the sample shelves.
examples.zh: 「矩形树图」显示示例书架上不同类别的书占用多大空间。

examples.en: We used a treemap to compare how study materials are distributed across folders and their subfolders.
examples.zh: 我们用「矩形树图」比较学习资料在各文件夹及其子文件夹中的分布情况。

words.enDefinition: A line drawn on a chart to summarize the overall direction or pattern in the data.

examples.en: The trend line rises across the example scatter plot of sunshine hours and plant height.
examples.zh: 在光照时数与植物高度的示例散点图中，「趋势线」向上倾斜。

examples.en: We added a trend line to highlight the gradual increase in weekly visits to the library.
examples.zh: 我们加了一条「趋势线」，突出图书馆每周客流量逐渐上升的变化。

words.enDefinition: A tree storing sequences that share paths for common prefixes

examples.en: The trie used the same first branch for these two words.
examples.zh: 「字典树」给这两个单词共用了第一条分支。

examples.en: We inserted the three place names into the trie in class.
examples.zh: 我们在课上把三个地名插入了「字典树」。

collocations: insert a word into a trie

words.enDefinition: To reduce unused storage in a resizable collection while keeping the elements it currently contains.

examples.en: The tutor showed how to trim excess capacity after the Java list stopped receiving new values.
examples.zh: 老师演示了 Java 列表不再接收新值后怎样「缩减多余容量」。

examples.en: We checked that the recorded grades stayed unchanged when the example chose to trim excess capacity.
examples.zh: 示例选择「缩减多余容量」时，我们核对了已记下的成绩是否保持原值。

collocations: trim excess capacity in an array-backed list
decide when to trim excess capacity

words.enDefinition: to remove whitespace characters from both ends of text while keeping the interior unchanged

examples.en: We used a text operation to trim leading and trailing whitespace before matching music titles from two files.
examples.zh: 匹配两份文件里的曲名前，我们用文本操作「去除首尾空白」。

examples.en: The tutor asked us to trim leading and trailing whitespace so labels would match the allowed list.
examples.zh: 导师要求我们「去除首尾空白」，使标签与允许值的清单匹配。

collocations: trim leading and trailing whitespace before matching
trim leading and trailing whitespace from a title
remember to trim leading and trailing whitespace

words.enDefinition: division such as Python's slash operation that can produce a fractional quotient instead of rounding it to an integer

examples.en: In Python, true division of two integers can produce a fractional value in the example.
examples.zh: 在示例中，Python 的两个整数作「真除法」可以得到带小数的值。

examples.en: The worksheet used true division to calculate the average of three different reading scores.
examples.zh: 练习表用「真除法」计算三个不同阅读分数的平均值。

words.enDefinition: An observation that belongs to the negative class and is predicted as negative.

examples.en: The classifier's correct rejection of a maple leaf counted as a true negative in the example.
examples.zh: 分类器正确排除了一片枫叶，因此在例题中算作「真负例」。

examples.en: Our tutor asked which row and column showed a true negative in the two-class matrix.
examples.zh: 老师问，二分类矩阵的哪一行哪一列显示「真负例」。

collocations: identify a true negative in the confusion matrix

words.enDefinition: An observation that belongs to the positive class and is predicted as positive.

examples.en: The worksheet marked an oak leaf as a true positive when the classifier correctly found it.
examples.zh: 分类器正确识别出一片橡树叶时，练习表将它记作「真正例」。

examples.en: We checked the recorded label before counting the photographed leaf as a true positive.
examples.zh: 把照片中的叶片计为「真正例」之前，我们先核对了记录的标签。

collocations: identify a true positive in the confusion matrix

words.enDefinition: An axis displayed over a narrower range that omits part of the underlying scale.

examples.en: The truncated axis makes the modest change in library visits look much larger than it is.
examples.zh: 「截断轴」让图书馆到访量的小幅变化看起来大得多。

examples.en: The worksheet asks whether the truncated axis makes the difference between the two bars misleading.
examples.zh: 练习题问「截断轴」是否会让两根条形的差异产生误导。

words.enDefinition: division whose quotient is rounded toward zero

examples.en: The JavaScript BigInt example used truncating division, so negative five divided by two gave negative two.
examples.zh: JavaScript 的 BigInt 示例采用「向零截断除法」，所以负五除以二得到负二。

examples.en: Our tutor compared truncating division with floor division using the same negative numerator in both cases.
examples.zh: 导师用同一个负数作为分子，比较了「向零截断除法」和向下取整除法。

words.enDefinition: evaluating a value as true or false in a condition

examples.en: The Python worksheet used truth value testing to decide whether an empty string counted as false.
examples.zh: Python 练习表用「真值测试」判断空字符串是否被视为假。

examples.en: We compared truth value testing for two values before tracing the example's result in class.
examples.zh: 我们先比较两个值的「真值测试」结果，再在课堂上追踪示例结果。

words.enDefinition: treated as true when tested in a Boolean context

examples.en: The JavaScript worksheet showed that a nonempty text value was truthy in the sample test.
examples.zh: JavaScript 练习表展示，在样本测试中，非空文本值「在条件中被视为真」。

examples.en: We marked the empty array as truthy in JavaScript before comparing the same idea in Python.
examples.zh: 比较 Python 中的相应情况之前，我们先把 JavaScript 的空数组标记为「在条件中被视为真的」。

collocations: test whether a value is truthy

words.enDefinition: the region of code attempted under an exception-handling construct

examples.en: We put the conversion in the try block because a row might contain an incorrectly formatted date.
examples.zh: 有的行可能包含无法解析的日期，所以我们把转换放在「try 保护块」里。

examples.en: The try block covered only the file operation whose error the surrounding code intended to handle.
examples.zh: 「try 保护块」只覆盖外层代码准备处理其错误的那项文件操作。

collocations: put an operation inside a try block

words.enDefinition: returning one tuple that groups several components for the caller to use

examples.en: The tuple return supplied the first and last dates found in the set of sample readings.
examples.zh: 这个函数「以元组形式返回」样本读数中的最早和最晚日期。

examples.en: We replaced the tuple return with a named record because the order of its three values was confusing.
examples.zh: 由于三个值的顺序容易弄混，我们用具名记录替换了「以元组形式返回」。

collocations: replace a tuple return with a named record

words.enDefinition: An array whose elements are addressed with two indexes, often interpreted as row and column.

examples.en: The puzzle stored its board in a two-dimensional array with one position for each square.
examples.zh: 这个谜题把棋盘存成「二维数组」，每个格子对应一个位置。

examples.en: We used a two-dimensional array to record three temperatures for each day of the week.
examples.zh: 我们用「二维数组」记录一周中每天的三个温度值。

collocations: access a cell in a two-dimensional array
store a grid in a two-dimensional array

words.enDefinition: a common signed integer encoding with a negative top-bit weight

examples.en: The class wrote negative three in two's complement using the fixed width specified on the worksheet.
examples.zh: 同学们采用练习表规定的固定宽度，用「二进制补码」写出了负三。

examples.en: Our tutor used two's complement to explain why the highest bit contributed a negative amount.
examples.zh: 导师用「二进制补码」解释为什么最高位的贡献值为负。

collocations: represent an integer in two's complement

words.enDefinition: written information stating the intended type of a program element

examples.en: The Python worksheet showed a type annotation indicating that the score should be an integer.
examples.zh: Python 练习表使用「类型注解」说明分数应该是整数。

examples.en: Our tutor explained why the type annotation could guide a checker without enforcing the value at runtime.
examples.zh: 导师解释了为什么「类型注解」能为检查器提供依据，却不在运行时强制要求该类型。

words.enDefinition: automatic conversion of a value to another type according to context

examples.en: The JavaScript example showed type coercion when a number was joined to a text label.
examples.zh: JavaScript 示例展示了数字与文本标签拼接时发生的「隐式类型转换」。

examples.en: Our tutor asked us to predict type coercion before reading the JavaScript expression's actual result.
examples.zh: 导师请我们先预测「隐式类型转换」，再看 JavaScript 表达式的实际结果。

words.enDefinition: determining a type from available program information without an explicit annotation

examples.en: The teaching compiler used type inference to determine a variable's type from its initial value.
examples.zh: 教学编译器通过「类型推断」，根据初始值确定变量的类型。

examples.en: Our tutor showed how type inference also considered the types of operands in an expression.
examples.zh: 导师展示了「类型推断」怎样考虑表达式中操作数的类型。

words.enDefinition: a disagreement between the expected type and the type supplied

examples.en: The Python exercise showed a type mismatch when the program tried adding a number to text.
examples.zh: Python 练习展示了程序尝试把数字和文本相加时出现的「类型不匹配」。

examples.en: I corrected the type mismatch by passing a number where the test expected one.
examples.zh: 我按测试要求传入数字，修正了「类型不匹配」。

words.enDefinition: A message sent using UDP that includes a UDP header and the application's payload.

examples.en: A single UDP datagram carries each temperature reading in the simulated classroom sensor example.
examples.zh: 在教室传感器的模拟示例中，每次温度读数都由一个「UDP 数据报」承载。

examples.en: The worksheet marks the boundary of each UDP datagram with a separate coloured box.
examples.zh: 练习纸用单独的彩色方框标明每个「UDP 数据报」的边界。

words.enDefinition: a name without an established value or object in that context

examples.en: The Python example produced an error because the expression tried to read an unbound name.
examples.zh: Python 示例报错，是因为表达式试图读取一个「未绑定名称」。

examples.en: I traced the unbound name back to a missing assignment in our practice example.
examples.zh: 我追查这个「未绑定名称」，发现练习示例缺少一条赋值语句。

collocations: an error for an unbound name

words.enDefinition: A queue with no fixed item limit in its interface, subject to available resources.

examples.en: The toy program used an unbounded queue with no fixed limit on waiting print jobs.
examples.zh: 示例程序采用「无界队列」，没有给等待打印的作业数量设固定上限。

examples.en: Our tutor explained that an unbounded queue still needed memory for every item stored.
examples.zh: 老师解释，「无界队列」仍需要占用内存来存放每一项。

collocations: use an unbounded queue for a demonstration
contrast an unbounded queue with a bounded queue

words.enDefinition: Input or output performed without the buffering layer being discussed, such as a library buffer.

examples.en: The second exercise used unbuffered I/O at the library level for each small write.
examples.zh: 第二项练习在程序库这一层对每次小块数据写入使用「无缓冲 I/O」。

examples.en: Our tutor clarified which buffer unbuffered I/O avoided in the example drawn on the board.
examples.zh: 老师说明了黑板例题中的「无缓冲 I/O」省去了哪个缓冲区。

collocations: compare unbuffered I/O with buffered I/O
perform unbuffered I/O in a test

words.enDefinition: A source line not executed by the measured software tests

examples.en: The uncovered line printed a warning that our example never triggered.
examples.zh: 「未覆盖的代码行」会输出一条示例始终未触发的警告。

examples.en: We read the uncovered line before deciding which input could reach it.
examples.zh: 我们先读了这条「未覆盖的代码行」，再判断哪种输入能执行到它。

words.enDefinition: JavaScript's special value commonly produced when a value has not been supplied

examples.en: The sample returned an undefined value when the requested JavaScript object property was missing.
examples.zh: 示例中所查的 JavaScript 对象属性缺失时，返回了一个「JavaScript 的未定义值」。

examples.en: We saw an undefined value after declaring a JavaScript variable with let and supplying no initializer.
examples.zh: 用 let 声明 JavaScript 变量但未提供初始值后，我们看到了一个「JavaScript 的未定义值」。

collocations: a property with an undefined value

words.enDefinition: Failure to learn important patterns, often leading to poor results even on the training data.

examples.en: The straight-line model showed underfitting because the training relationship curved sharply across the observed sorting times.
examples.zh: 训练数据中的分拣用时关系明显弯曲，因此直线模型表现出「欠拟合」。

examples.en: Our report discussed underfitting after the simplified model performed poorly on both training and validation examples.
examples.zh: 过于简单的模型在训练和验证样本上表现都很差，我们在报告里讨论了「欠拟合」。

words.enDefinition: A graph whose edges connect endpoints without a specified direction

examples.en: The undirected graph represented walking routes that could be used either way.
examples.zh: 「无向图」表示可以双向通行的步行路线。

examples.en: We drew the undirected graph with one unmarked line for each connection.
examples.zh: 我们绘制「无向图」时，每个连接用一条不带箭头的线表示。

collocations: an edge in an undirected graph

words.enDefinition: A stack of changes or saved states used to undo the most recent change first.

examples.en: The editor added each change to the undo stack when we moved a shape on screen.
examples.zh: 我们在屏幕上移动图形时，编辑器把每次改动放进「撤销栈」。

examples.en: Our example read the undo stack to identify the last colour change made by the user.
examples.zh: 例题读取「撤销栈」，确定用户最近一次颜色改动。

collocations: push a change onto the undo stack
read the top of the undo stack

words.enDefinition: A passing result from a test previously marked as expected to fail

examples.en: The unexpected pass made us check whether the old problem was still present.
examples.zh: 「意外通过」让我们去检查原有问题是否仍然存在。

examples.en: The tutor explained why the unexpected pass appeared after the formatter changed.
examples.zh: 导师解释了为什么格式化器改动之后出现「意外通过」。

collocations: an unexpected pass in the test output

words.enDefinition: A source element encountered where the language grammar does not allow it

examples.en: The JavaScript console reported an unexpected token beside a closing bracket.
examples.zh: JavaScript 控制台在一个右方括号旁报告了「意外的词法单元」。

examples.en: We located the unexpected token before checking the previous line for clues.
examples.zh: 我们先定位「意外的词法单元」，再去上一行找线索。

words.enDefinition: An exception for which the running program has no active handler

examples.en: An unhandled exception stopped the exercise before it could print the answer.
examples.zh: 一个「未处理的异常」让练习程序在打印答案之前停了下来。

examples.en: The debugger paused after the unhandled exception while we inspected the details.
examples.zh: 出现「未处理的异常」后，调试器暂停，让我们查看详细信息。

collocations: a log containing an unhandled exception

words.enDefinition: a standard assigning code points to characters and defining related text rules

examples.en: The tutor introduced Unicode using examples from two writing systems shown on the worksheet.
examples.zh: 导师用练习表上两种文字系统的例子介绍「统一码」。

examples.en: We checked the Unicode chart to identify the symbol in the sample sentence.
examples.zh: 我们查阅「统一码」表来识别样本句子中的符号。

words.enDefinition: converting Unicode text to a standard form according to rules for canonical or compatibility equivalence

examples.en: The class used Unicode normalization to compare two code point sequences for the same word.
examples.zh: 同学们用「Unicode 规范化」比较同一个单词的两个码点序列。

examples.en: We inspected the code points before and after Unicode normalization in the classroom example.
examples.zh: 我们查看了课堂示例执行「Unicode 规范化」前后的码点。

words.enDefinition: a Unicode code point outside the surrogate range

examples.en: The tutor explained why a high surrogate alone was not a Unicode scalar value.
examples.zh: 导师解释了为什么单个高代理码点不属于「Unicode 标量值」。

examples.en: The example represented one Unicode scalar value with a pair of UTF-16 code units.
examples.zh: 示例用一对 UTF-16 码元表示一个「Unicode 标量值」。

words.zhGloss: 保留重复项的并集操作
words.enDefinition: a SQL operation combining rows from two compatible query results without eliminating duplicates
acceptedZhAnswers: 保留重复项的并集操作

examples.en: We used UNION ALL because the combined report needed to retain every ticket sale from both counters.
examples.zh: 我们使用「保留重复项的并集操作」，因为合并报告需要保留两个售票处的每笔销售记录。

examples.en: The tutor compared UNION ALL with UNION after identifying identical rows in the two sample result sets.
examples.zh: 导师找出两个示例结果集里的相同行后，对比了「保留重复项的并集操作」和 UNION。

collocations: apply UNION ALL to compatible result sets

words.enDefinition: a SQL operator combining rows from both inputs and removing duplicate rows unless ALL is specified

examples.en: The UNION operator combined both reading lists and returned each shared title only once in the result.
examples.zh: 「UNION 并集运算符」合并了两份阅读清单，同时出现的书只返回一次。

examples.en: We checked column compatibility before using the UNION operator to merge results from two classroom queries.
examples.zh: 我们检查列的兼容性后，用「UNION 并集运算符」合并两条课堂查询的结果。

collocations: combine results with the UNION operator
remove duplicates with the UNION operator

words.enDefinition: a rule requiring that values or combinations of values are not duplicated where the database treats them as equal

examples.en: We added a unique constraint on the catalogue code so that the same identifier could not appear twice.
examples.zh: 我们给目录编号加了「唯一约束」，使同一标识符不能出现两次。

examples.en: The class tested how the unique constraint behaved when a missing locker number appeared in several sample rows.
examples.zh: 同学们测试了多个样本行的储物柜编号为空时，「唯一约束」会如何处理。

words.enDefinition: an index that enforces uniqueness of its indexed values under the system's null rules

examples.en: The unique index rejected a duplicate catalogue number when the practice import tried to add a second entry.
examples.zh: 练习导入尝试添加第二个同编号条目时，「唯一索引」拒绝了重复目录编号。

examples.en: We inspected whether a unique index already supported the rule requiring one product per assigned catalogue code.
examples.zh: 我们查看是否已有「唯一索引」用于保证一个指定目录编号只对应一种产品。

collocations: enforce uniqueness with a unique index
add a unique index on a column

words.enDefinition: testing whether selected values or combinations occur at most once in the expected scope

examples.en: The uniqueness check caught a repeated room identifier in the sheet prepared for the class exercise.
examples.zh: 「唯一性检查」在为课堂练习准备的表中找到了一个重复的房间标识符。

examples.en: We repeated the uniqueness check on the pair of columns that identified an individual booking.
examples.zh: 我们对共同标识单条预订的两列再次做了「唯一性检查」。

collocations: apply a uniqueness check to two columns

words.enDefinition: expressing a measured quantity in another unit while preserving the underlying quantity

examples.en: We applied unit conversion before adding distance readings entered in both centimetres and metres.
examples.zh: 累计以厘米和米录入的距离前，我们先做了「计量单位换算」。

examples.en: A missing unit conversion explained why one station appeared much colder than the others in the report.
examples.zh: 报表里有一个监测站看起来比其他站冷得多，原因是漏做了「计量单位换算」。

words.enDefinition: Examples for which the target values or categories have not been supplied.

examples.en: The exercise used unlabeled data containing leaf measurements gathered before anyone identified the plant species.
examples.zh: 练习所用的「无标签数据」包含识别植物物种之前收集的叶片测量值。

examples.en: We explored the unlabeled data to see which workshop records tended to fall into similar groups.
examples.zh: 我们分析了「无标签数据」，看哪些工作坊记录往往落入相近的组。

words.enDefinition: To remove a node from a linked structure by updating its neighbours or the list's endpoints.

examples.en: The class drew two new arrows to unlink a node from the middle of the list.
examples.zh: 为了让中间的「节点脱离链表」，全班画了两条新箭头。

examples.en: Our tutor asked what must change if we unlink a node that currently comes first.
examples.zh: 老师问，如果要「使节点脱离链表」，而它当前是第一个节点，必须改哪些内容。

collocations: unlink a node from a list
update neighbouring links to unlink a node
unlink a node before moving it

words.enDefinition: a key value in one source for which no corresponding key was found in another source

examples.en: The unmatched identifier pointed to a room listed under an earlier code in the paper inventory.
examples.zh: 「未匹配到的标识符」指向纸质清单中用旧代码列出的一间房。

examples.en: We checked each unmatched identifier before calculating how many workshop locations had approved descriptions.
examples.zh: 计算多少工作坊地点拥有获批描述前，我们检查了每个「未匹配到的标识符」。

words.enDefinition: A vertex with no path from the selected starting point

examples.en: The isolated room was an unreachable vertex when we started outside.
examples.zh: 我们从外面出发时，那个孤立房间是一个「不可达顶点」。

examples.en: The distance table left the entry for an unreachable vertex unfilled.
examples.zh: 距离表里「不可达顶点」对应的一项留空了。

words.enDefinition: an integer interpreted in a format with no negative values

examples.en: The exercise used an unsigned integer for a counter that could never become negative.
examples.zh: 练习给一个不会变为负数的计数器使用了「无符号整数」。

examples.en: Our tutor read the same eight bits as an unsigned integer in the second example.
examples.zh: 在第二个示例里，导师把同样的八个位解读为「无符号整数」。

words.enDefinition: to move one level of a row index onto the columns of a reshaped table

examples.en: We chose to unstack an index level so the summary had separate columns for the different survey outcomes.
examples.zh: 我们「将索引层级转为列」，让各类调查结果在汇总表中分别占列。

examples.en: The exercise asked us to unstack an index level while leaving the year as the row label.
examples.zh: 练习要求我们「将索引层级转为列」，并保留年份作为行标签。

collocations: unstack an index level by name
unstack an index level in a summary
unstack an index level into columns

words.enDefinition: Working tree edits that have not been selected for the next commit

examples.en: The unstaged changes were still present after I recorded the selected correction.
examples.zh: 我记录了选定的更正后，「未暂存的改动」仍然存在。

examples.en: Our tutor compared unstaged changes with the files prepared for the next commit.
examples.zh: 导师把「未暂存的改动」和已为下次提交准备好的文件作了对照。

collocations: inspect unstaged changes in a file

words.enDefinition: Finding patterns or structure in data that has no supplied prediction targets.

examples.en: The team used unsupervised learning to discover groups of books without providing any genre labels.
examples.zh: 团队采用「无监督学习」寻找相近的图书，没有提供任何体裁标签。

examples.en: Our tutor introduced unsupervised learning through an exercise with uncategorised leaf measurements from the garden.
examples.zh: 老师用花园里未经分类的叶片测量数据练习介绍了「无监督学习」。

words.enDefinition: A file in a working tree that Git is not tracking

examples.en: The new worksheet appeared as an untracked file after I saved it.
examples.zh: 我保存新练习表后，它显示为「未跟踪文件」。

examples.en: I checked why the untracked file was absent from the recorded project history.
examples.zh: 我检查了为什么这个「未跟踪文件」没有出现在项目历史记录里。

words.enDefinition: Space in an array-backed collection allocated for elements that are not currently stored.

examples.en: Adding two scores took up unused array capacity without requiring any additional storage allocation.
examples.zh: 增加两个分数占用了「数组剩余容量」，因此无需额外分配存储空间。

examples.en: Our tutor shaded the unused array capacity differently from positions that already contained real values.
examples.zh: 老师对「数组剩余容量」与已存有实际值的位置用了不同的底色。

collocations: add entries using unused array capacity

words.enDefinition: A graph where edges have no individual numeric costs

examples.en: The unweighted graph counted each connection as one step in the puzzle.
examples.zh: 解谜时，「无权图」把每个连接都计为一步。

examples.en: We used an unweighted graph when the time between rooms did not matter.
examples.zh: 房间之间的通行耗时不影响结果时，我们用「无权图」表示。

collocations: an example of an unweighted graph
shortest paths in an unweighted graph

words.enDefinition: To change the value associated with an existing key in a mapping.

examples.en: Our code needed to update a mapping after the tutor corrected the score for one team.
examples.zh: 老师更正某一队的分数后，代码需要「更新映射中的值」。

examples.en: We asked the program to update a mapping while keeping the original key exactly as written.
examples.zh: 我们让程序在保留原键的同时「更新映射中的值」。

collocations: update a mapping for an existing key
update a mapping without changing its keys
decide when to update a mapping

words.enDefinition: an inconsistency that can arise when a single fact is stored in multiple places and updated in only some

examples.en: An update anomaly left two different street addresses for the same building after only one record was changed.
examples.zh: 只改动一条记录后，「更新异常」导致同一栋楼留下两个不同的街道地址。

examples.en: The exercise showed how splitting off the building table prevented an update anomaly when its address changed.
examples.zh: 练习展示了拆出楼宇表如何在地址变化时防止「更新异常」。

words.enDefinition: a SQL statement changing selected column values in existing rows of a table

examples.en: The UPDATE statement changed the display title of a single workshop in the practice database for our lesson.
examples.zh: 本课练习数据库中的「UPDATE 更新语句」修改了一场工作坊的展示标题。

examples.en: We reviewed the condition in the UPDATE statement to make sure it applied to the intended practice rows.
examples.zh: 我们检查了「UPDATE 更新语句」的条件，确保它只作用于预定要改的练习数据行。

collocations: add a filter to an UPDATE statement

words.zhGloss: 首个大于目标值的查找
words.enDefinition: Finding the first position in sorted data whose value exceeds the target
acceptedZhAnswers: 首个大于目标值的查找

examples.en: The upper-bound search passed all three copies of the target value.
examples.zh: 「首个大于目标值的查找」越过了三个与目标值相等的项。

examples.en: Our worksheet showed an upper-bound search ending just past the last duplicate.
examples.zh: 练习表里，「首个大于目标值的查找」在最后一个重复值之后结束。

collocations: an upper-bound search in sorted data

words.enDefinition: a database operation that inserts a new row or updates an existing row when an applicable key conflict occurs

examples.en: The upsert operation added new catalogue codes and updated titles for codes already present in the practice table.
examples.zh: 「插入或更新操作」添加新的目录编号，并为练习表中已有编号更新标题。

examples.en: We tested the upsert operation twice to see how it handled a booking with an existing identifier.
examples.zh: 我们测试了两次「插入或更新操作」，观察它如何处理标识符已经存在的预订。

collocations: detect a conflict during an upsert operation

words.enDefinition: The branch configured as the comparison or update source for another branch

examples.en: I checked which upstream branch was configured before fetching the example updates.
examples.zh: 获取示例更新之前，我查看了配置的「上游跟踪分支」是哪一个。

examples.en: The upstream branch had two new commits in our classroom diagram.
examples.zh: 课堂示意图里的「上游跟踪分支」有两条新提交。

words.enDefinition: a URL component introduced by a hash sign, often referring to a part or state within the identified resource

examples.en: The URL fragment takes readers directly to the opening hours section of the example catalogue page.
examples.zh: 「URL 片段」把读者直接带到示例目录页的开放时间小节。

examples.en: The class used a URL fragment to link to the glossary near the end of the handout.
examples.zh: 全班用一个「URL 片段」链接到网页讲义接近末尾的术语表。

words.enDefinition: The portion of a URL that identifies a location or resource within the relevant scheme or host.

examples.en: We changed the URL path in the catalogue exercise to point to the help page.
examples.zh: 在目录练习中，我们修改「URL 路径」让它指向帮助页。

examples.en: The tutor highlighted the URL path before discussing the separate query part that follows it.
examples.zh: 老师先标出「URL 路径」，再讲后面独立的查询部分。

words.enDefinition: An Internet transport protocol that carries individual datagrams without guaranteeing delivery or ordering.

examples.en: The User Datagram Protocol carries each practice message as a separate datagram in this simulation.
examples.zh: 这次模拟中，「用户数据报协议」把每条练习消息作为独立的数据报传输。

examples.en: The User Datagram Protocol does not guarantee that the simulated messages arrive in order.
examples.zh: 「用户数据报协议」不保证模拟消息按顺序到达。

words.enDefinition: A processor mode in which ordinary application code runs with restricted access to system resources.

examples.en: The diagram showed the editor running in user mode before it requested a file operation.
examples.zh: 图中显示，编辑器请求文件操作之前在「用户态」运行。

examples.en: Our Windows example returned to user mode after the operating system finished handling the read.
examples.zh: Windows 示例在操作系统处理完读取后回到「用户态」。

words.enDefinition: a Unicode encoding using one or two sixteen-bit units per scalar value

examples.en: The tutor used UTF-16 to explain why one symbol required two units in the example.
examples.zh: 导师用「UTF-16 编码」解释为什么示例里的一个符号需要两个码元。

examples.en: Our worksheet showed why UTF-16 uses one code unit for some symbols and two for others.
examples.zh: 练习表演示了为什么「UTF-16 编码」对一些符号用一个码元，对另一些符号用两个。

words.enDefinition: a Unicode encoding using one to four bytes per scalar value

examples.en: The classroom file used UTF-8 to store both an English greeting and an accented name.
examples.zh: 课堂文件用「UTF-8 编码」存储一句英语问候语和一个带重音符号的姓名。

examples.en: We compared the number of bytes in two sample words after encoding them as UTF-8.
examples.zh: 我们将两个样本单词转为「UTF-8 编码」后，比较了它们的字节数。

words.enDefinition: a result indicating that input did not meet one or more recorded requirements

examples.en: The validation failure showed that a recorded reading was outside the classroom instrument's permitted range.
examples.zh: 「校验失败」表明，有一个读数超出了课堂仪器允许的范围。

examples.en: We reviewed the validation failure before deciding whether to correct the value or ask the source team.
examples.zh: 我们先查看「校验失败」，再决定是更正该值，还是询问数据来源小组。

collocations: report the cause of a validation failure

words.enDefinition: The subset held out for evaluation in one round of a cross-validation procedure.

examples.en: The model was scored on a different validation fold during each round of our exercise.
examples.zh: 练习的每一轮都在不同的「验证折」上对模型打分。

examples.en: We wrote down which plants belonged to the current validation fold before fitting the next model.
examples.zh: 拟合下一个模型前，我们写下了当前「验证折」包含哪些植物。

collocations: score a model on a validation fold

words.enDefinition: Loss evaluated on data reserved for comparing models or training choices.

examples.en: The validation loss started rising even though the model kept improving on the original training examples.
examples.zh: 尽管模型在原训练样本上的表现持续改善，「验证损失」却开始上升。

examples.en: We recorded validation loss after every full pass through the training data in our experiment.
examples.zh: 实验中，每完整遍历一次训练数据，我们就记录一次「验证损失」。

collocations: choose an epoch based on validation loss

words.enDefinition: A performance measure calculated on examples reserved for development evaluation.

examples.en: The validation score improved after we reduced the number of leaves allowed in the decision tree.
examples.zh: 限制决策树的叶节点数量后，「验证得分」提高了。

examples.en: We checked the validation score before deciding which version to keep for the final exercise.
examples.zh: 决定保留哪个版本做最后练习之前，我们先查看了「验证得分」。

collocations: select a model by validation score

words.enDefinition: A set of examples used to compare models or choose settings during development.

examples.en: We used the validation set to choose how deep the book classification tree should grow.
examples.zh: 我们用「验证集」决定图书分类树应当长到多深。

examples.en: The tutor asked us to compare both models on the same validation set before choosing one.
examples.zh: 老师要求我们选模型前先在同一个「验证集」上比较这两个模型。

collocations: evaluate models on a validation set

words.enDefinition: a column that holds recorded or computed values rather than the identifiers describing where they came from

examples.en: The value column contained the recorded temperature while a separate field identified the instrument that produced it.
examples.zh: 「值列」存放温度读数，另一个字段标明产生该读数的仪器。

examples.en: We chose the value column before reshaping the grouped summary so the correct totals appeared across months.
examples.zh: 我们在重塑分组汇总前选定「值列」，使各月显示正确合计。

collocations: reshape a table using the value column

words.enDefinition: equality based on the values being compared

examples.en: Our worksheet checked value equality by comparing two separate Python lists with the same contents.
examples.zh: 练习表比较了两个内容相同、但各自独立的 Python 列表，以检查是否「值相等」。

examples.en: The example used value equality to compare two scores calculated from different sequences of steps.
examples.zh: 示例使用「值相等」来比较用不同步骤算出来的两个分数。

collocations: compare two objects for value equality

words.enDefinition: an object considered equivalent to another when their defining values match

examples.en: The drawing exercise modelled a point as a value object defined by its two coordinates.
examples.zh: 绘图练习用两个坐标定义点，将它建模为「值对象」。

examples.en: Our tutor compared two instances of the same value object using their stored measurements.
examples.zh: 导师根据保存的测量值，比较同一个「值对象」类型的两个实例。

words.enDefinition: An object exposing the current values in a mapping without copying them into a new collection.

examples.en: The values view included the same score twice because two different teams had earned it.
examples.zh: 由于两支队伍取得同样的分数，「值视图」中该分数出现了两次。

examples.en: Our exercise used the values view to total the recorded scores without examining any names.
examples.zh: 练习用「值视图」计算已记录的分数总和，无需查看姓名。

collocations: read values through a values view

words.enDefinition: a construct that introduces a variable in a language requiring or supporting declarations

examples.en: The JavaScript example used a variable declaration to introduce a counter for the first time.
examples.zh: JavaScript 示例用「变量声明」首次引入了一个计数器。

examples.en: I read the variable declaration at the top to see which name the exercise introduced.
examples.zh: 我查看顶部的「变量声明」，确认练习引入了哪个名称。

collocations: a variable declaration with an initializer

words.enDefinition: giving a variable its first value

examples.en: The tutor demonstrated variable initialization by setting a game's score counter to zero.
examples.zh: 导师把游戏分数计数器设为零，用来演示「变量初始化」。

examples.en: Our first JavaScript exercise placed variable initialization beside the declaration so both were easy to read.
examples.zh: 我们的第一道 JavaScript 练习把「变量初始化」和声明放在一起，方便阅读。

words.enDefinition: a list of supplied arguments whose length is permitted to vary from one call to another

examples.en: The routine used a variable-length argument list because it could total any number of individual readings.
examples.zh: 例程使用「可变长度实参列表」，因为它可以对任意数量的单条读数求和。

examples.en: Our tutor demonstrated a variable-length argument list by calling the same function with two and four inputs.
examples.zh: 导师分别使用两个和四个输入调用同一函数，以演示「可变长度实参列表」。

words.enDefinition: the name used to refer to a variable in code

examples.en: Our tutor suggested a clearer variable name for the number of completed reading tasks.
examples.zh: 导师为已完成阅读任务的数量建议了一个更清楚的「变量名」。

examples.en: I corrected the variable name on the second line after noticing that one letter differed.
examples.zh: 我发现有一个字母不同，就修正了第二行的「变量名」。

words.enDefinition: applying an operation to an entire vector or array through a bulk interface rather than an explicit element loop

examples.en: A vectorised operation converted the full column from centimetres to metres in a single expression.
examples.zh: 「向量化操作」用一个表达式将整列从厘米换算为米。

examples.en: We replaced a loop with a vectorised operation that added a fixed offset to every recorded depth.
examples.zh: 我们用「向量化操作」替换循环，给每个已记录的深度值加上同一偏移量。

collocations: apply a vectorised operation to a column
replace a loop with a vectorised operation
