words.enDefinition: The ordering used to compare versions under a chosen versioning scheme

examples.en: We used version precedence to decide how the two version labels should sort.
examples.zh: 我们用「版本先后顺序」判断两个版本标签应该怎么排序。

examples.en: Our notes explained version precedence for the preview and the final release.
examples.zh: 笔记说明了预览版与最终发行版的「版本先后顺序」。

words.enDefinition: A named reference marking a specific version in repository history

examples.en: We used a version tag to identify the exact code discussed in class.
examples.zh: 我们用「版本标签」标识课堂上讨论的那份具体代码。

examples.en: I checked which revision corresponded to the version tag in our notes.
examples.zh: 我查了笔记中的「版本标签」对应哪个修订版本。

collocations: a commit marked by a version tag

words.enDefinition: An individual point in a graph that edges can connect

examples.en: The diagram used a vertex for each stop on the map.
examples.zh: 图中用一个「顶点」表示地图上的每一站。

examples.en: We labelled each vertex before adding the connections between the rooms.
examples.zh: 我们先给各「顶点」贴上标签，再添加房间之间的连接。

words.enDefinition: The axis that runs up and down on a standard two-dimensional plot.

examples.en: The vertical axis gives the total number of books loaned each month in the example.
examples.zh: 示例中的「纵轴」显示每月借出的图书总量。

examples.en: We extended the vertical axis so that the highest point was visible on the chart.
examples.zh: 我们延长了「纵轴」的显示范围，让图上可以看到最高点。

words.enDefinition: A chart that shows a numerical distribution as a mirrored density shape.

examples.en: The violin plot is widest where the estimated density of plant heights is highest in our example.
examples.zh: 示例「小提琴图」在植物高度估计密度最高的位置最宽。

examples.en: We used a violin plot for each group so readers could compare the shapes of their distributions.
examples.zh: 我们给每组各画一个「小提琴图」，让读者能够比较分布形状。

words.enDefinition: An address used by a program before translation by the memory system.

examples.en: The same virtual address appeared in both processes, but it referred to different storage locations.
examples.zh: 两个进程中出现了同一个「虚拟地址」，但它们指向不同的存储位置。

examples.en: We marked the virtual address in the diagram before showing where the memory access went.
examples.zh: 我们先在图上标出「虚拟地址」，再说明内存访问最终指向何处。

words.enDefinition: The range of virtual addresses available in a particular execution context, such as a process.

examples.en: The diagram showed the program code and the heap inside its virtual address space.
examples.zh: 图中显示，程序代码和堆都位于它的「虚拟地址空间」内。

examples.en: Our tutor explained how a virtual address space could be much larger than installed memory.
examples.zh: 老师解释了为什么「虚拟地址空间」可以比已安装的内存大得多。

collocations: reserve a region of virtual address space
map a region into virtual address space

words.enDefinition: A memory system that presents virtual addresses to programs and manages their underlying storage.

examples.en: The tutorial introduced virtual memory before explaining why the same address could appear in two processes.
examples.zh: 教程先介绍「虚拟内存」，再解释为什么两个进程可能出现同一个地址。

examples.en: Our simulator used virtual memory to demonstrate how an operating system handles pages on demand.
examples.zh: 模拟器用「虚拟内存」演示操作系统如何按需处理内存页。

collocations: enable virtual memory in a simulator

words.enDefinition: The collection marking vertices already discovered or processed during a search

examples.en: We checked the visited set before returning through the same doorway.
examples.zh: 我们穿过同一扇门返回前，先查了「已访问集合」。

examples.en: The visited set prevented the example from exploring the same vertices repeatedly.
examples.zh: 「已访问集合」让示例不会反复探索同样的顶点。

collocations: add a vertex to the visited set

words.enDefinition: a design placing operations that act on an object structure in separate objects

examples.en: The visitor pattern let us add a counting operation to the example's existing shape structure.
examples.zh: 「访问者模式」让我们可以给示例已有的图形结构增加一个计数操作。

examples.en: Our tutor used the visitor pattern to calculate totals for several kinds of classroom shapes.
examples.zh: 导师用「访问者模式」计算几种课堂图形的汇总值。

collocations: operations organised through the visitor pattern

words.enDefinition: The mapping of values or categories to graphical features such as position, size, or colour.

examples.en: The tutor changed the visual encoding so that shape showed the category instead of colour.
examples.zh: 老师更改了「视觉编码」，改用形状表示类别。

examples.en: We checked that the visual encoding used longer bars for larger values throughout the figure.
examples.zh: 我们确认整张图的「视觉编码」都用较长的条形表示较大的数值。

words.enDefinition: Pause further work until incoming data is available to read

examples.en: The program seemed quiet because it had to wait for input from us.
examples.zh: 程序看上去没有动静，因为它得「等待我们输入」。

examples.en: After printing the question, the example would wait for input before calculating anything.
examples.zh: 示例打印问题后，会先「等待输入」，再开始计算。

collocations: wait for input from a user
wait for input at a prompt

words.enDefinition: To suspend a thread while releasing its associated lock until the wait ends and that lock is reacquired.

examples.en: The program could wait on a condition variable while the practice queue had no jobs available.
examples.zh: 练习队列没有可用作业时，程序可以「在条件变量上等待」。

examples.en: In the exercise, the worker chose to wait on a condition variable for new sample data.
examples.zh: 例题中，工作线程选择「在条件变量上等待」新的样本数据。

collocations: wait on a condition variable after checking the predicate
wait on a condition variable with a mutex
wait on a condition variable when the queue is empty

words.enDefinition: A debugger expression whose current value is displayed during pauses

examples.en: I added a watch expression for the running total before resuming execution.
examples.zh: 继续运行前，我给累计合计值加了一个「监视表达式」。

examples.en: The watch expression changed after the program read the second number.
examples.zh: 程序读取第二个数字后，「监视表达式」的值发生了变化。

collocations: a watch expression in the debugger

words.enDefinition: A graph with numeric values assigned to edges or connections

examples.en: We used a weighted graph to show different walking times between rooms.
examples.zh: 我们用「带权图」表示房间之间各不相同的步行时间。

examples.en: The weighted graph in our worksheet assigned costs to the available routes.
examples.zh: 练习表里的「带权图」为可用路线赋了成本。

collocations: model travel in a weighted graph
an edge in a weighted graph

words.enDefinition: the SQL clause retaining input rows for which a condition evaluates to true

examples.en: The WHERE clause selected only bookings for the first week of classes in the sample calendar.
examples.zh: 「WHERE 筛选子句」只选取示例日历上开学第一周的预订记录。

examples.en: We removed the WHERE clause temporarily in the classroom database to see which records the unfiltered query returned.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂数据库里暂时移除「WHERE 筛选子句」，查看未经筛选的查询会返回哪些记录。

collocations: filter rows with a WHERE clause
combine conditions in a WHERE clause

words.enDefinition: a loop that checks its condition before each iteration and runs its body when the condition holds

examples.en: Our while loop asked for another reading until enough valid observations were available for the calculation.
examples.zh: 在拿到足够的有效观测值供计算之前，我们的「while 循环」会要求继续输入读数。

examples.en: The tutor asked whether the while loop would run if the queue was empty at the start.
examples.zh: 导师问，如果队列一开始就是空的，「while 循环」的循环体会不会执行。

words.enDefinition: A line extending from a box on a box plot to a defined limit beyond the quartile.

examples.en: The upper whisker ends at the highest value within the rule used on our worksheet.
examples.zh: 在练习规定的范围内，「箱线图的上须」止于最高值。

examples.en: The caption explains what each whisker represents for the plant height measurements in the exercise.
examples.zh: 图注解释了练习的植株高度测量图中，每条「箱线图的须」代表什么。

words.enDefinition: a layout in which several repeated measurements or category values appear in separate columns of the same row

examples.en: The report used wide format to show the four quarterly totals side by side for each campus.
examples.zh: 报告采用「宽表格式」，为各校区并排展示四个季度的合计。

examples.en: We converted the readings to wide format so each instrument had its own column in the table.
examples.zh: 我们将读数转换为「宽表格式」，使表里的每台仪器都有各自的一列。

words.enDefinition: a pattern that accepts an arbitrary value without binding it to a name

examples.en: A wildcard pattern caught all remaining values in the final case of our Python function.
examples.zh: 「通配模式」在 Python 函数的最后一个分支中匹配所有剩余值。

examples.en: We used a wildcard pattern to ignore the middle coordinate while keeping the other two.
examples.zh: 我们用「通配模式」忽略中间的坐标分量，同时保留另外两个。

words.enDefinition: the subset of rows in a window partition made available relative to the current row for frame-sensitive calculations

examples.en: The window frame included the current week and the two preceding weeks for each average we calculated.
examples.zh: 我们计算各次平均值时，「窗口帧」包含本周及前两周的数据。

examples.en: The tutor shortened the window frame to show why the early rows had fewer values to average.
examples.zh: 导师缩短「窗口帧」，说明为什么前几行能用于计算平均值的数据较少。

collocations: calculate a total over a window frame

words.enDefinition: a SQL function computing a value for each row using related rows in its window

examples.en: A window function added each booking's position in the schedule without collapsing the rows into one total.
examples.zh: 「窗口函数」为各条预订添加了它在日程中的位置，并保留了每条原始记录。

examples.en: We used a window function to display the current sales amount next to the previous month's amount.
examples.zh: 我们用「窗口函数」把本月销售额显示在上月金额旁边。

collocations: define a window for a window function
compute a running total with a window function

words.enDefinition: the order in which rows within each partition are considered for a window calculation

examples.en: We set the window ordering by date before calculating the change from each workshop's previous attendance record.
examples.zh: 计算工作坊每次出勤人数相对上次的变化前，我们按日期设置「窗口内排序」。

examples.en: The tutor distinguished window ordering from sorting the rows finally displayed in the example report.
examples.zh: 导师区分了「窗口内排序」和对示例报告最终显示的行排序。

collocations: check for ties in the window ordering

words.enDefinition: a group of query rows processed separately by a window function according to its partition expressions

examples.en: The window partition contained the monthly records for a single store in the sample reporting query.
examples.zh: 在示例报表查询中，「窗口分区」包含同一家门店的各月记录。

examples.en: We changed the window partition so the ranking would restart whenever the product category changed.
examples.zh: 我们修改了「窗口分区」，使每换一个产品类别就重新排名。

collocations: rank rows within a window partition
compute an average for each window partition

words.enDefinition: a Python statement that executes a block under one or more context managers

examples.en: The with statement managed the active file while the program read the data for its chart.
examples.zh: 程序读取图表数据时，由「with 上下文语句」管理所打开的文件。

examples.en: We used a with statement to keep the temporary settings active only during the report's formatting.
examples.zh: 我们用「with 上下文语句」，让临时设置只在排版报告期间有效。

collocations: open a file in a with statement
execute the body of a with statement

words.enDefinition: A thread assigned work on behalf of another part of a program.

examples.en: A worker thread prepared the miniature images while the practice editor continued accepting new input.
examples.zh: 「工作线程」在准备缩略图，练习编辑器可以继续接收新的输入。

examples.en: We checked which worker thread had processed the last batch of sample photographs that afternoon.
examples.zh: 我们查了当天下午是哪条「工作线程」处理完最后一批示例照片。

collocations: assign a task to a worker thread

words.enDefinition: A relationship in which a workflow task requires an input or result from another task.

examples.en: The workflow dependency means the chart waits until the regional totals are ready to use.
examples.zh: 这项「工作流依赖关系」意味着只有各区总量准备好，才能生成图表。

examples.en: We drew an arrow for each workflow dependency between the script and the final table.
examples.zh: 我们在脚本和最终表格之间，用箭头标出了每项「工作流依赖关系」。

words.enDefinition: A group of automated steps performed together within a workflow

examples.en: One workflow job checked the spreadsheet export after the build completed.
examples.zh: 构建完成后，一个「工作流作业」检查了电子表格导出。

examples.en: We renamed the workflow job to describe the classroom calculation it ran.
examples.zh: 我们给「工作流作业」改了名，好让人明白它运行的是哪项课堂计算。

words.enDefinition: One execution of an automated workflow with its configured jobs

examples.en: The workflow run showed separate results for building and checking the example.
examples.zh: 这「一轮工作流执行」分别显示了构建和检查示例的结果。

examples.en: I opened the workflow run associated with the revision from our demonstration.
examples.zh: 我打开了与演示所用修订版本对应的「一轮工作流执行」。

words.enDefinition: One action or command executed as part of a workflow job

examples.en: The final workflow step saved the test report for us to review.
examples.zh: 最后一个「工作流步骤」保存了测试报告供我们审阅。

examples.en: We checked which workflow step had installed the required tools in class.
examples.zh: 我们核对了课堂上是哪个「工作流步骤」安装了所需工具。

words.enDefinition: An event or condition that starts an automated workflow

examples.en: The workflow trigger started our class checks whenever we uploaded a revision.
examples.zh: 每当我们上传修订版本，「工作流触发条件」就启动课堂检查。

examples.en: We checked which workflow trigger applied when the exercise ran that morning.
examples.zh: 练习那天上午运行时，我们核对了当时满足的是哪个「工作流触发条件」。

collocations: a schedule as a workflow trigger

words.enDefinition: The pages a process has actively used during a recent interval or amount of execution.

examples.en: The image program's working set grew while it was applying the filter to more pictures.
examples.zh: 图像程序给更多图片应用滤镜时，程序的「工作集」变大了。

examples.en: Our tutor drew a short access history to show how the working set could change over time.
examples.zh: 老师画了一段访问记录，展示「工作集」如何随时间变化。

collocations: the size of the working set

words.enDefinition: The files currently present for editing in a versioned project

examples.en: The working tree still held the label I had just edited.
examples.zh: 「工作树」中仍有我刚编辑过的标签。

examples.en: We checked the working tree before comparing the edited files with history.
examples.zh: 我们先查看「工作树」，再把已编辑文件和历史版本作对照。

words.enDefinition: The largest running cost among inputs of a fixed size

examples.en: Our worst-case running time estimate assumed the algorithm checked every element in the list.
examples.zh: 我们估算「最坏情况运行时间」时，假设算法检查了列表中的每个元素。

examples.en: The class compared worst-case running time for two search methods at equal input sizes.
examples.zh: 全班比较了两种查找方法处理相同输入规模时的「最坏情况运行时间」。

words.enDefinition: An indexing scheme that returns to the start of a storage area after reaching its end.

examples.en: The circular storage exercise used wrap-around indexing to return to position zero after the final slot.
examples.zh: 循环存储练习用「环绕索引」在到达最后一格后返回位置零。

examples.en: Our tutor labelled wrap-around indexing on the diagram showing both sides of the storage boundary.
examples.zh: 老师在图中跨越存储边界的位置标出了「环绕索引」。

collocations: illustrate wrap-around indexing in a ring buffer

words.enDefinition: arithmetic that cycles through a fixed range when a boundary is crossed

examples.en: The worksheet used wraparound arithmetic to show a tiny unsigned counter returning to zero.
examples.zh: 练习表用「回绕运算」演示一个位宽很小的无符号计数器回到零。

examples.en: Our tutor compared wraparound arithmetic with a calculator that simply stopped at its maximum value.
examples.zh: 导师将「回绕运算」与到达最大值就停止计数的计算器作了比较。

words.enDefinition: an object that holds another object and exposes selected operations around it

examples.en: The example placed a wrapper object around a label so the display could add a prefix.
examples.zh: 示例用「包装对象」包住标签，让显示部分能够添加前缀。

examples.en: Our tutor compared the wrapper object's behaviour with the original object's output in the exercise.
examples.zh: 导师在练习中比较了「包装对象」的行为和原对象的输出。

collocations: a wrapper object around another object

words.enDefinition: Saving modified cached data to its backing storage after the change has been made in memory.

examples.en: The diagram showed write-back moving changed file data from the page cache to storage.
examples.zh: 图中展示了「回写」怎样把改过的文件数据从页缓存写入存储设备。

examples.en: Our tutor separated the time of write-back from the moment the application changed its cached data.
examples.zh: 老师区分了「回写」的时刻和应用修改缓存中数据的时刻。

words.enDefinition: In a buffer, the position where the next item is to be stored.

examples.en: The write index identified the location for the next reading in the sample buffer.
examples.zh: 「写入索引」标出了示例缓冲区中下一个读数要写入的位置。

examples.en: Our drawing showed the write index returning to the first slot after the last slot.
examples.zh: 图示显示，「写入索引」经过最后一格之后回到第一格。

words.enDefinition: The exclusive access mode of a read-write lock, which excludes other readers and writers.

examples.en: The editor took a write lock before changing the shared settings used by the preview workers.
examples.zh: 编辑器修改预览工作线程使用的共享设置前，先取得「写锁」。

examples.en: We watched the writer release its write lock after storing the new label in the example.
examples.zh: 例题中的写入者存好新标签后，我们看到它释放了「写锁」。

words.enDefinition: in Python's open function, the mode that creates the file if needed and truncates existing contents when opened

examples.en: The sample opened a fresh file in write mode for its results.
examples.zh: 示例以「写入模式」打开了一个新文件来存放结果。

examples.en: Our Python exercise used write mode when the old result needed replacing.
examples.zh: 我们在 Python 练习里用「写入模式」替换原有结果。

collocations: a file opened in write mode

words.enDefinition: A numbering convention in which the first element has index zero.

examples.en: Because Java uses zero-based indexing, the second reading was stored at index one in the example.
examples.zh: Java 采用「从零开始的索引」，所以例题中的第二个读数存放在索引一处。

examples.en: The diagram explained zero-based indexing by numbering the blank boxes from zero through four.
examples.zh: 图上给空格依次标了零到四，以说明「从零开始的索引」。

words.enDefinition: A reference line at zero from which a chart measures values such as bar lengths.

examples.en: The chart uses a zero baseline so the library counts can be compared by bar length.
examples.zh: 图表采用「零基线」，读者可以通过条形长度比较图书馆的计数。

examples.en: The tutor checked that every bar in our spending example starts at the zero baseline.
examples.zh: 老师确认支出示例里的每个条形都从「零基线」开始。
